papers.title: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
papers.abstract_en: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenCOPE 让类别级物体位姿估计 (COPE) 只用渲染合成数据训练即可直接部署到真实机器人抓取场景，靠 2D/3D 语义一致性约束与 2D-3D 交叉一致性学习压掉合成到真实的纹理域差。模型只用全局特征做端到端位姿回归，架构轻量，在 REAL275、Wild6D 及真实机器人操作场景上表现出更优的 Syn2Real 泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有 COPE 方法为新物体类别仍需大量重采真实训练数据，可扩展性受限；核心障碍是合成与真实数据在纹理外观上的域差距。
Method: 提出 2D 与 3D 语义一致性约束，降低特征编码器对域特异特征的敏感度；再用端到端位姿回归框架做 2D-3D 交叉一致性学习，通过稠密跨模态融合精化位姿；模型仅依赖全局特征，保持轻量高效。
Result: 在 REAL275 与 Wild6D 基准及真实机器人操作场景上，该范式展现出更优的 Syn2Real 泛化性能；代码与 demo 已发布。
Conclusion: 只用合成数据训练、以语义一致性和跨模态交叉一致性为核心的轻量全局特征范式，足以支撑真实机器人抓取部署的类别级位姿估计。

summary_sections.result: 在 REAL275 与 Wild6D 基准及真实机器人操作场景上，该范式展现出更优的 Syn2Real 泛化性能；代码与 demo 已发布。
summary_sections.conclusion: 只用合成数据训练、以语义一致性和跨模态交叉一致性为核心的轻量全局特征范式，足以支撑真实机器人抓取部署的类别级位姿估计。

papers.title: SoK: Decentralized Agent Economic Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized agent economies increasingly build a single task from protocols that were designed and secured separately. This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task. We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and economic requirements into 17 property families over six stages, with receipt soundness and completeness assessed separately. We examine 12 systems and standards, five reusable mechanism families, and four classical baselines. We introduce guarantee closure, a task-relative criterion for determining whether guarantees established at one stage remain available and constrain the later decisions that depend on them. We apply the criterion to controlled and native workflows, covering 840 matched executions and an exhaustive 11,648-case check over a finite objective-task domain. Our results expose recurring failures between verification and settlement, where conforming work can remain unaccepted or valid evidence can be ignored. Public records and model judgments further distinguish recorded approval from evidence of task conformance, while economic analysis identifies the report, penalty, and shared-error assumptions behind these guarantees. These findings show where end-to-end guarantees fail and what must be repaired to preserve them across the workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于去中心化智能体经济基础设施的 SoK：把智能体任务全生命周期的安全与经济需求系统化为六个阶段的 17 个属性族，分别评估收据的 soundness 与 completeness，并提出 guarantee closure 判据，用于判断某阶段建立的保证能否继续约束后续依赖它的决策。在 840 次匹配执行与对有限目标-任务域的 11,648 例穷举检查中，结果反复暴露验证与结算之间的断裂：合规工作可能始终不被接受，有效证据可能被忽略。
Motivation: 去中心化智能体经济把本就分别设计与加固的协议拼成一条任务流水线，导致每一步看起来都正确、整体却产出错误结果——例如托管在一次授权批准后放款，而该批准几乎不能证明交付物满足任务。
Method: 在任务全生命周期上系统化安全与经济需求，组织为六个阶段共 17 个属性族，收据 soundness 与 completeness 分开评估；考察 12 个系统与标准、5 类可复用机制族和 4 个经典基线；提出 guarantee closure 判据并应用于受控与原生工作流，辅以公开记录与模型判断区分「记录在案的批准」与「任务合规证据」，再用经济分析识别支撑这些保证的举报、惩罚与共享错误假设。
Result: 覆盖 840 次匹配执行，并对有限目标-任务域做 11,648 例穷举检查；结果显示验证与结算之间反复出现失败模式——合规工作可能保持不被接受，有效证据可能被忽略；公开记录与模型判断进一步把「记录的批准」与「任务合规的证据」区分开。
Conclusion: 端到端保证会在工作流阶段之间失效，必须修复阶段间保证的传递（即 guarantee closure）才能保住整条链路上的保证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 39 pages
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cog-VADU 把视频异常检测 (VAD) 改写成免训练的序列认知推理任务：用 Chain-of-Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP) 把 LVLM 展开成跨视频片段的递归推理链，再用跨模态重排序对齐文本 rationale 与视觉 embedding。在多个公开 VAD benchmark 上取得有竞争力的零样本性能，且 CoADTP 在跨模型评测中一致提升基于推理的异常检测。
Motivation: 现有 VAD 方法依赖数据集特定训练与人工标注，泛化到开集场景受限；近期基于 LVLM 的零样本方法虽缓解了这一依赖，但缺少时间连续性与结构化推理。
Method: CoADTP 将 LVLM 沿视频片段展开为递归推理链，跨时间传播结构化 rationale 以维持隐式时间记忆，用于区分复杂异常与高运动量的正常活动；其后接跨模态重排序阶段，将文本 rationale 与视觉 embedding 对齐，施加语义一致性与时间连贯性以精炼预测。
Result: 在多个公开 VAD benchmark 上达到有竞争力的零样本性能；跨模型评测显示 CoADTP 以模型无关的方式一致增强基于推理的异常检测。
Conclusion: 免训练的递归推理链加跨模态重排序足以让 LVLM 在 VAD 上给出可解释且可泛化的异常理解，无需数据集特定训练与标注。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Evidence-Gated Research (EGR)，把自适应模型搜索中的“挑战者被采纳”当作独立统计控制点：在决策证据揭示前冻结挑战者，跨预声明环境构建 anytime-valid 证据并合成持久 e-value，交给在线控制器，在条件有效性与可预测性条件下对全环境采纳目标控制 FDR。5,000 轨迹闭环基准中开发专用 e-LOND 持久 FDR 达 0.621，而受审计 EGR 变体在该有限运行中未观察到持久错误采纳路径。
Motivation: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖：挑战者一旦被采纳就成为后续候选的参照，统计上不成立的替换会污染尚未提出的假设，而现有流程缺少针对“采纳”这一动作的统计控制。
Method: EGR 在决策证据揭示前冻结每个挑战者，在预声明的环境集合上构建 anytime-valid 证据，将证据按可预测方式路由到未解决分量，合成持久候选 e-value 并传给在线控制器；在显式条件有效性与可预测性条件下保证 FDR 控制。评测含 5,000 轨迹闭环基准、600 对挑战者-在位者的 matched replay、三环境公开数据研究与 40,000 样本受控神经基准。
Result: 5,000 轨迹闭环基准中，development-only e-LOND 持久 FDR 为 0.621，受审计 EGR 变体在该有限运行中未观察到持久错误采纳路径。600 对 matched replay 中，Stagewise EGR 在代表性阈值下保持固定 anytime 替代穿越决策，同时少用 56.1% 决策证据。三环境公开数据研究与 40,000 样本受控神经基准复现了证据效率模式。
Conclusion: 模型替换应被视为自适应模型开发中一个独立的统计控制点：在采纳处加 e-value 门控，可在路径依赖的搜索中保住 FDR 并显著减少所需决策证据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.
papers.comment: 9 pages (main content), 21 pages total including references and appendix; 11 figures; under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FFBL-Coop 把协同 3D 多目标跟踪中的证据融合与身份继承拆开：先用置信度排序的槽位准入 (CSA) 与统一表示聚合 (URA) 融合跨 agent 观测，再用协同优先身份锚定 (CPIA) 单独建立跨帧身份分配。在 V2X-Seq 上取得 AMOTA/AP 0.611/0.548，Griffin-25M 上 0.688/0.653；共享码本压缩传输载荷后 AP 与 AMOTA 仍接近未压缩版本。
Motivation: 协同 3D 跟踪中证据整合与身份继承共用同一个匹配决策，跨视角外观差异与空间错配的误差会同时破坏特征融合与轨迹连续性。
Method: FFBL-Coop 采用 fuse-first-bind-later 框架：CSA 按置信度与空间邻近把协同 query 分配到 ego 槽位；URA 用协同语义特征与对齐的 anchor 引导 ego 特征检索，在共享 transformer decoder 中精化增强 query bank；随后 CPIA 结合学习到的关联与持久映射建立跨帧身份分配，并用共享码本降低传输载荷。
Result: V2X-Seq 上 AMOTA/AP 为 0.611/0.548，Griffin-25M 上为 0.688/0.653；共享码本压缩后 AP 与 AMOTA 接近未压缩变体。
Conclusion: 把实例准入与身份管理解耦，可以在协同 3D 多目标跟踪中同时保住融合质量与身份连续性，且压缩传输不显著损失精度；代码将开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Designing for Interpretation Uncertainty: Architecture and Principles for Topological Learning Analytics Dashboards
papers.abstract_en: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) offers novel methods for understanding temporal dynamics in complex systems, yet its application in information systems design faces a fundamental challenge: how should systems present analytical outputs when interpretation frameworks are still developing? This paper reports on the development of TopoLA, a dashboard system applying Zigzag Persistent Homology to learning management system data, and proposes three early design principles for interpretation support in emerging analytics: (1) separation of objective measurement from contextual interpretation, (2) graduated disclosure from metrics through patterns to reflective prompts, and (3) explicit acknowledgment of methodological uncertainty. The system implements a modular three-stage pipeline--feature extraction, topological computation, and interpretation support--enabling extension to additional analytical methods. This work contributes to information systems research by articulating preliminary design knowledge for systems that must communicate analytical insights from methods lacking established interpretation norms--a challenge increasingly common as novel computational techniques enter applied domains.
papers.comment: Author's version, posted under the preprint/reprint distribution rights retained in the IADIS copyright transfer agreement
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IADIS International Conference Information Systems 2026, pp. 506-510, IADIS, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoLA 把 Zigzag Persistent Homology 接到学习管理系统 (LMS) 数据上，用特征提取、拓扑计算、解释支持三段式模块化流水线输出，并给出三条解释支持设计原则：客观测量与情境解释分离、从指标到模式再到反思提示的分级披露、显式标注方法学不确定性。
Motivation: TDA 等新方法尚无成熟的解释规范，信息系统却必须把其分析结果呈现给用户，设计者缺少可依据的呈现原则。
Method: 系统采用三段式模块化流水线：特征提取、Zigzag Persistent Homology 拓扑计算、解释支持层；解释层按三条设计原则组织输出，即测量与解释分离、分级披露、显式承认方法学不确定性，流水线设计允许扩展其他分析方法。
Result: 报告 TopoLA 系统的开发过程并提出三条面向新兴分析方法的早期设计原则；摘要给出的是设计知识贡献，无定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 对缺乏既定解释规范的分析方法，把测量与解释分开、分级披露并显式标注不确定性，是可复用的初步设计知识。

papers.title: End-to-End Learning vs. Modular Architectures: Comparative Insights into Autonomous Driving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving systems have become a central focus of intelligent transportation research, with End-to-End Learning and Modular Architectures offering two prominent design paradigms for their implementation. E2E Learning uses deep learning algorithms to map raw sensory inputs directly to driving actuators, providing a streamlined and adaptable solution. while Modular Architectures employ a pipeline-based approach, dividing the system into distinct subsystems for perception, cognition, planning, and control. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of these paradigms, focusing on their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs to provide insights into their suitability for various autonomous driving applications. The study evaluates key factors such as interpretability, scalability, robustness, and real-world applicability. While End-to-End Learning emphasizes simplicity and adaptability in dynamic environments, it lacks transparency and is highly dependent on large datasets. Conversely, Modular Architectures offer superior interpretability and task-specific optimization, but face challenges related to integration complexity and scalability. To address these limitations, hybrid approaches that combine the strengths of both paradigms have emerged, offering a promising direction for overcoming these challenges. Beyond this comparative synthesis, following work proposes a Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework, comprising twelve binary criteria across safety, operating environment, data/computational resources, and deployment context, and validate it against ten published autonomous driving systems, correctly recommending 7/10 deployed architectures. This work synthesizes existing literature to highlight key trade-offs between the paradigms and identifies hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对比自动驾驶的端到端学习与模块化架构两种范式，并提出四维架构选择框架：用安全、运行环境、数据/算力资源、部署场景四个维度共十二条二元准则做选型，在十个已发表自动驾驶系统上验证，正确推荐 7/10 个已部署架构。综合结论是混合架构结合两者优势，是更有前景的方向。
Motivation: 自动驾驶设计范式选择缺少可操作的判据：E2E 简单自适应但不透明且依赖大数据，模块化可解释但集成复杂、扩展性差，工程上难以按场景快速定架构。
Method: 先对 E2E Learning 与 Modular Architectures 做文献综合比较，围绕可解释性、可扩展性、鲁棒性与真实世界适用性梳理优劣与权衡；再提出 Four-Dimensional Architecture Selection Framework，以安全、运行环境、数据/计算资源、部署场景四维共十二条二元准则打分选型，并在十个已发表系统上验证。
Result: 四维架构选择框架在十个已发表自动驾驶系统上正确推荐 7/10 个已部署架构；论文为 27 页、7 图、4 表的综述性比较。
Conclusion: 范式选择可被形式化为四维二元准则的可验证决策问题，而混合架构（结合 E2E 的自适应与模块化的可解释性）是未来研究的主方向。

papers.title: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DROID 提出一条标定感知 (calibration-aware) 流水线，把 feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建锚定到机器人的公制工作空间，并发布带逐场景可靠性标注的可渲染数据集。实验表明 pose conditioning 能提升新视角保真度，但其几何收益取决于注入外参 (extrinsics) 的可靠性。
Motivation: 机器人操作模型主要从 2D 观测推理 3D 物理世界；3DGS 以光度保真为设计目标，在相机外参不可靠时无法保持真实公制度量，几何监督因此不可信。
Method: 研究外参可靠性与 pose conditioning 对 feed-forward 3DGS 的影响，提出把重建场景锚定到机器人公制工作空间的标定感知流水线，并据此构建附带逐场景可靠性信息的可渲染、公制位姿锚定数据集。
Result: 实验显示 pose conditioning 改善新视角保真度，而其几何收益随注入外参的可靠性变化；产出为带场景级可靠性信息的可渲染数据集（HuggingFace: wonguen/3DROID）。
Conclusion: 给 3DGS 注入位姿前必须先核对外参可靠性，否则几何监督的收益无法兑现；数据集应随几何数据一并发布可靠性度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WMM 把动态 3D 场景统一表示为稀疏 SE(3) 位姿轨迹集合，用带 per-token 噪声水平的 flow-matching 把多实体联合分布建成序列建模问题，配合 context token 实现任意实体与时间步之间的 any-to-any 边缘条件化。未来预测、运动补全、MPC、逆运动学、跨具身重定向与策略学习都归结为同一网络上的不同 mask，在 6 项 3D 视觉与机器人任务上表现强劲。
Motivation: 动态场景要素分散在铰接物体、人体、手物交互、相机与机器人状态等不同表示里，缺少一个能同时承载 4D 动态与任意条件化任务的统一生成先验。
Method: 以稀疏 SE(3) 轨迹作为最小 4D 原语，把铰接物体、人体、手物交互、分段刚性场景、相机运动与机器人状态动作放进同一空间；用 flow-matching 加 per-token 噪声水平建模这些实体的联合分布，再用 context token 机制支持非序列条件输入，实现跨任意数量实体与时间步的 any-to-any 边缘条件化。
Result: 在 6 项 3D 视觉与机器人应用上展示 versatility 与 flexibility 并取得强劲性能，覆盖未来预测、运动补全、model-predictive control、逆运动学、跨具身 retargeting 与策略学习，这些任务通过在同一网络上施加不同 mask 完成。
Conclusion: 稀疏 SE(3) 轨迹加 mask 化的序列条件化足以把多种运动与控制任务统一成一个可复用的生成模型。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
papers.abstract_en: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATI-VLA 把预测式 Vision-Language-Action 模型的观测预测与动作预测先对齐到统一离散 codebook 的共享隐空间，再经轻量自适应旁路把预测隐变量作为先验注入动作解码，使学习始终围绕单一 action-centric 目标。仿真与真实机器人任务上达到 state-of-the-art 性能且收敛更快。
Motivation: 预测式 VLA 通过未来观测或世界动态预报来改善机器人操作，但现有方法因观测与动作之间的模态错位、以及联合优化冲突把学习带离动作中心目标，实际表现反而不如直接动作预测模型。
Method: 两步设计：Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook，用统一 codebook 把预测观测隐变量与动作表示映射到同一离散隐空间，缓解模态错位；随后 Action-Centric Adaptive Injection，通过轻量 adaptive side-path 将预测观测隐变量作为显式预测先验注入动作解码，在单一 action-centric 目标下实现自适应预测引导。
Result: 在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上的大量实验中，ATI-VLA 达到 state-of-the-art 性能并收敛更快；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 预测信息要先与动作表示对齐再注入解码，才能兑现预测式 VLA 的潜力并超过直接动作预测模型。

papers.title: Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler（D-GINS），一个基于不动点迭代的离散神经采样器，直接用密度评估训练生成模型而不需数据。它建立在 masked diffusion 之上并可扩展到分布间传输，在实践中大幅缓解模式崩塌，可扩展到高维系统、支持跨条件的摊销采样，并用于合金相图的准确估计。
Motivation: 无数据条件下从离散未归一化分布采样困难：现有离散神经采样器易模式崩塌，经不动点迭代训练时缺少收敛保证，且常绑定到特定参考过程（masked 或 uniform diffusion）。
Method: 提出 Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler，把神经采样器组织成不动点迭代，基于 masked diffusion 构建并扩展到成对分布之间的传输；训练直接使用密度评估，无需数据，并支持跨不同条件的摊销采样。
Result: 在实践中大幅减少模式崩塌，可有效扩展到高维系统，并实现合金相图的准确估计；框架支持摊销采样与分布间传输。
Conclusion: 以不动点迭代组织的离散神经采样器能在无数据设定下兼顾可扩展性与模式覆盖，并可作为合金相图等物理量估计的工具。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler，把神经采样器组织成不动点迭代，基于 masked diffusion 构建并扩展到成对分布之间的传输；训练直接使用密度评估，无需数据，并支持跨不同条件的摊销采样。
summary_sections.result: 在实践中大幅减少模式崩塌，可有效扩展到高维系统，并实现合金相图的准确估计；框架支持摊销采样与分布间传输。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以不动点迭代组织的离散神经采样器能在无数据设定下兼顾可扩展性与模式覆盖，并可作为合金相图等物理量估计的工具。

papers.title: Participation-Sensitive Convergence and the Fragment First, Converge Later Pattern in Asynchronous Online Learning: A Topological Analysis Across 22 OULAD Courses
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous online learning offers temporal flexibility at a structural cost: learning communities tend to fragment rather than cohere. $β_0$, the number of disconnected behavioral clusters from Zigzag Persistent Homology, serves as a cohort-level indicator of this structure. Two questions remained unverified at scale: (1) does apparent $β_0$ convergence reflect genuine behavioral alignment or learner dropout? and (2) do assessment deadlines produce reproducible fragmentation-convergence cycles? We address both across all 22 OULAD courses (N > 22,000; 857 week-pairs). Changes in $β_0$ strongly co-vary with active learner changes (pooled r = 0.387; median per-course r_delta = 0.459, 20/22 courses), identifying $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive indicator: $β_0$ and active learner counts co-respond to deadline events rather than one causing the other. Deadlines produced fragmentation in 82.6% of assessments and the full Fragment First, Converge Later (FFCL) cycle in 60.2%. 3-phase analysis confirmed structural fragmentation as the dominant long-term trajectory (90.9% of courses), moderated by curriculum structure. These findings establish $β_0$ as a participation-sensitive structural indicator with direct implications for AI-augmented learning analytics design.
papers.comment: Author's version, posted under the non-commercial rights retained in the APSCE copyright transfer agreement
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of ICLEA 2026: 2nd International Conference on Learning Evidence and Analytics, Asia-Pacific Society for Computers in Education, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Zigzag Persistent Homology 的 β0（断开行为簇数）刻画异步在线学习的群体结构，发现 β0 收敛并非真实行为对齐：它与活跃学习者数强共变（pooled r = 0.387，20/22 门课中位 r_delta = 0.459），且截止日期事件同时驱动两者。82.6% 的考核引发碎片化，60.2% 出现完整的 Fragment First, Converge Later (FFCL) 循环，90.9% 的课程长期以结构碎片化为主导轨迹。
Motivation: 异步在线学习中学习群体倾向碎片化而非凝聚，但两个问题在大规模数据上未被验证：β0 表观收敛究竟反映行为对齐还是学习者流失，以及考核截止日期能否产生可复现的碎片化-收敛周期。
Method: 在 OULAD 全部 22 门课程（N > 22,000，857 个 week-pairs）上计算 Zigzag Persistent Homology 的 β0，与活跃学习者变化做相关分析，再按截止日期事件做 3-phase 分析，区分结构性碎片化与流失驱动的收敛。
Result: β0 变化与活跃学习者变化强共变：pooled r = 0.387，逐课中位 r_delta = 0.459（20/22 门课）。截止日期在 82.6% 的考核中产生碎片化，60.2% 出现完整 FFCL 循环；3-phase 分析显示 90.9% 的课程以结构碎片化为主导长期轨迹，并受课程结构调节。
Conclusion: β0 是对参与度敏感的结构指标，β0 与活跃学习者数对截止日期事件共同响应而非互为因果，因此其收敛不能直接解读为行为对齐；该结论对 AI 增强的学习分析设计有直接含义。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出函数结构化图强化学习 (FSG-RL)，把子问题图与 Python 实现通过多验证器反馈绑定：先用 SFT 让策略从函数图生成代码，再用 GRPO 以答案门控奖励和 span 级信用分配优化。在 GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH 构建的函数图基准上，GRPO 把最终答案准确率从 43.25% 提到 67.50%，完整解题成功率从 32.25% 提到 52.25%。
Motivation: 最终答案奖励无法定位中间步骤错误，而代码执行成功也不等于数学正确，算法式数学推理缺少对分解、计算、聚合各环节的可靠监督信号。
Method: FSG-RL 用多验证器反馈连接子问题图与 Python 实现：先对函数图到代码做 SFT，再用 GRPO 以 answer-gated reward 和 span-level credit assignment 训练，并支持 teacher supervision 与 structured memory；基准以公开函数图配私有验证规格，覆盖 GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH。
Result: 统一评测协议下，GRPO 相对 SFT 将最终答案准确率从 43.25% 提升到 67.50%，完整解题成功率从 32.25% 提升到 52.25%；加入 teacher supervision 的持续 RL 带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 验证器引导的 RL 能同时提升答案正确率与完整解题成功率，且收益不止于生成格式正确的代码，可支撑数学推理的 verifier-guided RL。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections
papers.abstract_en: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 4 figures. Under review. Accompanying Lean 4 formalization available at https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Removing-spurious-minima-for-planar-features-by-skip-connections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在教师输出权重为正、特征张成平面的 teacher-student 设定下，给无偏置浅层 ReLU 网络加一个可学习线性 skip，可在学生宽度不小于教师宽度时消除所有非负输出权重的伪局部极小；不加 skip 时可构造仅 3 个隐神经元、输入维数 2 的固定教师，其伪极小在任何宽度≥3 时都持续存在。
Motivation: 神经网络损失面结构即使在简单模型中也只被部分理解，伪局部极小是否能靠过参数化消除缺少明确判定条件。
Method: 研究高斯总体损失 (Gaussian population loss) 下无偏置浅层 ReLU 网络的 teacher-student 模型，对正输出权重与平面特征的教师证明带可学习线性 skip 的良性结论，并构造无 skip 的反例；结论还转移到任意半径参数球上的经验极小，并附 Lean 4 形式化。
Result: 带 skip 时学生宽度≥教师即消除所有非负输出权重的伪局部极小；无 skip 时存在仅 3 隐神经元、输入维 2 的教师，其伪极小在所有宽度≥3 持续。正输出权重学生在极小处的特征落在教师特征张成的子空间内；二维 ReLU 网络中每个正输出权重临界点的不同特征方向数至多为教师神经元数的两倍。
Conclusion: 可学习线性 skip 能消除任意过参数化下仍持续的伪极小，而过参数化本身不能；二维下学生的有效宽度由教师宽度控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelICL 用表格基础模型沿 schema 图逐步传播并融合信息来做关系学习，避免深度特征合成 (DFS) 的特征爆炸与交互盲区。在 RelBench 任务上，RelICL 与最强 DFS 方法持平。
Motivation: DFS 把关系模式压平成单表时特征数随 schema 复杂度急剧膨胀，且逐列聚合忽略特征交互，限制了可扩展性与性能。
Method: RelICL 沿 schema 图逐跳传播并融合信息，复用最终做预测的同一个表格基础模型（training-free，无需训练），保留 DFS 的收益同时规避特征爆炸与交互盲区。
Result: 在 RelBench 任务的实验研究中，RelICL 表现与基于深度特征合成的最强方法持平 (on par)。
Conclusion: 沿图逐步传播信息可替代 DFS 的整体压平，在不训练的前提下达到同等关系学习性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的文本条件强化方法在去噪前对 cross-attention 做高斯平滑重分配，再增强 content token 贡献、削弱 padding 贡献，从而在不额外增加去噪器评估的前提下抑制扩散模型记忆化。在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 与 v2.0 上，所有被测平滑宽度都落在训练图像相似度对提示对齐与图像偏好的经验 Pareto 前沿上；在 SD 上选定的配置无需调参即可降低 DeepFloyd IF 的模板复现。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型会近乎原样复现个别训练样本，而缓解手段若削弱提示条件会牺牲提示信息，需要在相似度与提示对齐之间同时控制。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free)：先对 cross-attention 做高斯平滑的重分配，再强化 content token 的贡献并衰减 padding 贡献，不引入额外去噪器评估；辅以局部分析说明强化何时保留共享 value 信息、重分配如何降低局部注意力质量。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 与 v2.0 上，所有被测平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似度 vs 提示对齐、以及训练图像相似度 vs 图像偏好的经验 Pareto 前沿；在 Stable Diffusion 上选出的配置迁移到 DeepFloyd IF 后无需再调参即减少模板复现。
Conclusion: 提示一致的替代生成需要同时控制条件分配 (conditioning allocation) 与条件强度，而非只削弱记忆；更强的内容条件可在相当的训练图像相似度下提升提示对齐。

summary_sections.result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 与 v2.0 上，所有被测平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似度 vs 提示对齐、以及训练图像相似度 vs 图像偏好的经验 Pareto 前沿；在 Stable Diffusion 上选出的配置迁移到 DeepFloyd IF 后无需再调参即减少模板复现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提示一致的替代生成需要同时控制条件分配 (conditioning allocation) 与条件强度，而非只削弱记忆；更强的内容条件可在相当的训练图像相似度下提升提示对齐。

papers.title: Anomaly Detection and Localization for the Pantograph-Catenary System
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring the Pantograph-Catenary System (PCS) provides insight into the health conditions of the pantograph and the railway infrastructure. Recent industrial solutions trace the pantograph's contact wire height and stagger (PCS height/stagger) using video monitoring through convolutional neural networks. However, these solutions do not account for the train route's geographic location. Therefore, in this paper we propose a novel framework for 1) localization of the PCS height/stagger by alignment with the nominal GPS coordinates of the reference route, and 2) collective anomaly detection to evaluate the health conditions of the PCS. We apply and assess the localization and detection performance of the methodology to a case-study based on a real-world industrial dataset provided by a railway transportation company, which includes the PCS height/stagger of several train journeys across Italian railway routes.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at the Industry Track of the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems 2026 (IEEE ITSC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对受电弓-接触网 (PCS) 视频监测只输出高度与拉出值、不带线路地理位置的问题，提出把 PCS 高度/拉出值与参考线路名义 GPS 坐标对齐的定位框架，并在此基础上做集体异常检测以评估设备健康。在一家铁路公司提供的意大利线路真实工业数据集上评估了定位与检测性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 CNN 的视频监测方案只追踪受电弓接触线高度与拉出值，不考虑列车线路的地理位置，异常判断缺少空间上下文。
Method: 框架分两步：先将 PCS 高度/拉出值序列与参考线路的名义 GPS 坐标对齐完成定位，再在定位结果上做集体异常检测 (collective anomaly detection) 评估 PCS 健康状况。
Result: 在真实工业数据集上评估定位与检测性能，该数据集由铁路运输公司提供，包含多趟列车在意大利铁路线路上的 PCS 高度/拉出值记录。
Conclusion: 把 PCS 测量与线路 GPS 坐标对齐后再做异常检测，是评估受电弓-接触网健康状况的可行路径。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: vFedProtoQNAS 在虚拟联邦学习中完全不跨客户端聚合参数，改用类级原型 (class-wise prototype) 作为联邦语义锚点：每个客户端独立做个性化量子神经架构搜索 (QNAS) 并训练客户端专属 QNN，再用服务器下发的全局原型细化本地潜表示原型。实验中准确率比 FedAvg 提高 3.70%，类一致的表示对齐得到增强。
Motivation: 设备能力差异使单一共享 QNN 架构不适合所有客户端，而个性化 QNAS 产生结构不同的电路后，FedAvg 式参数平均会混合语义不一致的线路操作。
Method: 提出 vFedProtoQNAS：参数永不跨客户端聚合，各客户端独立搜索并训练客户端专属 QNN，从潜表示计算类级本地原型，再用服务器的全局原型作为联邦语义锚点进行细化，联邦协作仅通过类级原型共享实现。
Result: 实验中准确率较 FedAvg 提升 3.70%，并增强类一致的表示对齐 (class-consistent representation alignment)。
Conclusion: 在结构异构的 QNN 联邦场景下，用原型共享替代参数平均可以避免语义不一致的线路操作混合，同时保住联邦协作收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Architecture Without an Architect? Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence in a Divided World
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence presents an unusually difficult problem for global governance. The technology develops rapidly, crosses borders easily, and is shaped by actors whose resources and capabilities may rival those of states. Yet international responses remain fragmented, unevenly representative, and overwhelmingly non-binding. The challenge is therefore not simply to identify appropriate rules or institutions, but to understand who has the capacity and incentive to create, enforce, and adapt them. This review essay examines these questions through Matthijs Maas's Architectures of Global AI Governance. Maas offers an ambitious framework for thinking about AI governance through the lenses of sociotechnical change, governance disruption, and regime complexity. His account usefully resists both technological determinism and the search for a single institutional blueprint, emphasizing instead the possibilities of a fragmented and evolving governance architecture. The essay argues, however, that institutional design cannot be separated from the distribution of power. Maas frequently invokes what "we" should do about AI, but that collective subject obscures important differences among states, international institutions, and technology companies. States retain formidable powers over markets, infrastructure, strategic inputs, and firms themselves. At the same time, many consequential decisions about frontier AI - what is built, how quickly, with what safeguards, and when it is released - are concentrated within a small number of private companies. The central problem of global AI governance may therefore be less architecture without an architect than an emerging architecture shaped by multiple actors possessing different forms of power, divergent incentives, and no common set of plans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于全球 AI 治理的书评，评论对象是 Matthijs Maas 的《Architectures of Global AI Governance》。核心论断是：制度设计无法与权力分配分开——国际回应碎片化、代表性不均且以非约束性为主，而前沿 AI 的关键决策集中在少数私营公司手中，因此问题不是“没有建筑师的建筑”，而是多个权力与激励不一致的行为体共同塑造的治理架构。
Motivation: AI 发展快、跨境容易，且塑造者资源可与国家匹敌，但国际回应碎片化、代表性不均且以非约束性规则为主；需要解释谁有能力和激励去制定、执行并调整规则，而非仅仅寻找合适的制度蓝图。
Method: 以书评形式评析 Maas 的三层框架——社会技术变迁 (sociotechnical change)、治理扰动 (governance disruption)、机制复杂性 (regime complexity)——并论证制度设计必须与国家、国际机构和科技公司之间的权力分布绑定分析。
Result: 定性论断：Maas 的框架有助于抵制技术决定论和寻找单一制度蓝图，但其反复诉诸的集体主语“我们”掩盖了国家、国际机构与科技公司之间的差异；国家仍掌握对市场、基础设施、战略投入和企业的强大权力，而前沿 AI 关于构建速度、安全措施与发布时机的决策集中在少数私营公司。
Conclusion: 全球 AI 治理的核心问题应从“缺少建筑师的架构”重新表述为：多个行为体拥有不同形式的权力、分歧的激励、且无共同计划，正在共同塑造一个新兴的治理架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 single-index 任务上比较两类一层 attention 的 in-context learning：kernel learner 先用固定非线性特征映射再做线性 attention，feature learner 先对原始输入 做 attention 再接可学习非线性读出。用 replica method 推导两者的 memorization 与 generalization 误差，得到随预训练数据量、任务多样性和上下文长度变化的相图，并指出两者上下文长度标度定性不同。
Motivation: 现有 ICL 理论多局限于线性目标函数，而实际任务多为非线性；需要在同一批 single-index 任务上判定两种架构各自在何种数据与上下文条件下占优。
Method: 在同一族 single-index 任务上对比两个一层 attention 架构：kernel learner（固定非线性特征映射 + 线性 attention）与 feature learner（attention 作用于原始输入 + 可学习非线性读出）；用 replica method 推导 memorization 和 generalization 误差的预测，保留预训练规模、任务池多样性、训练与推理上下文长度的影响，并与数值实验对照。
Result: replica 推导的误差预测在很宽的参数范围内与数值实验吻合；给出随预训练数据量、任务多样性、上下文长度变化的相图，刻画两种架构各自占优的区域；识别出两者上下文长度标度存在定性差异。
Conclusion: 非线性 ICL 中架构选择与数据条件（预训练量、任务多样性、上下文长度）共同决定性能，kernel 与 feature learner 各有适用区间且上下文标度不同。

papers.title: CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoEvolve 把视觉定位拆成显式状态构建与状态编辑两步：RER 让每个推理步提交一个候选区域，BDR 把推理文本当固定语义上下文、对坐标字段做同位双向重建去噪。9B 骨干的定位精度可比肩最高 241B 参数的模型；在受控损坏下单次 BDR 使平均框重叠提升超过 27 个百分点。
Motivation: 多数多模态定位模型把目标识别、空间推理和边界估计压成一次终局预测，自由形式 rationale 又不暴露可度量、可编辑的空间状态，中间定位错误难以诊断纠正，错误区域与不精确边界会一直带到最终框。
Method: construct-to-edit 框架：Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) 把定位分析组织成语义到空间的渐进轨迹，每步推理提交一个显式候选区域；Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) 以推理文本为固定语义上下文，对轨迹坐标字段做同位双向重建；再用几何层与行为层目标分别提供目标几何信号与编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注纠正。
Result: 在自然图像与遥感定位评测上，9B 骨干的 CoEvolve 在定位精度上可比肩最高 241B 参数的模型；受控损坏 (controlled corruption) 条件下，单次 BDR 使平均框重叠 (mean box overlap) 提升超过 27 个百分点；状态来源对比支持显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑的互补性。
Conclusion: 把定位错误当作可编辑的显式空间状态而非终局输出，配合来源匹配的编辑信号，能在远小于对手参数量下实现强恢复与高精度定位。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 在自然图像与遥感定位评测上，9B 骨干的 CoEvolve 在定位精度上可比肩最高 241B 参数的模型；受控损坏 (controlled corruption) 条件下，单次 BDR 使平均框重叠 (mean box overlap) 提升超过 27 个百分点；状态来源对比支持显式状态构建与来源匹配编辑的互补性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把定位错误当作可编辑的显式空间状态而非终局输出，配合来源匹配的编辑信号，能在远小于对手参数量下实现强恢复与高精度定位。

papers.title: MEGA: Object-Level Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting via Spatial Visual Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{MEGA} (\underline{M}esh \underline{E}xtraction from \underline{GA}ussians), a ``segment-then-mesh'' framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes. At the core of MEGA are \textbf{Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)} and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEGA 提出先分割后建网格 (segment-then-mesh) 的框架，从 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景中提取物体级、水密 (watertight) 的网格：以 3DGS 作为 teacher，采样多样相机位姿渲染每个分割物体的视图，用光度监督训练网格重建模型，再由 mask 引导的神经表面重建模块补全几何。在多个常用基准上达到物体级 3D 占据恢复的 SOTA，并把物体网格的几何占据与 3DGS 的真实感渲染结合以支持复杂物理交互。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 网格提取方法集中在场景级，无法表达物体级占据，且常产生非水密表面，难以支持需要独立物体几何的交互。
Method: 核心为 Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)：把 3DGS 模型当 teacher，采样多样相机位姿并渲染每个分割物体的对应视图，用这些观测以光度监督 (photometric supervision) 训练一个网格重建模型；再接 mask 引导的神经表面重建模块，形成 segment-then-mesh 流程。
Result: 在多个广泛使用的基准上，MEGA 在恢复准确的物体级 3D 占据上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；并验证了把高质量物体级网格（几何占据）与 3DGS 表示（真实感渲染）组合后可实现复杂物理交互。
Conclusion: 物体级水密网格可以从 3DGS 中通过视觉蒸馏加分割引导的表面重建得到，几何占据与辐射表示分工组合即可同时支持精确占据与真实感渲染。

papers.title: Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators
papers.abstract_en: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Green's Observation Operator (GObO)：把固定的环境介质一次性映射为线性 PDE 在源子流形与观测子流形上的 Green 核，新源只需一次低维积分、无需网络评估。在三维热传导与平流扩散上，静态源训练后对移动源零样本预测，误差比黑盒代理低 4–8 倍，单次条件化后每次查询 1.4 ms。
Motivation: 许多物理系统只在低维子流形上被驱动和观测，但全域求解器每次换源都要重算整个体积，黑盒代理又无法利用环境介质固定这一结构。
Method: GObO 将线性 PDE 的 Green 核限制到源与观测子流形上并预计算一次；核的指数衰减率给出精确有限流式状态与与视野无关的记忆，作者证明其稳定性及受限热核的逼近速率。核可跨分辨率迁移，并通过修正项处理辐射损失、温度依赖电导率等弱非线性而无需重训练。
Result: 在三维热传导与平流扩散、源与观测几何共位与分离两种设置下，静态源训练的 GObO 对移动源零样本预测误差比黑盒代理低 4–8 倍，单次条件化后每次查询 1.4 ms；弱非线性修正无需重训练，代价是分布内精度下降。
Conclusion: 把固定环境介质预编译成受限 Green 核，可让换源预测退化为一次低维积分，在零样本移动源上大幅优于黑盒代理，代价是处理非线性时牺牲部分分布内精度。

papers.title: Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, plus 2 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/rtb-1005/SAFE-EDA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 腕部 EDA 情感识别中，归一化统计若取自留出被试本人的完整记录，会把设备首次佩戴时不可得的信息泄漏给模型，从而掩盖预训练的真实收益。用紧凑卷积网络 SAFE-EDA 在 WESAD 上做留一被试交叉验证：统计仅来自训练被试时，专家伪迹标注预训练把 macro-F1 提升 0.078 至 0.227；改用留出者自身统计后增益降到 0.020–0.050 且不再显著。作者的主张是：必须报告归一化数据来源，才能区分首次佩戴性能与校准后性能。
Motivation: 留一被试评估很少说明归一化统计的来源；用留出者自身记录算统计会引入设备首次佩戴时不存在的信息，使预训练收益的测量失真，而 50 篇 WESAD 已发表研究中只有 5 篇报告了这一点。
Method: 提出紧凑卷积网络 SAFE-EDA，在 43 名被试的专家伪迹标注上预训练，再与同结构从零训练对比；在 WESAD（15 名被试，leave-one-subject-out）上交叉两种归一化统计来源（仅训练被试 vs 留出者完整记录）与四种 window hop，并与同记录上的自监督预训练对照，另在第二个数据集（26 名被试）上重复共 13 种配置。
Result: 统计仅来自训练被试时，预训练使 macro-F1 提升 0.078 达到 0.227；统计来自留出者完整记录时增益降至 0.020–0.050 且不再显著。伪迹监督预训练远好于同记录自监督预训练（0.078 对 0.008）。两个数据集 13 种配置中预训练网络 12 种更优，但第二个数据集（26 人）上 per-user 归一化反而放大增益，交互方向依赖数据。50 篇已发表 WESAD 研究中仅 5 篇写明归一化数据来源。
Conclusion: 归一化统计来源会决定测得的预训练收益，报告这一选择是把首次佩戴性能与校准后性能分开的必要条件；该交互在不同数据集上方向不同，不能一概而论。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model's own outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 architectural sampling：在冻结的视觉-语言模型上通过复用解码器部分层块、改变块位置与重复次数，让同一模型走出多条不同计算路径来生成候选，从而在等预算下扩大候选覆盖。在五个 Qwen 检查点、十二个多模态基准上，九候选预算时 pass@9 比同预算的标准路径温度采样平均高 6.58 个百分点，复用早期层增益最大，且贪心解码下覆盖优势仍在。
Motivation: 测试时扩展通常靠对冻结模型多次采样，但温度采样让所有候选走同一条固定计算路径，候选多样性受限。
Method: 免训练、不改权重、不加辅助参数：复用解码器层的选定块并调整块位置与重复次数，产生计算路径不同的候选；候选还被用作无标签测试时强化学习的 rollout。
Result: 在五个 Qwen 检查点与十二个多模态基准上，同一九候选预算下 pass@9 比标准路径温度采样平均提升 6.58 个百分点；复用早期层带来最强增益，贪心解码下覆盖提升仍保持；候选间词汇重叠更低，作为无标签测试时 RL 的 rollout 可提升准确率。
Conclusion: 计算多样性（而非只调采样温度）是冻结 VLM 测试时扩展的有效来源，且能延伸到从模型自身输出中学习。

papers.title: MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.

Motivation: 构造式 NCO 中动态 embedding 方法每步都要用深层 attention 栈从头重建子问题表征，且多依赖解标签/伪标签或 RL 中激进的搜索空间剪枝才能高效训练。
Method: 提出 Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop)：纯 RL 的构造式框架，利用 rollout 的多步计算做选择性记忆传播——attention 层前将当前 embedding 与历史记忆融合，层后施加自适应门控更新，更新后的表征同时服务当前决策与逐步复用；训练只用 rollout 的解质量反馈，不用外部解标签，也不做训练期搜索空间剪枝。

Conclusion: 浅层策略配合 rollout 内的记忆传播即可学到有效动态 embedding，构造式 NCO 可以摆脱解标签、伪标签与训练期剪枝这三条常见依赖。

papers.title: Beyond Leaderboard Scores: A Deployment-Focused Protocol for Interpretable Tracking Evaluation in Pedestrian-Centric Environments
papers.abstract_en: Mobile robots operating among pedestrians need trajectories that become available quickly, remain spatially credible through missed observations, preserve identity, and fit within an embedded computing budget. Aggregate tracking scores provide limited insight into when and how trajectories fail, while varying detector inputs can confound tracker and detector quality. We present a deployment-focused, tracker-only evaluation protocol that uses shared detections to isolate tracker behavior and directly evaluates initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor association, and load-dependent tracker-step runtime, while Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) is retained as a complementary aggregate measure. We apply the protocol to the JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) using six open-source trackers and our lightweight Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack), together with a GT-assisted variant that estimates the remaining tracker-side gap under idealized association and motion. Under fixed detections, the non-GT trackers span only 24.26%-29.67% HOTA yet exhibit markedly different capability profiles. After 1.0 s without detector support, no tracker without GT assistance maintains spatially correct, same-identity output in more than half of eligible cases, making missing-observation continuation the dominant limitation among the tested properties. Close-neighbor failures are smaller and increase mainly at the shortest separations. Tracker-step runtime on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin is heavy-tailed and load-sensitive, causing several trackers to fall below the 10 Hz real-time target in crowded frames. The protocol provides a reproducible way to characterize tracker behavior and deployment suitability in pedestrian-centric environments. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures; supplementary video provided as ancillary material. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向部署的纯跟踪器评测协议，在共享检测输入下直接度量初始化、检测空缺续接、身份恢复、近邻关联与 Jetson Orin 上的跟踪步耗时，HOTA 仅作补充。在 JRDB 上用六个开源跟踪器与自研 PedRefTrack 检验：固定检测时非 GT 跟踪器 HOTA 仅 24.26%–29.67% 却能力画像迥异；1.0 s 无检测支持后无 GT 辅助跟踪器在过半合格案例中都无法保持同身份空间正确输出，缺观测续接是主导短板。
Motivation: 聚合跟踪分数（如 HOTA）无法说明轨迹何时、以何种方式失效，而检测器输入变化会混淆跟踪器与检测器各自的贡献，使行人场景下的部署适用性难以判定。
Method: 提出 tracker-only 评测协议：固定共享检测以隔离跟踪器行为，直接评测初始化、检测空缺续接、身份恢复、近邻关联与负载相关的 tracker-step 运行时，HOTA 作为补充聚合指标；在 JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) 上评测六个开源跟踪器与自研轻量 Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack)，并加入 GT-assisted 变体以估计理想化关联与运动下的跟踪器侧剩余差距。
Result: 固定检测下非 GT 跟踪器 HOTA 仅 24.26%–29.67%，但能力画像差异明显；1.0 s 无检测支持后，无 GT 辅助的跟踪器在过半合格案例中都无法保持空间正确、同身份的输出；近邻失败更小且主要出现在最短间距；在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上 tracker-step 运行时呈重尾且随负载敏感，多个跟踪器在拥挤帧跌破 10 Hz 实时目标。
Conclusion: 聚合分数不足以刻画行人场景跟踪器的部署适用性，缺观测续接是所测性质中的主导限制；共享检测下的分项协议加开源代码可复现地刻画跟踪器行为。

papers.title: When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.
papers.comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 统一模型在去噪过程中并非全程依赖源图条件：对某些编辑，源图注意力沿采样轨迹自然衰减。据此提出 task switching，在有界时间窗内切到 T2I 任务，跨三个统一编辑器与四个 benchmark 上提升编辑质量，同时平均感知保持度与纯编辑基本持平；切换时机决定质量与保持的平衡。
Motivation: 统一模型同时训练了指令编辑与 T2I 两种能力，但标准编辑流程在去噪全程保持源图条件，未回答编辑能否反过来利用 T2I 能力、以及条件效应如何随编辑类型与去噪阶段变化。
Method: 先测量纯编辑中源图注意力沿采样轨迹的变化，观察到部分编辑的注意力衰减；据此设计 task switching，在去噪的有界区间内把任务切到 T2I，让模型调用其生成能力，再在三个统一编辑器上比较切换时机对质量与保持的影响。
Result: 在三个统一编辑器与四个 benchmark 上，于有界区间切换到 T2I 任务提升编辑质量；三个模型的平均感知保持度 (mean perceptual preservation) 在切换后仍与纯编辑接近。
Conclusion: 统一编辑器应同时使用其训练得到的两种条件模式，切换时机是质量与感知保持之间的调节旋钮。

papers.title: From trends to optimized forecasts: Quantifying the skill and advancing the utility of dynamics-based early warnings for tipping events
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we explore and extend the state of the art for understanding the skill and utility of early warnings of critical transitions (tipping points) in forced nonlinear systems. We highlight some of the challenges and opportunities of transforming estimates of a dynamics-based early warning system, based on trends in stability or resilience into forecasts with high skill. We highlight the importance of (a) quantifying consequences of possible actions in response to warnings that may be false negatives or positives (b) considering finite time horizon predictions to give verifiable predictions (c) assumptions necessary for valid extrapolations of trends. We evaluate approaches to improving the skill and utility of the forecast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把基于动力学的临界点预警（trends in stability/resilience）转成可检验的高技巧预报，关键在于量化误报与漏报的行动后果、给出有限时间窗内可验证的预测、并明确外推趋势所依赖的假设；作者据此评估提升预警预报技巧与效用的途径。
Motivation: 把稳定性趋势估计当作预警直接使用时，既可能产生假阳性/假阴性，也缺少可验证的有限时域预测与合法外推条件，导致技巧与效用都不可靠。
Method: 围绕受迫非线性系统的临界点预警，从三方面扩展 state of the art：量化对误报/漏报预警的响应行动后果、构造有限时间窗的可验证预测、界定趋势外推成立所需的假设，并据此评估改进预报技巧与效用的方法。
Result: 论文给出对提升临界点预警预报技巧与效用之方法的评估框架，重点落在行动后果量化、有限时域可验证预测与外推假设三要素上。
Conclusion: 动力学预警要成为高技巧且有用的预报，必须把行动后果、可验证的有限时域预测和外推假设一并纳入，而不只是报告稳定性趋势。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed
papers.abstract_en: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Invent-A-Dataset 是一个 prompt 驱动的零种子数据集生成系统，从数据集描述直接产出大规模 post-training 数据集。在八个任务类型、规模最高 20K 样本上对比 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai 五个前沿模型 API，质量相对提升 17%、多样性相对提升 19%，且多样性优势随规模扩大（200 样本时持平，20K 时相对提升 37%）。
Motivation: 构建数据集仍是 AI 开发中最手工、最脆弱的环节，而实践中最极端也最常见的是零数据场景：开发者对目标能力没有任何现成数据可用。
Method: 提出 prompt 驱动系统 Invent-A-Dataset，输入数据集描述，输出真实且大规模的 post-training 数据集；评测覆盖八个任务类型、数据集规模最高 20K 样本，对照五个前沿模型 API（Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai），并用各生成器产出的数据微调模型比较下游表现。
Result: Invent-A-Dataset 在质量上相对提升 17%、多样性相对提升 19%，均为对照中最高；多样性优势随规模从 200 样本时的持平扩大到 20K 样本时的 37% 相对提升。其微调模型在不同 post-trained 模型架构上 consistently 排名高于其他生成器的微调模型。
Conclusion: 零数据条件下用 prompt 直接生成数据集可行，且规模越大多样性优势越明显，生成质量能转化为下游 post-training 收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EditJudgeBias 反事实基准：在经校准多模态验证器、对照与人工检查确认不改变编辑质量的前提下，向图像编辑评测注入 13 类线索，审计 5 个 MLLM 评判模型。质量保持线索使每个评判模型的偏移都超出其自身噪声底线，交换候选顺序最多反转 60.9% 的成对判断，编造的多数意见会抬高评分。
Motivation: MLLM 常被用作图像编辑的自动评判与训练奖励信号，但视觉干预本身可能改变被评质量，导致无法把判断偏移归因于评判偏差。
Method: 构建含 1,196 个真实编辑样本、跨 4 个评测位置注入 13 类线索的反事实基准，用校准多模态验证器、对照与人工检查确认编辑质量保持；沿三个维度审计 5 个 MLLM 评判模型：对质量保持线索的不变性、与人类判断的一致性、成对偏好的稳定性，且偏移对照各评判模型自身的 zero-dose 与 re-query 噪声底线而非零。
Result: 质量保持线索使每个评判模型的偏移都超出其自身噪声；编造的多数意见提高评分；无关视觉元素造成的偏移大于整图操纵；交换候选顺序最多反转 60.9% 的成对判断；编辑区域线索倾向于降低与人类的一致性；三个维度对评判模型的刻画互不相同。
Conclusion: MLLM 评判模型对与编辑质量无关的线索系统性敏感，且稳健性无法用单一指标刻画，评测须以评判模型自身噪声底线为参照。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows
papers.abstract_en: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. (Proceedings of the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, Sydney, Australia)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pCoMole 用离散流匹配 (discrete flow matching) 在可变长度生物序列上做带硬约束的多目标编辑：以增广 Tchebycheff 效用定义可行性门控的终端分布，再用底层编辑过程的 Doob-h transform 实现偏好倾斜，并用候选编辑上的短 Monte Carlo rollouts 近似调和函数。湿实验中两个 229 残基 pCoMole 设计的 eGFP 变体在 BL21 细胞中经 10 次缺失、外加 1 或 2 个替换后仍保持明显绿色荧光。
Motivation: 生物分子治疗常从已知序列出发，需在满足硬性生化与可制造性约束的同时改进多个性质；现有生成方法无法在离散、变长生物空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性与序列编辑。
Method: 框架建立在离散流匹配之上，引导预训练的 Edit Flow 朝用户偏好方向走并保证终端可行性：用增广 Tchebycheff 效用定义可行性门控终端分布，通过 Doob-h transform 实现偏好倾斜，再以候选编辑上的短 Monte Carlo rollouts 近似所需调和函数，得到带可证偏好一致性 (provable preference consistency) 的高效引导编辑器。
Result: 验证任务包括缩短 GFP 并保留荧光相关性质、缩短多种 Cas9 同源物并保持 PAM 特异性、把肽结合子压缩为短拟肽并优化七项药物相关性质（硬约束下）。湿实验中两个 229 残基 pCoMole 设计的 eGFP 变体在 BL21 细胞里经 10 次缺失、各带 1 或 2 个替换后仍保留清晰绿色荧光。
Conclusion: 在离散变长生物序列空间中，可行性门控的 Tchebycheff 终端分布加 Doob-h 引导可实现约束感知、Pareto 对齐的编辑，并能产出经湿实验验证的缩短荧光蛋白变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Stochastic First-Order Algorithms with Variance Reduction in Nonconvex--Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We establish complexity lower bounds for stochastic first-order algorithms in nonconvex--concave minimax optimization, allowing algorithms to use variance reduction. Our main contribution is a lower bound for a zero-respecting algorithm class that permits variance reduction, extending beyond the algorithmic restrictions imposed by some existing lower bounds. We consider objectives with an $L$-Lipschitz continuous joint gradient, a compact convex dual domain of Euclidean radius at most $D_Y$, and a primal value function, defined by maximizing the objective over the dual variable, with initial suboptimality at most $Δ$. The target accuracy $\varepsilon$ is measured by the gradient norm of the Moreau envelope of the constrained primal value function with parameter $1/(2L)$. Under an unbiased stochastic first-order oracle with variance at most $σ^2$ and mean-square smoothness, we prove the lower bound $Ω\!\left(L^2D_YΔ\varepsilon^{-3}+L^3D_Y^2Δσ^2\varepsilon^{-6}\right)$. This result quantifies the dependence on accuracy, dual-domain radius, and oracle noise even when variance reduction is allowed. We also establish complementary lower bounds for nonconvex--strongly-concave minimax optimization. With dual strong-concavity parameter $μ>0$ and condition number $κ:=L/μ$, we obtain $Ω\!\left(LΔ\sqrtκ\,\varepsilon^{-2}+LΔκσ^2\varepsilon^{-4}\right)$ under the bounded-variance oracle model. Under the additional mean-square smoothness condition with constant $\bar L$, we obtain $Ω\!\left(LΔ\sqrtκ\,\varepsilon^{-2}+Δ\bar Lσκ^{3/2}\varepsilon^{-3}\right)$. Together, these results identify complexity barriers across the concave and strongly concave regimes, with the main nonconvex--concave bound remaining valid for algorithms that use variance reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非凸–凹极小极大优化中，为允许方差缩减 (variance reduction) 的零尊重 (zero-respecting) 随机一阶算法类证明复杂度下界 Ω(L²D_YΔε⁻³ + L³D_Y²Δσ²ε⁻⁶)，精度以约束原始值函数 Moreau 包络（参数 1/(2L)）的梯度范数度量。该下界在允许方差缩减的前提下仍成立，说明精度、对偶域半径与噪声的依赖是不可突破的复杂度壁垒。
Motivation: 已有极小极大优化下界对算法类施加了较强限制，未覆盖使用方差缩减的随机一阶算法，因而这类算法能否突破已知复杂度界并不清楚。
Method: 在目标具有 L-Lipschitz 联合梯度、对偶域为欧氏半径至多 D_Y 的紧凸集、初始次优至多 Δ 的设定下，对零尊重算法类构造下界；采用无偏随机一阶 oracle，方差至多 σ² 且满足均方光滑 (mean-square smoothness)。
Result: 非凸–凹主下界为 Ω(L²D_YΔε⁻³ + L³D_Y²Δσ²ε⁻⁶)。非凸–强凹情形：在有界方差 oracle 下为 Ω(LΔ√κ ε⁻² + LΔκσ²ε⁻⁴)（κ = L/μ）；附加均方光滑（常数 L̄）时为 Ω(LΔ√κ ε⁻² + ΔL̄σκ^{3/2}ε⁻³)。
Conclusion: 即使允许方差缩减，非凸–凹极小极大优化仍存在由精度、对偶域半径与 oracle 噪声决定的复杂度壁垒；强凹与凹两种体制各有对应的互补下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid, a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiVid 把视频生成多样性拆成 Semantic、Style、Subject、Scene、Motion、Camera 六个可解释维度，用可复现的计算机视觉流水线逐维测量，并与质量、指令忠实度一起分析。系统评测显示多样性高度维度特异：全局多样性分数高的模型仍在特定因子上坍缩，尤其 Motion 和 Camera；受控提示干预进一步区分出默认模式收敛与实现落差两类瓶颈，且时序因子的忠实度损失更大。
Motivation: 同一提示反复采样得到高度相似的输出，限制了创作探索；现有多样性评测只用全局标量指标，掩盖了视频时空空间中多样性究竟在哪一维坍缩。
Method: DiVid 提出维度级诊断框架，把多样性分解为六个可解释维度（Semantic、Style、Subject、Scene、Motion、Camera），每个维度用可复现的计算机视觉流水线测量，并与质量、指令忠实度并列分析以检查权衡；再用受控提示干预定位坍缩成因。
Result: 对代表性视频生成模型的系统评测显示多样性高度维度特异：全局多样性分数强的模型仍在特定因子上坍缩，Motion 与 Camera 尤甚；过滤掉不忠实的生成后这些排名依然保持，说明是真实能力差异而非跑题输出。受控干预识别出默认模式收敛与实现落差两类瓶颈，时序因子的忠实度损失更大，表明仅靠文本难以控制运动与镜头变化。
Conclusion: 多样性研究应从「是否存在」转向「在哪、为何坍缩」，DiVid 给出面向维度的训练目标与控制信号的可操作方向，框架将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出闭环框架：把策略 rollout 记录成语义化表格数据，让 LLM 生成诊断分析代码，定位结构化策略的次优之处并自动迭代修正，无需人工指令。在 car racing 与 door opening 任务上，相比 zero-shot LLM 生成的结构，模仿学习性能最高提升 15%，达到同等强化学习性能所需算力减少 75%。
Motivation: 结构化策略能提升模仿学习的效率、鲁棒性与可解释性，但现有结构生成要么依赖大量人工输入，要么依赖 LLM 中静态的领域知识，可能与专家示范不一致。
Method: 闭环框架：将 policy rollout 记录为语义化表格数据，提示 LLM 生成诊断分析代码，识别策略结构中的次优之处并迭代修正结构，全程不需要人工指令。
Result: 在 car racing 和 door opening 任务上，相比 zero-shot LLM 生成的结构，模仿学习性能最高提升 15%；达到同等强化学习性能所需算力减少 75%。
Conclusion: 表格化的 rollout 分析可作为有效反馈信号，把 LLM 生成的策略结构与专家示范对齐，并自动产出好的策略结构。
