papers.title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIEScore2 把图像表示成 N×N 网格，单次前向同时输出质量分数与缺陷位置，用可直接校验的网格级目标做后训练。在主评测集上整体分数 SRCC 达 0.601，对比同输入下最强零样本通用 VLM 基线 Gemini-3-Flash 的 0.491。
Motivation: 现有合成图像评测器只给标量分数，不指出支撑该分数的图像区域，分数不可核验、解释不可定位。
Method: 以 N×N 网格的 text-native 表示统一生成与编辑任务（含可选条件图），在 38K 覆盖仅打分、仅定位与联合监督的样本上监督微调；再用 GRPO 优化缺陷定位，奖励混合 cell 级 Dice 重叠、分数准确率与输出格式合法性；最后用无参数 parser 把结构化预测转成可读解释。
Result: 主评测集整体分数 SRCC 0.601，对比 Gemini-3-Flash 的 0.491（同输入、零样本通用 VLM 中最强）；缺陷定位在六个基准中的三个上以逐图 grid IoU 超过通用 VLM 与专用空间评测器，六个中五个进入前三，且包含训练数据源之外的数据集。
Conclusion: 把分数与缺陷定位放进同一个网格接口并用可验证目标后训练，能在同输入条件下同时抬高评分相关性与空间定位质量，且定位能力可迁移到训练源之外的基准。

papers.title: The Price of Correlated Tests: How Strict Should a Model Release Gate Be?
papers.abstract_en: Before a machine learning model ships, it often has to pass a suite of automated tests. Requiring every test to pass looks safe, yet it can reject many models that would have served users well, and it does not say how trustworthy a passing model actually is. We treat the release gate as a design problem: choose how many tests a model must pass so that cleared models meet a stated reliability target, while keeping as many good models as possible. A two-class latent-factor model makes both costs explicit and reduces each calculation to a one-dimensional integral. We prove that when both classes share the same latent correlation, a stricter gate always raises reliability, so the gate that keeps the most good models is the most lenient one that still meets the target. Under pass-all gating, any reliability target short of perfection is attainable within the model, but the share of good models kept tends to zero as the suite grows. Correlation between tests sets the price. In one configuration, a 99 percent target needs 8 independent tests, but 74 tests at a latent correlation of 0.3 and 5,182 at 0.5, where the gate keeps fewer than one good model in ten. We also give a validation procedure, built on exact binomial bounds, that certifies a gate from labelled data even when the gate is chosen from a fixed shortlist.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted to ACDSA 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把模型发布门禁 (release gate) 当作设计问题：在两类潜因子模型中，通过数门禁的严格度与可靠性单调同向，因此在满足给定可靠性目标的门禁里，最宽松的那个保留的好模型最多。测试间相关性决定代价：99% 可靠性目标下，独立测试只需 8 个，潜相关 0.3 时需 74 个，0.5 时需 5,182 个，此时保留的好模型不足十分之一。
Motivation: 要求全部测试通过看似安全，却会拒掉许多本可服务好用户的模型，也无法说明通过的模型有多可信；测试之间的相关性会放大这种代价。
Method: 用两类潜因子模型 (two-class latent-factor model) 把误拒好模型与可靠性两类成本显式化，把每项计算化为一维积分；证明两类共享同一潜相关时更严格的门禁必然提高可靠性；并给出基于精确二项界 (exact binomial bounds) 的验证流程，即使门禁是从固定短名单中选出的也能用带标签数据认证。
Result: 在某一配置下，99% 可靠性目标需要 8 个独立测试；潜相关 0.3 时需 74 个，0.5 时需 5,182 个，且该门禁保留的好模型不足十分之一。pass-all 门禁下，模型内任何非完美可靠性目标都可达，但随着测试套件增大，保留好模型的比例趋于零。
Conclusion: 测试相关性是门禁的定价因素：满足目标的门禁中最宽松者最优，而 pass-all 会随套件增长把好模型全部拒掉。

papers.title: Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It
papers.abstract_en: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 训练会锐化策略，使采样错误越来越相关，多数投票因此失效：单个 LoRA 吃满预算虽提升单样本精度，却让多数投票在 4 个模型中的 3 个低于未训练 base，最多低 4.8 点。把同一数据与训练预算拆给 K 个各自吃随机不相交分片的 LoRA（adapter thicket）后，16 个 (model, K) 组合全部胜过全量训练的单 adapter，K≥4 时投票不低于 base 0.8 点以内。
Motivation: 测试时扩展的标准管线是先用 RLVR 训一个策略再多次采样投票，但 RLVR 让样本犯同样的错，投票只能翻转投票者之间不共享的错误，这个组合是有损的。
Method: 把同一份数据与训练预算分给 K 个 LoRA adapter，每个在自己的随机不相交分片上独立做 RLVR，称为 adapter thicket；对照组是吃满预算的单个 LoRA，以及在 thicket 成员步数处早停的单 adapter。所有方法每题恰好采样 160 个 completion，在 1.5B–8B 共 4 个模型上比较。
Result: 单 adapter 吃满 RLVR 预算在全部测试模型 (1.5B–8B) 上提升单样本精度，但在 4 个模型中的 3 个让多数投票低于未训练 base，最多低 4.8 点；训练中投票错误相关性持续上升，投票精度早峰后最多跌 7.0 点。Thicket 在全部 16 个 (model, K) 组合上胜过全量训练 adapter，K≥4 时保持在 base 的 0.8 点以内或更高；K≥8 时在 8 个设置中的 6 个胜过早停单 adapter 对照。投票数从 16 增到 160，thicket 对全量训练 adapter 的领先从 1.3 点扩大到 3.3 点。
Conclusion: 损失来自预算集中而非 RLVR 本身：当计划是采样加投票时，RLVR 预算花在广度（多个 adapter）上比花在深度（单 adapter 训满）上更好。

papers.title: Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures
papers.abstract_en: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可审计的代数计数场 (algebraic counting field, ACF)，把几何、理化与拓扑特征编译成整数权重查找表，从 apo 结构直接预测隐性配体结合口袋残基，每个分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重与空间聚合重建。在 57 个 post-CryptoBench apo-holo 单元的外部集上，ACF 的 mean paired ROC-AUC 比 P2Rank 高 +0.044（多重校正 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]），但优势依赖数据集。
Motivation: 隐性口袋在实验测定的 apo 结构中不可见，难以从非结合态几何识别；同时预测背后的结构测量与学习证据需要可直接检查。
Method: 监督式 ACF 将显式几何、理化与拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数权重查找表；推理阶段不使用序列搜索、结构模板迁移或蛋白语言模型，分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重与空间聚合重建。在 CryptoBench 及两个锁定外部集合上评测，并把排序性能与残基调用预算 (residue-calling budget) 的影响分开。
Result: 在 57 个 post-CryptoBench apo-holo 单元的外部集上，ACF 相对 P2Rank 的 mean paired ROC-AUC 差为 +0.044，多重校正 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]；官方 fold 的 ROC-AUC 与匹配预算 F1 差异相对 P2Rank 未解决，第二个外部评测未确认新增结构特征带来的增益。
Conclusion: ACF 是一个带外部验证信号、且从结构测量与训练计数到残基分数路径可检查的紧凑预测器，但其优势是数据集依赖的，官方 fold 与第二个外部集上未确立。

papers.title: Neural scaling laws and evolution of learnable activation functions of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a compelling alternative to traditional Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based neural networks. By employing activation functions as learnable elements, KANs offer superior interpretability, making them suited for scientific domains. In this work, we investigate the neural scaling laws of KANs and the structural evolution of their learnable activation functions under dataset expansion. Specifically, we evaluate the scaling behavior of three KAN variants---BSRBF-KAN, Gottlieb-KAN, and Faster-KAN---across standard image classification benchmarks (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and a specialized scientific regression task (magnetic parameter estimation from domain images of moiré magnetic textures). Our results demonstrate that the test loss ${\cal L}$ exhibits a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) behavior as a function of the dataset size $N_D$. After passing through a random-guess regime, the loss follows architecture- and task-dependent scaling behavior. The loss crosses from a faster- to a slower-scaling branch, ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-α}$ and ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-β}$ with $α>β$ for image classification tasks. The exponents $α$ and $β$ depend strongly on both the specific network architecture and the dataset-size regime, ranging from 0.4 to 1.5 and from 0.06 to 0.6, respectively. For the magnetic parameter-regression task, the loss follows a single scaling law with its exponent ranging from 1.28 to 2.59. Additionally, we provide a structural analysis of how activation functions refine their complexity as data volume increases, finding that dataset expansion drives a transition from simple linear-like approximations toward stable, interpretable symbolic forms. These findings provide a quantitative roadmap for the efficient application of KANs while managing the trade-off between model expressivity and computational overhead.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 10 figures. Supplementary Notes will be provided in the published version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 在数据集扩张下的神经缩放律与可学习激活函数的结构演化。测试损失呈 broken neural scaling law (BNSL)：先过随机猜测区，再从快分支转入慢分支 L∝N_D^{-α}、L∝N_D^{-β}（α>β），图像分类任务上 α 为 0.4–1.5、β 为 0.06–0.6；磁参数回归任务则服从单一缩放律，指数 1.28–2.59。数据量增大使激活函数从线性近似转向稳定、可解释的符号形式。
Motivation: KAN 以可学习激活函数替代 MLP 的固定非线性，可解释性强、适合科学领域，但其测试损失随数据量的缩放规律以及激活函数结构如何随数据演化尚不清楚，缺少定量刻画以指导模型与数据规模的选择。
Method: 在三个 KAN 变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN）上评估测试损失随数据集大小 N_D 的缩放行为：图像分类用 MNIST 与 Fashion-MNIST，科学回归任务为从 moiré 磁织构域图像估计磁参数；同时对可学习激活函数随数据量增加的结构复杂度做分析。
Result: 测试损失呈 broken neural scaling law：过随机猜测区后，图像分类任务从快分支 L∝N_D^{-α} 转入慢分支 L∝N_D^{-β}，α>β，α 取值 0.4–1.5、β 取值 0.06–0.6，且指数强依赖具体架构与数据量区间；磁参数回归任务服从单一缩放律，指数 1.28–2.59。数据量增大驱动激活函数由简单线性近似转向稳定、可解释的符号形式。
Conclusion: KAN 的数据缩放是分段且架构/任务相关的，图像分类存在快慢两支而磁参数回归为单一支；据此可为 KAN 的高效使用与模型表达力和计算开销的权衡给出定量路线图。

papers.title: HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record
papers.abstract_en: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). HADRec employs LLaMA-7B to encode clinical notes for rich patient representations and ChemBERTa to encode drug Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System strings, building a global molecular knowledge base. A cross-attention mechanism then performs deep multimodal fusion between patient states and drug features. The framework further incorporates a hierarchical predictor and a novel consistency constraint loss to enforce strict adherence to ATC logical dependencies. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III demonstrate that HADRec achieves state-of-the-art performance across Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC. External validation on MIMIC-IV confirms strong generalization under distribution shifts, and calibration analysis shows well-calibrated predictive confidence on MIMIC-IV with ECE = 0.04, and Brier = 0.06. Counterfactual evaluation reveals clinically aligned reasoning, disentangling disease-specific treatments from general care. Together, these results establish HADRec as a high-performance, interpretable, and clinically grounded pathway toward safe and reliable AI-driven medication recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HADRec 把药物从离散 token 换成分子结构表示，并用 ATC 层级预测器加一致性约束损失强制处方符合 ATC 上下位逻辑。在 MIMIC-III 上取得 Jaccard、F1、PR-AUC 的 SOTA，MIMIC-IV 外部验证 ECE=0.04、Brier=0.06，反事实评估显示能区分疾病特异性治疗与一般照护。
Motivation: 现有药物推荐把药抽象为离散 token、忽略分子结构与药理机制，且采用扁平推荐范式，浪费了 ATC 分类体系本身的层级逻辑。
Method: 用 LLaMA-7B 编码临床记录得到患者表示，用 ChemBERTa 编码药物 SMILES 构建全局分子知识库，再以 cross-attention 融合患者状态与药物特征；层级预测器 (hierarchical predictor) 配合一致性约束损失 (consistency constraint loss) 强制遵循 ATC 依赖。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 上 Jaccard、F1、PR-AUC 达到 SOTA；MIMIC-IV 外部验证在分布偏移下保持强泛化，校准分析 ECE=0.04、Brier=0.06；反事实评估显示推理与临床一致，可解耦疾病特异性治疗与一般照护。

papers.title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 训练后量化 (PTQ) 中逐阶段顺序量化，指出 MSE 重建损失在各量化阶段的量级差异巨大，导致梯度与参数更新强度严重失衡（Optimization Imbalance）。作者提出把优化强度与重建损失量级解耦：在样本、通道、token、元素四个层级定义的 RMSE 变体通过隐式梯度归一化天然实现该原则，作为 MSE 的即插即用替换显著更优。
Motivation: 学习式 PTQ 普遍用 MSE 作重建损失，但其诱导的优化行为缺乏研究：顺序量化从第一阶段到最后一阶段，损失量级与梯度量级跨阶段剧烈波动，造成各阶段优化强度不均。
Method: 从顺序量化整体视角系统考察各量化阶段的优化演化，覆盖多种代表性学习式 PTQ 方法、LLM 系列、模型规模、架构、量化设置与任务；理论上构造样本、通道、token、元素四个层级的 RMSE 变体，通过隐式梯度归一化把优化强度与重建损失量级解耦，作为 MSE 的直接替换。
Result: 实证一致发现 Optimization Imbalance：各阶段重建损失量级差异巨大，MSE 下梯度量级与参数更新高度不均；跨阶段损失量级范围被定义为 reconstruction loss scale，MSE 将其转化为不均的梯度进而导致各阶段优化强度不均。理论表明四个层级的 RMSE 变体实现解耦原则，作为 MSE 替换时显著更优。
Conclusion: 学习式 PTQ 的通用改进原则是让各量化阶段的优化强度与重建损失量级解耦；RMSE 变体因隐式梯度归一化可直接替换 MSE 实现这一点。

papers.title: Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle on history-dependent manipulation tasks, where the current observation alone does not determine the action, and the policy needs a memory of the history. Existing memory methods decide what to remember by design, for example, keeping frames with large pixel changes, and show inconsistent gains across tasks. We view what to remember as an optimisation problem. From the POMDP formulation of imitation learning, we show that the optimal memory maximises the conditional mutual information $I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$ between the action and the memory given the current observation. Intuitively, this means preserving the action-relevant information in the history that is not already contained in the current observation. Based on our analysis, we propose Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method that learns a memory function $m_t = M(h_t)$ and scales to long contexts while staying compute-light. It involves two strategies: (1) the selection over the full history is divided recursively into subproblems of top-$K$ selection over $2K$ tokens, so that fixed-size, lightweight selectors learned end-to-end support an unbounded history; (2) all recursion blocks share one selector, which captures the selection rule common to every block and keeps the method efficient. On RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering when, where, what, and how to act, D&R achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate with consistent gains across all four suites under a budget of only 64 tokens; real-robot experiments show the same gain. Code, checkpoints and more results are at https://dnr-memory.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「记什么」形式化为优化目标：在 POMDP 模仿学习下，最优记忆应最大化给定当前观测时动作与记忆的条件互信息 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，即保留当前观测里没有的动作相关信息。据此提出 Divide-and-Remember (D&R)，把全历史的 top-K 选择递归拆成在 2K 个 token 上选 K 的子问题，且所有递归块共享同一个选择器；在 RoboMME 的 16 个长程操作任务上，仅用 64 token 预算取得平均成功率 SOTA，四个 suite 均有一致增益，真机实验复现同样增益。
Motivation: VLA 策略在历史依赖操作任务上表现不佳，当前观测不足以决定动作；现有记忆方法靠人工设计（如保留像素变化大的帧），在不同任务上增益不一致。
Method: 从模仿学习的 POMDP 推导最优记忆目标为最大化条件互信息 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，据此学习递归记忆函数 m_t = M(h_t)：把全历史的 top-K 选择递归分解为在 2K 个 token 上做 top-K 的子问题，由固定大小、端到端学习的轻量选择器处理无界历史；所有递归块共享同一个选择器以捕捉通用选择规则并保持计算轻量。
Result: 在 RoboMME（16 个长程操作任务，需记住 when/where/what/how）上取得平均成功率 state-of-the-art，在全部四个 suite 上增益一致，且记忆预算仅 64 token；真机实验显示相同增益。
Conclusion: 把记忆内容当作以条件互信息为目标的优化问题，并用共享选择器的递归 top-K 分解，可在 64 token 的轻量预算下支撑无界历史的长程 VLA 策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
papers.abstract_en: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NarrativeFlow 用 flow matching 把机器人速度场 (robot velocity fields) 建成以语言为条件的连续速度场，取代稀疏关键点位移的粗粒度近似，从而生成与真实操作物理一致的机器人流。在标准语言条件操作数据集上超过代表性基线，并在真实实验的多个操作任务上取得更高成功率。
Motivation: 语言条件操作是实用机器人系统的关键，但机器人基础模型的扩展受限于逐个机体采集数据的成本；现有方法要么用稀疏关键点位移粗略近似机器人流，要么无法处理语言条件操作。
Method: 提出 NarrativeFlow：以 flow matching 形式把机器人流 (robot velocity fields) 建模为以语言为条件的连续速度场，作为跨机体、以运动为中心的表示，用于整合多机器人平台采集的数据。
Result: 在标准语言条件操作数据集上，NarrativeFlow 在标准评估指标上超过代表性基线方法；真实世界实验中在多个操作任务上取得高于基线的成功率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把机器人流写成语言条件的连续速度场，可以同时获得跨机体复用与物理一致的操作生成，优于关键点位移式的粗粒度近似。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can AI Scientists Coordinate at Runtime?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent AI scientists have shown improving performance across a diverse range of tasks. Yet a common approach is design-time agentic orchestration, which typically relies on fixed workflows. In contrast, human scientists coordinate and adjust their division of labor at runtime. We therefore ask: can AI scientists also coordinate at runtime? To this end, we introduce Runtime Agent Coordination (RAC), which selects agents from existing AI-scientist hosts during execution, assigns scoped work contracts, and provides artifact-grounded verification. Verification informs subsequent agents without blocking transitions or discarding artifacts. We conduct a single-seed exploratory evaluation across Agent Laboratory, EvoScientist, and ARK on ResearchClawBench, preserving host models, tools, and permissions under host-calibrated budgets. Four cumulative conditions separate native execution, runtime communication, runtime selection, and the combined addition of contracts and verification. Runtime selection yields the highest observed mean score for each host; adding contracts and verification reduces these means, with host-dependent outcomes relative to native execution. These results motivate runtime coordination while exposing the limits of additional coordination mechanisms under constrained budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/systemind-team/Runtime-AI-Scientist.
papers.comment: 35 pages (9 pages main text), 4 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/systemind-team/Runtime-AI-Scientist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Runtime Agent Coordination (RAC)，在 AI scientist 执行过程中动态挑选 agent、下发带范围的工作契约 (scoped work contracts) 并做基于工件的验证 (artifact-grounded verification)，验证结果传递给后续 agent 而不阻塞切换、不丢弃工件。在 Agent Laboratory、EvoScientist、ARK 三个宿主上对 ResearchClawBench 做单种子探索性评测：四个累积条件下，仅运行时选择 (runtime selection) 在每个宿主都取得最高均分，再叠加契约与验证反而拉低均分，相对原生执行的结果随宿主而异。
Motivation: 多智能体 AI scientist 主流做法是设计期固定工作流，无法像人类科学家那样在执行中重新分工；而在预算受限时，额外协调机制是否真有收益并不清楚。
Method: RAC 在执行期从既有 AI-scientist 宿主中选择 agent、分配带范围的工作契约，并用工件级验证把结果传给后续 agent（不阻塞转移、不丢弃工件）。评测为单种子探索性，覆盖 Agent Laboratory、EvoScientist、ARK 三个宿主，保留各宿主的模型、工具与权限并按宿主校准预算，用四个累积条件分离原生执行、运行时通信、运行时选择、以及契约+验证的叠加。
Result: 在 ResearchClawBench 上，运行时选择在三个宿主上都取得观测到的最高均分；在其上加入契约与验证后均分下降，且相对原生执行的增减随宿主不同而不同。
Conclusion: 运行时协调本身值得做，但在受限预算下叠加更多协调机制（契约与验证）会暴露收益边界，未必优于原生执行。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

Motivation: 多环境 LLM agent 的课程与数据选择多在环境层面分配或只看局部标量奖励，忽略跨环境 rollout 关系；且各环境学习速度不同，一批中会同时出现全失败与全成功组，组内没有奖励对比信号。
Method: LLM judge 依据跨环境共享的 rubric 词表为每条 rollout 生成行为画像 (profile)，据此选择与混合环境批次整体行为组成一致、且与已选数据重叠低的 prompt-group；正 rubric 作为 on-policy 自蒸馏教师的特权上下文提供 token 级监督，负 rubric 用于引导后续 rollout 生成以避开反复出现的失败模式，三者合称 RISED。

papers.title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TS-Router 用预训练时序基础模型 (TSFM) 的表征估计各专用异常检测器对目标序列的相对胜任度 (competence)，按 Top-k 路由选出适配的 specialist，再只对被选中的 detector 无监督拟合。在 16 个真实基准、4 项互补指标上取得最佳总体平均排名，并给出 Top-k 集合胜任度 regret 的理论上界。
Motivation: 时序异常检测难以跨数据集泛化：异质时间动态意味着不同的“正常”定义与检测准则，而基础模型配固定打分机制会抹平这种差异。
Method: 以预训练时序表征估计异质 detector 的相对胜任度并路由；胜任度监督来自各 specialist 在带标签的模拟任务上的相对表现，避免依赖真实任务的异常标签；部署时路由无需目标异常标签，仅对入选 specialist 在目标序列上无监督拟合，并在表征覆盖与条件胜任度稳定性假设下约束 Top-k set-competence regret。
Result: 在 16 个真实世界基准、4 项互补评估指标上取得最佳总体平均排名；多组冻结 TSFM 编码器的受控消融支持用预训练表征做胜任度估计与自适应 specialist 选择。
Conclusion: 让基础模型协调多个专用异常准则、而非强加统一打分，是可行的 TSAD 范式；胜任度路由在无目标标签条件下即可工作，且有 regret 上界保证。

papers.title: Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VSF 在 streaming flow 的物理时间速度场上加一个以动力学为条件的隐变量分布，把原本只给单条轨迹的确定性 SF 变成概率预报，同时保留其在物理时间中生成的计算效率。在确定性与随机动力系统上，VSF 的预测精度与分布保真度均优于 SF，在超过 1,000 步的长程 rollout 和分岔动力学上都成立，并可作为即插即用预测器接入 JEPA 世界模型。
Motivation: 流匹配 (flow matching) 做概率预报计算开销大；streaming flow 虽然把速度场直接学在物理时间里从而高效，但学到的是确定性速度场，同一初始状态与观测历史只给一条未来轨迹，无法表达内在随机性带来的多个合理未来。
Method: 在 streaming flow 的框架上学习一个以目标动力学为条件的隐分布 (latent distribution)，由该分布驱动物理时间中的速度场生成，从而在保留 SF 计算效率的同时输出概率预报；并把 VSF 作为即插即用预测器接入已有的 JEPA 世界模型。
Result: 在确定性与随机动力系统上，VSF 相对 SF 展现出更优的预测精度与分布保真度 (distributional fidelity)，优势覆盖超过 1,000 步的长程 rollout 以及具有分岔 (bifurcating) 动力学的设定；接入 JEPA 世界模型后改善了时序动力学与导航、运动规划、操作任务的目标导向成功率。
Conclusion: 给物理时间中的 streaming flow 加条件隐分布即可在不牺牲效率的前提下获得概率预报能力，且该模块能直接嵌入 JEPA 类世界模型充当预测器。

papers.title: Recent increase in near-perpendicular tropical cyclone landfall fraction projected to emerge under high-emissions warming
papers.abstract_en: Tropical cyclone landfall angle strongly modulates storm-surge potential, but how it changes with climate remains unknown. From 1980 to 2024, the global fraction of near-perpendicular landfalls shows a weak, statistically insignificant increase, with no significant basin-scale trends. PepC-Global simulations driven by reanalyses reproduce observed landfall-angle and pre-landfall approach-angle distributions and broad geographic variations in the near-perpendicular fraction. When driven by output from 14 CMIP6 models, the simulations show a similarly weak and statistically insignificant increase during 1980-2024, suggesting a forced contribution not yet detectable above internal variability. Under high emissions, however, the global near-perpendicular fraction increases significantly through 2099, with the strongest and most spatially coherent changes along the eastern North Pacific, whereas no significant global trend emerges under intermediate emissions. The projected increase arises mainly from changes in near-perpendicular fractions at individual coastal locations rather than from a redistribution of landfalls. These results identify landfall angle as an overlooked dimension of changing tropical cyclone coastal risk, one whose evolution this century depends on the emissions pathway.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 登陆角 (landfall angle) 决定风暴潮强度，1980–2024 年全球近垂直登陆比例仅弱增且不显著，各海盆无显著趋势；PepC-Global 用 14 个 CMIP6 模式驱动也复现这一不可检出的弱增。高排放情景下近垂直登陆比例到 2099 年显著上升，东太平洋东北部最强且空间最连贯，中排放情景则无显著全球趋势；增量来自各海岸地点自身近垂直比例变化，而非登陆点重新分布。
Motivation: 登陆角强烈调制风暴潮潜势，但其气候演变未知，现有热带气旋风险评估忽略了这一维度。
Method: 用 PepC-Global 模拟：先由再分析驱动以复现 1980–2024 年观测的登陆角与登陆前接近角分布及近垂直比例的地理变化，再用 14 个 CMIP6 模式输出驱动，比较历史与高/中排放情景到 2099 年的近垂直登陆比例趋势。
Result: 1980–2024 年全球近垂直登陆比例仅弱增且统计不显著，各海盆无显著趋势；14 个 CMIP6 模式驱动的模拟给出同样弱且不显著的 1980–2024 增幅，表明强迫贡献尚低于内部变率。高排放下全球近垂直比例到 2099 年显著上升，东太平洋东北部变化最强最连贯；中排放下无显著全球趋势。
Conclusion: 登陆角是被忽视的热带气旋海岸风险维度，其本世纪演变取决于排放路径；变化主要由单个海岸地点的近垂直比例改变驱动。

papers.title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
papers.abstract_en: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDDA 把「按抽象概念检索教学视频片段」重构为 concept-to-example 检索问题，用三阶段适配两塔视觉-语言模型：先用课本与教师手册的 example-concept 对结构化文本嵌入空间，再在冻结视觉编码器下把概念几何迁移到纪录片画面，最后用稀疏视觉概念监督联合微调双编码器。在自建的初中物理检索基准上，CDDA 的概念级检索强于包括 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B 在内的多个多模态基线，且适配后仍保持具体图文匹配能力。
Motivation: 科学教师按抽象教学概念而非画面可见事件检索纪录片片段，现有语言驱动的视频时刻检索方法假设查询描述可观测事件，无法把课程概念落到时序稀疏的影像证据上。
Method: 提出三阶段 Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA) 适配两塔 vision-language 模型：以概念为中间语义锚点，先用 textbook 与 teacher-handbook 的 example-concept 对结构化文本嵌入空间，再在视觉编码器冻结条件下把概念感知几何迁移到纪录片视觉，最后以稀疏视觉概念监督联合适配两个编码器；几何上压缩 text-concept 与 vision-concept 的角度差，同时保留预训练模型的具体图文对齐。
Result: 在自建的初中物理概念检索基准上，CDDA 的教学导向概念检索强于多个竞争性多模态基线（含 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B），并在适配后保持具体图文匹配；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把概念当作中间锚点做分阶段域适配，可以在不牺牲具体图文对齐的前提下，把两塔模型从事件级检索拉到概念级教学检索。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriHarness 把生成器所用的底层 LLM 改造成 agentic verifier：给它工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能，用 disagreement resolver 对照环境证据裁决竞争性主张，用 consensus challenger 检验共享主张并搜索遗漏要求。在五个长时程 workspace 基准、两个前沿模型上，相对单次 rollout 的平均增益达 6.2 分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）与 6.4 分（Claude Opus 4.8）。
Motivation: LLM agent 执行长时程任务后输出难以验证，且测试时没有参考答案或评分细则；重复采样产生的多个 rollout 含互补的正确主张，但缺少可靠的机制判断该信任哪些主张。
Method: 复用生成器的底层 LLM 作为验证器，配备工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能；disagreement resolver 依据环境证据核对相互竞争的主张，consensus challenger 检验共享主张并搜索遗漏要求，两者结论再指导最终产物的选择与修订；验证技能可从失败反馈中自提升。
Result: 在五个长时程 workspace 基准与两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 取得所评估基线中最高的 selection 分数；证据支撑的修订进一步提升平均表现，相对单次 rollout 的增益为 6.2 分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）与 6.4 分（Claude Opus 4.8）。发布约 26,000 条 rollout 全集，成本超过 100,000 美元。
Conclusion: 分歧往往暴露正确替代方案而共识会掩盖错误，因此把底层 LLM 组织成带证据工具的双角色验证器，是扩展长时程 agentic verification 的有效路径，且验证技能可从失败反馈自提升。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelationVGGT 把 3D 空间关系分割做成前馈、免位姿 (pose-free) 多视设定：给定视觉指定的主体与关系文本查询，在不提供类别名的情况下跨视图分割目标。它融合视觉基础模型语义特征与 3D 几何基础模型的几何表征，用 relation transformer 做主体条件的跨视图关系预测，无需逐场景优化或已知相机位姿。
Motivation: 3D 重建已从逐场景优化走向前馈推理，语义场景理解也随之演进，但现有方法局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽略物体之间的空间关系。
Method: RelationVGGT 框架：视觉基础模型提供语义特征，3D 几何基础模型提供 geometry-aware 表征，relation transformer 执行主体条件的跨视图关系预测；训练数据由一条全自动标注流水线生成，该流水线基于 ScanNet++ 并借助 VLM 与 LLM。
Result: 在 pose-free 多视设定下完成 3D 空间关系分割任务的提出与建模，模型在不接收目标类别名的条件下跨视图分割目标，且不依赖逐场景优化与已知相机位姿；配套发布基于 ScanNet++ 的全自动 VLM/LLM 标注流水线以规模化生成训练数据。
Conclusion: 把语义与几何两个基础模型经 relation transformer 耦合，可以在免位姿、前馈的条件下做主体条件的跨视图关系分割，而新任务的训练数据可由 VLM/LLM 流水线自动规模化产出。

papers.title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无需专家标注的数值证据评估方法，配合自动化数据集构建流水线，从 S&P 500 前 100 大成分股的电话会议记录 (ECT) 构建 ECTs-100，用于同时评测 LLM 分析的有据性 (groundedness) 与正确性 (correctness)。实证结果显示 LLM 在 groundedness 上表现良好，但 correctness 存在明显不足，证据不足 (informational insufficiency) 时还难以克制、会产出无支撑的幻觉。
Motivation: 带引用的可验证财务分析评测依赖大量专家标注，成本高且难以扩展；真实财务分析又常是长上下文的 question-answer 三元组，进一步抬高任务复杂度。
Method: 提出 numeric evidence evaluation 方法，用数值证据比对实现 groundedness 评估而不依赖专家标注；另建自动化数据集构建流水线，从 S&P 500 前 100 大成分股生成 ECTs-100，覆盖 groundedness 与 correctness 两类评测，并专门考察 conscious incompetence 这一失败模式（证据不足时应拒绝作答）。
Result: 实证结果：LLM 在 groundedness 上表现良好，correctness 上有明显不足；informational insufficiency 构成额外挑战。数据集 ECTs-100 来自 S&P 500 前 100 大成分股。
Conclusion: 有据性与正确性是可分离的两个维度：引用对得上不等于结论对；且模型需要在证据不足时识别自身无知 (conscious incompetence) 而非编造。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/sacrl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SaCRL 把因果结构选择写成对候选不变性约束的软优化，用 HSIC 违反度量打分并自适应加权到可实现的结构，从而在没有先验结构知识时同时识别结构与学习不变表示。在合成与半合成 Bayesian network 基准上恢复真实结构，在 Colored MNIST 上优于固定不变性基线，并在 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome 三个 DomainBed 基准上取得 SOTA 精度，结构误设与环境多样性不足时性能平缓退化。
Motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法需事先指定因果结构，而不同结构要求互不兼容的不变性约束，误设会丢弃有预测力的信息。
Method: SaCRL 将结构选择表述为对候选不变性约束的软优化，用 HSIC-based violation metrics 评估各候选，并以自适应权重自动集中到可实现的结构；给出结构识别、随机特征近似下、不变性满足与分布外泛化的理论保证。
Result: 在合成与半合成 Bayesian network 基准上恢复真实结构；在 Colored MNIST 上优于固定不变性基线；在 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome 三个 DomainBed 基准上达到 state-of-the-art accuracy；在结构误设与环境多样性受限下平缓退化。
Conclusion: 因果结构不必先验给定，可与不变表示联合识别，且在结构误设时保持稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search
papers.abstract_en: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts. We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPTune 把商品目录的上下文挑选与 LLM 后训练端到端耦合：encoder-reorganizer curator 依据下游 LLM 反馈对商品排序剪枝，剪枝后的目录再用 context-relative reward 反哺后训练。在 7 个真实商户、每商户 100 条复杂对话查询上，上下文挑选最多带来 31.4 个百分点的搜索准确率提升，后训练平均再加 10.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 对目录能塞进长上下文窗口的中小商户，全目录提示本可替代面向百万级商品的多阶段检索，但 LLM 并不均匀利用长上下文，塞满窗口不等于能用好。
Method: 端到端框架 RPTune：encoder-reorganizer curator 在下游 LLM 反馈指导下对商品排序与剪枝，自动生成 catalog-grounded 监督信号，用 context-relative reward 对 LLM 做后训练，两侧互相改进。
Result: 在 7 个覆盖不同零售垂直领域的真实商户、每商户 100 条复杂对话查询上，RPTune 在 proprietary 与 open-weight LLM 上均提升搜索准确率：上下文挑选最多提升 31.4 个百分点，后训练在此之上平均再提升 10.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 对能放进长上下文的 SMB 目录，把目录挑选与后训练联合优化比单纯堆长上下文更有效，且该收益在闭源与开源模型上一致成立。

papers.title: Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation
papers.abstract_en: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.
papers.comment: Accepted at TAS 2026 (AAAI Fall Symposium Series), Nov 5-7, 2026, Arlington VA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 AI 代码生成的瓶颈已从写代码转向监督写代码的系统，而现有 human oversight 缺乏区分「协调行动」(cybernetic) 与「协调理解」(epistemic) 的词汇，导致只检查输出是否被批准的监督可被橡皮图章满足。作者提出治理准则：每个有后果的选择都必须附带「若条件不同则会怎样」的可第三方检验条件，并给出两部分重建测试 (reconstruction test) 与记录约定 ORRCF 使其可操作。
Motivation: 代码生成日益委托给 AI 后，监督者需要判断代理为何做出选择，但领域只笼统要求 human oversight，无法区分基于批准的监督与要求理由可检索、可核查的问责式监督。
Method: 给出 cybernetic 与 epistemic 两类语言功能的区分，提出治理准则（每个有后果的选择须携带使其本会不同的条件，且形式可供第三方检验），并给出操作化形式：两部分重建测试（评分第二读者能否预测代理在扰动下的行为）与使该条件成为每条记录必备项的 ORRCF 审议记录约定；辅以三个委托片段、一个公开记录与一个失败案例作说明。
Result: 呈现三个委托片段（作者自述为说明而非受控证据），其中 epistemic 互动被证明可行且可审计；一个公开记录中建议按其自身声明的条件被撤回；一个失败案例展示不要求理由的监督如何放任自由裁量选择。
Conclusion: 没有「若条件不同则会怎样」的可检验条件，第三方无法区分一个决定与一次橡皮图章；该准则作为既有技术信任属性之外的补充被提出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video-Index 是一个视频理解元基准：先用五级「攻击金字塔」审计 115 个视频基准，筛出 505,518 个问答对，再由 agent 生成规格、确定性选择器加红队门控组装出 840 个经攻击验证的最难条目。审计发现大量基准可被捷径攻破——35 个基准上不看任何帧的攻击者接近全视频准确率，51 个基准中打乱帧仍保留全视频准确率的中位数 96%。在固定输入下 Claude Opus 5 领先所有开源模型超过 37 个百分点，agent 工具再加约 20 个百分点。
Motivation: 视频基准可能被答案选项、题干文本或局部视觉证据投机取巧，导致分数不能代表其声称测量的能力；需要系统审计并重组出抗捷径的评测集。
Method: 提出五级攻击金字塔（attack pyramid，对每题赋予递增访问权限的捷径攻击），据此审计 115 个视频基准；从其中 112 个筛出 505,518 个问答对构成受审池，agent 将评测请求转成规格，确定性选择器加红队门控 (red-team gate) 组装可复现基准，最终发布四个能力组各 210 条、共 840 条（来自 76 个来源）。
Result: 35 个基准上从不看帧的攻击者接近全视频准确率；51 个含时序探针的基准中，打乱帧保留全视频准确率的中位数 96%；63 个基准中近重复问题至少占一半条目。固定输入下 Claude Opus 5 比每个开源模型高出 37 个百分点以上，agent 工具再提升约 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 多数视频基准可被捷径攻破，评测应先过攻击金字塔审计再发布；即便最强系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
papers.abstract_en: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在掩码扩散 MLLM 中，答案候选的稳定时刻 (stabilization) 与 rationale 展开并不同步：单 block、抑制 EOS 的 LaViDa 运行里，稳定时 rationale 侧画布仍有 89.4–98.1% 未写。V*Bench 上把 block 长度从 128 降到 8，该比例从 89.4% 降到 1.7%；对称分解把提示词带来的准确率变化主要归因于 coverage 而非条件准确率。
Motivation: 扩散式 MLLM 解码中，日志记录的答案何时被锁定、rationale 何时写完，两者的时间关系没有被区分开；不区分就无法判断提示词带来的准确率差异来自覆盖度还是条件正确率。
Method: 区分 retrospective stabilization 与 token commitment 两个概念，围绕 rationale 生成刻画两套时钟；在三个 VQA 基准上做单 block、EOS 抑制与 EOS-enabled 提示的对照，用 matched-canvas 图像消融同时测量视觉敏感性与答案稳定，并对准确率变化做对称分解（coverage 与 conditional accuracy 两分量）。
Result: 单 block、EOS 抑制的 LaViDa 运行中，稳定时 rationale 侧画布 89.4–98.1% 仍未写；V*Bench 上 block 长度 128→8 使该比例 89.4%→1.7%，同时改变 answer coverage 与可用观察窗口。EOS-enabled 提示下，direct instructions 使 Nemotron 在 M3CoT 与 ScienceQA 上总体准确率分别提高 15.0 与 19.5 个百分点，却使 LaViDa 在 V*Bench 上下降 11.0 个百分点；对称分解显示每次变化的较大绝对分量来自 coverage 而非 conditional accuracy。
Conclusion: 答案稳定、rationale 展开与视觉敏感性是可分离的时间读数，提示词造成的准确率差异中 coverage 是更大的分量。

papers.title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可复用的 recaptioned 图文监督分布审计框架：在固定文本预算 B=64 下，用五轴画像（prompt 覆盖、图像条件忠实度、caption 表面健康度）并以 claimed controllable basic units (CBU) 作为统一声明单位，审计由 captioning 策略 π、captioner V_c 与源语料 C 诱导的分布。在五个公开源语料上的七组配对比较中，四组跨语料对比里 released surface 使每条 caption 的 supported CBU 提升 +3.39 至 +6.36，且在 Qwen 与 Gemma 两个 Judge 下一致。
Motivation: 长度相关代理量抓不到 caption 语域 (register) 伪影，而下游 T2I 基准又把语料本身与训练选择纠缠在一起，导致 recaptioned 语料在语料规模上难以审计。
Method: 定义 D_{π,V_c,C} 的 matched-budget 审计：固定文本预算 B=64，输出五轴画像，覆盖 prompt 侧覆盖度、图像条件忠实度与 caption 表面健康度，统一以 CBU 为声明单位；在五个公开源语料上实例化七组配对比较，并用 Qwen 与 Gemma 两个 Judge 交叉判定，另在 CC12M 上扫四个预算。
Result: 四组跨语料配对中，released surface 使每条 caption 的 supported CBU 提升 +3.39 至 +6.36，Qwen Judge 与 Gemma Judge 结果一致；在 CC12M 上框架揭示 long-vs-dense 权衡前沿，跨两个 judge 与四个预算均一致。发布约 490M 的多源 recap 语料与审计工件包。
Conclusion: 在固定文本预算下用 CBU 与五轴画像可以把 recaptioned 语料的监督分布差异从训练选择中剥离出来审计，且该结论对 judge 选择与预算不敏感。

papers.title: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PG-SFT 用 agent 轨迹的 turn 级信息增益 (information gain) 作为特权信号，动态调节 SFT 的监督强度，在获取目标任务能力与保留基座既有能力之间取得更均衡的取舍：相比标准 SFT 与 KL 惩罚/更新幅度约束，分布漂移和广泛能力退化显著减少，代价是目标任务性能轻微下降。
Motivation: 离线 agent 轨迹的逐 token 模仿式 SFT 会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用与代码生成等非目标任务能力，而单纯用 KL 惩罚约束分布漂移或限制更新幅度都无法避免这种退化趋势。
Method: 提出 Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)：利用 agent 轨迹的 turn 级信息增益作为指示信号，按轮次调整监督强度，使监督在需要偏离基座行为的位置和强度上施加，而非全局均匀施加。
Result: 在所评估的基线上，标准 SFT 提升目标任务基准同时拉低多个非目标任务基准；KL 惩罚与限制更新幅度均未阻止该退化趋势。PG-SFT 呈现更有利的观测取舍，大幅减少分布漂移与广泛能力退化，代价是目标任务性能轻微下降。
Conclusion: 获取-保留的平衡不仅取决于模型是否被锚定在基座行为上，还取决于监督应在何处、以多大强度偏离该行为；PG-SFT 通过 turn 级特权信号实现这一权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI-HARVEST 是面向 GUI agent 的自动 harness 优化器，在骨干模型冻结的前提下，用前后截图对齐诊断动作效果、把同任务重复运行当作联合证据定位行为差异，再把跨任务复现的失败模式映射为有界源码编辑并预登记预测。在 OSWorld-Verified 上六个骨干模型一致取得留出集提升，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 全套任务涨 12.33 分；冻结 harness 迁移使 GPT-5 在 WindowsAgentArena 50 步设置下提升 13.87 个百分点。
Motivation: GUI agent 的 harness 决定观测组装、动作执行与验证/恢复/终止控制，但自动优化它要同时解决模型意图与视觉效果对齐、执行结果可变下的失败诊断、以及跨任务失败模式的复用三个耦合难题；非 GUI agent 的 harness 优化方法不直接适用。
Method: 三步流水线：把模型输出与执行动作同前后截图对齐，将发现绑定到具体界面转移；把同一任务的重复运行作为联合证据单元，用任务内比较定位与结果相关的行为差异；把跨任务已验证发现聚合成反复出现的失败模式，映射为有界源码编辑，且在评估前记录预测的行为效应，再通过重复执行同时核对预测效应与任务性能。骨干模型全程冻结。
Result: OSWorld-Verified 上六个通用开源、GUI 专用开源与闭源骨干模型均有一致的留出集增益，其中 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 全套任务提升 12.33 分；冻结的 harness 迁移使 GPT-5 在 WindowsAgentArena、50 步设置下提升 13.87 个百分点，无需进一步优化；同骨干与同初始 harness 下优于 Self-Harness 与 Meta-Harness。
Conclusion: GUI 专用的诊断与验证流程能让 harness 改进泛化到未见任务，因此在骨干冻结时优化 harness 本身即可带来跨模型、跨基准的稳定收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a demonstration abstract in the Proceedings of COMMA 2026. Code at https://github.com/idaks/ABDA-NL and live demo at https://demo.abda-nl.org
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABDA-NL 给基于论证的讨论系统 ABDA 加上自然语言界面：LLM 负责从场景文档回答问题、把英文编辑译成候选形式化语句，而接受/拒绝/未决标签始终由确定性的 ABDA 引擎（ASPIC- 知识库、grounded semantics）给出，且每条模型提案都须经用户确认才生效。系统支持挂起假设与规则、修改偏好来做 what-if 探索，并渲染 grounded discussion game 解释结论为何成立。
Motivation: ASPIC- 论证系统的 grounded 语义对非专家不透明：用户难以看出结论为何被接受或拒绝，也难以用形式语言改动场景做假设分析。
Method: LLM 作为语言与形式化之间的桥梁，一方面依据场景参考文档与当前状态回答提问，另一方面把英文新增事实、假设、规则译成候选形式化语句；确定性 ABDA 引擎仍是 arguments、attacks 与 acceptance 标签的唯一来源，所有模型提案经验证并由用户确认后才生效；界面提供接受/拒绝/未决视图、可交互的 grounded discussion game 渲染，以及通过挂起假设与规则或修改偏好进行的 what-if 探索。
Result: 产出 ABDA-NL 系统本身：9 页 3 图，COMMA 2026 演示论文的扩展版，附代码仓库与在线演示；摘要给出的是功能构成而非定量评测。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 限定为翻译与问答层、把论证判定留给确定性引擎并要求用户逐条确认，可以在不牺牲 grounded 语义可追溯性的前提下让非专家用自然语言操作 ASPIC- 论证场景。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReHoPER 是推理阶段零样本的 LLM 推理增强方法：沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题，滚动规划一段候选中间问题、选一个作答后依据更新历史重新规划。在含新受控组合推理基准 iLLC 的多个数据集上超过强基线，且在组合性最强的设定下增益最大。
Motivation: LLM 推理在需要多步组合的问题上仍然吃力，而现有提示方法往往依赖标注数据或针对任务手工设计提示。
Method: 推理时 (inference-only) 的滚动时域规划：迭代规划一段候选中间问题的 horizon，选中一个作答，再从更新后的历史重新规划，沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题后给出最终答案；任务无关，跨数据集与模型共用同一套通用指令，无需标注数据与任务特定提示。
Result: 在包括 iLLC（作者新提出的组合推理受控基准）在内的多个数据集上优于强基线，增益在组合性最强的设定下最大；实现与 iLLC 生成器已公开。
Conclusion: 无需标注数据与任务定制提示，靠滚动规划中间问题即可提升 LLM 推理，且组合性越强收益越大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型 PTQ 中 CFG 条件/无条件分支的激活各自独立量化，浪费了跨分支相关性。本文用离线求得的 2x2 正交矩阵旋转配对 CFG 分支做 branch-space transform coding，并推导出 Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT)，在等速率量化噪声代理下给出闭式逐层解。叠加到现有 PTQ 方法上，多数对比中保真度提升具统计显著性，且无显著退化。
Motivation: 现有扩散激活量化虽已利用 timestep、feature、layer 结构，但条件与无条件坐标上的激活仍独立量化，配对 CFG 激活构成的强相关二维源未被利用。
Method: 提出 branch-space transform coding：用离线推导的 2x2 正交矩阵旋转配对 CFG 分支，几乎不改动模型参数与量化管线；进一步推导 GCBT，同时纳入 CFG guidance 方向与跨分支二阶矩，在等速率量化噪声代理下得到闭式逐层解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索，可叠加在既有 PTQ 方法之上。
Result: 在多数被评估的对比中 GCBT 带来统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，宿主量化管线保持不变。
Conclusion: 在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择实质影响量化保真度，联合 CFG 引导方向与跨分支二阶矩的正交旋转可在不改动画宿主管线的前提下改善激活量化。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: 现有扩散激活量化虽已利用 timestep、feature、layer 结构，但条件与无条件坐标上的激活仍独立量化，配对 CFG 激活构成的强相关二维源未被利用。
summary_sections.method: 提出 branch-space transform coding：用离线推导的 2x2 正交矩阵旋转配对 CFG 分支，几乎不改动模型参数与量化管线；进一步推导 GCBT，同时纳入 CFG guidance 方向与跨分支二阶矩，在等速率量化噪声代理下得到闭式逐层解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索，可叠加在既有 PTQ 方法之上。
summary_sections.result: 在多数被评估的对比中 GCBT 带来统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，宿主量化管线保持不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择实质影响量化保真度，联合 CFG 引导方向与跨分支二阶矩的正交旋转可在不改动画宿主管线的前提下改善激活量化。

papers.title: Platonic Task Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Platonic Task Arithmetic：把同一任务在不同模型上的参数更新视为共享的、与架构无关的 platonic task vector 的影子，用形状与架构和嵌入维度无关的 Universal Task Descriptors 记录任务的功能效应，并支持矩阵加法与取负。跨异构模型迁移仍保留目标自身 descriptor 增益的 74-80%，在六个模型家族、八个分类任务与一个 audio-text 设定上验证任务知识可跨模型迁移与组合。
Motivation: 同一任务在不同模型上学到的行为相似，但产生该行为的参数更新没有共同坐标系，权重空间的 task arithmetic 因此被限制在单一模型内，无法跨架构进行，除非先建立结构性对应。
Method: 引入 Universal Task Descriptors：形状独立于架构与嵌入维度的矩阵，记录任务的功能效应并支持加法与取负。迁移即在目标模型上用任务的无标注 probe 图像与类名 prompt 编辑目标使其复现 descriptor，无需逐图标签。两种实现：其一将 descriptor 分解为图像嵌入上的 shift field，用一次最小二乘解出线性算子并折叠进目标最后一层作为权重编辑，凭线性性可用带符号求和实现任意强度的任意组合；其二在同一目标上训练低秩 adapter，可触及每一层并联合拟合组合，代价是每次编辑一次优化。
Result: 异构模型只部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当；但跨模型迁移仍保留目标自身 descriptor 增益的 74-80%。实验覆盖六个模型家族、八个分类任务与一个 audio-text 设定，两种实现下任务知识均可跨异构模型迁移与组合。
Conclusion: 任务更新确实是一个共享的、与架构无关的对象的投影，因此 task arithmetic 可以跨异构模型进行；但共享只是部分的，模型特定残差与共享分量同量级，跨模型迁移的收益约为自身 descriptor 的 74-80%。

papers.title: Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗性线性 CMDP（损失与约束逐回合对抗变化、转移未知）上，新原对偶算法把遗憾与累积约束违反同时从先前的 Õ(K^{3/4}) 降到最优的 Õ(√K)，且不假设 Slater 条件。做法是自适应 FTRL 配收缩值估计与指数 Lyapunov 函数，自适应对偶正则项抵消对偶权重依赖从而免去 policy mixing。
Motivation: 对抗性线性 CMDP 中先前最好算法的遗憾与约束违反均为 Ó(K^{3/4})，与最优 Ó(√K) 存在差距；而 policy mixing 等标准约束在线学习技术会让值函数类的覆盖数变复杂，破坏一致集中所需的可控性。
Method: 提出新的原对偶算法，组合自适应 Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL)、收缩值估计 (contracted value estimation) 与指数 Lyapunov 函数；自适应对偶正则项抵消遗憾界中对偶权重的依赖以去掉 policy mixing，并证明 FTRL 更新中的归一化使策略参数不随对偶权重幅度增长，从而策略类与一致集中兼容。
Result: 遗憾与累积约束违反均达 Õ(√K)，优于先前的 Õ(K^{3/4})，且不需 Slater 条件；在 feature access 下计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。
Conclusion: 对抗性线性 CMDP 的 Õ(√K) 遗憾与约束违反可以在不依赖 Slater 条件、不做 policy mixing 的前提下达到，关键是用自适应对偶正则与归一化保持策略类可一致集中。

papers.title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training from the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is a cornerstone technology for the future of intelligent transportation, where end-to-end learning has emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly maps multimodal sensory inputs to driving actions through unified differentiable models. While offering advantages, the effectiveness of end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) is ultimately determined by the quality of its training ecosystem. This paper provides a comprehensive review of training methods and ecosystem for E2E-AD. We introduce a Data-Strategy-Platform taxonomy that conceptualizes training as an interdependent system. The data layer defines what can be learned, the strategy layer governs how learning aligns with driving objectives, and the platform layer supports scalability and continuous evolution. Within this framework, we survey recent advances across data-centric pipelines, learning paradigms, and training infrastructures, and analyze their interplay in shaping model performance, robustness, and deployability. Finally, we reflect on current limitations and articulate a forward-looking vision that emphasizes a shift from data quantity to data value, from isolated optimization to foundation-driven generalization, and from static training to integrated training-testing loops, aiming toward robust, scalable, and trustworthy autonomous driving systems. We maintain a continuously updated repository tracking cutting-edge literature and works at \href{https://github.com/Jiaaqiliu/Awesome-Training-Ecosystem-for-E2E-AD}{Our Project Page}.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, accepted by IEEE transactions on intelligent transportation systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇端到端自动驾驶 (E2E-AD) 训练生态综述，提出 Data-Strategy-Platform 三层分类法：数据层决定能学到什么，策略层决定学习如何对齐驾驶目标，平台层支撑可扩展与持续演进。结论主张训练重心应从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化转向基础模型驱动的泛化、从静态训练转向训练-测试闭环。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶的效果最终取决于训练生态质量，但现有工作在数据管线、学习范式与训练基础设施上分散，缺少把三者当作互依系统的统一框架。
Method: 提出 Data-Strategy-Platform 分类法，按 data-centric pipelines、learning paradigms、training infrastructures 三条线综述近期进展，并分析三层交互如何塑造模型性能、鲁棒性与可部署性。
Result: 综述给出三层框架下的定性分析与局限反思，并维护一个持续更新的文献仓库（GitHub 项目页）；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: E2E-AD 训练应从数据数量转向数据价值、从孤立优化转向基础模型驱动的泛化、从静态训练转向训练-测试集成闭环，以获得鲁棒、可扩展、可信赖的自动驾驶系统。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EyeTAG 把自身近期预测做差分得到一阶视线轨迹，作为运动学 token 反馈给因果 Transformer 解码器，从而显式建模眼动而非隐式学运动。在 Gaze360 上平均角度误差降低约 1.0°，EVE 上 2.56° 与最强基线 2.58° 持平；固定编码器的消融显示，是差分形式而非单纯时序上下文消除了扫视偏置。
Motivation: 单帧视线估计逐帧独立导致输出抖动；多帧方法把运动隐式塞进外观特征，视线轨迹从未成为显式变量，扫视偏置因此残留。
Method: 因果多帧框架：每步对自身最近预测做差分（平移不变，携带与个体无关的运动），将结果作为紧凑 kinematic token 反馈；人脸与眼部双流提供视觉证据，经 cross-attention 融合后送入 causal Transformer 解码器。
Result: Gaze360 平均角度误差降低约 1.0°；EVE 上 2.56° 对最强基线 2.58°，表现持平。固定编码器与其余架构、只改视线历史的 within-model 消融表明，差分形式消除了绝对视线历史先验下仍存在的系统性扫视偏置。
Conclusion: 把视线轨迹作为显式差分先验反馈，比单纯堆时序上下文更能抑制扫视偏置与抖动；代码已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update. Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CEM 中世界模型的打分同时决定当前动作选择与下一轮候选分布拟合，作者把这两个角色拆开独立评估：四种预测模型生成 CEM 轨迹并互相重打分所有候选池，用环境真实执行结果作参照。在 Walker 与 Cheetah 共 12 个独立训练的任务-种子单元上，预设的 proposal 距离从第一次到最后一次 CEM 迭代在每个单元都下降，proposal 宽度收缩、拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度分离；把首个按模型排序的更新换成按环境排序的更新，可降低最终实际选中序列的 cost。
Motivation: CEM 里打分误差会同时污染当前决策与后续候选分布，两种角色混在一起时无法判断性能变化来自哪一侧，也难以知道模型排序与环境真实排序是否一致。
Method: 四种预测模型分别生成 CEM 轨迹，且每个模型对每个保存的候选池重新打分；在环境中执行同一批候选得到参照 elite 集与 proposal 更新。用原始 6 个单元在不查看干预结果的前提下选出 Random nonlinear，再做一次单步更新替换的干预实验。
Result: 在 Walker 与 Cheetah 的 12 个独立训练任务-种子单元上，预设 proposal 距离从首次到末次 CEM 迭代在每个单元都下降，proposal 宽度收缩、拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度分离。成对排序一致性在 Walker 上接近随机、在 Cheetah 上下降，elite 集一致性没有改善；Cheetah 上打分器之间的差异大于候选池来源之间，Walker 上两者及其配对都有差异。把 Random nonlinear 的首个模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新后，最终实际选中序列 cost 在用于选择的 6 个单元以及另外 6 个留出单元上均下降。
Conclusion: CEM 的 proposal 会随迭代系统性收缩，而模型排序与环境排序的一致性并不随之提高；用一次环境排序更新替换首个模型排序更新即可降低最终 cost，且该效果在留出单元上同样成立。
