summary_sections.method: 给定补丁，用带代码导航工具的 LLM agent 合成参数化 fuzzing harness，固定前置 setup 逻辑、仅暴露不确定的 bug 关键参数给 Syzkaller 变异；再把 harness 翻译成 Syzkaller 兼容接口，并用分层可达性反馈 (hierarchical reachability feedback) 迭代精化。
summary_sections.result: 在 100 个 KernelCTF 案例上复现成功率 78%；在 SyzDirect 基准上 73%，大幅超过既有定向灰盒 fuzzing；对 2026 年 3 月之后修复的 50 个近期已知可触发 syzbot bug，仅以 fix commit 为输入复现 40/50（80%）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 LLM 的脚手架推理与覆盖引导 fuzzing 的具体取值搜索分工组合，可以在补丁输入下高效复现真实世界 Linux 内核漏洞，覆盖多个真实漏洞数据集。

papers.title: NemotronLabs VoiceChat: An Open Full-duplex Speech-to-Speech Model with Tool Calling Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NemotronLabs VoiceChat, an open full-duplex speech-to-speech model with native tool-calling capabilities. NemotronLabs VoiceChat combines a streaming speech encoder and decoder-only language model with parallel specialized output streams for agent text and structured function calls, an auxiliary RNN-T branch for incremental user transcription, and a streaming TTS decoder. This design enables the model to listen, transcribe, reason, invoke tools, and speak within a unified streaming architecture while preserving the temporal behavior required for natural conversation. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0, NemotronLabs VoiceChat achieves the lowest pause-handling takeover rates among evaluated open-weight systems, 100\% takeover following user interruptions, and a 4.33/5 post-interruption response-quality score. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5, it resumes its response after user backchannels in 93\% of cases. NemotronLabs VoiceChat obtains a 55.1 normalized average on VoiceBench and, on Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 (FDB 3.0), achieves 82.5\% tool-selection F1, while argument accuracy and end-to-end tool execution remain areas for improvement. These results demonstrate that full-duplex interaction, speech recognition and generation, general language capabilities, and external tool use can be integrated in a single open speech-to-speech model without sacrificing real-time conversational behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NemotronLabs VoiceChat 是一个开源全双工语音到语音模型，把流式语音编码器、decoder-only LM、并行的 agent 文本与结构化函数调用输出流、RNN-T 增量转写分支和流式 TTS 解码器统一在一个流式架构里，实现听、转写、推理、调工具、说话的同步进行。在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 上取得被评估开源权重系统中最低的暂停接管率、用户打断后 100% 接管、打断后响应质量 4.33/5；FDB 1.5 中 93% 情况下能在用户 backchannel 后恢复作答，VoiceBench 归一化均分 55.1，FDB 3.0 工具选择 F1 为 82.5%。
Motivation: 全双工对话要求模型在持续收听的同时保持时序行为、转写、推理与调用外部工具，现有开源语音到语音模型难以在单一架构内同时做到这些而不牺牲实时对话表现。
Method: 流式语音编码器接 decoder-only 语言模型，输出侧并行多条专用流（agent 文本与结构化 function call），另加 RNN-T 分支做增量用户转写和流式 TTS 解码器；在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0/1.5/3.0 与 VoiceBench 上评测。
Result: FDB 1.0：被评估开源权重系统中最低的 pause-handling takeover rate，用户打断后 100% 接管，打断后响应质量 4.33/5；FDB 1.5：93% 情况下在 backchannel 后恢复作答；VoiceBench 归一化均分 55.1；FDB 3.0 工具选择 F1 82.5%，参数准确率与端到端工具执行仍待改进。
Conclusion: 全双工交互、语音识别与生成、通用语言能力与外部工具调用可以在单一开源语音到语音模型中集成，且不牺牲实时对话行为；参数准确率和端到端工具执行是明确的改进方向。

papers.title: Chinese Competitive Debating Dataset and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Debate adjudication requires tracking how arguments develop through interaction, yet existing datasets rarely combine fine-grained debate transcripts with professional judgments collected during real competitions under a shared rubric. We introduce a dataset and benchmark for evaluating large language models' understanding of competitive Chinese-language debate at the match, stage, and speaker levels. We organized 182 matches and recruited 120 professional judges, with each match independently adjudicated by three judges using a predefined rubric. After excluding matches with incomplete records, the dataset contains 148 matches, 2,698 stages, and 20,542 exchange units, with manually verified transcripts and segmentation. It preserves original stage scores, match votes, best-debater ballots, and adjudication rationales. We define three tasks: winner-tendency prediction, stage-score prediction, and best-debater prediction. Zero-shot evaluation of multiple large language models yields a highest winner-prediction accuracy of 66.2%, a highest Pearson correlation of 0.250 between model stage scores and mean human ratings, and a highest best-debater prediction accuracy of 56.8%. The dataset and benchmark provide a testbed for studying large language models' understanding of interactive argumentation and their agreement with professional judges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建中文竞技辩论数据集与基准：148 场比赛、2,698 个阶段、20,542 个交锋单元，配 120 名专业评委按统一量表的独立打分与判词，定义赢家倾向、阶段打分、最佳辩手三项任务。零样本评测多个大语言模型，赢家预测最高准确率 66.2%，阶段分数与人类均分 Pearson 相关最高 0.250，最佳辩手预测最高准确率 56.8%。
Motivation: 现有辩论数据集很少把细粒度交锋转写与真实赛事中按统一量表收集的专业评判合并，难以评测大语言模型对互动式论证的理解及其与评委的一致性。
Method: 组织 182 场比赛并招募 120 名专业评委，每场由三名评委按预定义量表独立裁决；剔除记录不完整者后保留 148 场，含人工核验的转写与交锋切分，保留原始阶段分、比赛票、最佳辩手表与裁决理由。定义赢家倾向预测、阶段分数预测、最佳辩手预测三项任务，对多个大语言模型做零样本评测。
Result: 数据集含 148 场比赛、2,698 个阶段、20,542 个交锋单元（自 182 场、120 名评委、每场三评委裁决中筛出）。零样本评测中最高赢家预测准确率 66.2%，模型阶段分数与人类均分最高 Pearson 相关 0.250，最高最佳辩手预测准确率 56.8%。
Conclusion: 该数据集与基准可作为研究大语言模型对互动式论证理解及其与专业评委一致性的测试平台；零样本下阶段分数与人类评分的相关性明显弱于赢家与最佳辩手的分类准确率。

papers.title: From Switching to Dynamic Regret: A Simple Reduction via Unbiased Random Sequences
papers.abstract_en: In non-stationary online learning, dynamic regret has attracted increasing attention as a measure of how well an online learner performs against a time-varying comparator sequence. Despite considerable advances, attaining optimal bounds for strongly convex and exp-concave losses often involves intricate analysis. In this paper, we present a \textit{simple} framework that reduces dynamic regret minimization to switching regret minimization. As a result, we can derive dynamic regret bounds by using off-the-shelf algorithms with switching regret guarantees. The key idea of our reduction is to construct, for \textit{any} comparator sequence, an auxiliary random sequence that is unbiased at each round, with the controlled variance and a manageable number of switches. Combining this construction with suitable surrogate losses, we can decompose dynamic regret into the expected switching regret against the random sequence and its controlled variance. Theoretically, for strongly convex and exp-concave losses, we establish the $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3})$ dynamic regret bounds, where $T$ denotes the time horizon and $P_T$ denotes the path-length of the comparator sequence. Moreover, for general convex losses, the same reduction also recovers the $O(\sqrt{T(1+P_T)})$ dynamic regret bound. Notably, all our findings match the minimax optimal results for these three types of losses, highlighting the versatility of our proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把动态遗憾 (dynamic regret) 最小化归约到切换遗憾 (switching regret)：对任意比较器序列构造逐轮无偏、方差受控且切换次数可控的辅助随机序列，配合代理损失把动态遗憾分解为对该随机序列的期望切换遗憾加受控方差。强凸与 exp-concave 损失下得到 Õ(T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}) 界，一般凸损失下恢复 O(√(T(1+P_T)))，三类损失均匹配 minimax 最优。
Motivation: 非平稳在线学习中，强凸与 exp-concave 损失的最优动态遗憾界通常依赖复杂分析，缺少一条能直接复用现成切换遗憾算法的通用路径。
Method: 提出一个归约框架：对任意比较器序列构造逐轮无偏、方差受控、切换次数可控的辅助随机序列，再结合合适的代理损失，把动态遗憾分解为对该随机序列的期望切换遗憾与受控方差两部分，从而直接调用带切换遗憾保证的现成算法。
Result: 强凸与 exp-concave 损失下建立 Õ(T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}) 动态遗憾界（T 为时间 horizon，P_T 为比较器序列 path-length）；一般凸损失下恢复 O(√(T(1+P_T)))；三类损失的结果均匹配各自 minimax 最优。
Conclusion: 动态遗憾的最优界可以通过无偏随机序列的归约从切换遗憾算法直接得到，说明该框架对强凸、exp-concave 与一般凸三类损失具有通用性。

papers.title: Directions That Don't Drift: Stiefel Manifold Routing for Transformer Attention
papers.abstract_en: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no geometric constraint. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize with a Riemannian Adam carrying one scalar second moment per frame---the form of \citet{becigneul2019}, here extended to the compact, non-Hadamard $\St(d,r)$ with a tangent projector, step-norm cap, and polar retraction. Four propositions prove steepest descent in the embedded metric, gradient-scale independence, well-conditioning, and exact $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariance. A fifth records that weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$ ($W{=}WI_r$ lies in the normal space), so decay cannot act on the constrained frames. On a CIFAR-10 patch benchmark at $n{=}10\mathrm{k}$ this rule gains $\mathbf{+6.79}$\,pp over AdamW across 12 paired starts ($t{=}38.33$, $12/12$); earlier fixed-step Riemannian SGD gains $+1.97$\,pp, of which $+1.69$\,pp comes from frozen orthonormal initialization alone. The corrected Adam's lead grows with data: $+1.9$\,pp at $n{=}1\mathrm{k}$ to $+6.7$\,pp at $n{=}50\mathrm{k}$. A 12-seed ablation credits all gain to the scale-free step ($+4.63$\,pp, $12/12$), nothing to the projector or equivariance; a targeted $\varepsilon$-sweep causally confirms the mechanism ($-2.6$\,pp at $\varepsilon{=}0.1$, $p{<}0.001$). Two five-seed grokking studies confirm the constrained arm does not grok better than the baseline ($p{=}0.019$, A2 wins): the weight-decay exemption has no grokking consequence. A single-seed pilot exploiting this localization achieves the first stable grokking under slingshot conditions---Stiefel + targeted circuit regularization keeps routing-frame isometry error $10^6\times$ lower than the unconstrained ablation through every collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 attention 的 query/key 投影约束到 Stiefel 流形 St(d,r)，用带切空间投影、步长上限与极重traction 的 Riemannian Adam（每帧一个标量二阶矩）训练。CIFAR-10 patch 基准 n=10k 上比 AdamW 高 6.79pp（12/12 配对起点，t=38.33），12-seed 消融把全部增益归于 scale-free step（+4.63pp），投影与等变性贡献为零。
Motivation: attention 的 W_Q、W_K 一直用欧氏优化器训练，没有几何约束；作者要区分 Riemannian 优化中真正起作用的成分，并指出 weight decay 在 Stiefel 约束下梯度恒为零、根本无法作用于这些 frame。
Method: 将 W_Q、W_K 约束在 St(d,r)，用 Riemannian Adam（becigneul2019 形式，扩展到非 Hadamard 的紧 Stiefel 流形）配合 tangent projector、step-norm cap 与 polar retraction；给出四条命题（嵌入度量最速下降、梯度尺度无关、良条件、O(d) 等变）与第五条（weight decay 的 Riemannian 梯度恒为零）。评测用 CIFAR-10 patch 基准、配对随机起点、12-seed 消融与 ε-sweep，另有两项 five-seed grokking 研究。
Result: CIFAR-10 patch 基准 n=10k 上比 AdamW 高 +6.79pp（12 个配对起点，t=38.33，12/12）；早期 fixed-step Riemannian SGD 仅 +1.97pp，其中 +1.69pp 来自冻结正交初始化。领先随数据量扩大：n=1k 时 +1.9pp，n=50k 时 +6.7pp。12-seed 消融把全部增益归于 scale-free step（+4.63pp，12/12），projector 与 equivariance 无贡献；ε-sweep 在 ε=0.1 时 −2.6pp（p<0.001）。两项 five-seed grokking 研究显示约束臂并不比基线更 grok（p=0.019，A2 胜）。单 seed pilot 在 slingshot 条件下实现首个稳定 grokking，Stiefel + targeted circuit regularization 使 routing-frame isometry 误差在整个 collapse 过程中比无约束消融低 10^6 倍。
Conclusion: Riemannian Adam 在 Stiefel 约束下的收益可完全归因于 scale-free step，与投影、等变性及 weight decay 豁免无关；grokking 上约束臂并不占优，但该收益定位使单 seed pilot 在 slingshot 条件下首次稳定 grokking。

summary_sections.result: CIFAR-10 patch 基准 n=10k 上比 AdamW 高 +6.79pp（12 个配对起点，t=38.33，12/12）；早期 fixed-step Riemannian SGD 仅 +1.97pp，其中 +1.69pp 来自冻结正交初始化。领先随数据量扩大：n=1k 时 +1.9pp，n=50k 时 +6.7pp。12-seed 消融把全部增益归于 scale-free step（+4.63pp，12/12），projector 与 equivariance 无贡献；ε-sweep 在 ε=0.1 时 −2.6pp（p<0.001）。两项 five-seed grokking 研究显示约束臂并不比基线更 grok（p=0.019，A2 胜）。单 seed pilot 在 slingshot 条件下实现首个稳定 grokking，Stiefel + targeted circuit regularization 使 routing-frame isometry 误差在整个 collapse 过程中比无约束消融低 10^6 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: Riemannian Adam 在 Stiefel 约束下的收益可完全归因于 scale-free step，与投影、等变性及 weight decay 豁免无关；grokking 上约束臂并不占优，但该收益定位使单 seed pilot 在 slingshot 条件下首次稳定 grokking。

papers.title: Rank and computation of the pathlifting Jacobian of a DAG ReLU network
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides a self-contained proof of the rank of the pathlifting Jacobian of a DAG ReLU network by performing an induction on the network's number of hidden nodes. In fact, the induction is elementary, and the key recipe is to consider the skeleton matrix of the network, a sparse matrix encoding the network paths, and transform the representation of one of its hidden neurons into an output node. The proof relies on intermediate propositions which link the pathlifting, its Jacobian, the network parameters, and its skeleton matrix, which, on top of permitting to conclude on the rank of the pathlifting Jacobian, also provide a way to compute it without backpropagation and whose computation cost is super efficient in practice compare to usual backpropagation. The paper is provided with a Python module that implements the different propositions of the paper for feed forward networks and is used to experimentally quantifies the computational gain of computing the pathlifting Jacobian with the proposed theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 DAG ReLU 网络 pathlifting Jacobian 秩的自足证明：对隐藏节点数归纳，用稀疏的 skeleton matrix 编码网络路径，把某个隐藏神经元的表示变换为输出节点。中间命题把 pathlifting、其 Jacobian、网络参数与 skeleton matrix 联系起来，从而无需反向传播即可计算该 Jacobian，实践中计算开销远低于 backpropagation，并附 Python 模块在前馈网络上量化这一计算收益。
Motivation: pathlifting Jacobian 的秩与高效计算此前缺少自足的结构性证明与可直接实现的算法，常规 backpropagation 计算代价高。
Method: 对隐藏节点数做初等归纳，核心是网络的 skeleton matrix（编码网络路径的稀疏矩阵），通过把一个隐藏神经元的表示变换为输出节点推进归纳；中间命题连接 pathlifting、Jacobian、网络参数与 skeleton matrix，据此直接计算 Jacobian 而不需反向传播，并提供实现这些命题的 Python 模块用于前馈网络。
Result: 证明了 pathlifting Jacobian 的秩；给出无需 backpropagation 的计算方法，作者称其计算代价在实践中相比常规 backpropagation 高效得多，并用 Python 模块在前馈网络上实验量化了计算收益。
Conclusion: pathlifting Jacobian 的秩可由 skeleton matrix 上的初等归纳确定，且其计算可绕开反向传播而大幅降本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: De-GAN - Dynamic Parameter Tuned GAN for 3D Medical Image Segmentation: A Step Towards Generalisation
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumor segmentation remains difficult because enhancing tumor (ET) has low contrast and overlaps surrounding tissue, while scanner and site variation causes domain shift. We propose DE-GAN, a contrast-enhancing conditional GAN that combines input-adaptive dynamic convolutions, style-aware feature mixing, and coordinate encoding to synthesize slice-adaptive FLAIR images. A label-guided, class-conditional target separates tumor-core (TC) and ET intensities while preserving anatomy. The generated FLAIR is concatenated with the original MR modalities and used to train a 3D U-Net. Across BraTS 2015, 2018, and 2019, DE-GAN improves segmentation over the baseline and static EnhGAN replacement on most reported TC/ET metrics, with the largest gains from retaining both original and enhanced FLAIR. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/zkhansuri-ui/DE-GAN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DE-GAN 用输入自适应动态卷积、风格感知特征混合与坐标编码的条件 GAN 逐切片合成增强 FLAIR，再与原始 MR 模态拼接训练 3D U-Net，以抬高脑肿瘤 TC/ET 分割。在 BraTS 2015/2018/2019 上，多数已报告的 TC/ET 指标优于基线与静态 EnhGAN 替换，且同时保留原始与增强 FLAIR 时增益最大。
Motivation: 增强肿瘤 (ET) 对比度低且与周围组织重叠，扫描器与站点差异带来 domain shift，使脑肿瘤分割在 TC/ET 上不稳定。
Method: DE-GAN 是对比增强条件 GAN：输入自适应动态卷积 (input-adaptive dynamic convolutions)、风格感知特征混合 (style-aware feature mixing) 与坐标编码共同生成切片自适应 FLAIR；用标签引导的类条件目标区分 TC 与 ET 强度并保持解剖结构，生成的 FLAIR 与原始 MR 模态拼接后训练 3D U-Net。
Result: 在 BraTS 2015、2018、2019 上，DE-GAN 在多数已报告的 TC/ET 指标上优于基线与静态 EnhGAN 替换；最大增益来自同时保留原始与增强 FLAIR。
Conclusion: 逐切片自适应的增强 FLAIR 合成配合保留双路 FLAIR 输入，是提升 3D 脑肿瘤 TC/ET 分割并缓解站点 domain shift 的有效路径；代码与预训练模型已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Gödel's and Scott's Variants of the Ontological Argument in Lean 4 and TPTP THF
papers.abstract_en: The Isabelle/HOL dataset of Benzmüller and Scott's study of Gödel's ontological argument and Scott's variant (Monatshefte für Mathematik, 2025) is carried to Lean 4 and from there back to the automated provers, as a benchmark independent of either proof assistant. The port covers all thirty theories, structure and names preserved: 548 statements compare identical as parsed, every named result is proved again, and five results the original reports without replaying them are proved here. For every theorem, #print axioms gives the postulates its proof consumes: Scott's necessary existence and modal collapse need only a symmetric frame, confirming that KB suffices. The benchmark, in TPTP THF and SMT-LIB, turns the steps of an argument debated in philosophy into 294 theorems, alongside 45 statements the original refutes or leaves open, ten left open there. Five THF provers, and cvc5 on SMT-LIB, prove 227 theorems within ten seconds on one core and 232 within sixty, and none proves any of the 45. E and Leo-II solve the most, although Leo-II's calculus has been unchanged for about a decade and was only repaired and modernised here, as release 2.2. Vampire, whose later version won the higher-order division of CASC-30, solves the most in no configuration. Only E and Leo-II are measured in their own automatic mode: Zipperposition proves 101 in a single mode and 213 with its developers' portfolio, Vampire 174 without options and 209 with a higher-order schedule that its CASC mode does not select, and Leo-III 159 alone and 177 with E as partner.
papers.comment: 57 pages. Version 3 measures every prover in the setting it is used in (CASC, SystemOnTPTP, Sledgehammer), which changes several figures, and cites the companion article arXiv:2609.36279, which settles all ten statements the dataset leaves open. Ancillary files: the Lean 4 package, its typeset sources, the tools, and both renderings with every prover result
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Benzmüller 与 Scott 的 Gödel/Scott 本体论证明 Isabelle/HOL 数据集移植到 Lean 4，再回流到自动化定理证明器，形成独立于证明助手的基准：30 个理论、548 条语句解析一致，294 条定理与 45 条被否定或未决语句。五个 THF 证明器加 cvc5 在单核十秒内证出 227 条、六十秒内 232 条，且 45 条非定理无一被证出。
Motivation: 本体论论证的机器验证此前绑定在 Isabelle/HOL 上，无法作为独立于单一证明助手的基准；同时需要区分哪些证明器真正能处理高阶模态逻辑。
Method: 将全部三十个理论移植到 Lean 4（结构与命名保留，548 条语句解析后完全一致），用 #print axioms 记录每条定理消耗的公理，再导出为 TPTP THF 与 SMT-LIB 基准，交给五个 THF 证明器与 cvc5 测量；版本 3 在各证明器实际使用环境（CASC、SystemOnTPTP、Sledgehammer）中测量。
Result: 548 条语句解析一致，原文未重放的五条结果在此证出；Scott 的必然存在与模态坍缩只需对称框架，确认 KB 足够。基准含 294 条定理与 45 条被否定或未决语句（其中十条原文留空）。单核十秒内证出 227 条、六十秒 232 条，45 条非定理零误证。Zipperposition 单模式 101、开发者 portfolio 213；Vampire 无选项 174、高阶调度 209；Leo-III 单独 159、与 E 搭档 177；E 与 Leo-II 解出最多。
Conclusion: 该基准把哲学论证的推理步骤变成可由外部证明器复检的 294 条定理，且证明器配置（自动模式、portfolio、搭档）对结果影响巨大，Vampire 在其 CASC 模式下反而解出最少。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4DMulti: automated multicomponent identification at complex material interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Mapping crystalline phases at heterogeneous interfaces is essential for understanding material performance and degradation. However, structural heterogeneity, phase overlap, and local disorder complicate diffraction interpretation, while growing data volumes make manual analysis increasingly impractical. We introduce 4DMulti, a physics-guided learning framework for automated multicomponent identification from large-scale four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) data. The supporting diffraction data resource comprises over 6 million high-quality experimental patterns and labeled patterns generated by Sim2real. A retrieval-conditioned latent diffusion transformer (Sim2real) translates simulated patterns into experimental-style examples under constraints designed to preserve Bragg geometry, while a rotation-invariant coordinate convolutional network identifies phases across in-plane rotations. 4DMulti achieves 98.82% classification accuracy on a five-phase experimental nanoparticle benchmark, with ablation studies supporting the complementary benefits of domain adaptation and rotation-invariant classification. We define diffraction-inferred structural complexity (DISC), a normalized predictive entropy score that quantifies phase-assignment ambiguity within a specified candidate phase library. We apply 4DMulti to generate structural maps of superconducting heterostructures, corroded alloy surfaces, and degraded solid-state battery interfaces down to single-nanometer spatial resolution. 4DMulti connects simulation-derived crystallographic knowledge to automated experimental interpretation, establishing a foundation for scalable analysis of complex interfaces and data-driven discovery of interfacial design principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4DMulti 是面向 4D-STEM 衍射数据的物理引导多相识别框架：用检索条件化的 latent diffusion transformer（Sim2real）把模拟衍射图翻译成实验风格样本以保留 Bragg 几何，再用旋转不变坐标卷积网络跨面内旋转识别物相。在五相实验纳米粒子基准上分类准确率 98.82%，并可对超导异质结构、腐蚀合金表面与固态电池退化界面生成单纳米级结构图。
Motivation: 异质界面的结晶相映射受结构异质、相重叠与局部无序干扰，衍射判读困难，且 4D-STEM 数据量增长使人工分析日益不可行。
Method: 框架含三部分：超过 600 万张高质量实验衍射图与 Sim2real 生成的标注图构成数据资源；检索条件化的 latent diffusion transformer（Sim2real）在保持 Bragg 几何的约束下把模拟图域迁移到实验风格；旋转不变坐标卷积网络 (rotation-invariant coordinate convolutional network) 保证面内旋转下的相识别一致性。另定义 DISC（diffraction-inferred structural complexity），即在给定候选相库下的归一化预测熵分数，量化相指派歧义。
Result: 在五相实验纳米粒子基准上分类准确率 98.82%；消融实验支持域适应与旋转不变分类的互补收益；数据资源含超过 600 万张实验衍射图。将 4DMulti 用于超导异质结构、腐蚀合金表面与固态电池界面的结构成像，空间分辨率达单纳米量级。
Conclusion: 模拟来源的晶体学知识经域适应与旋转不变判别可转化为可扩展的实验界面自动解读，并以 DISC 熵分数给出相指派的不确定性度量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Windowed A-K-MDP
papers.abstract_en: Markov decision processes (MDPs) are used to support decision-making in conservation of biodiversity, but policies, even over small state spaces, can be difficult to interpret for conservation managers. K-MDP methods address this problem by building simpler MDPs with at most K abstract states. We show that the previously proposed A-K-MDP algorithm that relies on selecting a discretisation divisor using binary search can skip better abstract states. To fix this issue, we propose Windowed A-K-MDP, an algorithm that generates every distinct feasible partition induced within a declared divisor window and evaluates candidates until reaching the ideal value loss (J = 0) or exhausting the family of candidates. Across 33 K-MDP instances, Windowed improved 25 and tied 8.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: K-MDP 的 A-K-MDP 用二分搜索选离散化除数，会跳过更优的抽象状态；Windowed A-K-MDP 改为在声明的除数窗口内枚举所有不同可行划分并逐一评估，直到达到理想值损失 J=0 或穷尽候选。在 33 个 K-MDP 实例上，Windowed 改进 25 个、持平 8 个。
Motivation: 生物多样性保护中 MDP 策略即使状态空间很小也难向管理者解释，K-MDP 用至多 K 个抽象状态简化，但原 A-K-MDP 的二分搜索可能错过更好的抽象状态。
Method: Windowed A-K-MDP 在声明的 divisor window 内生成该窗口诱导的每一个不同可行划分，逐一评估候选，直到达到理想值损失 J=0 或穷尽候选族，替代原先的二分搜索选除数。
Result: 在 33 个 K-MDP 实例上，Windowed A-K-MDP 相对 A-K-MDP 改进 25 个、持平 8 个。

papers.title: Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models
papers.abstract_en: As the use of Large Language Models moves from chatbots into agentic systems, where outputs become actions with irreversible consequences on reality, the existing paradigm on AI Interpretability research, post-hoc interpretability, is structurally inadequate for safe and trustworthy model deployment: it explains behavior after the fact but cannot audit or intervene in an inference computation before it commits to an output. We therefore argue for a shift toward \emph{generative interpretability}, an architectural property under which a model's inference pass natively exposes semantically meaningful checkpoints that are human-understandable and amenable to causal intervention. We show the merits of generative interpretability as comparison to other interpretability research paradigms, and propose Neuro-Symbolic Models as a concrete instantiation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 AI 可解释性应从 post-hoc 转向 generative interpretability：让模型推理过程本身原生暴露语义可读、可被人类理解并可做因果干预的检查点，从而在输出提交之前审计与干预推理计算。作者论证该范式相对既有可解释性研究的优势，并以 Neuro-Symbolic Models 作为其具体落地形式。
Motivation: LLM 从聊天机器人走向 agentic 系统后，输出会变成对现实有不可逆后果的动作，而 post-hoc 可解释性只能事后解释行为，无法在推理提交输出之前审计或干预其计算过程。
Method: 提出 generative interpretability 这一架构性质：模型推理前向过程原生产生语义有意义、人类可理解且支持因果干预的检查点；将其与其他可解释性范式作对比论证，并以 Neuro-Symbolic Models 作为具体实例化方案。
Result: 论文给出 generative interpretability 相对其他可解释性研究范式的论证与优势比较，并提出 Neuro-Symbolic Models 作为该范式的具体实例化；摘要中无实验数字或基准指标。
Conclusion: 安全可信部署要求可解释性内建于架构而非事后补充：模型应在输出提交前暴露可审计、可因果干预的推理检查点，Neuro-Symbolic Models 是实现这一性质的一条具体路径。

papers.title: Scaling Clinical Judgment to Evaluate Medical AI
papers.abstract_en: Blinded physician evaluation has been considered by many to be the gold standard for assessing clinical reasoning in large language models (LLMs). This is difficult to scale; thus, prior studies typically rely on small physician panels, often from a single institution or specialty, which both limits the scientific questions investigated and makes it unclear whether findings would be reproduced with a different set of evaluators. To more rigorously and scalably study clinical reasoning in AI models, here we introduce PrecepTron, an LLM fine-tuned for physician-level evaluation of open-ended responses. PrecepTron was trained using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of a 32-billion-parameter model on a small number of physician examples. We also release GRAND-ROUNDS, a new large-scale physician-annotated benchmark of 9,217 scored responses from 160 clinicians across seven studies. We show that frontier LLMs in typical "LLM-as-a-judge" approaches often disagree with physicians and with each other, but fine-tuning PrecepTron on a small number of cases enables physician-level consistent scoring across tasks. We use PrecepTron to reproduce headline findings from five influential studies assessing LLMs for clinical care in JAMA, Science, and Nature Medicine without new human grading. Using PrecepTron, we then pose new questions about how LLMs reason in medicine that would have been infeasible with human grading alone, including measuring the diagnostic accuracy of frontier LLMs when clinical cases are provided piecemeal, even token by token. Together, PrecepTron and GRAND-ROUNDS provide a foundation for reproducible, large-scale study of how LLMs reason in medicine. All code, data, and labels are made freely available for researchers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PrecepTron：用 LoRA 微调 320 亿参数模型来替代小规模医师面板，对开放式临床回答做医师水平的评分，并发布含 9,217 条评分回答、160 位临床医生、7 项研究的 GRAND-ROUNDS 基准。常规 LLM-as-a-judge 与医师及彼此之间常不一致，而用少量病例微调 PrecepTron 即可跨任务达到与医师一致的打分，并在无需新的人工评分下复现 JAMA、Science、Nature Medicine 五项研究的核心结论。
Motivation: 盲法医师评审被视为评估 LLM 临床推理的金标准，但难以扩展：既往研究多依赖单机构或单专科的小医师面板，既限制可研究的科学问题，也使结论能否在另一组评审者下复现存疑。
Method: 用低秩适配 (LoRA) 微调一个 320 亿参数模型，以少量医师示例训练成可对开放式回答做医师水平评分的 PrecepTron；同时发布 GRAND-ROUNDS，一个由 160 位临床医生在 7 项研究中给出的 9,217 条评分回答的大规模标注基准；再用 PrecepTron 替代人工评分复现既往研究并提出新问题。
Result: 常规 LLM-as-a-judge 方法常与医师不一致、彼此也不一致；在少量病例上微调 PrecepTron 后可在各任务上达到与医师一致的打分。用 PrecepTron 无需新的人工评分即复现了 JAMA、Science、Nature Medicine 上五项评估 LLM 临床应用研究的核心结论，并测得前沿 LLM 在临床病例逐段甚至逐 token 给出时的诊断准确率。
Conclusion: 少量医师示例微调的评审模型加上大规模医师标注基准，可替代小面板人工评分，支撑可复现、大规模的医学 LLM 推理研究；代码、数据与标签全部公开。

papers.title: CHOIR: heterogeneity-aware conformal prediction for crash injury severity across driver safety strata
papers.abstract_en: Transportation agencies increasingly predict crash-injury severity with statistical and machine-learning models, but these models do not state how often their output contains the recorded injury level or for which groups of drivers it fails, a gap that matters most for motorcyclists and unrestrained drivers. This study develops and evaluates a certification layer that gives any fitted severity model a finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantee within prespecified safety strata. The layer, CHOIR (Conformal Heterogeneity-aware Ordinal Inference with Risk control), combines groupwise and weighted conformal prediction with conformal risk control to return contiguous KABCO intervals, and adds a declared sensitivity analysis for medically assessed injury and bounds on fatal omission. It is evaluated on 4.04 million Texas crashes from 2017-2023, one sampled driver per crash, with seven base models from the ordered logit to a tabular foundation model, and on held-out counties and later years. Under one pooled threshold every model reaches 0.90 coverage overall but covers motorcyclists or unrestrained drivers at 0.868 or lower, and class-balanced gradient boosting covers unrestrained drivers at only 0.374. Calibration within four safety strata places all 28 model-by-stratum estimates between 0.898 and 0.907, at the cost of sets spanning 3.6 to 4.6 of five categories for these groups, and the certified ordered logit is within 0.03 categories of the narrowest model. Injury-model coverage should therefore be certified within safety groups rather than on average, calibration rather than model complexity determines validity, and a statewide threshold should not be applied to small rural counties without local calibration data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHOIR 给任意事故伤害严重度模型加上分层保形预测 (conformal prediction) 认证层，在预设安全分层内给出有限样本、无分布假设的覆盖率保证，并输出连续的 KABCO 区间。用单一 pooled 阈值时所有模型总体覆盖率达 0.90，但摩托车手或未系安全带司机仅 0.868 或更低，class-balanced gradient boosting 对未系安全带司机只有 0.374；在四个安全分层内各自校准后，28 个模型×分层估计全部落在 0.898–0.907。
Motivation: 事故伤害严重度模型只给点预测，不说明输出包含记录伤害等级的频率、也不说明对哪些驾驶人群体失效，而摩托车手与未系安全带司机正是最需要可靠区间的群体。
Method: CHOIR (Conformal Heterogeneity-aware Ordinal Inference with Risk control) 组合 groupwise 与 weighted conformal prediction 及 conformal risk control，返回连续 KABCO 区间，并附带对医学评估伤害的声明式敏感性分析与致命漏报 (fatal omission) 上界；在 2017–2023 年德州 404 万起事故（每起取一名驾驶员）上评测七个基线模型（从 ordered logit 到 tabular foundation model），并用留出县与后续年份检验。
Result: 单一 pooled 阈值下七个模型总体覆盖均达 0.90，但摩托车手或未系安全带司机覆盖仅 0.868 或更低，class-balanced gradient boosting 对未系安全带司机覆盖 0.374；四个安全分层内校准后，28 个模型×分层估计全部落在 0.898–0.907，代价是这些群体的预测集横跨五类中的 3.6 至 4.6 类，认证后的 ordered logit 与最窄模型相差不超过 0.03 类。
Conclusion: 伤害模型的覆盖率应在安全分层内而非总体上认证，决定有效性的是校准而非模型复杂度；州级统一阈值不应直接用于缺少本地校准数据的小型农村县。

papers.title: Hologram Representation via Quadratic Phase Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Complex-Valued Quadratic Phase Gaussian (CVQPG), a novel hologram representation method that augments each 2D Gaussian primitive with a quadratic phase profile controlled by a learnable curvature parameter. Against the planar Gaussian baseline, CVQPG improves the average PSNR of holographic reconstructions by 0.19 dB (RGB) and 0.33 dB (grayscale) at equal primitive counts, and by 0.05 dB (RGB) and 0.08 dB (grayscale) at equal parameter counts, where it still leads in all visual quality metrics. Our frequency-domain analysis shows that CVQPG better preserves the mid-to-high frequency band of natural images, where the reconstruction MSE drops by up to 11% (RGB) and 22% (grayscale), indicating that modulating primitive wavefronts is an effective and lightweight enhancement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CVQPG 给每个 2D Gaussian primitive 加上由可学习曲率参数控制的二次相位轮廓，用于全息图表示。相对平面 Gaussian 基线，等 primitive 数下全息重建平均 PSNR 提升 0.19 dB（RGB）与 0.33 dB（灰度），等参数数下仍提升 0.05 dB 与 0.08 dB；中高频段重建 MSE 最多下降 11%（RGB）与 22%（灰度）。
Motivation: 平面 Gaussian primitive 缺少波前曲率自由度，全息重建在中高频段保真度不足，需要在不增加参数量的前提下提升重建质量。
Method: 提出 Complex-Valued Quadratic Phase Gaussian (CVQPG)：在每个 2D Gaussian primitive 上叠加二次相位轮廓，相位曲率作为可学习参数与复值表示联合优化；对照平面 Gaussian 基线，分别在等 primitive 数与等参数数两种设定下比较，并做频域分析。
Result: 等 primitive 数下平均 PSNR 提升 0.19 dB（RGB）与 0.33 dB（灰度）；等参数数下提升 0.05 dB（RGB）与 0.08 dB（灰度），且在全部视觉质量指标上领先。频域分析显示中高频段重建 MSE 最多下降 11%（RGB）与 22%（灰度）。
Conclusion: 调制 primitive 波前（相位而非仅振幅）是一种有效且轻量的全息表示增强，可在同等参数预算下提升重建质量。

papers.title: Tensor-Train Weak SINDy: Identifying High-Dimensional Nonlinear Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Weak Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (WSINDy) provides a noise-robust approach for learning dynamical systems from data without requiring numerical differentiation. However, for high-dimensional systems, tensor-product libraries of candidate functions grow exponentially with the state dimension, making standard WSINDy expensive in both computation and memory. The Multidimensional Approximation of Nonlinear Dynamics (MANDy) addresses this scaling through a tensor-train (TT) representation of the candidate library, but does not provide a mechanism for sparse model selection. Here, we combine these approaches to develop TT-WSINDy, which performs the weak-form transformation, regression, and sparsification in TT format. We show that the TT formulation recovers the corresponding WSINDy regression problem and derive polynomial time and memory complexity bounds for the tensor-train sparsification procedure. Numerical experiments demonstrate robustness to measurement noise and computational savings for high-dimensional systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TT-WSINDy：把 WSINDy 的弱形式变换、回归与稀疏化全部搬到 tensor-train (TT) 格式中，使候选函数库不再随状态维度指数增长。TT 形式可恢复对应的 WSINDy 回归问题，并给出 TT 稀疏化过程的多项式时间与内存复杂度界；数值实验显示其对测量噪声稳健，且在高维系统上带来计算节省。
Motivation: WSINDy 虽然抗噪且无需数值微分，但张量积候选库随状态维度指数膨胀，计算与内存开销都不可承受；MANDy 用 TT 表示缓解了这一扩展性问题，却缺少稀疏模型选择机制。
Method: 融合 WSINDy 与 MANDy 得到 TT-WSINDy：在 TT 格式内依次执行弱形式变换、回归与稀疏化 (sparsification)；证明该 TT 形式恢复标准 WSINDy 回归问题，并推导 TT 稀疏化的时间与内存复杂度多项式界。

papers.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TANGO 是首个面向杂乱室内环境的人形机器人全身视觉-语言导航 (vision-language navigation) 框架：给定自然语言指令与第一人称 RGB 观测，直接输出 29 自由度关节空间动作做全身控制。训练完全在仿真中完成，靠全局路径规划、运动学全身动作生成、避障动作编辑与 RL 跟踪合成无碰撞穿越行为作为监督；仿真中达到 SOTA 并在需要跨越障碍的场景上超过强模块化基线，零样本部署到 Unitree G1 上实现杂乱真实场景中的语言引导穿越。
Motivation: 现有人形导航多把问题当作 2D 路径规划，而杂乱环境穿越需要连续的几何感知全身适应——手臂摆放、躯干调整与步态调制协同才能在 3D 空间中无碰撞移动。
Method: TANGO 以语言指令和自我中心 RGB 为输入，直接回归 29-DoF 关节动作；训练数据由仿真合成管线产生：全局路径规划给出轨迹，运动学全身动作生成补全身姿态，避障动作编辑处理障碍，再用 RL-based tracking 得到动力学可行的动作监督，从而学习语言条件下的全身策略。
Result: 在大量仿真实验中，TANGO 在视觉-语言导航上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并在需要障碍协商 (obstacle negotiation) 的挑战性场景上超过强模块化基线；随后在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上零样本部署，未使用任何真实导航数据训练，仍实现杂乱真实场景中的稳健语言引导穿越。
Conclusion: 用仿真合成的全身可行动作监督可以直接学出语言条件的人形全身导航策略，并以零样本方式迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents use large libraries of reusable skills. At thousands of skill entries, retrieval becomes the bottleneck. Graph-of-Skills (GoS) retrieves dependency-aware bundles from a typed skill graph, and SkillDAG shows that such a graph can accumulate execution-backed structure online. Neither asks whether execution traces can be distilled into a better retrieval graph that generalizes to unseen tasks. We present \textbf{Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills (SE-GoS)}, which treats the retrieval graph as an index rather than a learned representation: the graph is maintained from execution traces while the retrieval pipeline, the skill library, and the model stay fixed. SE-GoS applies three updates: (1) \textbf{topology}, which induces relations from execution evidence and retracts an avoid edge only after repeated successful co-use; (2) \textbf{edge-weight}, which softly attenuates unsupported semantic edges and reinforces incoming edges to used skills; and (3) \textbf{node-description}, which updates retrieval-facing descriptions stored on graph nodes ranked too low. On SkillsBench, one evolution round lifts average reward from 52.4\% to 59.4\%, above full-library loading, vector retrieval, static GoS, and SkillDAG, and this ordering repeats on all three backbones. Retrieval over the evolved graph spends about two-thirds of the input tokens that loading the full library costs. Repeating the round does not help. The same graph improves a held-out split it never saw from 52.9\% to 58.3\%, so what it accumulates transfers rather than memorizes traces. Skill graphs can therefore be improved from execution experience without model training, retrieval-algorithm changes, skill-content modifications, or a model judging which skills are related.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SE-GoS 把技能检索图当作索引而非学习表示，在检索管线、技能库和模型全部固定的前提下，仅用执行轨迹对图做三类更新（拓扑、边权、节点描述）。在 SkillsBench 上一轮演化把平均 reward 从 52.4% 提到 59.4%，超过全库加载、向量检索、静态 GoS 与 SkillDAG，且在三个 backbone 上排序一致；检索耗 token 约为全库加载的三分之二，未见过的 held-out split 也从 52.9% 升到 58.3%。再重复一轮没有增益。
Motivation: 技能条目达到数千量级时检索成为 LLM agent 瓶颈；现有 Graph-of-Skills 与 SkillDAG 能在线积累图结构，但都没有回答执行轨迹能否被蒸馏成对未见任务泛化的检索图。
Method: SE-GoS 只改图、不改模型：topology 从执行证据归纳关系，仅在反复成功共用后才撤销 avoid 边；edge-weight 软性衰减无证据支撑的语义边并强化指向被用技能的入边；node-description 更新检索排名过低节点上的描述。检索管线、技能库内容与模型保持固定，不训练模型也不改检索算法。
Result: SkillsBench 上一轮演化平均 reward 52.4% → 59.4%，高于 full-library loading、vector retrieval、静态 GoS 与 SkillDAG，该排序在三个 backbone 上重复出现；演化图的检索输入 token 约为全库加载的三分之二；held-out split（训练时未见）52.9% → 58.3%；重复第二轮无增益。
Conclusion: 技能图可以从执行经验中改进而无需模型训练、检索算法改动、技能内容修改或由模型判断技能相关性，且积累的是可迁移结构而非轨迹记忆；但单轮演化即饱和，重复轮次不再提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating LLM Over-Refusal via Dynamic Semantic Routing Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) aligned for safety often suffer from over-refusal, incorrectly rejecting benign yet safety-related instructions. Prior studies primarily attribute this to static representation overlap, largely overlooking the underlying dynamic mechanisms. In this paper, we present the mechanistic analysis of over-refusal through the lens of internal routing conflicts within transformer attention. We discover that a sparse subset of Hypersensitive Safety Heads misfires on Hard-Safe prompts, exhibiting abnormal attention entanglement that forcefully binds harmless target entities to refusal semantics. This triggers a severe, high-entropy routing conflict that deprives target entities of necessary attention. To counteract this, we propose Semantic Routing Calibration (SRC), a lightweight, training-free inference framework. SRC precisely localizes and dynamically suppresses these hypersensitive safety heads at the inference stage. Coupled with a dual-branch logits fusion that acts as a safety regularizer during subsequent decoding, SRC seamlessly restores trustworthy reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SRC alleviates over-refusal, with intrinsic safety performance preserved as much as feasible.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对安全对齐 LLM 的过度拒绝 (over-refusal)，从 transformer 注意力内部路由冲突的机理出发，定位一组 Hypersensitive Safety Heads 在 Hard-Safe 提示上误触发、把无害实体强行绑定到拒绝语义。提出训练无关的推理框架 Semantic Routing Calibration (SRC)：推理时动态抑制这些过敏安全头，并用双分支 logits 融合在解码阶段充当安全正则。实验显示 SRC 缓解过度拒绝，同时尽可能保留内在安全性能。
Motivation: 安全对齐的 LLM 会错误拒绝无害但涉及安全话题的指令；既有研究主要归因于静态表征重叠，忽略了注意力内部的动态路由机制。
Method: SRC 是轻量、training-free 的推理框架：先定位 Hypersensitive Safety Heads 并在推理阶段动态抑制，再在后续解码中用双分支 logits 融合 (dual-branch logits fusion) 作为安全正则，恢复可信推理。
Result: 实验表明 SRC 缓解过度拒绝，同时尽可能保留内在安全性能；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 过度拒绝源于过敏安全头引发的高熵路由冲突，推理期抑制这些头并配合安全正则即可在不过度牺牲安全的前提下缓解误拒。

papers.title: GLASS: Graph-Language Alignment with Spherical Scoring for Transferable Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GLASS, a framework for graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) that achieves robust cross-domain transferability through graph-language alignment on the unit hypersphere. GLASS builds a unified representation space by aligning a structure-aware graph encoder with an instruction-aware text embedding via a multi-slice soft cosine objective. Our framework serializes local, global, and semantic graph properties into a compact Graph Descriptor Prompt (GraphDP), creating a text bridge that enables domain-agnostic anomaly scoring. By enforcing multi-scale consistency through Matryoshka representation slices, the model captures anomalous deviations at multiple levels of granularity. We formulate anomaly detection as density estimation on the aligned hypersphere and introduce Spherical Multi-Modal Scoring (SMS), which instantiates von Mises-Fisher kernel density estimators in both graph and text embedding spaces. This probabilistic formulation recovers angular 1-nearest-neighbor scoring in the high-concentration limit, motivates the practical mean k-nearest-neighbor scorer, and provides a principled fusion of structural and semantic anomaly signals. The shared text embedding space further serves as a cross-domain bridge: by encoding a target domain's GraphDP without target-domain training data, GLASS performs zero-shot anomaly detection, and with only a handful of normal examples, few-shot adaptation via reference-set calibration. For privacy-sensitive deployment, we extend reference-set calibration with a bounded joint graph-text kernel summary that provides graph-record differential privacy while keeping the encoders fixed independently of the private target references. Across twelve benchmarks and three meta-domains, GLASS obtains the best average AUROC and rank compared with recent advanced GLAD baselines and enables effective cross-domain transfer.
papers.comment: This work and project were done in Apr. 2026. This work was included in Xudong Wang's Ph.D. thesis (Defense Passed on 13 Apr. 2026), "Principled and Effective Graph Representation Learning with Application to Anomaly Detection," deposited with The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen Library
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLASS 把图编码器与指令感知文本嵌入对齐到单位超球面上，用 Graph Descriptor Prompt (GraphDP) 串起局部、全局与语义属性，把图级异常检测 (GLAD) 写成超球面上的密度估计。Spherical Multi-Modal Scoring (SMS) 在图与文本空间各放一个 von Mises-Fisher 核密度估计，高集中度极限退化为 angular 1-NN，并给出结构与语义信号的融合；不带目标域训练数据即可零样本检测，少量正常样本时用 reference-set calibration 做少样本适配。在十二个 benchmark、三个 meta-domain 上取得相对近期 GLAD 基线的最佳平均 AUROC 与排名。
Motivation: 图级异常检测在跨域迁移时结构分布与语义分布同时漂移，现有方法依赖目标域训练数据，难以零样本或少样本地把异常评分搬到新域。
Method: 结构感知图编码器与指令感知文本嵌入通过 multi-slice soft cosine 目标对齐；GraphDP 把局部、全局、语义属性序列化成紧凑文本提示，Matryoshka representation slices 施加多尺度一致性。异常检测建模为对齐超球面上的密度估计，SMS 在图与文本嵌入空间实例化 von Mises-Fisher 核密度估计，高集中度极限恢复 angular 1-NN，并导出 mean k-NN 评分器与结构-语义融合；隐私场景下用有界的 graph-text 联合核摘要扩展 reference-set calibration，编码器相对私有参考保持固定，得到 graph-record 差分隐私。
Result: 在十二个 benchmark、三个 meta-domain 上，GLASS 相对近期先进 GLAD 基线取得最佳平均 AUROC 与最佳平均排名；不使用目标域训练数据即可零样本异常检测，仅需少量正常样本即可通过 reference-set calibration 完成少样本适配。
Conclusion: 把结构与语义信号对齐到共享文本嵌入空间并做超球面密度估计，是实现图级异常检测跨域可迁移（零样本与少样本）且可加差分隐私的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 结构感知图编码器与指令感知文本嵌入通过 multi-slice soft cosine 目标对齐；GraphDP 把局部、全局、语义属性序列化成紧凑文本提示，Matryoshka representation slices 施加多尺度一致性。异常检测建模为对齐超球面上的密度估计，SMS 在图与文本嵌入空间实例化 von Mises-Fisher 核密度估计，高集中度极限恢复 angular 1-NN，并导出 mean k-NN 评分器与结构-语义融合；隐私场景下用有界的 graph-text 联合核摘要扩展 reference-set calibration，编码器相对私有参考保持固定，得到 graph-record 差分隐私。
summary_sections.result: 在十二个 benchmark、三个 meta-domain 上，GLASS 相对近期先进 GLAD 基线取得最佳平均 AUROC 与最佳平均排名；不使用目标域训练数据即可零样本异常检测，仅需少量正常样本即可通过 reference-set calibration 完成少样本适配。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把结构与语义信号对齐到共享文本嵌入空间并做超球面密度估计，是实现图级异常检测跨域可迁移（零样本与少样本）且可加差分隐私的可行路径。

papers.title: SMILE: Bridging Continuous Optimization and Discrete Symbolic Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers closed-form mathematical expressions from data, offering interpretability beyond black-box models. Existing methods suffer from slow convergence in combinatorial search spaces and lack mechanisms to exploit compositional structure in the data. We introduce SMILE (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential), a hybrid framework that unifies continuous gradient-based optimization with discrete symbolic recovery through three stages: structural analysis of the data to identify the compositional hierarchy of the target expression, continuous optimization to learn parameters of a network that encodes the target expression using interpretable activations, and symbolic recovery through structured pruning, coefficient optimization, and rounding. This final stage distills the learned network into a compact expression with exact symbolic constants. We evaluate SMILE on SRBench across ground-truth and black-box datasets, with ablation studies validating each component. SMILE achieves the highest symbolic solution rate at the largest noise levels, demonstrating strong robustness where competing methods degrade substantially. It consistently lies on the Pareto front of accuracy versus complexity, recovering significantly simpler expressions in a fraction of the time required by the competing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMILE 把符号回归拆成三段：先做数据的结构分析识别目标表达式的组合层级，再用可解释激活 (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential) 的网络做连续梯度优化学参数，最后经结构化剪枝、系数优化与取整把网络蒸馏成带精确符号常数的紧凑表达式。在 SRBench 的 ground-truth 与 black-box 数据集上，它在最大噪声档取得最高的符号解率，并稳定处于精度-复杂度 Pareto 前沿，用竞争方法所需时间的一小部分恢复出显著更简单的表达式。
Motivation: 符号回归在组合搜索空间中收敛慢，且现有方法缺少利用数据组合结构的机制，导致高噪声下符号解率崩塌、表达式冗长。
Method: 三阶段混合框架：结构分析识别目标表达式的组合层级；用 Sine、Multiplication、Identity、Logarithm、Exponential 等可解释激活的网络做连续梯度优化学习参数；结构化剪枝 + 系数优化 + 取整完成离散符号恢复，得到含精确符号常数的紧凑表达式，并对各组件做 ablation。
Result: 在 SRBench 上评测 ground-truth 与 black-box 数据集：SMILE 在最大噪声水平取得最高符号解率，而竞争方法在此显著退化；始终位于精度-复杂度 Pareto 前沿，恢复的表达式显著更简单，耗时仅为竞争方法的一小部分；ablation 验证了每个组件的作用。
Conclusion: 连续优化与离散符号恢复可以统一在一个流水线里，借助数据的组合结构在高噪声下保住符号解率，同时把表达式复杂度和求解时间一起压下来。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do Scan-Derived Class Prototypes Add? Disentangling Supervision, Prototype Content and Query Protocol in Recognition over Frozen Foundation Features
papers.abstract_en: A scan supplies labeled images and a geometric reference. We separate their contributions in a recognizer whose scan-derived prototype matrix acts as a supervised head's fixed output layer. On T-LESS, HOPE and 18 self-collected industrial parts, we test real, random and exactly permuted prototypes, matched geometry-free classifiers, stronger appearance rules and paired background protocols. Across DINOv2-giant and MetaCLIP-H with real-background queries, the largest fused-accuracy advantage of the real prototypes over either control is one percentage point; larger differences favor controls, by up to 2.8 points in arm means. On HOPE with DINOv2-giant the head alone is 2.8 points above exact permutations (95% interval: 0.8-4.7); this advantage does not reach fusion and is not observed on MetaCLIP-H. On DINOv2-giant, matched logistic regression comes within 0.5 points of fusion on T-LESS and exceeds it on HOPE and the self-collected parts. Against white cutouts, real HOPE query backgrounds lower image-prototype accuracy by 43 points on DINOv2-giant and 13 on MetaCLIP-H. The audit separates prototype content, label supervision and query protocol.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Revised version with a new title; adds prototype controls, matched supervision references, a second backbone, paired query protocols, a third dataset and an external experiment on Hyperspherical Prototype Networks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 DINOv2-giant 与 MetaCLIP-H 特征上，把扫描得到的原型矩阵当作监督头的固定输出层，系统拆解原型内容、标签监督与查询协议三者各自的贡献。真实原型相对随机与精确置换对照的融合精度优势最多只有 1 个百分点，arm means 上反而有对照高出最多 2.8 点；而查询背景从白色剪影换成真实 HOPE 背景会让 image-prototype 精度在 DINOv2-giant 上掉 43 点、MetaCLIP-H 上掉 13 点。结论是扫描原型的收益主要来自监督与查询协议，而非原型本身的内容。
Motivation: 扫描同时提供带标签图像和几何参考，二者对识别的贡献混在一起无法区分；在冻结基础特征上用原型做固定输出层时，需要判定真实原型内容到底带来多少增益。
Method: 在 T-LESS、HOPE 与 18 个自采工业零件上，把扫描派生的原型矩阵作为监督头的固定输出层，对照真实、随机与精确置换三种原型，配以匹配的无几何分类器、更强的外观规则和成对背景查询协议；骨干覆盖 DINOv2-giant 与 MetaCLIP-H，并在 Hyperspherical Prototype Networks 上做外部实验。
Result: 真实原型相对任一对照的最大融合精度优势为 1 个百分点（DINOv2-giant 与 MetaCLIP-H，真实背景查询）；arm means 上差异反而偏向对照，最多 2.8 点。HOPE 上 DINOv2-giant 的头单独比精确置换高 2.8 点（95% 区间 0.8-4.7），但该优势未传导到融合，且在 MetaCLIP-H 上不出现。匹配的逻辑回归在 T-LESS 上距融合 0.5 点以内，在 HOPE 与自采零件上反超融合。真实 HOPE 查询背景相对白色剪影使 image-prototype 精度在 DINOv2-giant 上降 43 点、MetaCLIP-H 上降 13 点。
Conclusion: 扫描原型的可辨识收益主要来自标签监督与查询协议，而非原型内容本身；评估这类原型头时必须把背景协议与监督强度当作一等变量控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking World Models for Safety-Critical Embodied Systems
papers.abstract_en: World models have progressed from compact latent dynamics to generative, controllable, and interactive simulators of embodied environments. However, high predictive likelihood and visual fidelity do not necessarily ensure that a model preserves the evidence required for safe decision-making. This perspective identifies three structural mismatches in current world modeling: likelihood versus risk, prediction versus intervention, and finite-horizon prediction versus accumulated consequences. We propose the Risk-Informed World Model (RIWM) as a decision-centric research direction for safety-critical embodied systems. RIWM organizes world modeling around consequences, intervention, epistemic uncertainty, and recoverability, and integrates four interdependent capabilities: decision-relevant representation, counterfactual reasoning, safety-critical episodic memory, and runtime safety assurance. It distinguishes physical, social, and operational consequences while using epistemic uncertainty to qualify the evidence supporting action. We further discuss open challenges in identifying consequential futures, validating counterfactual reasoning, maintaining revisable safety memories, translating learned consequences into executable constraints, and determining when evidence is sufficient to act. This perspective argues that future world models should move beyond predicting likely futures toward identifying which futures matter, revising judgments through experience, and recognizing when to act, revise, sense, defer, or abstain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于安全关键具身系统世界模型 (world model) 的 perspective：指出高预测似然与视觉保真并不保证保留安全决策所需证据，提出以后果为中心的 Risk-Informed World Model (RIWM)，把建模组织在后果、干预、认知不确定性与可恢复性之上。
Motivation: 当前世界模型优化似然与视觉保真，与安全决策真正需要的证据错位：似然对风险、预测对干预、有限时域预测对累积后果三重结构性不匹配。
Method: RIWM 整合四项相互依赖的能力：决策相关表征 (decision-relevant representation)、反事实推理 (counterfactual reasoning)、安全关键情节记忆 (safety-critical episodic memory)、运行时安全保障 (runtime safety assurance)；区分物理、社会与运营后果，并用认知不确定性为行动证据定级。
Result: 作为 perspective 文章，给出三项结构性错位的诊断与 RIWM 概念框架，并列出五个开放挑战：识别有后果的未来、验证反事实推理、维护可修订的安全记忆、把学到的后果转成可执行约束、判定证据何时足以行动。
Conclusion: 未来世界模型应从预测最可能的未来，转向识别哪些未来真正要紧、通过经验修订判断，并明确何时行动、修订、感知、让渡或弃权 (abstain)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoFiE: Coarse-to-Fine Evidence Selection for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires Vision Language Models (VLLMs) to process growing video streams and answer user questions under tight latency constraints. Existing methods improve efficiency through token pruning and memory-bank schemes, but mainly reduce visual tokens after visual encoding. Consequently, downstream token pruning alone cannot substantially reduce end-to-end latency because the expensive frame encoding cost has already been incurred. We propose CoFiE, a Coarse-to-Fine Evidence Selection framework that decouples evidence selection into a coarse, query-agnostic filtering stage before the vision encoder and a fine, query-specific refinement stage during LLM prefill. CoFiE introduces Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering to retain visually distinctive candidate frames and Query-Specific Evidence Refinement to select the frames most relevant to the user query. This design removes substantial redundancy before frame encoding while preserving query-specific refinement once semantic information becomes available. Experiments show that CoFiE establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple video understanding benchmarks, reaching 78.86% accuracy on StreamingBench and 68.72% on OvO-Bench, with improvements of up to 3.15% over prior methods. Even with up to 80% evidence-frame filtering, CoFiE outperforms strong open-source multimodal models while improving end-to-end inference latency by up to 2.54 times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoFiE 把流式视频理解的证据选择拆成两段：视觉编码器之前做与查询无关的粗筛 (Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering)，LLM prefill 阶段再做与查询相关的细筛 (Query-Specific Evidence Refinement)。在编码前就删掉冗余帧，StreamingBench 达到 78.86% 准确率、OvO-Bench 68.72%，端到端延迟最多提速 2.54 倍。
Motivation: 现有 token pruning 与 memory-bank 方案都在视觉编码之后才削减 token，昂贵的逐帧编码成本已经付出，因此无法真正降低端到端延迟。
Method: CoFiE 框架分两阶段解耦证据选择：粗阶段用 Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering 在视觉编码器之前保留视觉上有区分度的候选帧；细阶段用 Query-Specific Evidence Refinement 在 LLM prefill 中挑选与用户查询最相关的帧，最多可过滤 80% 证据帧。
Result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得新的准确率-效率权衡：StreamingBench 准确率 78.86%，OvO-Bench 68.72%，较先前方法最高提升 3.15%；即使过滤多达 80% 的证据帧，仍优于强开源多模态模型，端到端推理延迟最多改善 2.54 倍。
Conclusion: 把证据选择前移到帧编码之前、再用查询相关细筛补回语义精度，可以在高压缩比下同时保住准确率并大幅降低端到端延迟。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Channel-Boosted Multi-Agent System with Iterative Consultation for Document Sensitivity Classification
papers.abstract_en: Organizations in critical national infrastructure sectors must assess heterogeneous documents for sensitivity before routing or storage. Manual assessment is slow, inconsistent, and unscalable. Extending our prior leakage-controlled benchmark, BERT established the top single-encoder baseline (89.14% accuracy, 89.33% F1-score under 5-fold cross-validation on the Strategic 16K corpus). However, transformer baselines suffer from a structural limitation: fixed input length truncation discards evidence beyond the retained window-precisely where sensitive cables tend to be longest. We present Channel-Boosted MAS (CB-MAS) and instantiate it as IC-MAS (Iterative Consultation Multi-Agent System) to solve this without long-context computational costs. A Channel Critic Agent learns document-adaptive trust weights governing Gated Channel Boosting between two first-window encoders, while paired Consultation Agents iteratively exchange belief states to reconcile evidence from the beginning and end of long documents. IC-MAS holds computation constant regardless of document length by reconciling fixed windows in a compact representation space. Ablation studies show critic-controlled Channel Boosting provides the bulk of accuracy gains, while consultation recovers recall without precision collapse. Critic-Controlled Gated Channel Boosting with Max-Pool fusion and Blackboard Adaptive Consultation achieves 90.72% accuracy, 91.23% F1-score, 92.01% sensitive recall, and 90.46% sensitive precision, using about 54% less average computation than a fixed-round baseline. Gains over the single-encoder baseline are statistically significant (McNemar's test, p less than 0.000001; paired t-test). We include LIME/SHAP explainability, multi-agent evaluation, and an honest accounting of limitations.

papers.title: Baseline Climatology of Tornadoes and Waterspouts in the Philippine Archipelago
papers.abstract_en: Tornadoes are documented on every inhabited continent, yet the environmental conditions used to anticipate them were developed and validated overwhelmingly on mid-latitude records, leaving tropical regimes largely unexamined. Here, we collected 1,186 combined tornado and waterspout reports in the Philippines spanning the early 1900s to 2025 and paired each with an ERA5 proximity sounding to construct the first baseline climatology and environmental characterization of these events in the archipelago. Activity concentrates in three corridors, mostly flanked by mountain ranges, one in each major island group, and is sharply phased within a May--October window that closely tracks the annual cycle of thunderstorm frequency, peaking in August and lagging into October for waterspouts alongside the tropical cyclone season. These events cluster in the mid-to-late afternoon, consistent with a daytime heating regime rather than nocturnal convection. The environments are thermodynamically permissive but kinematically shallow, with convective available potential energy (CAPE) exceeding typical Great Plains values, while the 0--6 km bulk wind difference (BWD; DLS) remains weak at $\sim$10--14 kt, departing from the mid-latitude covariance in which instability and shear increase together. Although streamwise vorticity is modest in magnitude, nearly all discriminating variance resides in the lowest kilometer, where 68\%--79\% of near-surface horizontal vorticity is streamwise, reaching $>$0.005 s$^{-1}$ and 96\% streamwiseness in the most organized profiles, and the hodographs retain low-level curvature. Consequently, composite indices remain low even as tornadoes and waterspouts recur. Mid-latitude-calibrated parameters can therefore misdiagnose tropical-maritime regimes, and recalibration toward shallow-layer, orientation-aware kinematic discriminators may recover the diagnostic signal.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Submitted to a journal. Final part of Project Severe Weather Archive of the Philippines (SWAP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 菲律宾群岛 1900 年代初至 2025 年的 1,186 条龙卷与水龙卷报告配对 ERA5 邻近探空，构成该区域首份基线气候学：活动集中在三条山脉夹持的走廊，5–10 月窗口内 8 月达峰，多发于午后。环境热力充沛（CAPE 超过典型大平原值）但 0–6 km 风切变仅约 10–14 kt，判别方差几乎全在最低 1 km（近地面水平涡量 68%–79% 为流向性，最强廓线 >0.005 s⁻¹、流向性 96%），因此中纬度标定的综合指数偏低、会误判热带海洋性 regime，作者主张把判别参数向浅层、考虑取向的运动学量重新标定。
Motivation: 预判龙卷所用的环境参数几乎全部在中纬度记录上建立和验证，热带 regime 长期未被检验；菲律宾群岛此前缺少把龙卷/水龙卷报告与探空环境配对的基线气候学。
Method: 收集 1,186 条合并的龙卷与水龙卷报告（1900 年代初–2025），逐条配对 ERA5 邻近探空 (proximity sounding)，做事件气候学与环境表征：统计走廊分布、月内相位、日内时段，并分析 CAPE、0–6 km bulk wind difference (BWD/DLS)、低层流向性涡量 (streamwise vorticity) 与 hodograph 曲率。
Result: 活动集中于三条走廊、5–10 月窗口内 8 月峰值（水龙卷滞后到 10 月，与热带气旋季同步），事件集中在午后中后段；CAPE 超过典型大平原值而 0–6 km BWD 仅约 10–14 kt；近地面水平涡量的 68%–79% 为流向性，最组织化廓线 >0.005 s⁻¹ 且流向性达 96%，综合指数仍偏低。
Conclusion: 中纬度标定的龙卷参数会误诊热带海洋性 regime，诊断信号需要用浅层、考虑取向的运动学判别量重新标定才能恢复。

papers.title: Design and Implementation of a Kalman Filter-Infused Algorithm for Tilt Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate tilt angle estimation is important in many engineering applications, such as robotics, motion tracking, and embedded control systems. However, measurements from low-cost inertial sensors are often degraded by noise and drift. This paper presents a single-axis tilt angle estimation system based on the MPU6050 inertial measurement unit, implemented on an RP2040 microcontroller platform, with sensor fusion achieved through a Kalman filter. The accelerometer provides a direct estimate of tilt angle from gravity but is sensitive to noise and short-term fluctuations. The gyroscope provides smooth angular rate measurements, but integration over time introduces drift. To overcome these limitations, a Kalman filter is used to combine measurements from both sensors, leveraging the long-term stability of the accelerometer and the short-term smoothness of the gyroscope. Both simulation and hardware experiments are performed. In simulation, sensor noise and drift are modeled to evaluate the filter performance under control conditions. In the hardware implementation, real-time MPU6050 data is acquired and processed by the RP2040 platform, and the estimated tilt angle is compared with accelerometer-only and gyroscope-only outputs. The results show that the proposed method effectively reduces noise measurements and suppresses long-term drift while preserving good dynamic response. Overall, the system provides more stable and accurate tilt estimation than either sensor alone, demonstrating a practical and accessible approach for Kalman filter based sensor fusion in embedded application. This manuscript is a preprint version of the work. Keywords: Kalman Filter, Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Noise Reduction, Angle Tracking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MPU6050 + RP2040 嵌入式平台上用 Kalman filter 融合加速度计与陀螺仪做单轴倾角估计：加速度计长期稳定但噪声大，陀螺仪短期平滑但积分漂移，滤波后同时压低噪声与长期漂移并保持动态响应，整体比任一传感器单独输出更稳更准。
Motivation: 低成本惯性传感器的噪声与漂移使倾角测量在机器人、运动跟踪和嵌入式控制中不可靠，单用加速度计或陀螺仪各有失效模式。
Method: 以 Kalman filter 融合 MPU6050 的加速度计（重力直接给出倾角但噪声敏感）与陀螺仪（角速率平滑但积分漂移），在 RP2040 微控制器上实时采集处理；先在建模了噪声与漂移的仿真中评估，再做硬件实验，与 accelerometer-only、gyroscope-only 输出对比。
Result: 仿真与硬件实验均显示该方法有效降低噪声、抑制长期漂移并保持良好动态响应；相对加速度计单独与陀螺仪单独输出，倾角估计更稳定准确。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: Kalman filter 传感器融合是嵌入式场景下可落地、易获取的倾角估计方案，优于任一传感器单独使用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Disciplined Bilevel Programming
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization provides a natural modeling language for hierarchical decision problems. However, applying existing numerical solvers usually requires substantial manual analysis and reformulation. In this paper, we introduce disciplined bilevel programming (DBLP), a symbolic framework that allows users to specify and solve optimistic bilevel problems in a high-level, human-readable way that is close to the mathematical formulation. For problems with a disciplined nonlinear upper problem and a convex lower problem satisfying the disciplined parameterized programming rules, DBLP automatically canonicalizes the lower problem into conic form and constructs an equivalent single-level reformulation using the conic Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. We relax the resulting complementarity constraint and use a gap continuation procedure to approximately solve a sequence of smooth nonlinear problems. We implement DBLP in the open-source Python package BLVPY, an extension of CVXPY for bilevel programming. We demonstrate the modeling and solution capabilities of BLVPY on a range of bilevel optimization problems from several application domains. The proposed framework and implementation allow users to specify and solve bilevel optimization problems within a few lines of code, without prior expertise in bilevel modeling and numerical optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DBLP：把乐观双层规划写成接近数学形式的高层符号语言，对满足 disciplined parameterized programming 规则的问题自动把下层规范化为锥形式，用锥 KKT 条件等价改写为单层问题，再松弛互补约束并以 gap continuation 逐次求解光滑非线性问题。实现为 CVXPY 的双层扩展 BLVPY，几行代码即可建模求解，无需双层数值优化经验。
Motivation: 双层优化适合描述层级决策问题，但现有数值求解器需要大量手工分析与问题重构，门槛高。
Method: DBLP 符号框架要求上层为 disciplined nonlinear、下层为凸且满足 DPP 规则；自动将下层规范化为锥形式，用 conic KKT 条件构造等价单层改写，松弛互补约束后以 gap continuation 求解一串光滑非线性问题；实现为开源 Python 包 BLVPY（CVXPY 的双层扩展）。
Result: 在来自若干应用领域的双层优化问题上演示 BLVPY 的建模与求解能力，用户可用几行代码指定并求解双层问题，无需双层数值优化的先验经验。
Conclusion: 对满足 DPP 规则的凸下层双层问题，符号化建模加锥 KKT 单层化加 gap continuation 可以把双层求解变成接近写数学式的短代码流程。

papers.title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic reasoning has shown promising success in addressing complex reasoning tasks by combining large language models (LLMs) and symbolic solvers. While this approach shows promise, a fundamental challenge remains: improving the accuracy of translations from natural language to logical formulas. Current methods predominantly rely on prompt engineering, which is difficult to scale across different domains and input formats. Drawing inspiration from the success of fine-tuning in other model adaptation and alignment applications, we propose a fine-tuning-based Stratified Consistency Distillation approach: (1) We generate K logical translations per input using a frontier LLM and cluster them by semantic equivalence (2) Based on the entropy level, we apply majority voting (low entropy), LLM-as-a-Judge (medium entropy), or unification/abstention (high entropy), and (3) fine-tune a smaller model using the selected pseudo-labels. Our experiments show significant and consistent improvements in both Pass@K and our novel Equivalent Logical Similarity metrics, demonstrating the potential of advancing logical translation through consistency distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层一致性蒸馏 (Stratified Consistency Distillation)：用前沿 LLM 对每条自然语言输入生成 K 个逻辑翻译并按语义等价聚类，再按熵水平选伪标签——低熵多数投票、中熵 LLM-as-a-Judge、高熵 unification/abstention——据此微调小模型。实验显示 Pass@K 与新提出的 Equivalent Logical Similarity 指标均显著且一致地提升。
Motivation: 神经符号推理中自然语言到逻辑公式的翻译精度是瓶颈，现有方法主要靠 prompt engineering，难以跨领域和输入格式扩展。
Method: 三步流程：前沿 LLM 对每条输入生成 K 个逻辑翻译并按语义等价聚类；依据簇的熵水平分别采用多数投票（低熵）、LLM-as-a-Judge（中熵）或 unification/abstention（高熵）产出伪标签；用这些伪标签微调一个更小的模型。
Result: 实验在 Pass@K 与作者新提出的 Equivalent Logical Similarity 指标上均取得显著且一致的提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 一致性蒸馏加熵分层伪标签选择，可把逻辑翻译质量的改进从 prompt 工程转移到可扩展的微调路径上。

papers.title: Supraglacial Lake Fate Is Knowable Long Before the Season Ends
papers.abstract_en: A supraglacial lake on the Greenland Ice Sheet ends its melt season in one of four ways: it drains rapidly through a hydrofracture, drains slowly across the surface, refreezes in place, or is buried by late-season snowfall. Which one occurs decides whether the meltwater reaches the ice bed. Satellite classifiers recover the outcome accurately but only after the season closes, and how much of a season each outcome actually requires has never been measured. We measure it directly: holding the representation and the classifier fixed, we truncate the input at 14 cutoffs from May 1 to December 31, retrain at each, and record the earliest cutoff at which each outcome's per-class F1 reaches a fixed target. The outcomes resolve in a consistent order, two of them months early: rapid drainage by July 15 and slow drainage by August 1, respectively 92 and 75 days ahead of the earliest date a full-season pipeline can be computed at all, with buried and refreeze following at 44 and 30 days. Five further learners, from a majority-class floor and 54 summary statistics to a trigger-based early classifier, leave the ordering largely intact: the three that produce a per-class trajectory reproduce it in five of six cases despite end-of-season accuracies differing by up to 18 percentage points, and it survives leave-one-basin-out evaluation, though not a move to machine-labeled lakes in an unseen season. Every feature we compute at day t reads only days up to t, at a cost of at most 1.3 percentage points. A monitoring system should therefore not have one release date: rapid drainage can be flagged on July 15, three months before a full-season pipeline can be computed at all.

TL;DR: 在格陵兰冰盖冰面湖四种消融季结局（快速水力破裂排水、缓慢地表排水、原地再冻结、被晚季积雪掩埋）的分类中，把输入序列在 14 个截止日截断并重训，可提前判定结局：快速排水 7 月 15 日即达 per-class F1 目标，比全季流程最早可计算日提前 92 天，缓慢排水 8 月 1 日提前 75 天，掩埋与再冻结分别提前 44 与 30 天。作者据此主张监测系统不应设单一发布日期，快速排水可在 7 月 15 日单独标记。

Result: 快速排水 7 月 15 日、缓慢排水 8 月 1 日达标，分别比全季流程最早可计算日早 92 天与 75 天，掩埋与再冻结早 44 天与 30 天；五种额外学习器中三种能给出 per-class 轨迹者在六种情形中的五种复现该排序，尽管季末准确率差异可达 18 个百分点；排序在 leave-one-basin-out 下成立，但在未见过季节的机器标注湖上不成立；因果式逐日特征代价至多 1.3 个百分点。

papers.title: Implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization for maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile satellites
papers.abstract_en: Maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile Earth observation satellites is a dynamic, sequence-dependent combinatorial optimization problem. Sea-surface targets move continuously, causing feasible observation windows to vary with target motion and satellite orbital geometry. The scheduler must jointly determine task selection, satellite assignment, observation-window selection, and observation ordering under time-window, attitude-maneuvering, and onboard-resource constraints. This paper proposes an implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization method, termed IQACO, for multi-satellite maritime moving-target observation scheduling. Rather than directly learning a task-selection policy, IQACO embeds an offline implicit Q-learning module into constructive ant colony optimization to adaptively adjust the pheromone factor, heuristic factor, and evaporation rate. A compact search-state representation captures pheromone distribution, current and historical-best solution quality, and iteration progress. During online scheduling, ant colony optimization constructs feasible observation sequences, while the learned policy adjusts the search behavior according to the current search state. Experiments on 14 scenarios with different scales and satellite configurations show that IQACO consistently outperforms the compared algorithms, improving the mean objective value over conventional ant colony optimization by 2.86%-9.41%. Further comparative and supplementary experiments demonstrate its effectiveness and robustness across different scheduling conditions and problem settings. These results indicate that offline value learning provides an effective adaptive search-control mechanism for constrained maritime moving-target observation scheduling.
papers.comment: Revised manuscript incorporating changes made during peer review. Published in Aerospace Science and Technology

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IQACO 把离线 implicit Q-learning (IQL) 模块嵌入构造式蚁群优化 (ACO)，用紧凑搜索状态表示（信息素分布、当前与历史最优解质量、迭代进度）在线调整信息素因子、启发式因子与蒸发率，从而为敏捷卫星海上动目标观测调度生成可行观测序列。在 14 个不同规模与卫星配置的场景上，IQACO 一致优于对比算法，平均目标值比传统 ACO 提升 2.86%–9.41%。
Motivation: 海上动目标连续运动使观测窗口随目标与轨道几何变化，调度需在时间窗、姿态机动与星上资源约束下联合决定任务选择、卫星分配、窗口选择与排序，是动态、序列依赖的组合优化问题，传统 ACO 的搜索控制参数难以自适应。
Method: 离线训练 IQL 模块学习一个由信息素分布、当前/历史最优解质量与迭代进度构成的紧凑搜索状态到搜索行为的策略；在线调度时由 ACO 构造满足约束的可行观测序列，学习到的策略按当前搜索状态自适应调整信息素因子、启发式因子与蒸发率，而非直接学任务选择策略。
Result: 在 14 个不同规模与卫星配置的场景上，IQACO 一致优于所比较算法，平均目标值较传统 ACO 提升 2.86%–9.41%；补充对比实验显示其在不同调度条件与问题设置下均有效且稳健。
Conclusion: 离线价值学习可作为受约束海上动目标观测调度的有效自适应搜索控制机制，把学习嵌入构造式启发式比直接学调度策略更合适。

papers.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax output. From this representation, we derive a single commitment rule: the model commits to an answer only when its lower probability exceeds the upper probability of every alternative, and otherwise returns the set of answers that no plausible predictor rules out. We apply this commitment rule at two depths: Credal Token Commitment (CTC) applies it to answer tokens from one ensemble forward pass, which decides constrained answers without any generation; for open-ended answers, credal decoding extends a partial answer only when no completed answer dominates it, so that the completions produced are those the plausible predictors license, and Credal Semantic Commitment (CSC) applies the rule to their meaning clusters. We evaluate CLLMs with Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B on OpenBookQA, CoQA, TriviaQA and ARC-Challenge. On multiple choice, CTC commits on 73-91% of questions at 89-98% accuracy, returns sets of 1.1-1.5 options containing the gold one on 89-98%, and its intervals contain the observed accuracy in 24 of 30 confidence bins without calibration; corrupted context lowers commitment from 87-92% to 65-71%, and on Gemma the credal bound detects corruption better than every baseline. On open-ended QA, CLLM outperforms semantic entropy and Laplace-LoRA at a fixed coverage by up to 19% and 9.5% absolute accuracy on CoQA and TriviaQA with context, for every backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Credal LLM (CLLM)：用 LoRA 适配器集成诱导 credal set，以区间上下概率代替单一 softmax，并给出唯一承诺规则——当下概率超过所有备选的上概率时才作答，否则返回未被任何可信预测器排除的答案集合。在 Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 上，多选题以 89–98% 准确率在 73–91% 题目上承诺，返回 1.1–1.5 个含金标选项的集合；上下文被污染时承诺率从 87–92% 降至 65–71%。
Motivation: 标准 LLM 用单一预测分布表达不确定性，把认知无知与真实歧义混为一谈，导致流畅但错误且过度自信的回答。
Method: LoRA 适配器集成诱导 credal set，给出上下概率区间与单一承诺规则；分两层应用：Credal Token Commitment (CTC) 在一次集成前向中对答案 token 判定，无需生成；开放生成用 credal decoding 仅在无完成答案占优时扩展前缀，再由 Credal Semantic Commitment (CSC) 对语义簇施加同一规则。
Result: 多选题上 CTC 在 73–91% 题目上承诺，准确率 89–98%；返回 1.1–1.5 个选项的集合，89–98% 含金标；30 个置信分箱中 24 个的区间覆盖观测准确率（未做校准）。上下文污染使承诺率从 87–92% 降到 65–71%，Gemma 上 credal 界对污染的检测优于全部基线。开放问答在固定覆盖率下比 semantic entropy 与 Laplace-Lora 最多高 19% 与 9.5% 绝对准确率（CoQA、TriviaQA 带上下文，所有 backbone）。
Conclusion: 把不确定性表示为 credal set 并按单一规则作答，可在保持高准确率的同时给出可校准的承诺与可检测的上下文污染。

papers.title: The Exceedance Design Effect: Effective Sample Size for Thresholds under Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Suppose we want a cutoff that 90% of a population falls below. We estimate it from a sample, and another sample would give a different cutoff and a different fraction below it. We ask how much that fraction varies when observations come in independent groups, such as pupils in classrooms or sentences in news articles. We prove that grouping multiplies its large-sample variance by $1+(m-1)ρ_I(p)$, where $m$ is the group size, $p$ is the target fraction, and $ρ_I(p)$ measures whether two members of a group fall on the same side of the cutoff. That correlation can differ from the correlation between the scores themselves, and it changes with the target. We give a direct proof, a counterexample to using score correlation, and an extension to unequal group sizes. A dataset therefore does not have one effective sample size. How much information it contains depends on the question you ask. In our document experiment, the same 1,000 rows carried about 217 independent observations' worth of information at the median. At the 95th percentile, they carried about 621. Nothing about the dataset changed. We asked it a different question. The number of rows is a property of the dataset. The effective sample size belongs to the analysis.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 2 figures. Lean proofs and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21595640
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明当观测按组聚集（如学生按班级、句子按文章）时，阈值以下比例的渐近方差被放大 1+(m-1)ρ_I(p)，其中 ρ_I(p) 衡量同组两人是否落在同一侧，且随目标分位点变化。因此同一数据集没有唯一有效样本量：文档实验中 1,000 行在中位数处约相当于 217 个独立观测，在 95 分位处约 621 个，数据未变、问题变了信息量就变了。
Motivation: 按分位点/阈值估计比例时，若样本存在组内聚集，用分数间相关或单一有效样本量会给出错误的方差估计；有效样本量依赖于所问的具体分位点。
Method: 推导分组情形下阈值比例的大样本方差放大因子 1+(m-1)ρ_I(p)，给出直接证明、说明分数相关不适用的反例，并推广到组大小不等的情形；配文档数据实验。
Result: 渐近方差乘以 1+(m-1)ρ_I(p)；ρ_I(p) 可不同于分数间相关且随 p 变化。文档实验中同一 1,000 行在中位数处约含 217 个独立观测的信息，在 95 分位处约 621 个。
Conclusion: 行数是数据集属性，有效样本量属于分析：同一数据集对不同分位点问题携带的信息量不同，必须按目标阈值 p 计算 ρ_I(p)。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 渐近方差乘以 1+(m-1)ρ_I(p)；ρ_I(p) 可不同于分数间相关且随 p 变化。文档实验中同一 1,000 行在中位数处约含 217 个独立观测的信息，在 95 分位处约 621 个。
summary_sections.conclusion: 行数是数据集属性，有效样本量属于分析：同一数据集对不同分位点问题携带的信息量不同，必须按目标阈值 p 计算 ρ_I(p)。

papers.title: Adam at the Edge of Stability: Adaptive Feedback, Provable Oscillation, and Gradient Reversal
papers.abstract_en: The edge-of-stability (EoS) phenomenon of full-batch Adam has been widely observed, yet its underlying dynamical mechanism remains poorly understood. In this paper, we identify Adam's second-moment adaptation as a negative-feedback mechanism that drives the dynamics toward the stability boundary. We characterize this mechanism through the *active curvature*, namely, the preconditioned curvature along the preconditioned gradient direction, and establish rigorous characterizations in progressively richer settings: rank-one quadratics with momentum, diagonal quadratics, on which the active curvature separates from the sharpness, and general objectives. Importantly, the mechanism predicts *gradient reversal* of full-batch Adam near the edge: consecutive gradients repeatedly point in nearly opposite directions, as we observe across fully connected networks, ResNets, ViTs, LSTMs, GPT-2 medium, and Adam-family optimizers. Consistent with this picture, averaging iterates suppresses these fast oscillations and produces smoother and lower loss curves. Together, these results provide an important first step towards fully understanding the dynamical behavior of Adam's EoS through active curvature and gradient reversal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 full-batch Adam 的二阶矩自适应解释为把动力学推向稳定性边界的负反馈机制，并用 active curvature（沿预条件梯度方向的预条件曲率）刻画：在含动量的 rank-one 二次、对角二次到一般目标上，active curvature 与 sharpness 分离。该机制预测边缘处的 gradient reversal——相邻梯度近乎反向，作者在全连接网络、ResNet、ViT、LSTM、GPT-2 medium 与 Adam 系优化器上均观察到；对迭代取平均可抑制这种快振荡，得到更平滑且更低的 loss 曲线。
Motivation: full-batch Adam 的 edge-of-stability 现象被广泛观察到，但其背后的动力学机制仍不清楚，缺少能解释为何曲率被推到稳定性边界并导致振荡的理论刻画。
Method: 把 Adam 的二阶矩自适应建模为负反馈，引入 active curvature 作为核心量，依次在含动量的 rank-one 二次、对角二次（此处 active curvature 与 sharpness 分离）以及一般目标上给出严格刻画；再据此预测边缘处的 gradient reversal，并在多种网络架构与 Adam 系优化器上对照观察。
Result: 在全连接网络、ResNet、ViT、LSTM、GPT-2 medium 与 Adam-family 优化器上均观察到相邻梯度近乎反向的 gradient reversal；对迭代取平均抑制快振荡，loss 曲线更平滑且更低。
Conclusion: Adam 的 EoS 可以通过 active curvature 与 gradient reversal 这一负反馈图景来理解，取平均是缓解边缘快振荡的直接手段；作者将其定位为完全理解 Adam EoS 动力学的第一步。

papers.title: Geometric Data Perturbation with Noisy-Anchor Alignment for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Learning
papers.abstract_en: Geometric data perturbation enables one-shot representation sharing for privacy-preserving collaborative learning: each participant applies a secret distance-preserving transformation to its private data and uploads the resulting representation to a central analyst. We study analyst-participant collusion, in which a colluding participant discloses its data and transformation to help the analyst reconstruct another participant's data. Independent participant-specific transformations block direct inversion through a disclosed common transformation but leave uploads in incompatible coordinate systems, degrading pooled learning. Data Collaboration analysis restores compatibility by aligning transformed copies of a common anchor matrix withheld from the analyst. We show that, when the centered anchor matrix has full column rank, a colluder who discloses it enables exact recovery of every participant's transformation and inversion of noiseless private representations. Adding noise to private-data representations leaves this transformation-recovery channel intact and reduces leakage at a substantial utility cost. Instead, we perturb the anchor representations: each participant perturbs only its transformed anchor representation, preserving the geometry of its private-data upload while turning known-anchor transformation recovery into a noisy estimation problem. The analyst estimates the alignment using a spectral estimator for a generalized orthogonal Procrustes problem. We analyze recovery attacks against this protocol and compare both noise placements on the CelebA and VGGFace2 facial image datasets. Under the evaluated collusion attacks, noisy-anchor alignment retains higher downstream accuracy at low identity-linkage levels. Participant-count experiments examine the utility gains and limitations of larger collaborations at comparable measured linkage.
papers.comment: 18 pages total: 13-page main paper and 5-page supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 几何数据扰动的协作学习中，若合谋参与者泄露自己的数据与变换，中心化锚点矩阵（centered anchor matrix）满列秩时可精确恢复所有参与者的变换并反演无噪声私有表示；对私有表示加噪虽降低泄漏但效用代价大。改为只对锚点表示加噪，用广义正交 Procrustes 的谱估计器 (spectral estimator) 对齐，在 CelebA 与 VGGFace2 上于低身份关联 (identity-linkage) 水平下保持更高的下游准确率。
Motivation: 参与者各自使用私有变换虽能阻断通过泄露的公共变换直接反演，但上传表示坐标系不兼容会损害合并学习；而合谋攻击可在锚点已知时精确恢复全部变换，需要在隐私与效用间重新选择加噪位置。
Method: 在 Data Collaboration analysis 的锚点对齐框架上，每个参与者只对自己变换后的锚点表示加噪，保持私有数据上传的几何不变；分析者用广义正交 Procrustes 问题的谱估计器估计对齐，并对针对该协议的恢复攻击做分析，比较对私有表示加噪与对锚点加噪两种方案。
Result: 在 CelebA 与 VGGFace2 人脸图像数据集上、在所评估的合谋攻击下，noisy-anchor alignment 在低身份关联水平下保持更高的下游准确率；另设参与者数量实验，考察在可比实测关联度下更大规模协作带来的效用增益与限制。
Conclusion: 把噪声放在锚点而非私有表示上，能在可评估的合谋攻击下以更小的效用代价阻断变换恢复通道，但该防护在低身份关联水平下才体现优势。
Relevance: 0
