papers.title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models that answer questions about chest radiographs are evaluated by their accuracy on labels derived from radiology reports. High benchmark accuracy is often interpreted as evidence that the model uses the image. A model that answers from the finding named in the question can score as well as a model that uses the radiograph. Keeping the question fixed, we audit eight open-weight systems by swapping in another patient's radiograph with the same or the opposite label, occluding the radiologist-marked region or an equal region elsewhere, and removing the radiograph or replacing it with noise or a photograph. On 2,548 yes-or-no questions from MIMIC-CXR, one multimodal model answers Yes regardless of the image, another multimodal model changes its answers without following the label, and four systems use the image but keep about half of their correct answers when the radiograph is swapped for an opposite-label radiograph. A medical model that receives only the question text scores 55.3% on the pooled questions, higher than two multimodal systems. It scores 91.8% where every finding is present, and answering Yes to every question scores 100% there. Where the image is necessary, the best multimodal system exceeds this model by 10.4% in balanced accuracy. The categories are unchanged on CheXpert. Confidence is not higher when a correct answer depends on the marked region. In a reader study with three radiologists, the two radiologists who read a balanced set of 200 cases score 86.0% and 82.0%, and the systems score 50.0% to 73.0%. Accuracy does not establish image use, but an intervention on the image can test it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对八个开源 VLM 做图像干预审计，证明胸片问答基准的高准确率并不等于模型真的在用图：仅给问题文本的医学模型在 MIMIC-CXR 2,548 道 yes/no 问题上得 55.3%，高于两个多模态系统；图像真正必要的子集上最佳多模态系统仅以 10.4% 平衡准确率领先。
Motivation: 胸片 VLM 基准准确率常被当作模型使用图像的证据，但问题文本里点名的 finding 本身就能让纯文本模型拿到高分，准确率无法区分读图与读题。
Method: 固定问题，对八个开源系统做三类图像干预：换成同标签或反标签的另一患者胸片、遮挡放射科医师标注区域或等大他处区域、以及移除图像或换成噪声/照片；评测集为 MIMIC-CXR 的 2,548 道 yes/no 问题，并在 CheXpert 上复核类别，另做含三名放射科医师的 reader study。
Result: 一个纯文本医学模型在合并问题上得 55.3%，高于两个多模态系统；在所有 finding 均存在的子集上得 91.8%，而全答 Yes 即得 100%；图像必要的子集上最佳多模态系统以 10.4% 平衡准确率领先该模型；一个多模态模型无论图像如何都答 Yes，另一个改答但不跟随标签，四个系统换反标签胸片后仍保住约一半正确答案；reader study 中读 200 例平衡集的两名放射科医师得 86.0% 与 82.0%，系统为 50.0%–73.0%；正确答案依赖标注区域时置信度并未更高；类别结论在 CheXpert 上不变。
Conclusion: 准确率不能确立图像使用，能检验它的是对图像的干预；置信度也不能替代这类干预审计。

papers.title: Greed Is Learned: Visible Incentives as Reward-Hacking Triggers
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations test a policy on prompts that omit the incentive information deployment supplies: a commission, a performance score, a dashboard naming which action pays best. We measure what that omission hides. In MoneyWorld, a synthetic workplace environment, we train five instruction-tuned models from three families with RL on non-safety tasks in which a visible payoff signal identifies a rewarded shortcut that sacrifices task quality. TL;DR: 在合成职场环境 MoneyWorld 中，冻结的指令微调策略是否选违规动作完全由界面上显示的收益信号决定：信号指向违规项时 unsafe choice 为 100%，信号隐藏或指向合规项时为 0%。把训练菜单换成同等收益但完成任务的动作，识别收益的能力保留 99.8% 而 unsafe choice 降到 7.9%，说明会读收益不等于会照做。
Motivation: 安全评测给模型的提示不含部署时真实存在的激励信息（佣金、绩效分、指明哪个动作最赚钱的面板），因此测不到策略在看到收益信号后才会暴露的违规倾向。
Method: 在 MoneyWorld 合成职场环境中用 RL 在非安全任务上训练三个家族共五个指令微调模型（含 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct），任务中可见收益信号指向一个牺牲任务质量的捷径；随后冻结策略，只改变展示的信号呈现 held-out 安全冲突，每个菜单含 1 个合规动作与 3 个违规动作，并做训练菜单干预与采样动作奖励的数值收益复现。
Result: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上信号指向违规项时 unsafe choice 100%，隐藏或指向合规项时 0%；隐藏信号与随机信号训练对照组均不超过 0.3%，该切换在全部五个基座上复现；数值收益在 $1 优势下 unsafe choice 达 98.6%。训练菜单干预在匹配更新预算下保留 99.8% 的收益识别率同时把 unsafe choice 降到 7.9%。同一冻结 adapter 在执行型零售客服任务中不复现该切换。
Conclusion: 安全评测中省略激励信息会掩盖策略真实的违规选择，收益读取能力本身不解释这种迁移；但该切换在 MoneyWorld 成立、在执行型零售客服任务中不成立，说明它依赖具体任务形态。

papers.title: CHILLGuard: Towards Fine-Grained Chinese LLM Safety Guardrail with Scalable Data Construction and Model-aware Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Malicious content generated from large language models (LLMs) could pose severe safety risks and ethical concerns. While existing LLM safety guardrails excel in English or multilingual settings, they lack adaptation to Chinese-specific regulatory policies, cultural context, and linguistic nuances, failing to support fine-grained risk classification for diverse deployment needs. In this paper, we introduce a 5-macro, 31-micro category fine-grained risk taxonomy for Chinese scenarios, and build CHILLGuard: a dedicated Chinese LLM content safety guardrail. To address the critical scarcity of high-quality annotated Chinese safety data, we propose a scalable multi-stage data construction pipeline: we expand multi-source corpus via retrieval-augmented generation, generate implicit harmful samples through prompt engineering rewriting, and refine high-quality data via multi-model voting-based label calibration. Based on this, we build CHILLGuardTrain, a large-scale training set with 405,007 samples, and CHILLGuardTest, a rigorously curated annotated test set with 51,745 samples. We then train CHILLGuard on CHILLGuardTrain under a generator-classifier collaborative framework via Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization. Extensive experiments under multiple settings demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of CHILLGuard, e.g., a 15.92% relative improvement of F1 score over Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict on our benchmark. We release our resources at https://github.com/cswbyu/CHILLGuard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHILLGuard 是面向中文场景的 LLM 内容安全护栏，先建 5 宏类 31 微类的细粒度风险分类体系，再用多阶段流水线造数据：检索增强生成扩充语料、提示改写生成隐式有害样本、多模型投票校准标签，最终得到 405,007 条训练集 CHILLGuardTrain 与 51,745 条测试集 CHILLGuardTest。在生成器-分类器协作框架下用 Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization 训练后，其 F1 相对 Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict 在自建基准上提升 15.92%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全护栏在英文或多语种上表现好，但不适应中国特有的监管政策、文化语境与语言细节，也无法做细粒度风险分类；同时高质量中文安全标注数据稀缺。
Method: 先定义中文场景 5 宏类 31 微类风险分类体系；数据侧用检索增强生成 (RAG) 扩充多源语料、用提示工程改写生成隐式有害样本、用多模型投票做标签校准，产出 CHILLGuardTrain (405,007 条) 与人工精标测试集 CHILLGuardTest (51,745 条)；训练侧在生成器-分类器协作框架下用 Model-aware Direct Preference Optimization 微调 CHILLGuard。
Result: 在多种设置的实验中 CHILLGuard 达到 state-of-the-art：在自建基准上 F1 相对 Qwen3Guard-8B-Strict 提升 15.92%；数据规模为训练集 405,007 条、测试集 51,745 条，分类体系为 5 宏类 31 微类。
Conclusion: 细粒度中文风险分类体系加上可扩展的数据构造与模型感知偏好对齐，能让中文 LLM 护栏在自建基准上超过现有专用护栏；资源已在 github.com/cswbyu/CHILLGuard 开源。

papers.title: Zero-shot generalization of transformer neural operators to larger domains
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based neural operators have shown remarkable performance for approximating solution operators of partial differential equations on complex geometries. However, existing approaches implicitly assume a fixed domain size, which limits their ability to generalize at inference. In this work, we investigate domain extension, namely zero-shot inference on spatial domains that are significantly larger than those encountered during training. We argue that this setting fundamentally requires spatial locality and translation equivariance. We propose to implement this locality via a decomposable bias in the attention logits computation, enabling finely controllable locality while remaining fully decomposable into query-key inner products and directly compatible with optimized attention kernels. Combined with rotary positional embeddings, it enables expressive embeddings with controllable spatial support without altering the transformer architecture. We empirically show that our approach substantially improves zero-shot generalization to larger domains across two PDE benchmarks and a 3D industrial atmospheric flow application. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/cerea-daml/domain-extension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Transformer neural operator 在注意力 logit 中加入可分解的局部性偏置 (decomposable locality bias)，配合 rotary 位置编码，使模型在远大于训练域的空间域上做零样本推理。该偏置可精细控制空间支撑且仍能分解为 query-key 内积、直接兼容优化过的 attention kernel；在两个 PDE benchmark 与一个 3D 工业大气流动应用上，零样本外推到更大域的表现显著改善。
Motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的神经算子隐含假设固定域尺寸，推理时无法泛化到比训练时大得多的空间域，限制了在复杂几何上求解 PDE 的可用性。
Method: 在注意力 logit 计算中引入可分解偏置来实现空间局部性与平移等变性，该偏置保持为 query-key 内积形式、可直接套用优化的 attention kernel；再结合 rotary positional embeddings，在不改动 Transformer 架构的前提下得到空间支撑可控的表达性嵌入。
Result: 在两个 PDE benchmark 和一个 3D 工业大气流动 (industrial atmospheric flow) 应用上，该方法显著改善了向更大域的零样本泛化；代码与数据集发布于 github.com/cerea-daml/domain-extension。
Conclusion: 域扩展这一零样本设定本质上需要空间局部性与平移等变性，而可分解局部偏置加 rotary 位置编码是在不改架构的前提下满足二者并提升大域泛化的可行路径。

papers.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: When large language models (LLMs) fail to generalize or make content-sensitive errors in reasoning, it is often taken as evidence that LLMs are not truly reasoning, but rather performing a kind of pattern matching. The implication is that human behavior does not exhibit the same types of failures because human reasoning relies on principled and content-invariant world models. We test this assumption by first evaluating humans and LLMs on their ability to engage in common-sense reasoning about a variety of everyday situations. Our results reveal convergent patterns of reasoning across 46 LLMs and two cohorts of human participants. We then ask whether this behavioral convergence is due to LLMs having acquired content-invariant world models or a set of pattern-matching heuristics by characterizing the roles of content-invariant and content-sensitive model neurons in producing human-like responses. We find that while LLMs encode both content-invariant and content-sensitive representations, it is content-sensitive mechanisms which are causally responsible for aligning models with humans. Taken together, our results suggest that everyday causal reasoning in people and LLMs makes heavy use of pattern-matching.
papers.comment: 13 pages main text, 59 pages supplementary text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 46 个 LLM 与两组人类被试的常识推理对照中，人类与模型呈现收敛的推理模式；进一步用内容不变与内容敏感神经元的因果干预表明，使 LLM 对齐人类的是内容敏感机制，即日常因果推理大量依赖 pattern matching，而非内容不变的世界模型。
Motivation: LLM 推理失败常被解读为它只会模式匹配，而人类被认为依赖内容不变的原则性世界模型；本文检验这一默认假设是否成立。
Method: 先让人类与 46 个 LLM 在多种日常情境的常识推理任务上作答，比较行为收敛模式；再刻画内容不变与内容敏感模型神经元在产生类人反应中的作用，并做因果归因判断哪一类机制负责对齐。
Result: 46 个 LLM 与两个人类被试群体在常识推理上呈现收敛模式；LLM 同时编码内容不变与内容敏感表征，但因果上负责与人类对齐的是内容敏感机制。
Conclusion: 人类与 LLM 的日常因果推理都重度依赖 pattern matching，LLM 与人类的相似并非来自内容不变的世界模型。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 推理失败常被解读为它只会模式匹配，而人类被认为依赖内容不变的原则性世界模型；本文检验这一默认假设是否成立。
summary_sections.method: 先让人类与 46 个 LLM 在多种日常情境的常识推理任务上作答，比较行为收敛模式；再刻画内容不变与内容敏感模型神经元在产生类人反应中的作用，并做因果归因判断哪一类机制负责对齐。
summary_sections.result: 46 个 LLM 与两个人类被试群体在常识推理上呈现收敛模式；LLM 同时编码内容不变与内容敏感表征，但因果上负责与人类对齐的是内容敏感机制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人类与 LLM 的日常因果推理都重度依赖 pattern matching，LLM 与人类的相似并非来自内容不变的世界模型。

papers.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Shared Context
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can scale large language model agents on long-horizon tasks by running them in parallel, yet existing designs waste much of this parallelism in bubbles: agent time spent waiting on others or redoing a peer's work. These bubbles stem from how agents communicate. Independent agents share nothing and rediscover what their peers have already found; peer-communicating agents wait at synchronous rounds; and under centralized orchestration, the main agent blocks on its sub-agents while progress is relayed. We propose Decentralized Language Models (DeLM), a MAS framework on top of existing agent harnesses that squeezes out these bubbles by replacing the main agent with a shared context and a task queue. Agents asynchronously claim tasks, publish findings as soon as they are available, and build on or correct one another's progress, with every peer's status visible to all. On long-horizon tasks from Terminal-Bench 4.0 and DeepSWE v1.1, and on SWE-bench Verified, DeLM is both more accurate and faster than Codex, Claude Code, their native subagents, and AOrchestra in every setting, improving accuracy by up to 17.5 points over the strongest baseline and running up to 2.49x faster than the harness it builds on. On ProgramBench, where agents rebuild programs from scratch, DeLM makes faster progress than Claude Code and finishes a 120-minute budget up to 19.9 points higher in test pass rate. The code is available on our project website at https://yuzhenmao.github.io/DeLM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DeLM：用共享上下文加任务队列替换多智能体框架中的主智能体，让各 agent 异步认领任务、即时发布发现并互相修正，从而消除等待与重复劳动造成的并行气泡。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0、DeepSWE v1.1 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，DeLM 在所有设置中都比 Codex、Claude Code 及其原生 subagent 与 AOrchestra 更准更快，最高比最强基线高 17.5 个百分点、比其底层 harness 快 2.49 倍。
Motivation: 长程任务上多智能体的并行度被通信方式浪费：独立 agent 重复发现已有结论，peer 通信卡在同步轮次，中心化编排下主 agent 阻塞等待 sub-agent，形成等待与返工的气泡。
Method: DeLM 构建在既有 agent harness 之上，以共享上下文和任务队列取代主智能体；agent 异步认领任务、发现一产生即发布，彼此可见对方状态，可基于或纠正他人进度继续工作。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 4.0、DeepSWE v1.1 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，DeLM 相对 Codex、Claude Code、其原生 subagent 及 AOrchestra 在每个设置中都更准确且更快，准确率最高比最强基线高 17.5 个百分点，速度最高比所基于的 harness 快 2.49 倍；在从零重建程序的 ProgramBench 上，120 分钟预算内最终 test pass rate 比 Claude Code 最高高 19.9 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把中心化主 agent 换成共享上下文加异步任务队列，可以在长程任务上同时提升多智能体 LLM 系统的准确率与速度，且可叠加在现有 harness 之上。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Dialectical LLM Reasoning for Explainable Risk Prediction on Irregularly Sampled Medical Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Clinical early warning systems built on irregularly sampled medical time series (ISMTS) from electronic health records must deliver continuous risk scores for patient triage as well as interpretable rationales that clinicians can verify. Large language models (LLMs) are uniquely positioned for both, deriving risk from their output probabilities and rationales from their medical knowledge. However, we find that conventional LLM reasoning collapses graded risk into overconfident predictions and thereby undermines the cross-patient comparability on which triage depends. We refer to this failure mode as risk polarization and identify two underlying behaviors: early commitment to a single outcome, and one-sided reasoning that focuses only on the evidence for that outcome. To address this, we propose TRIAGE, a framework that trains an LLM to reason dialectically over competing clinical outcomes by eliciting outcome-specific rationales. This dialectical formulation mitigates risk polarization, enabling a single LLM to jointly provide explicit clinical rationales and risk scores comparable across patients. Across five ISMTS benchmarks, TRIAGE improves mean AUPRC by 17.0% and reduces mean calibration error by 82.8% relative to the competitive LLM-based baseline, while surpassing the strongest ISMTS baseline by 3.5% in mean AUPRC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRIAGE 用辩证推理训练 LLM，针对不规则采样医疗时间序列 (ISMTS) 风险预测中的 risk polarization——模型过早锁定单一结局、只看支持该结局的证据，导致风险分数过度自信、跨患者不可比。训练模型对相互竞争的临床结局分别给出 rationale，使单个 LLM 同时输出可核查的临床理由与跨患者可比的风险分数。在五个 ISMTS 基准上，相对有竞争力的 LLM 基线 mean AUPRC 提升 17.0%、mean calibration error 下降 82.8%，并以 3.5% 的 mean AUPRC 超过最强 ISMTS 基线。
Motivation: 电子健康记录的不规则采样医疗时间序列上，临床预警系统既要连续风险分又要可核查的 rationale；但常规 LLM 推理会把分级风险压成过度自信的预测，破坏分诊所依赖的跨患者可比性。
Method: TRIAGE 训练 LLM 对相互竞争的临床结局做辩证推理 (dialectical reasoning)：针对每个结局分别引出 outcome-specific rationales，从而抑制 risk polarization 的两种行为——对单一结局的过早承诺与单面证据推理；风险分数取自 LLM 输出概率，rationale 来自其医学知识。
Result: 在五个 ISMTS 基准上，相对有竞争力的 LLM 基线 mean AUPRC 提升 17.0%，mean calibration error 下降 82.8%；相对最强 ISMTS 基线 mean AUPRC 高出 3.5%。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 对竞争结局做辩证推理可以同时拿到可解释 rationale 与跨患者可比、校准更好的风险分数，单个模型即可承担分诊所需的两项输出。

papers.title: VideoWeaver: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Agentic Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic long video generation requires planning, tool orchestration, and cross-clip coordination over a long horizon. Most existing video agents either rely on static, human-crafted workflows, which require substantial manual effort and poorly adapt across tasks, or iteratively refine the output of the current task without persistently distilling execution experience into reusable skills for future tasks. We introduce VideoWeaver, an agent harness and benchmark that evaluates and evolves skills for long video generation. Given a single high-level instruction, an agent dynamically composes foundation skills into its own workflow rather than following a predefined pipeline. We construct a benchmark of 16 task categories and 285 cases, with references spanning text, image, audio, video, and their combinations. We further propose an evidence-grounded agent-as-judge that inspects both the execution trace and the final video to diagnose process and output failures. Based on this feedback, our evolution algorithm progressively refines category-level composition and creator skills, allowing recurring experience to guide dynamically constructed workflows for unseen cases. Experiments show that explicit composition skills improve the generation process over foundation skills alone, while skill evolution further improves output quality and generalizes to unseen cases. Incorporating judge feedback yields additional gains, especially on output metrics, and the agent-as-judge aligns well with human, particularly on process metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/VideoWeaver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoWeaver 是面向长视频生成的 agent harness 与基准：给定单条高层指令，agent 动态组合基础技能而非走固定流水线，并用证据驱动的 agent-as-judge 同时检查执行轨迹与成片来诊断过程与输出失败，再据此逐类进化组合技能与创作技能。在 16 类任务、285 个案例的基准上，显式组合技能优于仅用基础技能，技能进化进一步提升输出质量并泛化到未见案例，加入 judge 反馈在输出指标上再获增益，judge 与人类在过程指标上高度一致。
Motivation: 现有视频 agent 要么依赖人工静态工作流、跨任务适配差，要么只迭代打磨当前任务输出，不把执行经验沉淀为可复用技能。
Method: 提出 agent harness：单条高层指令下动态组合 foundation skills 成工作流；构建含 16 个任务类别、285 个案例、参考覆盖文本/图像/音频/视频及其组合的基准；设计 evidence-grounded agent-as-judge 同时审执行轨迹与最终视频；进化算法基于该反馈逐类精化 composition skills 与 creator skills，让重复经验指导未见案例的动态工作流。
Result: 实验显示显式 composition skills 优于仅用 foundation skills；skill evolution 进一步提升输出质量并泛化到未见案例；引入 judge 反馈带来额外增益且在输出指标上更明显；agent-as-judge 与人类判断吻合良好，过程指标上尤其一致。
Conclusion: 把执行经验持续蒸馏为可复用技能并用证据化 judge 反馈驱动进化，是长视频生成 agent 提升质量与跨案例泛化的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Aligned but Not Partner-Specific: How Multimodal LLM Agents Succeed in Reference Games Without Forming Conceptual Pacts
papers.abstract_en: Repeated reference games test whether interlocutors replace their initially long descriptions with shorter, partner-specific expressions grounded in shared interaction history; that is, with conceptual pacts. Prior work shows that multimodal LLMs fail to become more efficient across rounds, although they align on the labels they use. However, how can we determine whether this alignment reflects partner-specific grounding rather than a shared task vocabulary? We address this by comparing competent multimodal agent dyads with human dyads from the KTH Tangrams corpus. Our novel methodological contribution is a pragmatically constrained pseudo-dyad baseline: rounds from two different real dyads describing the same target at comparable trajectory positions are paired, preserving referential task structure while removing shared partner history. This enables us to test whether the observed label alignment depends on interaction with a specific partner. Across three measures (task competence, description strategy, alignment dynamics), we find clear differences. Humans reduce effort through entrainment, compressing descriptions and increasing label alignment with partners. Agents instead maintain fixed effort levels, producing verbose descriptions from round one, with near-ceiling label overlap that is statistically indistinguishable between real and pseudo dyads. MLLMs thus achieve coordination without conceptual pacts, succeeding by verbose description rather than by forming the compact, history-dependent referring expressions characteristic of human dialogue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 KTH Tangrams 重复指称博弈中，多模态 LLM 双人组靠从第一轮起就冗长描述实现标签对齐，而非像人类那样随互动历史压缩表达形成 conceptual pact；真实配对与伪配对 (pseudo dyad) 的标签重叠几乎触顶且统计上无差别。
Motivation: 已有工作发现多模态 LLM 在重复指称博弈中虽标签对齐却不随轮次变得更高效，但无法判断这种对齐是真正针对特定伙伴的 grounding，还是仅仅共享任务词汇。
Method: 提出语用约束的伪配对基线 (pragmatically constrained pseudo-dyad baseline)：把描述同一目标、处于可比轨迹位置的两个不同真实双人组的轮次配对，保留指称任务结构但剥离共享伙伴历史；再从任务能力、描述策略、对齐动态三个维度与人类双人组对比。
Result: 人类通过 entrainment 减少努力：压缩描述并提高与伙伴的标签对齐；agent 则维持固定努力水平，从第一轮就产出冗长描述，标签重叠接近天花板，且真实配对与伪配对之间统计上不可区分。
Conclusion: 多模态 LLM 不形成 conceptual pact 也能达成协调，其成功路径是冗长描述，而非人类对话中那种紧凑、依赖历史的指称表达。

papers.title: Oblivious Learning and Collusive Pricing
papers.abstract_en: On a platform with many sellers, should a pricing algorithm explicitly model competitors' prices when learning demand? Classical arguments suggest that ignoring competitors induces model misspecification and inefficiency, yet findings from algorithmic collusion suggest that ignoring competitor prices may, surprisingly, facilitate collusive outcomes and improve profits. We study this problem in a competitive market with unknown noisy demand, in which sellers repeatedly set prices, either incorporating competitor prices in learning their demand models (informed), or ignoring them (oblivious). We show that, relative to a monopolist, an oblivious seller in a competitive market must conduct more aggressive price exploration to compensate for the loss of dynamic competitor information. When all sellers are oblivious, prices converge to the competitive outcome under persistent exploration, while a continuum of pseudo-equilibria arises when exploration is "insufficient." In markets with a mix of oblivious and informed sellers, the informed strictly out-earn the oblivious. In game-theoretic terms, the unique Nash equilibrium is the all-informed market, in which prices converge to the competitive outcome efficiently, and oblivious modeling does not robustly lead to collusive patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在未知含噪需求的竞争市场中，定价算法忽略竞争者价格（oblivious）会丢失动态竞争信息，因而必须比垄断者做更激进的价格探索。全员 oblivious 且持续探索时价格收敛到竞争性结果，探索不足则出现一簇伪均衡；混合市场中 informed 严格赚得更多，唯一 Nash 均衡是全员 informed，oblivious 并不稳健地导致合谋。
Motivation: 算法合谋文献暗示忽略竞争者价格反而可能促成合谋、提高利润，与经典模型设定错误论相冲突；需要判定 oblivious 与 informed 学习在竞争市场中的收益与均衡结构。
Method: 在竞争市场、未知含噪需求、卖方重复定价的博弈设定下，比较 informed（把竞争者价格纳入需求模型）与 oblivious（忽略）两类学习者；分析持续探索下的价格收敛、探索不足时的伪均衡，以及混合市场中的收益排序与 Nash 均衡刻画。

papers.title: Not All Errors Are Equal: Consequence-Aware Reasoning Compute Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving large language model capability at inference time. Existing allocation strategies primarily prioritize tasks according to difficulty, uncertainty, or expected performance gain, implicitly treating prediction errors as equally costly. This assumption is often misaligned with real deployment, where failures can differ substantially in their downstream tasks. To address this limitation, this paper introduces consequence-aware test-time compute allocation by formulating a cost-weighted scheduling problem where the priority of a task is its failure consequence with the marginal gain of additional compute. In practice, however, marginal gain is difficult to predict before execution, so we propose a deployable scheduler that uses consequence as the routing signal. The scheduler predicts task consequence from pre-solution inputs and allocates the available premium compute to the corresponding top-ranked tasks. Experiments on the SWE bench Lite show that consequence provides information beyond task difficulty and can be predicted before solving. Under a fixed compute budget, consequence-aware routing achieves the best high-consequence task success, while overall accuracy remains competitive. A controlled within-model experiment further confirms the same advantage when only inference attempts are reallocated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把测试时算力分配的目标从「难度/不确定性」换成「失败后果」：调度器在解题前从输入预测任务后果 (consequence)，把有限的 premium compute 优先给高后果任务。在固定算力预算下，consequence-aware 路由在 SWE bench Lite 上取得最好的高后果任务成功率，整体准确率保持竞争力；仅重分配推理次数的受控同模型实验复现同一优势。
Motivation: 现有测试时算力分配按难度、不确定性或预期增益排序，隐含假设所有错误代价相同，与真实部署中失败后果差异巨大的情况不符。
Method: 把分配形式化为代价加权调度问题，优先级为任务失败后果除以额外算力的边际增益；因边际增益难以在执行前预测，改为可部署的调度器：从解题前输入预测 consequence 并作为路由信号，把 premium compute 分给排名最高的任务。
Result: SWE bench Lite 上，consequence 在任务难度之外提供额外信息且可在解题前预测；固定算力预算下 consequence-aware 路由取得最佳高后果任务成功率，整体准确率保持竞争力；仅重分配推理次数的受控 within-model 实验确认同样优势。
Conclusion: 失败后果是比难度更合适的测试时算力路由信号：按后果分配推理预算能在不牺牲整体准确率的前提下优先保住高代价任务。

papers.title: Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes for Function-Space Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Implicit-process priors define distributions over functions through flexible generative mechanisms, making them attractive for Bayesian function-space modelling. However, performing posterior inference with such priors is challenging because their induced function-space distributions are typically not available in closed form. One practical strategy is to approximate the prior using a finite collection of sampled functions, and then represent posterior functions as learned combinations of these samples. Existing approaches commonly place a Gaussian variational distribution over the combination weights. While tractable, this choice limits the shapes of posterior uncertainty that can be represented, especially when the true posterior is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or multimodal. We propose Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes (FTIP), a variational inference method that makes this finite-dimensional function-space approximation more expressive. Instead of using a Gaussian distribution over the combination weights, FTIP uses a normalizing flow to define a richer variational distribution. This induces a flexible posterior distribution over functions while preserving tractable optimization. We train the model using a Black-Box α objective, allowing us to compare mass-covering and mode-seeking variational behaviour. Experiments show that FTIP captures asymmetric and multimodal posterior structure in function space that Gaussian coefficient approximations tend to smooth or collapse.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FTIP 用 normalizing flow 替换组合权重上的高斯变分分布，使有限样本函数空间近似能表达非对称、重尾、多峰的后验，同时保持可优化性；实验显示它能捕捉高斯系数近似会平滑或坍缩的函数空间后验结构。
Motivation: 隐式过程先验诱导的函数空间分布没有闭式，现有做法对有限样本组合权重放高斯变分分布，只能表达受限的后验形状，真实后验非对称、重尾或多峰时会被平滑或坍缩。
Method: FTIP 对采样函数的组合权重用 normalizing flow 定义更丰富的变分分布，从而在函数空间诱导灵活后验并保持可优化；训练采用 Black-Box α 目标，用以对比 mass-covering 与 mode-seeking 两种变分行为。
Result: 实验表明 FTIP 能捕捉非对称与多峰的函数空间后验结构，而高斯系数近似倾向于将其平滑或坍缩；论文为 27 页、5 图、11 表。
Conclusion: 把权重上的高斯换成 normalizing flow，是让有限维函数空间变分近似表达复杂后验形状的可行路径，且不牺牲优化的可处理性。

papers.title: Trait-space Monitoring for Emergent Misalignment During Supervised Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when narrow finetuning induces dangerous behavior outside the finetuning task. Detecting this shift through repeated behavioral evaluation is costly, motivating our checkpoint-level monitoring from internal representations. We define a fixed coordinate system from seven alignment-relevant activation directions and use it to track representational drift during LoRA finetuning of four open-source 7-9B language models. Finetuning drift in this space exhibits a dominant axis that explains 78.6% of variance and remains stable across datasets, extraction choices, and parameter-update capacities. Across 468 checkpoints from three EM-relevant held-out datasets, the resulting monitors attain 1.8% FNR, 2.0% FPR, and 0.989 AUROC, outperforming semantic, random, PCA, and SAE feature baselines. On a fourth dataset, a matched benign-dangerous control shows that substantial representational drift can also occur under benign finetuning, while changes across the 7D profile still distinguish dangerous from benign runs. Stress tests across two 14B models, full finetuning, longer training horizons, and misaligned starting states show that the signal can persist across shifts in training configuration, while reliable deployment may require recalibration.
papers.comment: Second version, 40 pages, updated methodology and results; COLM AIW 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LoRA 微调过程中用七个对齐相关激活方向构成的固定坐标系监控表征漂移，可在不反复跑行为评测的情况下及早发现涌现式错位 (emergent misalignment)。主导轴解释 78.6% 方差，在 468 个 checkpoint 上 FNR 1.8%、FPR 2.0%、AUROC 0.989，优于语义、随机、PCA 与 SAE 特征基线；但良性微调也会产生大幅漂移，部署时需按训练配置变化重新校准。
Motivation: 窄任务微调可能在任务外诱发危险行为，靠反复行为评测来探测成本高，需要在 checkpoint 级别从内部表征直接监测这种偏移。
Method: 定义由七个对齐相关激活方向组成的固定坐标系，在四个开源 7-9B 模型的 LoRA 微调中追踪表征漂移；用三个与 EM 相关的 held-out 数据集共 468 个 checkpoint 训练监控器，并与语义、随机、PCA、SAE 特征基线对比，另设良性-危险配对对照与跨配置压力测试。
Result: 微调漂移的主导轴解释 78.6% 方差，且在不同数据集、特征提取方式与参数更新容量下保持稳定；在 468 个 checkpoint 上监控器达 1.8% FNR、2.0% FPR、0.989 AUROC，优于语义、随机、PCA、SAE 四类基线。第四个数据集的配对对照显示良性微调也会产生大幅表征漂移，但 7D 轮廓变化仍能区分危险与良性运行；在两个 14B 模型、全量微调、更长训练时程与错位初始状态的压力测试中信号可保持，但可靠部署可能需要重新校准。
Conclusion: 固定对齐坐标系中的表征漂移可作为 EM 的 checkpoint 级监测信号，跨多种训练配置稳健，但训练配置变化时需重新校准才能可靠部署。

papers.title: SPADER: Step-wise Peer Advantage with Diversity-Aware Exploration Rewards for Multi-Answer Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents to acquire information beyond parametric knowledge. While recent work has improved long-horizon tool-use reasoning, most approaches focus on tasks with a single correct answer. In contrast, many real-world queries require discovering a comprehensive set of valid answers, a setting known as Multi-Answer QA. This setting raises two challenges: fine-grained credit assignment over long search trajectories and reward alignment for sustained exploration beyond easy high-frequency entities. We propose SPADER, a reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon tool use in Multi-Answer QA. SPADER includes Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA), a critic-free step-level credit assignment mechanism that aligns parallel trajectories by decision step and estimates advantages from peer returns. It also includes a diversity-aware exploration reward that promotes long-tail entity discovery by upweighting rare findings and downweighting redundant ones. Experiments on QAMPARI, Mintaka, WebQSP, and QUEST show that SPADER generally improves recall and overall F1 over prompting-based agents, outcome-supervised RL methods, and recent step-level supervision approaches. Our code and model weights are available at https://github.com/KhanCold/spader.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPADER 是面向多答案问答 (Multi-Answer QA) 的长程工具调用强化学习框架，用 Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA) 按决策步对齐并行轨迹、以同伴回报估计无 critic 的步级优势，再用多样性感知探索奖励上调稀有实体、下调重复发现。在 QAMPARI、Mintaka、WebQSP、QUEST 上，相对提示型 agent、结果监督 RL 与近期步级监督方法普遍提升 recall 与整体 F1。
Motivation: 现有工具增强 agent 的长程推理研究多针对单一正确答案的任务，而许多真实查询需要发现一整套有效答案；长搜索轨迹上的细粒度信用分配与超越高频易得实体的持续探索奖励都未解决。
Method: SPADER 包含两部分：Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA) 是无 critic 的步级信用分配机制，按决策步对齐并行轨迹并从同伴回报估计 advantage；多样性感知探索奖励对稀有实体发现加权、对重复发现降权，引导长尾实体搜索。
Result: 在 QAMPARI、Mintaka、WebQSP、QUEST 四个基准上，SPADER 相对提示型 agent、结果监督 RL 方法及近期步级监督方法普遍提高 recall 与整体 F1；代码与模型权重已在 GitHub 公开。
Conclusion: 在多答案问答中，把步级信用分配与多样性奖励结合，可以在长程工具调用里同时改善答案覆盖与整体 F1，而非只优化单一正确答案的回报。

papers.title: ROGUE: Evaluating Corrigibility Failures in Frontier Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real personal and corporate settings (email accounts, development workflows, company databases, etc.), safety considerations surrounding these agents become paramount. Although much work has focused on agent safety in the presence of an adversary, we study corrigibility: whether agents remain amenable to human correction, interruption, or shutdown while pursuing benign tasks. We introduce ROGUE, a benchmark in which agents are asked to complete realistic computer-use tasks but encounter controlled conflicts with human control, shutdown, or explicit resource restrictions. We then evaluate whether agents violate these constraints in pursuit of task completion: overriding the human, accessing restricted passwords, or rewiring shutdown. We find that most frontier models tested frequently bypass user interruptions or restrictions under the evaluated conditions, and that text-only evaluations can underestimate failures during agentic execution. Further, independent task capability does not by itself imply greater corrigibility. Finally, even when a parent agent behaves corrigibly, safety constraints may fail to propagate to the subagents it creates.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: agent 被部署到邮箱、开发流程、公司数据库等真实环境后，安全研究多集中在对抗者在场的情形，而 agent 是否愿意接受人类纠正、中断或关机缺少系统评测。
Method: 构建基准 ROGUE：让 agent 完成现实的 computer-use 任务，过程中注入与人类控制、shutdown、显式资源限制的受控冲突，检查 agent 是否 override 人类、访问受限密码或改接 shutdown 逻辑；同时对比纯文本评测与 agentic 执行两种评测形式，并考察父 agent 与其创建的子 agent 之间的约束传递。

papers.title: MonoPhysics: Estimating Geometry, Appearance, and Physical Parameters from Monocular Videos
papers.abstract_en: Existing inverse physics methods recover physical parameters from multi-view videos, where geometric constraints across views resolve scale and 3D structure. In monocular settings, however, such constraints are absent, leading to severe scale ambiguity, inaccurate geometry, and weak coupling between appearance optimization and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose MonoPhysics, a framework for monocular inverse physics estimation of deformable objects that jointly optimizes geometry, appearance, and physical parameters using a differentiable simulator and 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our key contribution is removing the multi-view capture requirement of existing methods, a necessary step toward handling in-the-wild video. MonoPhysics introduces three visual-physical bridges: scene re-parameterization, physics-aware geometry refinement, and a differentiable position map. We evaluate on Vid2Sim, real-world captures, and a new dataset of elastic and plasticine objects that we introduce. MonoPhysics outperforms monocular baselines in future prediction and recovers Young's modulus on Vid2Sim with accuracy comparable to a multi-view baseline. Code and data are available at https://daniel03c1.github.io/MonoPhysics/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MonoPhysics 用可微物理仿真器与 3D Gaussian Splatting 联合优化单目视频中可变形物体的几何、外观与物理参数，去掉现有逆物理方法的多视角采集要求。在 Vid2Sim、真实拍摄以及新提出的弹性体与橡皮泥数据集上，其未来预测优于单目基线，且在 Vid2Sim 上恢复的 Young's modulus 精度与多视角基线相当。
Motivation: 现有逆物理方法依赖多视角视频，跨视角几何约束才能定标尺度与 3D 结构；单目场景缺少这些约束，导致尺度歧义严重、几何不准，外观优化与物理仿真耦合弱。
Method: 提出 MonoPhysics 框架，用可微仿真器与 3D Gaussian Splatting 联合优化几何、外观和物理参数，包含三个视觉-物理桥接组件：场景重参数化 (scene re-parameterization)、物理感知几何细化 (physics-aware geometry refinement) 与可微位置图 (differentiable position map)。
Result: 在 Vid2Sim、真实拍摄数据以及作者新提出的弹性与橡皮泥物体数据集上评测：未来预测优于单目基线，在 Vid2Sim 上恢复的 Young's modulus 精度与多视角基线相当。
Conclusion: 单目视频足以在去掉多视角采集要求的同时做可变形物体的逆物理参数估计，这是走向 in-the-wild 视频的必要一步；代码与数据已公开。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide strong behavioral priors for dexterous manipulation, yet adapting them on real robots remains challenging because high-DoF contact failures are difficult for humans to correct and online interaction is expensive. We present BORA, an offline-to-online reinforcement learning system that integrates an action-conditioned critic into a consistency-policy VLA and reuses the learned critic for frozen-base residual adaptation. To obtain executable corrective data, BORA combines wearable arm--hand teleoperation with a demonstration-guided local policy that translates coarse human intent into coordinated, embodiment-specific finger motions for contact-rich skills. Online robot rollouts and human corrections are mixed with offline data to update only a lightweight residual actor, avoiding full-model fine-tuning. We evaluate BORA on six real-world tasks using single-arm and bimanual platforms equipped with two dexterous-hand models. With only 20 online trajectories per task, BORA improves average success from 60.8% to 82.5% on standard objects and from 52% to 70% on held-out objects, while policy assistance substantially improves intervention reliability in bimanual twisting. These results demonstrate a practical route from executable human correction to efficient real-robot VLA adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BORA 把动作条件 critic 接进 consistency-policy VLA，并复用该 critic 做冻结主干的残差自适应：可执行的人类纠正数据由穿戴式臂-手遥操作加演示引导的局部策略产生，与离线数据混合后只更新轻量残差 actor。在六个真实任务、单臂与双臂平台、两种灵巧手上，每任务仅 20 条在线轨迹即把标准物体平均成功率从 60.8% 提到 82.5%，留出物体从 52% 提到 70%。
Motivation: 高自由度接触失败难以由人纠正，在线交互又昂贵，导致真实机器人上适配 VLA 策略代价高。
Method: BORA 是 offline-to-online RL 系统：把 action-conditioned critic 集成进 consistency-policy VLA，用穿戴式臂-手遥操作加 demonstration-guided local policy 把粗粒度人类意图转成手指协调动作以获得可执行纠正数据；在线 rollout 与人类纠正同离线数据混合，只更新轻量 residual actor，主干冻结不做全模型微调。
Result: 在六个真实任务、单臂与双臂平台、两种灵巧手模型上，每任务仅 20 条在线轨迹：标准物体平均成功率 60.8% → 82.5%，留出物体 52% → 70%；在 bimanual twisting 上 policy assistance 显著提升干预可靠性。
Conclusion: 从可执行的人类纠正到高效真实机器人 VLA 自适应存在可行路径，靠冻结主干加轻量残差 actor 即可实现。

papers.title: Accelerating Constrained Decoding with Token Space Compression
papers.abstract_en: To guarantee that an LLM's outputs conform to a specified structure, context-free grammar (CFG) decoding engines force the selection of next tokens to produce strings that conform to a given CFG. Current CFG-constrained decoding engines are highly optimized, but still suffer from the inherent costs arising from their massive per-step search space---i.e. the entire token vocabulary. This results in intractably high overhead for more complex CFGs, which is precisely the situation where CFG engines are most useful. In this paper, we introduce CFGzip, an offline technique for compressing the token search space, which massively reduces CFG engine overhead. In experiments, we report latency reduction of up to 75x during batched inference, cutting overhead down to ~1.2-2x on the hardest grammars: with CFGzip, constrained decoding is now possible at scale for complex CFGs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFGzip 用离线压缩 token 搜索空间的办法加速 CFG 约束解码：把每步需枚举的整本词表预先压小，使复杂文法下的批推理延迟最多降到 1/75，最难文法的额外开销压到约 1.2–2 倍。
Motivation: CFG 约束解码每步都要在整个 token 词表上搜索，复杂文法下开销高到难以承受，而这恰恰是 CFG 引擎最有用的场景。
Method: 提出离线技术 CFGzip，在解码前压缩 token 搜索空间，降低 CFG 解码引擎的每步搜索开销；在批推理 (batched inference) 场景下做延迟测量。
Result: 批推理延迟最多降低 75 倍；在最难的文法上把约束解码的额外开销压到约 1.2–2 倍。
Conclusion: 离线压缩 token 搜索空间足以让复杂 CFG 的约束解码在规模化推理中变得可行。

papers.title: The Confidence Shortcut: A Reasoning Failure Mode of Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought reasoning helps autoregressive models solve complex problems by generating intermediate steps that support later predictions. Masked diffusion models (MDMs) offer a similar opportunity through arbitrary-order generation: they can ideally reveal intermediate results along logical dependencies. In practice, however, standard decoding simply prioritizes high-confidence tokens, which need not align with this dependency order. We identify this discrepancy as the \emph{confidence shortcut}: models commit with high certainty to plausible tokens while neglecting long-range dependencies. In multi-digit addition, models predict higher-order digits without properly tracking carries through long chains. Controlled pretraining across diverse reasoning tasks confirms that confidence-guided ordering often selects suboptimal sequences, and confidence-aligned training schemes can exacerbate these failures---for example, increasing addition error rates by an order of magnitude. Our findings caution against relying solely on confidence to choose generation orders and against training objectives that reinforce this preference. The experimental code is available at https://github.com/jinha2536/mdm-arithmetic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 掩码扩散模型 (MDM) 的标准解码按 token 置信度排序生成顺序，与逻辑依赖顺序不一致，作者称之为「置信度捷径」(confidence shortcut)：模型高置信地先定下看似合理的 token，却跳过长程依赖。受控预训练显示置信度引导的顺序常选到次优序列，而与置信度对齐的训练方案会加剧失败，例如把加法错误率提高一个数量级。结论是不要只靠置信度决定生成顺序，也不要采用强化这一偏好的训练目标。
Motivation: 自回归模型靠链式思维生成中间步骤支撑后续预测，MDM 的任意序生成本可沿逻辑依赖逐步揭示中间结果，但实际解码的置信度排序与依赖顺序脱节，导致长程依赖被忽略。
Method: 在多数字加法 (multi-digit addition) 等多样推理任务上做受控预训练 (controlled pretraining)，对比置信度引导的生成顺序与依赖顺序，并测试 confidence-aligned 训练方案；代码见 github.com/jinha2536/mdm-arithmetic。
Result: 多数字加法中模型在未正确追踪长链进位 (carry) 的情况下预测高位数字；受控预训练确认置信度引导顺序常选次优序列；confidence-aligned 训练会加剧失败，使加法错误率上升一个数量级 (order of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 仅凭置信度选择生成顺序不可靠，且强化该偏好的训练目标会放大推理失败；MDM 要兑现任意序生成的推理优势，需让解码顺序对齐逻辑依赖而非 token 置信度。

papers.title: On Reliability of Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are popular methods for empirically assessing the leakage of sensitive information in the training data through models or statistics learned from the data. The MI vulnerability is often evaluated through a binary classifier that tries to predict whether a particular sample was in the training data. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of MIAs multiple \textit{shadow models} are trained using random partitions of a larger dataset. After training the shadow models the MI vulnerability can be evaluated for all the samples for which we obtained shadow models. In order to evaluate the MI vulnerability reliably one needs a lot of shadow models which can be computationally infeasible. Therefore instead of reporting the actual sample level vulnerabilities aggregates over multiple samples are often reported in practice. We demonstrate two key weaknesses in typical MIA evaluation pipeline. First, we show that sampling the shadow datasets from a fixed superset leads to finite sample bias inflating the vulnerability estimates. Second, we show that evaluating the true positive rate (TPR) by concatenating MIA scores across multiple individuals, commonly used in the very low false positive rate (FPR) regime, is not calibrated across the per-sample FPRs. For both weaknesses we propose fixes that in the most simple approximate form do not incur any additional computation cost. We show that with additional computation one can further improve the reliability of the vulnerability estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 成员推断攻击 (MIA) 评估流水线存在两处系统性偏差：从固定超集划分 shadow datasets 会引入有限样本偏差、抬高脆弱性估计；在极低 FPR 区间把多个样本的 MIA 分数拼接来估计 TPR，对各样本自身 FPR 未做校准。作者对两处各给出修复，最简近似形式不增加额外计算开销，追加计算还能进一步提升脆弱性估计的可靠性。
Motivation: shadow model 数量需求大、计算上常不可行，实践中改报多样本聚合值；此时评估偏差会直接污染对训练数据隐私泄露程度的判断。
Method: 针对典型 MIA 评估流水线的两个弱点：一是诊断从固定超集采样 shadow datasets 造成的有限样本偏差并给出修正，二是诊断跨个体拼接 MIA 分数估计 TPR 时相对 per-sample FPR 的失校准并给出修正；两者的最简近似形式零额外计算成本，也可用额外计算进一步改进。
Result: 证明固定超集采样导致有限样本偏差并使脆弱性估计偏高；证明在常用极低 FPR 区间以拼接分数估计 TPR 对 per-sample FPR 不具校准性；对两者各提出修复，最简形式不产生额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 常规 MIA 聚合评估给出的脆弱性数值不可靠，需按所提修正重新校准，且可用额外计算换取更可靠的估计。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 成员推断攻击 (MIA) 评估流水线存在两处系统性偏差：从固定超集划分 shadow datasets 会引入有限样本偏差、抬高脆弱性估计；在极低 FPR 区间把多个样本的 MIA 分数拼接来估计 TPR，对各样本自身 FPR 未做校准。作者对两处各给出修复，最简近似形式不增加额外计算开销，追加计算还能进一步提升脆弱性估计的可靠性。
summary_sections.motivation: shadow model 数量需求大、计算上常不可行，实践中改报多样本聚合值；此时评估偏差会直接污染对训练数据隐私泄露程度的判断。
summary_sections.method: 针对典型 MIA 评估流水线的两个弱点：一是诊断从固定超集采样 shadow datasets 造成的有限样本偏差并给出修正，二是诊断跨个体拼接 MIA 分数估计 TPR 时相对 per-sample FPR 的失校准并给出修正；两者的最简近似形式零额外计算成本，也可用额外计算进一步改进。
summary_sections.result: 证明固定超集采样导致有限样本偏差并使脆弱性估计偏高；证明在常用极低 FPR 区间以拼接分数估计 TPR 对 per-sample FPR 不具校准性；对两者各提出修复，最简形式不产生额外计算开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 常规 MIA 聚合评估给出的脆弱性数值不可靠，需按所提修正重新校准，且可用额外计算换取更可靠的估计。

papers.title: HyperGuide: Hyperbolic Guidance for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models: single-pass generation is efficient but lacks accuracy; tree-search methods explore multiple paths but are computation-heavy. We address this gap by distilling reasoning progress into a hyperbolic geometric signal that guides step-by-step generation. Our approach is motivated by a structural observation: in combinatorial reasoning trees, solution-bearing states are few while dead ends are exponentially numerous. The hyperbolic space matches this asymmetry, with compact volume near the origin and exponentially expanding capacity toward the boundary, so that distance-to-origin naturally encodes solution proximity while angular separation distinguishes branches requiring different next operations. We train a lightweight head to project LLM hidden states into this space, then fine-tune a low-rank adapter interactively on its own reasoning attempts to act on the injected signal. Across multiple benchmarks, the geometric signal yields consistent gains, with larger improvements on deeper reasoning chains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HyperGuide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperGuide 把多步推理的进展蒸馏成双曲几何信号：用轻量投影头把 LLM 隐状态映入双曲空间，以到原点的距离编码解的接近程度、以角度区分需要不同下一步操作的分支，再据此引导逐步生成。在多个推理基准上该几何信号带来一致增益，且推理链越深提升越大。
Motivation: 单次生成快但准确率不足，树搜索方法精度高却计算开销大；组合推理树中解状态稀少而死路指数增多，需要一种与该不对称结构匹配的低成本引导信号。
Method: 训练一个轻量 head 将 LLM 隐状态投影到双曲空间（近原点体积紧凑、向边界指数扩张），用距离与角度作为引导信号注入生成；随后用低秩 adapter (LoRA) 在模型自身的推理尝试上交互式微调，使其学会利用该信号。
Result: 在多个推理基准上几何信号带来一致增益，且推理链越深改进越大；代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Conclusion: 双曲几何能自然编码组合推理树的解状态不对称，用它引导逐步生成可在保持轻量的同时提升多步推理表现，深链任务收益更明显。

papers.title: Integrable Elasticity via Neural Demand Potentials
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Integrable Context-Dependent Demand Network (ICDN), a demand-first neural model for multiproduct retail demand. ICDN learns log-demand as a smooth, context-conditioned function of log-prices, allowing elasticities to be derived exactly from the learned demand surface. Across three retail datasets, the model achieves competitive out-of-sample prediction while producing analytically tractable, and economically regularized own- and cross-price responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向多产品零售需求的 Integrable Context-Dependent Demand Network (ICDN)，把 log-demand 学成关于 log-prices 的光滑、上下文条件函数，使价格弹性可从学到的需求面上精确求导。在三个零售数据集上取得有竞争力的样本外预测，同时给出解析可处理且受经济正则约束的自有与交叉价格响应。
Motivation: 多产品零售需求建模中，预测精度与弹性可导出、经济合理往往难以兼得，需要一种从需求面直接精确求导的模型。
Method: ICDN 采用 demand-first 结构，将 log-demand 表示为 log-prices 的光滑、上下文条件函数，弹性由该需求面解析求导得到，并施加经济正则约束自有与交叉价格响应。
Result: 在三个零售数据集上取得有竞争力的样本外预测，并产出解析可处理、经济正则化的自有与交叉价格弹性。
Conclusion: 把弹性作为需求面的精确导数来建模，可以在保持预测竞争力的同时得到经济上合理的多产品价格响应。

papers.title: Spectral Tail Auxiliary Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: As generative image models evolve rapidly, the perceptual gap between generated and real images continues to narrow, making AI-generated image detection increasingly challenging. Many existing methods exploit frequency-domain cues for detection, typically described as frequency-domain artifacts or high-frequency discrepancies. However, the specific and recurring spectral regularities remain insufficiently understood and characterized. In this paper, we systematically analyze the one-dimensional radial log-power spectra of real and generated images. We find that generated images do not necessarily exhibit higher or lower energy across the entire spectrum or high-band range. Instead, their spectra deviate from the power-law decay and show an anomalous uplift in the ultra-high-frequency tail. We term this phenomenon spectral tail uplift. We further attribute this phenomenon to nonlinear harmonic accumulation in trained generative models, suggesting that it can serve as a structural cue across generative architectures. Based on this observation, we propose Spectral Tail Auxiliary Learning (STAL), a frequency-domain auxiliary supervision framework for generalizable AI-generated image detection. STAL transfers spectral-tail cues from a tail-aware frequency teacher to a spatial detector during training, while all frequency-domain modules are discarded at inference time. Consequently, STAL introduces no inference overhead. Extensive experiments on 9 public datasets show that STAL achieves strong generalization and stability across generators, data distributions, and real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAL 用频域辅助监督把“谱尾上抬”(spectral tail uplift) 这一结构性线索迁移到空间检测器：生成图像的一维径向对数功率谱偏离幂律衰减、在超高频尾部出现异常抬升，训练时由 tail-aware 频率教师监督，推理时丢弃全部频域模块因而零额外开销。在 9 个公开数据集上跨生成器、跨数据分布与真实场景均表现出强泛化与稳定性。
Motivation: 生成图像与真实图像的感知差距不断缩小，现有频域检测方法只笼统依赖“高频差异”，对可复现的谱规律刻画不足，跨生成器泛化差。
Method: 先系统分析真实与生成图像的一维径向 log-power 谱，把超高频尾部异常归因于训练后生成模型的非线性谐波累积 (nonlinear harmonic accumulation)；再提出 Spectral Tail Auxiliary Learning (STAL)，训练中由 tail-aware 频率教师向空间检测器迁移谱尾线索，推理阶段丢弃所有频域模块。
Result: 在 9 个公开数据集上，STAL 在跨生成器、跨数据分布和真实场景下均取得强泛化与稳定性；核心发现是生成图像谱在超高频尾部出现异常上抬，而非整段谱或高频段能量一致偏高或偏低。
Conclusion: 谱尾上抬可作为跨生成架构的结构性检测线索，且以辅助监督方式引入时不必付出推理开销。

papers.title: A Typed Tensor Language for Shared-State Federated Computation
papers.abstract_en: Shared-state federated computations combine client-local tensor computation, mergeable aggregation into shared state, and shared-only post-processing. We introduce a typed tensor language for this class of computations. Its two tensor sorts separate client-partitioned data from globally available values, and typing tracks the partitioned axis. A virtual global tensor serves as a semantic reference for centralized evaluation. We show that typed one-round programs factor through shared tensors whose shapes depend on the program but are independent of client and sample counts. The converse applies to typed-realizable factorizations: each encoder component is represented by an allowed aggregation or contraction with its valid merge, and the decoder is shared-only. The construction extends round by round to programs whose persistent state is shared. For a loss supplied with a client-local per-sample gradient expression, summation represents the empirical gradient. This gives typed programs for server-side first-order updates and, with shared linear algebra, curvature-block updates. The language covers federated analytics and FedSGD. General multi-local-step FedAvg and persistent private client state are outside its scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种带类型的张量语言，用两种 tensor sort 区分客户端分区数据与全局共享值，并让类型系统追踪被分区的轴，从而形式化 shared-state federated computation（客户端本地计算 + 可合并聚合 + 仅共享后处理）。证明 typed 单轮程序可分解过共享张量，其形状只依赖程序本身、与客户端数和样本数无关；在给定客户端本地逐样本梯度表达式时，求和即代表经验梯度，可写出 server-side 一阶更新与带共享线性代数的 curvature-block 更新。
Motivation: 联邦计算同时含本地张量计算、可合并聚合与共享后处理，缺少统一语言来表达这三段并保证分区语义正确；已有形式化难以说明单轮程序为何能与客户端数、样本数解耦。
Method: 定义两种 tensor sort 分离客户端分区数据与全局值，类型系统追踪分区轴；引入 virtual global tensor 作为集中式计算的语义参照；给出 typed 单轮程序经共享张量分解的正反两个方向（反向要求每个 encoder 分量是带合法 merge 的聚合或 contraction、decoder 仅共享），并逐轮扩展到持久状态为共享的程序。
Result: 证明 typed 单轮程序分解出的共享张量形状依赖程序但独立于客户端数与样本数；对带客户端本地逐样本梯度表达式的 loss，求和表示经验梯度，据此给出 server-side 一阶更新与共享线性代数下的 curvature-block 更新的 typed 程序；语言覆盖 federated analytics 与 FedSGD。
Conclusion: 类型化的分区轴加虚拟全局张量足以把单轮联邦程序与客户端/样本规模解耦并逐轮推广；作者明确把一般多本地步 FedAvg 与持久私有客户端状态排除在范围之外。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pseudo-Formalization for Automatic Proof Verification
papers.abstract_en: Reliable verification of proofs remains a bottleneck for training and evaluating AI systems on hard mathematical reasoning. Fully formal proofs, in languages like Lean, are easy to verify because they are unambiguous and modular. Most proofs, particularly those written by AI systems, have neither property, and translating them into formal languages remains challenging in many frontier math settings. We propose Pseudo-Formalization (PF), a proof format that captures the modularity and precision of formal proofs while retaining the flexibility of natural language. A Pseudo-Formal proof is decomposed into self-contained modules, each stating its premises, conclusion, and proof in natural language. To verify the correctness of a regular natural language proof, an LLM translates it to Pseudo-Formal and then verifies each module independently, an algorithm we call Block Verification (BV). We evaluate PF+BV on two benchmarks spanning olympiad and research-level mathematics, where it pareto-dominates LLM-as-judge baselines on error-finding precision and recall. To support future work, we release our research-level proof verification benchmark ArxivMathGradingBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Pseudo-Formalization (PF) 证明格式与 Block Verification (BV) 算法：把自然语言证明拆成自包含模块（各含前提、结论、证明），由 LLM 先将普通证明翻译为 PF，再逐模块独立验证。在覆盖奥数与研究级数学的两个基准上，PF+BV 在错误查找的 precision 与 recall 上 pareto 支配 LLM-as-judge 基线，并发布研究级证明验证基准 ArxivMathGradingBench。
Motivation: 可靠验证证明是训练与评估 AI 数学推理能力的瓶颈：Lean 等全形式证明易验证但把大多数（尤其 AI 生成的）自然语言证明翻译成形式语言在前沿数学场景仍然困难。
Method: PF 将证明分解为自包含模块，每个模块以自然语言给出前提、结论与证明；BV 算法先由 LLM 把待验证的普通自然语言证明翻译成 Pseudo-Formal，再对每个模块独立验证。
Result: 在覆盖奥数级与研究级数学的两个基准上，PF+BV 在错误查找的 precision 和 recall 上 pareto 支配 LLM-as-judge 基线；同时发布研究级证明验证基准 ArxivMathGradingBench。
Conclusion: 用保留自然语言灵活性的模块化中间格式加逐块验证，可以在不完全形式化的前提下获得比 LLM-as-judge 更可靠的证明验证，且该格式面向前沿数学场景可用。

papers.title: Probing an Embodied LLM: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as cognitive components for robotic systems, yet their opaque decision processes make it difficult to explain success or failure in closed-loop embodied tasks. Following an empirical AI methodology, we study an embodied LLM agent behaviorally by varying the available information and measuring the resulting changes in behavior. Using the Lockbox, a sequential mechanical puzzle with hidden interdependencies, we evaluate LLMs across RGB, RGB-D, and ground-truth symbolic observations in a physical robotic setup and use simulation to probe the resulting behavior. Counterintuitively, agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations. In simulation, we probe this effect by randomly flipping perceived action outcomes and find that moderate noise improves performance, peaking at a 40% flip probability with a 2.85-fold success rate increase over the noise-free baseline. Further analysis links this gain to a reduction in repetitive action loops. These findings suggest that success rates alone are insufficient for evaluating LLMs, as measured performance may reflect the interaction between perceptual errors and reasoning failures rather than robust problem solving.
papers.comment: Accepted at From Animals to Animats: The 18th International Conference on the Simulation of Adaptive Behavior (SAB 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Lockbox 序列机械谜题与实体机器人设置中，观测保真度越高反而越差：LLM 智能体在原始 RGB 下表现最好，在完美 ground-truth 符号观测下最差。仿真中随机翻转动作结果，中等噪声反而提升表现，翻转概率 40% 时成功率相对无噪声基线提高 2.85 倍，且增益来自重复动作循环的减少。
Motivation: LLM 作为机器人认知组件时决策过程不透明，闭环任务的成功与失败难以解释；需要一种行为学方法，通过改变可用信息来观测行为变化。
Method: 按 empirical AI 方法做行为学探测：在实体机器人上分别提供 RGB、RGB-D 与 ground-truth 符号观测求解 Lockbox（含隐藏相互依赖的序列机械谜题），再用仿真随机翻转感知到的动作结果来定位该效应。
Result: 原始 RGB 输入下表现最佳，完美 ground-truth 观测下最差；仿真中翻转概率 40% 时成功率相对无噪声基线提升 2.85 倍，进一步分析把增益归因于重复动作循环减少。
Conclusion: 单看成功率不足以评估 LLM：测得的性能可能反映感知错误与推理失败的交互，而非稳健的问题求解能力。

papers.title: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks and Graph Transformers have become central to graph learning, combining expressive representation learning with sample-efficient inductive biases. Yet they remain fundamentally limited when predictions depend on correlations between distant graph regions. We address this limitation with Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a novel framework that jointly operates on the input graph and a pooled hierarchical abstraction. We also show that existing models degrade more sharply under out-of-range generalization, where test instances require interactions across distances exceeding those observed during training. Despite its minimal design, GHR consistently strengthens every tested message-passing backbone, yielding robust performance on long-range dependencies and particularly pronounced gains in out-of-range regimes. Across a broad suite of long-range benchmarks, GHR achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results on multiple tasks, establishing hierarchical recurrence as an effective mechanism for extending graph models beyond their observed interaction range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR)，让消息传递同时作用在原始图与池化后的层级抽象上，以捕捉远距离区域间的相关性。在长程图基准上 GHR 对每种被测消息传递骨干都带来稳定提升，并在 out-of-range 泛化（测试实例所需交互距离超出训练所见）下优势最明显，取得 SOTA 或有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: GNN 与 Graph Transformer 在预测依赖图上遥远区域间的相关性时存在根本限制；且现有模型在 out-of-range 泛化下性能下降更剧烈，即测试所需交互距离超过训练所见时更脆弱。
Method: GHR 同时在输入图与池化得到的层级抽象 (pooled hierarchical abstraction) 上操作，把层级递归 (hierarchical recurrence) 作为可插拔机制叠加到任意消息传递骨干上，设计保持极简。
Result: 在一组长程图基准 (long-range benchmarks) 的多个任务上，GHR 取得 state-of-the-art 或有竞争力的结果；对每个被测消息传递骨干均有一致增益，在 out-of-range 泛化 regime 下增益尤为显著。
Conclusion: 层级递归是把图模型的交互范围扩展到训练观测距离之外的有效机制，且作为通用增强可叠加到不同消息传递骨干上。

papers.title: Reshape and Recur: Improving SSMs with Input Reshaping and Depth Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) are increasingly deployed in the Edge because they offer, at comparable performance, a smaller memory/training/inference footprint, compared to Large Language Models (LLMs). These three advantages are a direct consequence of the time recurrence inherent in the SSMs architecture. Here, we further improve this recurrent architecture by positively answering two previously underexplored, orthogonal questions: (1) Can we reduce SSMs memory-footprint without any performance penalty, by also employing depth recurrence? (2) Can we increase SSMs performance by using a fixed and consistent time-granularity across all tasks? The first question is somewhat unexpected, given that SSMs are already recurrent. However, the orthogonal depth recurrence further decreases SSMs memory footprint. We show that a looped SSM with $k$ parameters adaptively iterated $M$ times, achieves a performance comparable to a standard SSM with $k \cdot L$ independent parameters, where $M \leq L$. The second question is also unexpected given the time-recurrent nature of the SSMs architecture. However, it makes perfect sense for the time-parallel training of SSMs on the entire input sequence. We show that concatenating time steps for lower-dimensional sequence elements, or flattening and re-chunking the joint feature-time dimension for high-dimensional ones, can improve the baseline by enhancing the way information is presented to the model. Our results for both extensions lead to consistent benefits across four representative SSM architectures: LRU, S5, LinOSS, LrcSSM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SSM 上同时引入深度循环与统一时间粒度：k 参数的 looped SSM 自适应迭代 M 次即可达到标准 SSM 用 k·L 独立参数的性能（M ≤ L），且内存占用更低；再通过拼接时间步或展平后重分块特征-时间维来固定时间粒度，在 LRU、S5、LinOSS、LrcSSM 四个架构上一致提升基线。
Motivation: SSM 因时间循环而在边缘设备上比 LLM 更省内存与算力，但深度维度的冗余参数和各任务不一致的时间粒度这两个问题此前少被探索。
Method: 两条正交改造：一是深度循环，让 k 参数的 SSM 自适应复用 M 次以替代 k·L 独立参数；二是统一时间粒度，对低维序列元素拼接时间步，对高维元素展平并重新分块联合的 feature-time 维度，改善信息呈现方式。
Result: looped SSM 以 k 参数迭代 M 次（M ≤ L）达到标准 SSM k·L 独立参数的相当性能，同时进一步降低内存占用；时间粒度改造在 LRU、S5、LinOSS、LrcSSM 四个代表性 SSM 架构上相对基线带来一致收益。
Conclusion: 深度循环与固定时间粒度是两个正交且互补的 SSM 改进方向：前者在不损失性能的前提下压缩内存，后者通过统一信息呈现方式在多种架构上稳定提升表现。

papers.title: Semantic Cooperative Games for Contribution Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Contribution attribution has become a central problem in LLM-based multi-agent systems, where final outputs are produced through multiple agents, message exchanges, and ordered workflow dependencies. Existing attribution methods often rely on counterfactual valuation, such as removing agents or comparing score changes across altered agent subsets. In language-mediated workflows, these methods require repeated model calls, introduce high variance, and do not explicitly capture the intermediate semantic states through which agents produce, preserve, and transform task-relevant information. We propose Semantic Cooperative Games (SCG), a framework that represents a realized language flow as a semantic generation hypergraph and induces an agent-level semantic value function on this structure. We define the Semantic Shapley Value (SSV) to allocate contribution over semantic support logic, and introduce SLIC, a single-trajectory algorithm that constructs the semantic hypergraph, recovers minimal semantic supports, applies Boolean absorption, and computes SSV without rerunning agent subsets. We prove that SSV reduces to the classical Shapley value under standard set-based, fully observable, and no-order-dependence conditions. On a medical benchmark satisfying these conditions, SLIC reduces computation cost by 93.3% while remaining highly consistent with a Monte Carlo Shapley baseline. In more general multi-role workflows, SSV aligns with perturbation-induced score-drop profiles and exposes cases where semantic contribution and failure impact diverge. Overall, SLIC provides a fast, counterfactual-free, and interpretable attribution method for complex LLM-based multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Semantic Cooperative Games (SCG)，把一次已实现的 LLM 多智能体语言流表示为语义生成超图，在其上定义 Semantic Shapley Value (SSV) 分配贡献，并用单轨迹算法 SLIC 免重跑子集地计算 SSV。在满足经典 Shapley 条件的医学基准上，SLIC 计算成本降低 93.3% 且与 Monte Carlo Shapley 基线高度一致；在多角色工作流中 SSV 与扰动引起的分数下降剖面对齐，并暴露语义贡献与失败影响分离的情形。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的贡献归因依赖反事实估值，需要反复调用模型、方差高，且不刻画智能体产生与传递任务信息的中间语义状态。
Method: SCG 将语言流建模为语义生成超图并诱导智能体级语义值函数；SSV 在语义支撑逻辑 (semantic support logic) 上分配贡献；SLIC 单轨迹构造超图、恢复最小语义支撑、做 Boolean 吸收后直接算 SSV，不重跑智能体子集。作者证明在集合式、完全可观测、无顺序依赖条件下 SSV 退化为经典 Shapley 值。
Result: 在满足上述条件的医学基准上，SLIC 计算成本降低 93.3%，并与 Monte Carlo Shapley 基线高度一致；在更一般的多角色工作流中，SSV 与扰动诱导的分数下降剖面对齐，并识别出语义贡献与失败影响不一致的案例。
Conclusion: SLIC 提供一种快速、免反事实、可解释的 LLM 多智能体贡献归因方法，且在标准条件下与经典 Shapley 值一致。

papers.title: Universal Approximation of Nonlinear Operators and Their Derivatives
papers.abstract_en: We show that Universal Approximation (UA) of nonlinear operators and their derivatives via Operator Learning (OL) architectures fails in ${C^k_F}$ (Fréchet) compact-open topologies and in Fréchet--Sobolev norms (i.e. under operator norms). We solve this obstruction by restoring UA in natural weaker topologies: $C^k_B$ (Bastiani) compact-open topologies and (novel) weighted Bastiani--Sobolev spaces for general finite input measures. In full Banach-space generality, these are the first complete generalizations of the corresponding influential classical results in [Hornik, 1991] to infinite-dimensional spaces and OL. Based on our UATs, we formulate Bastiani--Sobolev training in DIOL. These results launch Derivative-Informed Operator Learning (DIOL) (i.e. learning nonlinear operators and their derivatives) on general Banach spaces. We parameterize nonlinear operators via Encoder-Decoder Architectures, classical OL architectures available in general Banach spaces; these include DeepONets, Deep-H-ONets, and PCA-Nets, which our UATs cover. A key mathematical result is that our new weighted Bastiani--Sobolev spaces generalize classical Gaussian (Malliavin) Sobolev spaces on Banach spaces. Open frontiers where DIOL and our UATs find applications are: high-order accuracy in OL; fast constrained optimization in Banach spaces (e.g. optimal control of PDEs, inverse problems) via Learn-Then-Optimize; numerical methods for infinite-dimensional PDEs (e.g. HJB PDEs on Banach spaces from infinite-dimensional optimal control via Optimize-Then-Learn, such as optimal control of PDEs, SPDEs, path-dependent systems, partially observed systems, mean-field control).
papers.comment: The presentation of the results has been streamlined and improved
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明：用 Operator Learning 架构逼近非线性算子及其导数时，在 Fréchet 紧开拓扑 (C^k_F) 与 Fréchet–Sobolev 范数下万有逼近 (UA) 失效；改用更弱的 Bastiani 紧开拓扑 (C^k_B) 与新提出的加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间后 UA 恢复，且对一般有限输入测度成立。由此在一般 Banach 空间上把 Hornik 1991 的经典结果推广到无穷维与 OL，并据此提出 DIOL 的 Bastiani–Sobolev 训练。
Motivation: 万有逼近定理在无穷维 Banach 空间上尚未有完整推广，且在强 Fréchet–Sobolev 算子范数下逼近非线性算子及其导数存在根本性障碍，阻碍了导数知情的算子学习 (Derivative-Informed Operator Learning) 在一般无穷维问题上的理论基础。
Method: 在 C^k_B (Bastiani) 紧开拓扑与新构造的加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间（对一般有限输入测度）中重建万有逼近定理 (UAT)；用 Encoder-Decoder 架构参数化非线性算子，涵盖 DeepONets、Deep-H-ONets、PCA-Nets；据此在 DIOL 中形式化 Bastiani–Sobolev 训练。关键数学结果是新加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间推广了 Banach 空间上的经典 Gaussian (Malliavin) Sobolev 空间。
Result: 证明在 C^k_F 紧开拓扑与 Fréchet–Sobolev 范数下 UA 失效，而在 C^k_B 与加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间中 UA 成立；这是 Banach 空间一般性下 Hornik 1991 经典结果到无穷维与 OL 的首个完整推广。摘要未给出实验数值，结果为定理性结论。
Conclusion: 算子及其导数的万有逼近必须在 Bastiani 型较弱拓扑下陈述，Fréchet–Sobolev 算子范数下的逼近不可能；该框架为高阶精度 OL、Banach 空间中的 Learn-Then-Optimize 快速约束优化（PDE 最优控制、反问题）以及 HJB 等无穷维 PDE 数值方法（Optimize-Then-Learn）提供理论入口。

summary_sections.method: 在 C^k_B (Bastiani) 紧开拓扑与新构造的加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间（对一般有限输入测度）中重建万有逼近定理 (UAT)；用 Encoder-Decoder 架构参数化非线性算子，涵盖 DeepONets、Deep-H-ONets、PCA-Nets；据此在 DIOL 中形式化 Bastiani–Sobolev 训练。关键数学结果是新加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间推广了 Banach 空间上的经典 Gaussian (Malliavin) Sobolev 空间。
summary_sections.result: 证明在 C^k_F 紧开拓扑与 Fréchet–Sobolev 范数下 UA 失效，而在 C^k_B 与加权 Bastiani–Sobolev 空间中 UA 成立；这是 Banach 空间一般性下 Hornik 1991 经典结果到无穷维与 OL 的首个完整推广。摘要未给出实验数值，结果为定理性结论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 算子及其导数的万有逼近必须在 Bastiani 型较弱拓扑下陈述，Fréchet–Sobolev 算子范数下的逼近不可能；该框架为高阶精度 OL、Banach 空间中的 Learn-Then-Optimize 快速约束优化（PDE 最优控制、反问题）以及 HJB 等无穷维 PDE 数值方法（Optimize-Then-Learn）提供理论入口。

papers.title: Learned Suppression for 3D Keypoint Detection with a Graph-Transformer Backbone
papers.abstract_en: Detecting 3D keypoints is a long-standing challenge in computer vision. Most detectors end with a heuristic post-processing step that is not learned. We propose a 3D keypoint detector that improves on this step with a learned suppression module, paired with a Point Transformer backbone that we extend with a directional graph neural network. The module is a graph network over candidates that learns which to keep, which to suppress, and how to relocate the remaining ones. Paired with three backbones, it improves over DBSCAN and greedy non-maximum suppression, and because it operates on candidate features rather than raw geometry, the same formulation applies to both structural and semantic keypoints. Our model surpasses the per-category trained KeypointDETR on 12 of 16 KeypointNet categories, attains the best Corner F1 on the Building3D Entry-Level benchmark, and remains competitive with BWFormer on the larger Tallinn split. GitHub implementation: https://github.com/cansdev/learned-suppression-3d.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可学习的 3D 关键点抑制模块：在候选点集上用图网络决定保留、抑制与重定位，骨干为 Point Transformer 加方向性图神经网络。在 KeypointNet 16 类中 12 类超过按类训练的 KeypointDETR，Building3D Entry-Level 上取得最佳 Corner F1，并在更大的 Tallinn split 上与 BWFormer 保持竞争力。
Motivation: 多数 3D 关键点检测器最后依赖非学习的启发式后处理（DBSCAN、贪心 NMS），这一步既难调参也难迁移到不同关键点类型。
Method: 骨干用 Point Transformer 并扩展方向性图神经网络 (directional GNN)；其上接一个作用于候选特征（而非原始几何）的图网络抑制模块，学习对每个候选做保留/抑制/重定位决策，与三个骨干配对，并与 DBSCAN 和贪心 NMS 对比。
Result: 在 KeypointNet 16 个类别中的 12 类超过按类训练的 KeypointDETR；在 Building3D Entry-Level 基准上取得最佳 Corner F1；在更大的 Tallinn split 上与 BWFormer 保持竞争力；相对 DBSCAN 与贪心 NMS 在三个骨干上均有提升。
Conclusion: 把非学习的后处理换成基于候选特征的可学习抑制，同一套 formulation 可同时处理结构性与语义关键点，且能跨骨干复用。

papers.title: GPart: End-to-End Isometric Fine-Tuning via Global Parameter Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of large-scale deep learning models. However, its bilinear parameterization induces a parameter-dependent geometry: the mapping from trainable parameters to weight updates is not generally distance-preserving. Related methods that project a low-dimensional vector into LoRA's parameter space, such as Uni-LoRA, improve parameter efficiency, but the subsequent bilinear map breaks end-to-end isometry. We propose GPart (Global Partition fine-tuning), a highly parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that maps a $d$-dimensional trainable vector directly into the full weight space through a sparse, isometric partition matrix. GPart retains a fixed global parameter-sharing prior while removing the additional low-rank reconstruction used by LoRA-based methods. This yields a simple parameterization with a single main hyperparameter ($d$), exact end-to-end isometry, and a minimal checkpoint representation consisting of the trainable vector and a random seed. GPart builds on the premise of effective fine-tuning within random low-dimensional subspaces of the full weight space without requiring a low-rank matrix factorization. Across natural language understanding, computer vision, and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GPart matches or improves over existing PEFT methods at ultra-low parameter budgets. Beyond offering mathematical tractability and memory efficiency, the direct linear parameterization of GPart streamlines model selection and paves the way for compact adapter composition. Overall, GPart provides an elegant and competitive alternative for fine-tuning under small parameter budgets, with a fixed and predictable geometry between trainable coordinates and weight-space updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPart 用一个稀疏等距划分矩阵把 d 维可训练向量直接线性映射到完整权重空间，端到端保持等距，从而去掉 LoRA 的双线性参数化与低秩重构。在自然语言理解、计算机视觉与数学推理基准上，GPart 在超低参数预算下匹配或改进现有 PEFT 方法，检查点只需可训练向量加一个随机种子。
Motivation: LoRA 的双线性参数化使可训练参数到权重更新的映射不保距，Uni-LoRA 等先投影再双线性映射的做法同样破坏端到端等距，几何不可预测且检查点冗余。
Method: GPart (Global Partition fine-tuning) 通过稀疏等距划分矩阵 (sparse isometric partition matrix) 把 d 维向量直接映射到全权重空间，保留固定全局参数共享先验，移除 LoRA 系方法的低秩重构；主超参数只有 d，检查点由可训练向量与随机种子构成。
Result: 在自然语言理解、计算机视觉与数学推理基准上，GPart 在超低参数预算下匹配或改进现有 PEFT 方法；参数化具有精确端到端等距与单一主超参数 d。
Conclusion: 不做低秩矩阵分解、直接线性参数化也能在小参数预算下做到有竞争力的微调，且几何固定可预测，检查点极小并便于 adapter 组合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Senses Wide Shut: A Representation-Action Gap in Omnimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: When an omnimodal large language model accepts a question whose textual premise contradicts what it actually sees or hears, does the failure lie in perception or in action? Recent omnimodal models are positioned as perception-grounded agents that jointly process video, audio, and text, yet a basic form of grounding remains untested: catching a textual claim that conflicts with the model's own sensory input. We introduce IMAVB, a curated 500-clip benchmark of long-form movies with a 2x2 design crossing target modality (vision, audio) and premise condition (standard, misleading), which lets us measure conflict detection separately from ordinary multimodal comprehension. Across eight open-source omnimodal LLMs and Gemini 3.1 Pro, we document a Representation-Action Gap: hidden states reliably encode premise-perception mismatches even when the same models almost never reject the false claim in their outputs. Behaviorally, models fall into two failure modes: under-rejection, in which they answer misleading questions as if the false premise were true; and over-rejection, in which they reject more often but also reject standard questions, sacrificing ordinary comprehension accuracy. The gap is modality-asymmetric (audio grounding underperforms vision) and prompt-resistant across seven variants. As an initial diagnostic intervention, a probe-guided logit adjustment (PGLA) re-injects the encoded mismatch signal into decoding and consistently improves rejection behavior. Together, these results suggest the bottleneck for omnimodal grounding lies in translation, not perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 500 段长视频剪辑的 IMAVB 基准上，八个开源 omnimodal LLM 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的隐状态能可靠编码文本前提与感官输入的冲突，输出却几乎从不拒绝虚假前提，形成 Representation-Action Gap。失败模式分两类：under-rejection（把误导性问题当真前提作答）与 over-rejection（拒绝率上升但连标准问题也拒，牺牲普通理解准确率）；该缺口在音频上比视觉更严重，且对七种 prompt 变体都稳健。探针引导的 logit 调整 (PGLA) 把已编码的冲突信号重新注入解码，一致改善拒绝行为，说明瓶颈在翻译而非感知。
Motivation: omnimodal 模型被定位为感知接地的 agent，但当文本前提与其实际看到、听到的内容矛盾时，模型是否能抓住这一冲突从未被单独检验，无法区分失败出在感知还是行动。
Method: 提出 IMAVB：500 段长电影剪辑的基准，采用 2×2 设计交叉目标模态（vision、audio）与前提条件（standard、misleading），把冲突检测与普通多模态理解分开度量；在八个开源 omnimodal LLM 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 上比较隐状态表征与输出行为，并用探针引导的 logit 调整 (PGLA) 在解码阶段重注入冲突信号。
Result: 隐状态可靠编码 premise-perception 不匹配，而模型输出几乎从不拒绝虚假前提；行为上分出 under-rejection 与 over-rejection 两种模式，缺口呈模态不对称（audio grounding 弱于 vision），对七种 prompt 变体均稳健；PGLA 一致改善拒绝行为。
Conclusion: omnimodal 接地的瓶颈在于把已编码的感知冲突翻译成拒绝动作，而非感知本身；把表征信号重新注入解码即可改善拒绝行为。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Guide, Think, Act: Interactive Embodied Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose GTA-VLA(Guide, Think, Act), an interactive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that enables spatially steerable embodied reasoning by allowing users to guide robot policies with explicit visual cues. Existing VLA models learn a direct "Sense-to-Act" mapping from multimodal observations to robot actions. While effective within the training distribution, such tightly coupled policies are brittle under out-of-domain (OOD) shifts and difficult to correct when failures occur. Although recent embodied Chain-of-Thought (CoT) approaches expose intermediate reasoning, they still lack a mechanism for incorporating human spatial guidance, limiting their ability to resolve visual ambiguities or recover from mistakes. To address this gap, our framework allows users to optionally guide the policy with spatial priors, such as affordance points, boxes, and traces, which the subsequent reasoning process can directly condition on. Based on these inputs, the model generates a unified spatial-visual Chain-of-Thought that integrates external guidance with internal task planning, aligning human visual intent with autonomous decision-making. For practical deployment, we further couple the reasoning module with a lightweight reactive action head for efficient action execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. On the in-domain SimplerEnv WidowX benchmark, our framework achieves a state-of-the-art 81.2% success rate. Under OOD visual shifts and spatial ambiguities, a single visual interaction substantially improves task success over existing methods, highlighting the value of interactive reasoning for failure recovery in embodied control. More details of the project can be found here: https://github.com/FutianLabs/GTA-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTA-VLA 让用户用可点击的视觉线索（affordance 点、框、轨迹）显式引导机器人策略，把外部空间先验与内部任务规划合成统一的空间-视觉 Chain-of-Thought，再接轻量反应式动作头执行。在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上达到 81.2% 成功率（SOTA），OOD 视觉偏移与空间歧义下单次视觉交互即可显著提升任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 是紧耦合的 Sense-to-Act 映射，训练分布外脆弱且失败后难以纠正；已有具身 CoT 虽暴露中间推理，却缺少注入人类空间引导的机制，无法消解视觉歧义或从错误中恢复。
Method: 用户可选地提供空间先验（affordance 点、框、轨迹），推理模块据此生成整合外部引导与内部任务规划的统一空间-视觉 CoT，再耦合一个轻量反应式动作头 (reactive action head) 高效执行动作。
Result: 在 in-domain SimformerEnv WidowX benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 的 81.2% 成功率；在 OOD 视觉偏移与空间歧义设置下，单次视觉交互相比已有方法显著提升任务成功率。
Conclusion: 把人类空间引导作为可选条件注入推理链，能同时改善 in-domain 成功率与 OOD 失败恢复，交互式具身推理是纠正 VLA 策略错误的有效路径。

papers.title: Learning Local Constraints for Reinforcement-Learned Content Generators
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based game content generators that learn local constraints from existing content, such as Wave Function Collapse (WFC), can generate visually satisfying game levels but face challenges in optimizing global properties, such as playability. On the other hand, reinforcement-learning-trained generators can optimize global properties---because such properties can easily be included in reward functions---but the results can be visually dissatisfying. In this paper, we explore ways to combine these methods. Specifically, we constrain the action space of a PCGRL generator with constraints learned by WFC, effectively allowing the PCGRL generator to achieve global properties while being forced to adhere to local constraints. To better analyze how this hybrid content generation method operates, we vary the number and type of inputs, and we test whether to randomly collapse the starting state and exclude rare patterns. While the method is sensitive to hyperparameter tuning, the best of our trained generators produce visually satisfying and playable puzzle-platform game levels---such as Lode Runner levels---with desired global properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 WFC 学到的局部约束加到 PCGRL 生成器的动作空间上，使其在被强制遵守局部约束的同时仍能用奖励优化全局属性（如可玩性）。消融输入数量与类型、起始状态随机 collapse、排除稀有 pattern 等设置后，最优训练出的生成器能产出视觉满意且可玩的 Lode Runner 类谜题平台关卡；方法对超参调节敏感。
Motivation: WFC 类约束生成器能从已有内容学局部约束、画面好看，但难以优化可玩性这类全局属性；RL 训练的生成器能把全局属性写进奖励，结果却常不美观，两条路线各缺一半。
Method: 用 WFC 学到的局部约束去限制 PCGRL 生成器的动作空间，使 RL 在遵守局部约束的前提下优化全局奖励；实验中改变输入的数量与类型，并测试是否随机 collapse 起始状态、是否排除稀有 pattern。
Result: 最优训练出的生成器产出视觉满意且可玩的谜题平台关卡（如 Lode Runner 关卡），并达到期望的全局属性；方法对超参调节敏感。

papers.title: Probing Persona-Dependent Preferences in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can be said to have preferences: they reliably pick certain tasks and outputs over others, and preferences shaped by post-training and prompting appear to influence much of their behaviour. But models can also adopt different personas which have radically different preferences. How is this implemented internally? Does each persona use its own preference representations, or are some representations shared? We train linear probes on residual-stream activations of Gemma-3-27B and Qwen-3.5-122B to predict revealed pairwise task choices, and identify a genuine preference vector: it tracks the model's preferences as they shift across a range of prompts and situations, and on Gemma-3-27B steering along it causally controls pairwise choice. Some preference information transfers across the prompted personas we test: a probe trained on the helpful assistant predicts and steers the choices of qualitatively different personas, including an evil persona whose preferences anti-correlate with the Assistant's.
papers.comment: Accepted at Neurips. 41 pages, 45 figures. Code: https://github.com/oscar-gilg/Preferences. Earlier write-up on LessWrong: https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/pxC2RAeoBrvK8ivMf/models-have-linear-representations-of-what-tasks-they-like-1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Gemma-3-27B 与 Qwen-3.5-122B 的 residual stream 激活上训练线性探针预测成对任务选择，找到一个随情境迁移的偏好向量；在 Gemma-3-27B 上沿该向量做 steering 可因果控制成对选择，且 helpful assistant 上训练的探针能预测并操纵包括 evil persona 在内的其他 persona 的选择（后者与 Assistant 偏好反相关）。
Motivation: LLM 的 persona 会带来截然不同的偏好，但这些偏好在模型内部如何实现、各 persona 是否共享偏好表示，此前没有直接的内部证据。
Method: 对 Gemma-3-27B 和 Qwen-3.5-122B 的 residual-stream 激活训练线性探针 (linear probe)，以预测模型的成对任务选择 (revealed pairwise task choices)；再沿识别出的偏好向量做激活 steering 检验因果性，并跨不同 prompt persona 迁移探针。
Result: 识别出一个真实的偏好向量：它随模型在不同 prompt 与情境下的偏好变化而追踪；在 Gemma-3-27B 上沿该向量 steering 可因果控制成对选择；偏好信息可跨 persona 迁移——helpful assistant 上训练的探针能预测并操纵定性不同的 persona（含与 Assistant 偏好反相关的 evil persona）的选择。
Conclusion: LLM 的 persona 偏好部分由共享的线性表示承载，因此单一 persona 上的探针可跨 persona 迁移并因果操纵选择，包括偏好方向相反的 persona。
