papers.title: EgoForge: Goal-Directed Egocentric World Simulator
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models have shown promise for simulating dynamic environments, yet egocentric video remains challenging due to rapid viewpoint changes, frequent hand-object interactions, and goal-directed procedures whose evolution depends on latent human intent. Existing approaches either focus on hand-centric instructional synthesis with limited scene evolution, perform static view translation without modeling action dynamics, or rely on dense supervision, such as camera trajectories, long video prefixes, and synchronized multi-camera capture. In this work, we introduce EgoForge, an egocentric goal-directed world simulator that generates coherent, first-person video rollouts from minimal static inputs: a single egocentric image, a high-level instruction, and an optional auxiliary exocentric view. To improve intent alignment and temporal coherence, we introduce GRAFT, a trajectory-level diffusion refinement method that uses positive and negative rollout distributions, derived from goal, temporal, scene-consistency, and perceptual rewards, to steer the diffusion velocity field toward coherent, goal-complete egocentric simulations. Extensive experiments show EgoForge achieves consistent gains in semantic alignment, geometric stability, and motion fidelity over strong baselines, and performs robustly in real-world smart-glasses experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoForge 从单张第一人称图像加高层指令（可选外部视角）生成目标导向的连贯第一人称视频推演，核心是轨迹级扩散精修方法 GRAFT，用正/负 rollout 分布与目标、时序、场景一致性、感知奖励引导扩散速度场。实验显示其在语义对齐、几何稳定性、运动保真上相对强基线一致提升，并在真实智能眼镜实验中表现稳健。
Motivation: 现有第一人称视频世界模型要么只做手部指令合成且场景演化有限，要么只做静态视角转换不建模动作动态，要么依赖相机轨迹、长视频前缀、同步多相机等稠密监督，难以从极简静态输入模拟依赖潜在意图的目标导向操作。
Method: EgoForge 输入单张 egocentric 图像、高层指令与可选辅助 exocentric 视图；GRAFT 用由 goal、temporal、scene-consistency、perceptual rewards 构造的正负 rollout 分布，对扩散速度场做轨迹级精修，以对齐意图并保持时序连贯。
Result: 在语义对齐 (semantic alignment)、几何稳定性 (geometric stability)、运动保真 (motion fidelity) 三项上相对强基线取得一致增益，并在真实世界智能眼镜实验中表现稳健。
Conclusion: 目标导向的第一人称世界模拟可从极简静态输入出发，靠轨迹级扩散精修与多源奖励在不依赖稠密监督的情况下同时保住意图对齐与视频连贯。

papers.title: Man and machine: artificial intelligence and judicial decision making
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into judicial decision making -- particularly in pretrial, sentencing, and parole contexts -- has generated a substantial and rapidly growing literature. Across computer science, economics, law, criminology, and psychology, researchers have examined the reliability, fairness, and real-world effects of AI-assisted decision making. Yet this literature remains fragmented, and differences in assumptions, concepts, and research priorities make it difficult to assess what is actually known. Using criminal justice risk assessment as a focal case, this article makes two contributions. First, we develop a conceptual framework that distinguishes and relates three central questions: (1) the predictive validity of automated risk assessment tools; (2) how algorithmic risk assessments compare with human predictions (AI-versus-Human); and (3) how algorithmic recommendations affect judges' decisions (AI-plus-Human). Second, we use this framework to synthesize the empirical evidence addressing each of these questions. Our review identifies important limitations in existing research on predictive validity, as well as substantial gaps in understanding how judges respond to AI advice and how those responses vary across individuals and decision-making environments. The available evidence suggests that AI decision aids have, so far, had at most modest effects on pretrial and sentencing decisions. We conclude that further research is needed to understand how judges make decisions in noisy informational environments and under what conditions AI tools can produce meaningful improvements in judicial decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以刑事司法风险评估为焦点，把 AI 司法决策研究拆成三个问题：自动风险评估的预测效度、AI 对比人类预测 (AI-versus-Human)、AI 建议如何改变法官决策 (AI-plus-Human)，并据此整合跨学科实证证据。现有证据显示 AI 决策辅助迄今对审前与量刑决定至多只有温和影响，且预测效度研究存在重要局限、法官如何响应 AI 建议及其个体与情境差异仍有明显空白。
Motivation: AI 辅助司法决策文献分散在计算机科学、经济学、法学、犯罪学与心理学之间，假设、概念与研究重点不一致，难以判断究竟已知什么。
Method: 提出一个区分并关联三个核心问题（预测效度、AI-versus-Human、AI-plus-Human）的概念框架，并用该框架对每个问题的实证证据做综合综述，焦点案例为刑事司法风险评估。
Result: 综述发现现有预测效度研究存在重要局限，对法官如何响应 AI 建议以及响应如何随个体与决策环境变化的理解存在明显缺口；可得证据表明 AI 决策辅助迄今对审前与量刑决定至多只有温和影响 (modest effects)。
Conclusion: 进一步研究需弄清法官在含噪信息环境中如何做决策，以及 AI 工具在何种条件下才能带来实质性改善。

papers.title: Do Vision Language Models Understand Human Engagement in Games?
papers.abstract_en: Inferring human engagement from gameplay video is important for game design and player-experience research, yet it remains unclear whether vision--language models (VLMs) can infer such latent psychological states from visual cues alone. Using the GameVibe Few-Shot dataset across nine first-person shooter games, we evaluate three VLMs under six prompting strategies, including zero-shot prediction, theory-guided prompts grounded in Flow, GameFlow, Self-Determination Theory, and MDA, and retrieval-augmented prompting. We consider both pointwise engagement prediction and pairwise prediction of engagement change between consecutive windows. Results show that zero-shot VLM predictions are generally weak and often fail to outperform simple per-game majority-class baselines. Memory- or retrieval-augmented prompting improves pointwise prediction in some settings, whereas pairwise prediction remains consistently difficult across strategies. Theory-guided prompting alone does not reliably help and can instead reinforce surface-level shortcuts. These findings suggest a perception--understanding gap in current VLMs: although they can recognize visible gameplay cues, they still struggle to robustly infer human engagement across games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GameVibe Few-Shot 数据集（九款第一人称射击游戏）上评测三个 VLM 的玩家投入度 (engagement) 推断：零-shot 预测普遍偏弱，常不敌逐游戏多数类基线；记忆或检索增强提示在部分设置下改善逐点预测，而相邻窗口投入度变化的成对预测在所有策略下都持续困难；仅靠理论提示（Flow、GameFlow、SDT、MDA）并不可靠，反而会强化表面捷径。
Motivation: 游戏设计与玩家体验研究需要从游戏画面推断投入度这一潜在心理状态，但尚不清楚 VLM 能否仅凭视觉线索做到，且逐点与成对变化两种任务的难度差异未知。
Method: 在 GameVibe Few-Shot 数据集（九款 FPS 游戏）上评测三个 VLM、六种提示策略：零-shot 预测、基于 Flow、GameFlow、Self-Determination Theory 与 MDA 的理论引导提示、检索增强提示；任务同时含逐点投入度预测与相邻窗口间投入度变化的成对预测。
Result: 零-shot VLM 预测普遍偏弱，常不敌简单的逐游戏多数类基线；记忆或检索增强提示在部分设置下改善逐点预测；成对预测在所有策略下持续困难；仅用理论引导提示不能可靠提升，反而可能强化表面捷径。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 存在感知—理解鸿沟：能识别可见的游戏画面线索，却难以跨游戏稳健推断玩家投入度，尤其难以判断投入度的变化。

papers.title: The COTe score: A decomposable framework for evaluating Document Layout Analysis models
papers.abstract_en: Document Layout Analysis (DLA) is the process by which a page is parsed into meaningful elements, often using machine learning models. Typically, the quality of a model is judged using general machine vision metrics such as IoU, F1 or mAP. However, these metrics are designed for images that are 2D projections of 3D space, not for the natively 2D imagery of printed media. This discrepancy can result in misleading or uninformative interpretation of model performance. To encourage more robust, comparable, and nuanced DLA, we introduce: The Structural Semantic Unit (SSU), a relational labelling approach that shifts the focus from the physical to the semantic structure of the content; and the Coverage, Overlap, Trespass, and Excess (COTe) score, a decomposable metric for measuring page parsing quality. We demonstrate the value of these methods through case studies and by evaluating 5 common DLA models on 3 DLA datasets. We show that the COTe score is more informative than traditional metrics and reveals distinct failure modes across models, such as breaching semantic boundaries or repeatedly parsing the same region. We find that, under granularity differences between model and ground truth, the COTe score is substantially more robust than the F1. Even in the worst case, comparing character-level predictions against paragraph-level ground truth with otherwise perfect parsing, COTe returns 0.68 where F1 returns 0. Notably, we find that, on real datasets, the COTe's granularity robustness largely holds even without explicit SSU labelling, reducing the barrier to entry. Finally, we release an SSU labelled dataset and a Python library for applying COTe in DLA projects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出文档版面分析 (DLA) 的可分解评分框架：以 Structural Semantic Unit (SSU) 关系标注把评价对象从物理框转到语义结构，并给出 Coverage、Overlap、Trespass、Excess (COTe) 分数。在 3 个 DLA 数据集上评测 5 个常用模型，COTe 比 IoU/F1/mAP 更能揭示跨模型的不同失败模式；即使字符级预测对段落级真值这种最坏粒度差异，COTe 仍给 0.68 而 F1 为 0。
Motivation: IoU、F1、mAP 是为 3D 空间的 2D 投影图像设计的，用在原生 2D 的印刷页面上会给出误导或无信息的模型性能解读，且无法区分不同失败模式。
Method: 引入 SSU 关系标注，把标注焦点从物理结构移到内容语义结构；在此之上定义可分解的 COTe 分数，由 Coverage、Overlap、Trespass、Excess 四个分量组成。通过案例研究并在 3 个 DLA 数据集上评测 5 个常用 DLA 模型，同时发布一个 SSU 标注数据集和实现 COTe 的 Python 库。
Result: COTe 比传统指标更有信息量，揭示出跨模型的不同失败模式，如越过语义边界、反复解析同一区域。在模型与真值粒度不一致时 COTe 明显比 F1 稳健：最坏情形下字符级预测对段落级真值、其余解析完全正确时，COTe 返回 0.68 而 F1 返回 0。在真实数据集上，即使不做显式 SSU 标注，COTe 的粒度稳健性大体仍成立。
Conclusion: DLA 评价应从物理框匹配转向语义结构匹配，COTe 在粒度差异下比 F1 更可靠，且不强制 SSU 标注即可使用，降低了采用门槛。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Task Anti-Causal Learning for Reconstructing Urban Events from Residents' Reports
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world machine learning tasks are anti-causal: they require inferring latent causes from observed effects. In practice, we often face multiple related tasks where the structural dependencies are a hybrid of task-invariant and task-specific mechanisms. We propose Multi-Task Anti-Causal learning (MTAC), a framework for estimating causes from outcomes and confounders by explicitly exploiting such cross-task invariances. MTAC learns a structural equation model (SEM) that factorizes the outcome-generation process into (i) a task-invariant mechanism and (ii) task-specific mechanisms via a shared backbone with task-specific deviations. Building on the learned forward model, MTAC performs maximum A posteriori (MAP) based inference to reconstruct causes by jointly optimizing latent mechanism variables and cause magnitudes under the learned structural model. We evaluate MTAC on the application of urban event reconstruction from resident reports, spanning three tasks: parking violations, abandoned properties, and unsanitary conditions. On real-world data collected from Manhattan and Newark, MTAC consistently improves reconstruction accuracy over strong baselines, achieving up to 33.04\% MAE reduction and demonstrating the benefits of learning transferable mechanisms across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多任务反因果学习框架 MTAC，用共享骨干加任务特定偏移的结构方程模型 (SEM) 把结果生成过程分解为任务不变机制与任务特定机制，再在其上做 MAP 推断反推潜因。在 Manhattan 与 Newark 居民报告的三项城市事件重建任务上，MTAC 相对强基线最高降低 33.04% MAE。
Motivation: 反因果任务要从观测结果反推潜在原因，且多个相关任务的结构依赖混合了任务不变与任务特定机制，直接建模难以复用跨任务的可迁移机制。
Method: MTAC 学习一个结构方程模型，用共享骨干加任务特定偏移把结果生成过程分解为任务不变机制与任务特定机制；在学到的前向模型上做最大后验 (MAP) 推断，联合优化潜机制变量与原因幅度来重建原因。
Result: 在 Manhattan 与 Newark 真实数据上的三项任务（停车违规、废弃物业、卫生不良）中，MTAC 的重建精度一致优于强基线，MAE 最高降低 33.04%。
Conclusion: 跨任务共享可迁移机制能提升从居民报告反推城市事件原因的重建精度，收益来自任务不变机制与任务特定偏移的分解。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FocusGraph: Graph-Structured Frame Selection for Embodied Long Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Understanding long videos is crucial for embodied intelligent agents, as their performance depends on effectively accumulating and using long-horizon perceptual memories. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used for long-video understanding, but their performance degrades and inference time increases as more frames are provided. Therefore, selecting informative keyframes is essential for efficient question answering over long videos. In this work, we develop FocusGraph, a framework for keyframe selection in egocentric long-video question answering. It includes a lightweight Scene-Graph LLM Selector that identifies query-relevant clips from compact graph-based captions, avoiding the need to process raw frame sequences at question time. From these clips, we extract keyframes using Patch-wise Sparse-Flow Retention (PSFR), an offline program-evolved method with no learned parameters at inference time, before passing them to an MLLM for answer generation. FocusGraph achieves state-of-the-art performance on FindingDory and HourVideo while reducing question-time inference cost compared with existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FocusGraph 针对具身第一视角长视频问答提出两阶段关键帧选择：先用轻量 Scene-Graph LLM Selector 从图结构字幕中挑出与问题相关的片段，再用无推理期参数的 Patch-wise Sparse-Flow Retention (PSFR) 在片段内抽取关键帧送入 MLLM 作答。在 FindingDory 与 HourVideo 上达到 state-of-the-art，同时降低提问时的推理成本。
Motivation: MLLM 处理长视频时随帧数增加性能下降、推理时间上升，而具身智能体依赖长时程感知记忆，需要在提问时高效选出信息量大的关键帧。
Method: 框架含 Scene-Graph LLM Selector，基于紧凑的图结构字幕 (graph-based captions) 定位查询相关片段，避免提问时处理原始帧序列；再用离线程序演化 (program-evolved)、推理期无学习参数的 Patch-wise Sparse-Flow Retention (PSFR) 从片段中抽取关键帧，最后交给 MLLM 生成答案。
Result: 在 FindingDory 与 HourVideo 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并相对现有方法降低提问时的推理成本。
Conclusion: 先按图结构字幕选片段、再用无参数的稀疏光流保留法抽帧，可以在具身长视频问答上同时保住精度并压低推理开销。

summary_sections.conclusion: 先按图结构字幕选片段、再用无参数的稀疏光流保留法抽帧，可以在具身长视频问答上同时保住精度并压低推理开销。

papers.title: The Alignment Flywheel: A Governance-Centric Hybrid MAS for Architecture-Agnostic Safety
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems provide mature abstractions for role decomposition, coordination, and normative governance, but increasingly capable learned components make post-deployment safety harder to inspect, audit, and update. When safety behavior is absorbed into a decision component, narrow failures may require retraining or rollback of the full component. This instantiates our vision of the Alignment Flywheel as a governance-centric hybrid MAS architecture that decouples decision generation from safety governance. We denote the agent or policy that generates candidate trajectories as the Proposer; it passes its output to a governed Safety Oracle stack, which returns safety scores, prediction uncertainty, audit coverage uncertainty, and evidence hooks through a stable interface. An Enforcement layer applies explicit risk policy at runtime. Around this loop, a governance MAS performs monitoring, red-teaming, verification, triage, refinement, and versioned release management. The central engineering principle is patch locality: many newly observed safety failures can be mitigated through small governance batches for the Oracle stack and its audit state rather than by retraining or retracting the Proposer. The architecture is implementation-agnostic with respect to both Proposer and Oracle. It defines the roles, artifacts, protocols, and release semantics needed for runtime gating, audit intake, signed updates, staged rollout, and rollback. We demonstrate executability in two scenarios: a learned spatial Oracle patched through regression-checked governance updates, and a clinical GenAI proxy setting illustrating structured norms, escalation, and audit coverage. Our implementation code and documentation are available open source at https://github.com/decide-ugent/Alignment-Flywheel.
papers.comment: Accepted for the EMAS workshop at AAMAS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Alignment Flywheel：把生成候选轨迹的 Proposer 与受治理的 Safety Oracle 栈、运行时 Enforcement 层解耦，用小批量治理补丁（patch locality）修复新观察到的安全失败，而不必重训或回滚整个 Proposer。架构对 Proposer 与 Oracle 实现均无关，并在学习型空间 Oracle 与临床 GenAI 代理两个场景中演示可执行性。
Motivation: 多智能体系统 (MAS) 的角色分解与规范治理已成熟，但学习组件把安全行为吸收进决策器后，部署后安全难以检查、审计与更新；一次局部失败可能要重训或回滚整个组件。
Method: 治理中心的混合 MAS 架构：Proposer 生成候选轨迹，交给受治理的 Safety Oracle 栈，经稳定接口返回安全分数、预测不确定性、审计覆盖不确定性与 evidence hooks；Enforcement 层在运行时执行显式风险策略，外层治理 MAS 负责监控、红队、验证、分诊、精化与版本化发布（含签名更新、分阶段上线与回滚）。
Result: 在两个场景演示可执行性：学习型空间 Oracle 通过带回归检查的治理更新完成补丁；临床 GenAI 代理场景展示结构化规范、升级路径与审计覆盖。实现代码与文档以开源形式发布于 GitHub 仓库 decide-ugent/Alignment-Flywheel。
Conclusion: 安全失败可通过针对 Oracle 栈与审计状态的小批量治理批次缓解，而非重训或撤回 Proposer；架构对 Proposer 与 Oracle 的具体实现保持无关。

papers.title: ProtoDCS: Towards Robust and Efficient Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot recognition, yet their real-world deployment is challenged by distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this, existing VLM-based TTA methods operate under a closed-set assumption, failing in open-set scenarios where test streams contain both covariate-shifted in-distribution (csID) and out-of-distribution (csOOD) data. This leads to a critical difficulty: the model must discriminate unknown csOOD samples to avoid interference while simultaneously adapting to known csID classes for accuracy. Current open-set TTA (OSTTA) methods rely on hard thresholds for separation and entropy minimization for adaptation. These strategies are brittle, often misclassifying ambiguous csOOD samples and inducing overconfident predictions, and their parameter-update mechanism is computationally prohibitive for VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose Prototype-based Double-Check Separation (ProtoDCS), a robust framework for OSTTA that effectively separates csID and csOOD samples, enabling safe and efficient adaptation of VLMs to csID data. Our main contributions are: (1) a novel double-check separation mechanism employing probabilistic Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) verification to replace brittle thresholding; and (2) an evidence-driven adaptation strategy utilizing uncertainty-aware loss and efficient prototype-level updates, mitigating overconfidence and reducing computational overhead. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10/100-C and Tiny-ImageNet-C demonstrate that ProtoDCS achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly boosting both known-class accuracy and OOD detection metrics. Code will be available at https://github.com/O-YangF/ProtoDCS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoDCS 针对视觉-语言模型的开放集测试时适应 (open-set TTA)：用概率高斯混合模型 (GMM) 的双重校验分离替代硬阈值，把协变量偏移的分布内 (csID) 与分布外 (csOOD) 样本区分开，再用不确定性感知损失加原型级 (prototype-level) 高效更新做适应。在 CIFAR-10/100-C 与 Tiny-ImageNet-C 上达到 SOTA，同时提升已知类精度与 OOD 检测指标。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 的 TTA 方法假设闭集，而真实测试流同时含 csID 与 csOOD；依赖硬阈值与熵最小化的 OSTTA 易误分模糊 csOOD 样本、产生过自信预测，且参数更新对 VLM 计算代价过高。
Method: 提出 Prototype-based Double-Check Separation (ProtoDCS)：一是用概率 GMM 验证的双重校验分离机制取代脆弱阈值；二是证据驱动的适应策略，用不确定性感知损失与高效的原型级更新替代全参数更新，抑制过自信并降低计算开销。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100-C 与 Tiny-ImageNet-C 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，显著提升已知类精度与 OOD 检测指标；代码将发布于 github.com/O-YangF/ProtoDCS。
Conclusion: 以概率分离加原型级更新取代硬阈值与熵最小化，可在开放集测试流上同时实现 VLM 的安全分离与高效适应。

papers.title: InterviewSim: A Scalable Framework for Interview-Grounded Personality Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulating real personalities with large language models requires grounding generation in authentic personal data. Existing evaluation approaches rely on demographic surveys, personality questionnaires, or short AI-led interviews as proxies, but lack direct assessment against what individuals actually said. We address this gap with an interview-grounded evaluation framework for personality simulation at a large scale. We extract over 671,000 question-answer pairs from 23,000 verified interview transcripts across 1,000 public personalities, each with an average of 11.5 hours of interview content. We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework with four complementary metrics measuring content similarity, factual consistency, personality alignment, and factual knowledge retention. Through systematic comparison, we find that interview grounding yields consistent gains in content alignment and exact-match factual recall over biographical profiles and parametric prompting. We further find complementary strengths: retrieval-augmented methods tend to preserve personality alignment, while larger chronological contexts generally reduce contradictions and improve factual recall. Our evaluation framework enables principled method selection based on application requirements, and our empirical findings provide actionable insights for advancing personality simulation research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InterviewSim 用 23,000 段真实访谈转录（1,000 位公众人物、人均 11.5 小时）替代人口统计问卷与 AI 短访谈，作为人格模拟的接地与评测依据。系统比较显示访谈接地在内容对齐与精确匹配事实召回上稳定优于传记档案和参数化提示；检索增强更保人格对齐，更长的按时间顺序上下文则减少矛盾、提升事实召回。
Motivation: 现有人格模拟评测只用人口统计问卷、人格量表或 AI 主导的短访谈作代理，无法对照个体实际说过的话直接打分。
Method: 从 1,000 位公众人物的 23,000 段已验证访谈转录中抽取超过 671,000 组问答对（人均 11.5 小时访谈内容），构建大规模访谈接地评测框架，含四条互补指标：内容相似度、事实一致性、人格对齐、事实知识保持；并系统比较访谈接地、传记档案、参数化提示、检索增强与按时间顺序长上下文等设定。
Result: 访谈接地相对传记档案与参数化提示在内容对齐和精确匹配 (exact-match) 事实召回上取得一致增益；检索增强方法倾向保持人格对齐，更大的按时间顺序上下文总体上减少矛盾并改善事实召回。数据规模为 671,000+ 问答对、23,000 段转录、1,000 位人物、平均每人 11.5 小时。
Conclusion: 真实访谈是人格模拟的更可靠接地源，且不同接地策略各有取舍，应按应用需求（要人格对齐还是低矛盾高召回）选择方法。

papers.title: JEPA-Bisim: Learning Robust Visual Representations for Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models learned from high-dimensional visual observations allow agents to make decisions and plan directly in latent space, avoiding pixel-level reconstruction. However, recent latent predictive architectures (JEPAs), including the DINO world model (DINO-WM), display a degradation in test time robustness due to their sensitivity to ``slow features". These include visual variations such as background changes and distractors that are irrelevant to the task being solved. We address this limitation by augmenting the predictive objective with a bisimulation encoder that enforces control-relevant state equivalence, mapping states with similar transition dynamics to nearby latent states while limiting contributions from slow features. We evaluate our model on a navigation task (PointMaze) and on a manipulation task (PushT) under different test-time background changes and visual distractors. Across all benchmarks, our model consistently improves robustness to slow features while operating in a reduced latent space, up to $10\times$ smaller than that of DINO-WM. Moreover, our model is agnostic to the choice of pre-trained visual encoder and maintains robustness when paired with DINOv2, SimDINOv2, and iBOT features.
papers.comment: This version refines the text and provides additional numerical validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEPA-Bisim 在 DINO-WM 类联合嵌入预测世界模型的预测目标上加一个 bisimulation 编码器，把转移动力学相近的状态映射到相近潜状态，从而压低背景变化与干扰物这类 slow features 的影响。在 PointMaze 导航与 PushT 操作任务的不同测试时背景变化和视觉干扰下，模型在更小的潜空间（比 DINO-WM 最多小 10×）中仍持续提升对 slow features 的鲁棒性，且换用 DINOv2、SimDINOv2、iBOT 特征都保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 潜空间预测架构（JEPA）与 DINO-WM 对与任务无关的视觉慢变特征（背景变化、干扰物）敏感，导致测试时鲁棒性下降，无法直接在潜空间规划。
Method: 在预测目标上叠加 bisimulation 编码器，施加控制相关状态等价约束：转移动力学相似的状态映射到邻近潜状态，同时限制 slow features 的贡献；配合预训练视觉编码器在潜空间做规划。
Result: 在 PointMaze 导航与 PushT 操作两个任务、不同测试时背景变化与视觉干扰下，模型在全部基准上持续提升对 slow features 的鲁棒性，同时潜空间比 DINO-WM 最多缩小 10×；配 DINOv2、SimDINOv2、iBOT 三种预训练特征均保持鲁棒，对编码器选择不敏感。
Conclusion: 把 bisimulation 的控制相关状态等价直接写进 JEPA 预测目标，可以在压缩潜空间的同时消除 slow features 引起的测试时鲁棒性退化，且不依赖特定预训练视觉编码器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Capabilities Ain't All You Need: Measuring Propensities in AI
papers.abstract_en: AI evaluation has primarily focused on measuring capabilities, with formal approaches inspired from Item Response Theory (IRT) being increasingly applied. Yet propensities - the tendencies of models to exhibit particular behaviours - play a central role in determining both performance and safety outcomes. However, traditional IRT describes a model's success on a task as a monotonic function of model capabilities and task demands, an approach unsuited to propensities, where both excess and deficiency can be problematic. Here, we introduce the first formal framework for measuring AI propensities by using a bilogistic formulation for model success, which attributes high success probability when the model's propensity is within an "ideal band". Further, we estimate the limits of the ideal band using LLMs equipped with newly developed task-agnostic rubrics. Applying our framework to six families of LLM models whose propensities are incited in either direction, we find that we can measure how much the propensity is shifted and what effect this has on the tasks. Critically, propensities estimated using one benchmark successfully predict behaviour on held-out tasks. Moreover, we obtain stronger predictive power when combining propensities and capabilities than either separately. More broadly, our framework showcases how rigorous propensity measurements can be conducted and how it yields gains over solely using capability evaluations to predict AI behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个 AI 倾向性 (propensity) 形式化测量框架：用 bilogistic 成功函数替代 IRT 的单调函数，使模型倾向落在“理想区间”内时成功概率最高，过高过低都算问题。区间边界由带任务无关 rubric 的 LLM 估计；在六个 LLM 家族上，倾向被双向激发后可测出偏移量及其任务影响，且倾向能预测留出任务行为，倾向与能力合并预测力强于任一单独使用。
Motivation: AI 评估长期只测能力，IRT 把任务成功当作能力与任务难度的单调函数，无法刻画倾向性——偏离与不足同样有害的行为倾向，而倾向直接决定性能与安全结果。
Method: 用 bilogistic 形式建模模型成功概率，把成功归因于倾向落在“理想区间”内；用配备新开发的任务无关 (task-agnostic) rubric 的 LLM 估计理想区间边界；在六个 LLM 家族上激发双向倾向以测量偏移，并比较倾向、能力及二者合并对留出任务行为的预测力。
Result: 在六个 LLM 家族上可测出倾向被激发的偏移量及其对任务的影响；用一个基准估计的倾向能成功预测留出任务上的行为；倾向与能力合并的预测力强于单独使用倾向或能力。
Conclusion: 倾向性可以被严格测量，且相比只用能力评估，加入倾向测量能更好地预测 AI 行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SeedFlood: A Step Toward Scalable Decentralized Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: This work presents SeedFlood, a new approach to decentralized LLM fine-tuning designed to scale across large models, large collaborations, and complex network topologies while achieving global consensus with negligible communication overhead. Traditional methods suffer from high communication costs that grow with model size, while information decay over network hops renders global consensus inefficient. SeedFlood takes a significant departure from these practices by exploiting the seed-reconstructible structure of zeroth-order gradients and effectively making the messages to transmit near-zero in size, allowing them to be flooded to every client in the network, and thereby enhancing scalability of decentralized training. Consequently, SeedFlood enables training in regimes previously considered impractical, such as billion-parameter scale models or distributed across hundred of clients. Our experiments on decentralized LLM fine-tuning demonstrate that SeedFlood consistently outperforms the standard zeroth-order baselines in both communication efficiency and generalization performance, and even achieves results comparable to first-order gossip-based methods in large-scale settings, while requiring orders-of-magnitude less communication cost. We also provide theoretical analysis to formalize that SeedFlood avoids topology-dependent consensus terms in the convergence bound while retaining the acceleration enabled by increased client participation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeedFlood 利用零阶 (zeroth-order) 梯度可由随机种子重构的结构，把待传输消息压到近零大小并直接在网络中洪泛 (flood) 到每个客户端，从而在通信开销几乎不随模型与网络规模增长的前提下做去中心化 LLM 微调。实验显示它在通信效率与泛化性能上一致优于标准零阶基线，大规模设定下可与一阶 gossip 方法相当，而通信成本低若干个数量级。
Motivation: 去中心化 LLM 微调的通信开销随模型规模增长，且信息经多跳后衰减，使全局共识在大模型、大协作与复杂拓扑下低效甚至不可行。
Method: 利用零阶梯度的 seed-reconstructible 结构，把每条消息压到近零大小并洪泛至全网客户端；配套给出收敛性理论分析，去掉收敛界中依赖拓扑的共识项，同时保留客户端参与带来的加速。
Result: 在去中心化 LLM 微调实验中，SeedFlood 在通信效率与泛化性能上一致优于标准零阶基线，大规模设定下达到与一阶 gossip 方法可比的结果，通信成本低若干数量级；使十亿参数级模型、数百客户端分布式训练成为可行区间。
Conclusion: 把零阶梯度的可重构性当作通信压缩手段，可以让去中心化训练的通信量与模型规模和网络拓扑解耦，同时不牺牲一阶方法式的加速。

papers.title: Efficient Generative Modeling beyond Memoryless Diffusion via Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models often yield highly curved trajectories and noisy score targets due to an uninformative, memoryless forward process that induces independent data-noise coupling. We propose Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Matching (ASBM), a generative modeling framework that recovers optimal trajectories in high dimensions via two stages. First, we view the Schrödinger Bridge (SB) forward dynamic as a coupling construction problem and learn it through a data-to-energy sampling perspective that transports data to an energy-defined prior. Then, we learn the backward generative dynamic with a simple matching loss supervised by the induced optimal coupling. By operating in a non-memoryless regime, ASBM produces significantly straighter and more efficient sampling paths. Compared to prior works, ASBM scales to high-dimensional data with notably improved stability and efficiency. Extensive experiments on image generation show that ASBM improves fidelity with fewer sampling steps. We further showcase the effectiveness of our optimal trajectory via distillation to a one-step generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASBM 把 Schrödinger Bridge 的前向动态当作耦合构造问题，用 data-to-energy sampling 学出把数据运送到能量定义先验的耦合，再用该耦合诱导的最优耦合以 matching loss 学反向生成动态，从而脱离 memoryless 扩散。非 memoryless 机制产生更直、更高效的采样路径，在图像生成上以更少采样步数提升保真度，并可蒸馏为 one-step generator。
Motivation: 扩散模型的前向过程无记忆且数据-噪声独立耦合，导致采样轨迹高度弯曲、score 目标噪声大，高维下训练与采样效率受限。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段把 SB 前向动态视为耦合构造，用 data-to-energy sampling 把数据运送到能量定义的 prior；第二阶段以该最优耦合为监督，用简单 matching loss 学习反向生成动态，整体运行在非 memoryless 体制。
Result: 在图像生成实验中，ASBM 以更少采样步数提升生成保真度；相比先前工作扩展到高维数据时稳定性与效率明显改善，采样路径显著更直；最优轨迹可通过蒸馏得到 one-step generator。
Conclusion: 作者主张非 memoryless 的 Schrödinger Bridge 匹配能同时给出更直的最优轨迹与更高效的高维采样，且该轨迹足以支撑单步蒸馏。

papers.title: Wrivinder: Towards Spatial Intelligence for Geo-locating Ground Images onto Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Aligning ground-level imagery with geo-registered satellite maps is crucial for mapping, navigation, and situational awareness, yet remains challenging under large viewpoint gaps or when GPS is unreliable. We introduce Wrivinder, a zero-shot, geometry-driven framework that aggregates multiple ground photographs to reconstruct a consistent 3D scene and align it with overhead satellite imagery. Wrivinder combines SfM reconstruction, 3D Gaussian Splatting, semantic grounding, and monocular depth--based metric cues to produce a stable zenith-view rendering that can be directly matched to satellite context for metrically accurate camera geo-localization. To support systematic evaluation of this task, which lacks suitable benchmarks, we also release MC-Sat, a curated dataset linking multi-view ground imagery with geo-registered satellite tiles across diverse outdoor environments. Together, Wrivinder and MC-Sat provide a first comprehensive baseline and testbed for studying geometry-centered cross-view alignment without paired supervision. In zero-shot experiments, Wrivinder achieves sub-30\,m geolocation accuracy across both dense and large-area scenes, highlighting the promise of geometry-based aggregation for robust ground-to-satellite localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Wrivinder 是零样本、几何驱动的地面图像对卫星影像地理定位框架：用 SfM 重建加 3D Gaussian Splatting 聚合多张地面照片得到一致 3D 场景，配合语义锚定与单目深度度量线索渲染出稳定的天顶视角图，再与卫星上下文直接匹配。零样本实验中在密集场景与大范围场景上均达到 30 m 以内的地理定位精度。
Motivation: 地面视角与卫星俯视之间视角差极大，GPS 不可靠时地面图像难以精确配准到卫星地图，而该任务缺少可用的评测基准。
Method: 流水线组合 SfM 重建、3D Gaussian Splatting、语义 grounding 与单目深度度量线索，生成可与卫星影像直接匹配的天顶视角 (zenith-view) 渲染，实现度量精度的相机地理定位；同时发布 MC-Sat 数据集，关联多视角地面图像与地理配准卫星瓦片。
Result: 零样本实验中 Wrivinder 在密集场景与大范围场景上均取得 sub-30 m 地理定位精度；并发布 MC-Sat 数据集作为该任务的首个综合基线与测试平台。
Conclusion: 几何聚合可以在无配对监督的条件下实现稳健的地面到卫星定位，为跨视角对齐提供以几何为中心的基线与测试集。

papers.title: PhGPO: Pheromone-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Tool Planning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in executing complex tasks through tool use. However, long-horizon multi-step tool planning is challenging, because the exploration space suffers from a combinatorial explosion. In this scenario, even when a correct tool-use path is found, it is usually considered an immediate reward for current training, which would not provide any reusable information for subsequent training. In this paper, we argue that historically successful trajectories contain reusable tool-transition patterns, which can be leveraged throughout the whole training process. Inspired by ant colony optimization where historically successful paths can be reflected by the pheromone, we propose Pheromone-Guided Policy Optimization (PhGPO), which learns a trajectory-based transition pattern (i.e., pheromone) from historical trajectories and then uses the learned pheromone to guide policy optimization. This learned pheromone provides explicit and reusable guidance that steers policy optimization toward historically successful tool transitions, thereby improving long-horizon tool planning. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed PhGPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhGPO 借鉴蚁群优化，把历史成功轨迹中可复用的工具转移模式学成“信息素”，再用它引导策略优化，缓解长程多步工具规划中组合爆炸与即时奖励不可复用的问题。摘要称综合实验验证了其有效性，但未给出具体指标数值。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长程多步工具规划面临组合爆炸式探索空间；即使找到正确工具路径，也只被当作当前训练的即时奖励，无法为后续训练提供可复用信息。
Method: 提出 Pheromone-Guided Policy Optimization (PhGPO)：从历史轨迹中学习基于轨迹的转移模式（即 pheromone），再用该 pheromone 显式引导策略优化，使其偏向历史上成功的工具转移。
Result: 摘要仅称“综合实验结果证明了 PhGPO 的有效性”，未给出数据集、基线或定量指标。
Conclusion: 历史成功轨迹中的工具转移模式可作为贯穿整个训练过程的可复用引导信号，用于改进长程工具规划。

papers.title: TensorCommitments: A Lightweight Verifiable Inference for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Most large language models (LLMs) run on external clouds: users send a prompt, pay for inference, and must trust that the remote GPU executes the LLM without any adversarial tampering. We critically ask how to achieve verifiable LLM inference, where a prover (the service) must convince a verifier (the client) that an inference was run correctly without rerunning the LLM. Existing cryptographic works are too slow at the LLM scale, while non-cryptographic ones require a strong verifier GPU. We propose TensorCommitments (TCs), a tensor-native proof-of-inference scheme. TC binds the LLM inference to a commitment, an irreversible tag that breaks under tampering, organized in our multivariate Terkle Trees. For LLaMA2, TC adds only 0.97% prover and 0.12% verifier time over inference while improving robustness to tailored LLM attacks by up to 48% over the best prior work requiring a verifier GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TensorCommitments (TC)，一种张量原生的 LLM 推理证明方案：把推理绑定到不可逆的 commitment 标签，标签用多变量 Terkle Trees 组织，一旦被篡改即失效，从而让客户端在不重跑模型的情况下验证云端推理正确性。对 LLaMA2，TC 只增加 0.97% prover 时间与 0.12% verifier 时间，相比需要 verifier GPU 的最佳已有工作，对针对性 LLM 攻击的鲁棒性最多提升 48%。
Motivation: LLM 普遍跑在外部云上，用户无法确认远端 GPU 未被篡改地执行了模型；已有密码学方案在 LLM 规模上太慢，非密码学方案又要求客户端有强 GPU。
Method: TC 将 LLM 推理绑定到一个不可逆的 commitment（被篡改即破裂的标签），标签结构为多变量 Terkle Trees，构成张量原生的 proof-of-inference；验证方无需重跑 LLM，也无需强 GPU。
Result: 在 LLaMA2 上，prover 时间开销 0.97%，verifier 时间开销 0.12%；相对需要 verifier GPU 的最佳已有工作，对针对性 LLM 攻击的鲁棒性最多提升 48%。
Conclusion: 张量原生的 commitment 可以把可验证 LLM 推理的开销压到 1% 量级，同时摆脱对强 verifier GPU 的依赖，并在对抗性篡改下更鲁棒。

papers.title: Modeling The Object Representations Underlying Human Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Humans appear to represent objects when reasoning about physics with coarse, volumetric "bodies" that smooth concavities, trading fine visual detail for efficient physical predictions. Yet, the structure of these representations remains largely unknown. Segmentation models, in contrast, are trained for pixel-accurate masks that may misalign with such bodies. We ask whether and when these models nonetheless acquire human-like object representations. Using a time-to-collision (TTC) and change detection (CD) behavioral task with data from 178 and 50 human participants, respectively, we introduce a pipeline and an alignment metric to compare the visual representations of segmentation models to those of humans. We do this systematically on multiple architectures (DINOv2, SegFormer, DeepLabV3+, and UPerNet), varying their size and training time. We find that briefly trained models segment objects too coarsely, aligning poorly with humans, while fully trained models segment objects too finely. For each model, there is an intermediate training regime that best matches the coarse bodies observed in human behaviour, and larger models tend to reach it earlier. We show these bodies emerge under resource constraints in general-purpose vision models, providing computational support to resource-rational accounts of human cognition. This work provides a foundational framework for testing alignment between vision models and humans and shows there is a growing gap between the state-of-the-art in artificial intelligence and human cognition, driven by scaling model size and training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 TTC 与 change detection 两类行为任务（分别 178 与 50 名人类被试）建立对齐度量，比较分割模型与人类的物体表征：训练不足的模型切分过粗、对齐差，训练充分的模型切分过细，每个模型都存在一个最接近人类粗粒度“body”的中间训练阶段，且模型越大越早到达该阶段。
Motivation: 人类物理推理用抹平凹陷的粗粒度体积“body”做预测，而分割模型按像素级精确掩码训练，两者表征结构是否以及何时对齐尚不清楚。
Method: 提出一套流水线与对齐度量，用 TTC 和 change detection 行为任务数据（178 与 50 名被试）比较分割模型与人类的视觉表征，系统覆盖 DINOv2、SegFormer、DeepLabV3+、UPerNet 多个架构并改变模型规模与训练时长。
Result: 短暂训练的模型切分过粗、与人类对齐差；完全训练的模型切分过细；每个模型都存在一个最匹配人类行为中粗粒度 body 的中间训练区间，模型越大越早进入该区间。
Conclusion: 粗粒度 body 在通用视觉模型的资源约束下自然涌现，为人类认知的 resource-rational 解释提供计算支持；同时表明随模型规模与训练量扩大，AI 与人类认知的差距在拉大。

papers.title: Evaluating Memory Structure in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM-based agents and chat assistants rely on long-term memory frameworks to store reusable knowledge, recall user preferences, and augment reasoning. As researchers create more complex memory architectures, it becomes increasingly difficult to analyze their capabilities and guide future memory designs. Most long-term memory benchmarks focus on simple fact retention, multi-hop recall, and time-based changes. While undoubtedly important, these capabilities can often be achieved with simple retrieval-augmented LLMs and do not test complex memory hierarchies. To bridge this gap, we propose StructMemEval - a benchmark that tests the agent's ability to organize its long-term memory, not just factual recall. We gather a suite of tasks that humans solve by organizing their knowledge in a specific structure: transaction ledgers, to-do lists, trees and others. Our initial experiments show that simple retrieval-augmented LLMs struggle with these tasks, whereas memory agents can reliably solve them if prompted how to organize their memory. However, we also find that modern LLMs do not always recognize the memory structure when not prompted to do so. This highlights an important direction for future improvements in both LLM training and memory frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 StructMemEval，一个测试 LLM agent 长期记忆组织能力（而非事实回忆）的基准，任务取自人类需要按结构组织知识的场景：交易流水、待办清单、树结构等。初步实验显示简单检索增强 LLM 在这些任务上吃力，而记忆 agent 在被提示如何组织记忆时能可靠完成；但现代 LLM 在无提示时常常识别不出该用的记忆结构。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准多测事实保持、多跳回忆与时间性变化，这些能力用简单 RAG 即可达成，无法检验复杂记忆层级，导致记忆架构设计缺少可分析的评测抓手。
Method: 构建 StructMemEval 基准，收集一组人类需按特定结构组织知识才能解决的任务（transaction ledgers、to-do lists、trees 等），对比简单检索增强 LLM 与记忆 agent，并区分有无组织提示两种条件。
Result: 初步实验：简单检索增强 LLM 在结构组织类任务上表现吃力；记忆 agent 在被告知如何组织记忆时可可靠解决；现代 LLM 在无提示条件下并不总能识别所需的记忆结构。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 记忆结构识别是独立于事实回忆的能力，且当前 LLM 需要显式提示才会按结构组织记忆，这指向 LLM 训练与记忆框架两方面的改进方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VideoSTF: Stress-Testing Output Repetition in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved strong performance on video understanding tasks, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only what models predict, leaving the stability of how they generate largely unexamined. We surface a previously underexplored generation failure of VideoLLMs, defined as output repetition, in which the decoder collapses into self-reinforcing loops of repeated phrases or sentences, and present VideoSTF, a benchmarking framework for systematically measuring, stress-testing, and exploiting this failure mode. VideoSTF formalizes repetition with three complementary $n$-gram-based metrics, ships a standardized testbed of 10,000 diverse videos, and provides a library of controlled temporal stressors. Across 10 advanced VideoLLMs, VideoSTF reveals four key findings: (i) repetition is pervasive on unperturbed videos and stable across commonly used frame counts, with repetition rates up to 91%; (ii) it spans a severity spectrum from mild redundancy to token-cap loops, and is highly amplified by temporal perturbations; (iii) temporal stressors form a practical black-box attack surface, flipping benign videos into repetitive ones with tens of queries and high attack success rates (up to 98%), and (iv) repetition is not explained by visual redundancy, its amplification tracks local temporal disruption, and only repetition penalties reduce it among common mitigations such as top-$k$ sampling, input filtering, and prompt variation, but increasing the penalty weakens visual grounding. VideoSTF reframes generation stability as a useful and complementary evaluation axis for VideoLLMs and provides the tools to study it. The project page is available at https://videostf.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoSTF 把 VideoLLM 的输出重复（output repetition）作为生成稳定性缺陷来系统压测：用三个 n-gram 指标形式化重复，配 10,000 条多样视频的标准化测试床与可控时间扰动库。在 10 个先进 VideoLLM 上，未扰动视频的重复率最高达 91%，时间扰动可作为黑盒攻击面、数十次查询内把良性视频翻成重复输出、攻击成功率最高 98%；常见缓解手段中只有 repetition penalty 能降低重复，但惩罚加大又会削弱视觉对齐。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准只评模型预测了什么，不评生成过程是否稳定；VideoLLM 解码器会塌进自我强化的重复短语或句子循环，这一失效模式此前基本未被刻画。
Method: VideoSTF 用三个互补的 n-gram 指标形式化重复，提供含 10,000 条多样视频的标准化测试床和一组可控时间扰动 (temporal stressors)，并把扰动当作黑盒攻击手段；同时对比 top-k sampling、输入过滤、prompt 变化与 repetition penalty 等缓解方式。
Result: 在 10 个先进 VideoLLM 上：未扰动视频重复普遍存在且在常用帧数下稳定，重复率最高 91%；严重度从轻度冗余到 token 级死循环，时间扰动显著放大；数十次查询即可把良性视频翻成重复输出，攻击成功率最高 98%；重复不能由视觉冗余解释，其放大与局部时间扰动对应；在 top-k、输入过滤、prompt 变化等常见缓解中只有 repetition penalty 降低重复，但加大惩罚会削弱视觉对齐 (visual grounding)。
Conclusion: 生成稳定性应作为与准确率互补的 VideoLLM 评测轴，时间扰动是实用的黑盒攻击面，而 repetition penalty 是唯一有效但会牺牲视觉对齐的缓解手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Online Generalized-Mean Welfare Maximization: Achieving Near-Optimal Regret from Samples
papers.abstract_en: We study online fair allocation of $T$ sequentially arriving items among $n$ agents with heterogeneous preferences, with the objective of maximizing generalized-mean welfare, defined as the $p$-mean of agents' time-averaged utilities, with $p\in (-\infty, 1)$. We first consider the i.i.d. arrival model and show that the pure greedy algorithm -- which myopically chooses the welfare-maximizing integral allocation -- achieves $\widetilde{O}(1/T)$ average regret. Importantly, in contrast to prior work, our algorithm does not require distributional knowledge and achieves the optimal regret rate using only the online samples. We then go beyond i.i.d. arrivals and investigate a nonstationary model with time-varying independent distributions. In the absence of additional data about the distributions, it is known that every online algorithm must suffer $Ω(1)$ average regret. We show that only a single historical sample from each distribution is sufficient to recover the optimal $\widetilde{O}(1/T)$ average regret rate, even in the face of arbitrary non-stationarity. Our algorithms are based on the re-solving paradigm: they assume that the remaining items will be the ones seen historically in those periods and solve the resulting welfare-maximization problem to determine the decision in every period. Finally, we also account for distribution shifts that may distort the fidelity of historical samples and show that the performance of our re-solving algorithms is robust to such shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线公平分配中，纯贪心与 re-solving 算法只用在线样本即可把广义均值福利 (generalized-mean welfare, p∈(-∞,1)) 的平均后悔降到 Õ(1/T)：i.i.d. 到达下贪心无需分布知识即达最优速率；非平稳、时变独立分布下，每个分布仅需一个历史样本即可恢复 Õ(1/T)，而无额外数据时任何算法都必须承受 Ω(1)。
Motivation: 在线分配若要最优后悔通常需要知道到达分布，而现实中分布时变且不可知：非平稳模型下无额外分布数据时任何算法都有 Ω(1) 平均后悔的下界，历史样本还可能因分布漂移失真。
Method: 基于 re-solving 范式：假设剩余物品为历史同期出现过的物品，每期求解相应的福利最大化问题来决定当期分配；先在 i.i.d. 到达模型上用纯贪心（myopically 选择福利最大化的整数分配），再扩展到时变独立分布的非stationary 模型，并分析历史样本受分布漂移影响时的鲁棒性。
Result: i.i.d. 到达下纯贪心达到 Õ(1/T) 平均后悔，且不需分布知识、仅用在线样本即达最优速率；非平稳时变独立分布下，无额外分布数据时任何在线算法必须 Ω(1) 平均后悔，而每个分布仅一个历史样本即足以恢复 Õ(1/T)，即使分布任意非平稳；re-solving 算法对扭曲历史样本保真度的分布漂移表现鲁棒。
Conclusion: 最优在线公平分配后悔的关键不是完整分布知识，而是每期分布的单个历史样本，配合 re-solving 即可在任意非平稳下保持 Õ(1/T) 并对分布漂移鲁棒。

papers.title: MedFeat: Model-Aware and Explainability-Driven Feature Engineering with LLMs for Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In clinical tabular prediction, classical machine learning models with feature engineering often outperform neural methods. LLMs are increasingly used to automate this process, acting as domain experts that propose diverse feature transformations to boost downstream performance. However, the feature generation process of existing LLM-based methods is agnostic to the downstream learner: the LLM receives no signal about which features currently drive predictions or where the model's representational capacity falls short, so proposals are neither targeted to promising regions of the feature space nor tailored to the learner's inductive bias. This shortcoming is amplified in healthcare data, which simultaneously exhibits class imbalance, heterogeneous feature spaces, and strict interpretability requirements. In this paper, we propose MedFeat, the first feature engineering framework inspired by the workflow of machine learning practitioners, leveraging model-awareness and feature importance signals to iteratively guide feature discovery for clinical tabular learning. We evaluate MedFeat on a broad range of challenging real-world clinical tasks and show that it statistically significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with an average F1 improvement of more than 10% over the baseline across models with distinct inductive biases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedFeat 把下游模型的特征重要性信号反馈给 LLM，模仿 ML 从业者的迭代流程来生成特征，在临床表格预测上跨不同归纳偏置的模型平均 F1 相对基线提升超过 10%，且具统计显著性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 特征工程方法对下游学习器无感知，不知道哪些特征在驱动预测、模型表征能力在哪里不足，导致生成的特征既不针对有希望的特征空间区域也不匹配归纳偏置；医疗数据的类别不平衡、异质特征空间与严格可解释性要求放大了这一缺陷。
Method: 提出 MedFeat，首个受 ML 从业者工作流启发的特征工程框架，利用 model-awareness 与 feature importance 信号迭代引导临床表格学习的特征发现。
Result: 在一系列真实世界临床任务上评估，统计显著优于 SOTA 基线，跨不同归纳偏置的模型平均 F1 相对基线提升超过 10%。
Conclusion: 把下游模型的特征重要性与表征短板反馈进 LLM 的特征生成循环，可在临床表格预测上稳定抬升 F1 并超越现有 LLM 特征工程基线。

papers.title: Stochastic Parrots or Singing in Harmony? Testing Five Leading LLMs for their Ability to Replicate a Human Survey with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: How well can AI-derived synthetic research data replicate the responses of human participants? An emerging literature has begun to engage with this question, which carries deep implications for organizational research practice. This article presents a comparison between a human-respondent survey of 420 Silicon Valley coders and developers and synthetic survey data designed to simulate real survey takers generated by five leading Generative AI Large Language Models: ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro plus Claude CoWork 1.123, Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro, Incredible 1.0, and DeepSeek 3.2. Our findings reveal that while AI agents produced technically plausible results that lean more towards replicability and harmonization than assumed, none were able to capture the counterintuitive insights that made the human survey valuable. Moreover, deviations grouped together for all models, leaving the real data as the outlier. Our key finding is that while leading LLMs are increasingly being used to scale, replicate and replace human survey responses in research, these advances only show an increased capacity to parrot conventional wisdom in harmony with each other rather than revealing novel findings. If synthetic respondents are used in future research, we need more replicable validation protocols and reporting standards for when and where synthetic survey data can be used responsibly, a gap that this paper fills. Our results suggest that synthetic survey responses cannot meaningfully model real human social beliefs within organizations, particularly in contexts lacking previously documented evidence. We conclude that synthetic survey-based research should be cast not as a substitute for rigorous survey methods, but as an increasingly reliable pre- or post-fieldwork instrument for identifying societal assumptions, conventional wisdoms, and other expectations about research populations.

Motivation: 研究中用 LLM 合成受访者替代、扩展或复刻人类问卷的做法正在兴起，但合成数据能否复刻真实人类回答、在什么条件下可用，缺少可复现的验证与报告标准。
Method: 对比一项 420 名硅谷程序员与开发者的人类问卷与五个生成式 LLM 生成的合成问卷数据：ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro 加 Claude CoWork 1.123、Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro、Incredible 1.0、DeepSeek 3.2，检验其复刻真实受访者回答的能力。
Result: 五个 LLM 的合成结果技术上看似合理，整体偏向可复刻与彼此协调而非分歧；但没有一个能捕捉使人类问卷有价值的反直觉洞见，且所有模型的偏差聚在一起，真实数据成为离群点。

papers.title: Scalable Delphi: Large Language Models for Structured Risk Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative risk assessment relies on structured expert elicitation to estimate unobservable properties. The Delphi method produces calibrated, auditable estimates but requires months of coordination and specialist time, placing rigorous risk assessment out of reach for most applications. We propose Scalable Delphi, adapting the classical protocol for LLMs with diverse expert personas, iterative refinement, and rationale sharing. Beyond lowering cost, this makes the assessment analyzable and dynamic. Rationales and revision histories record what each estimate rests on, information can be ablated to test which evidence matters, and the elicitation can be rerun with new evidence, changed assumptions, or adverse scenarios. Because target quantities are unobservable by construction, we design an evaluation framework based on necessary conditions any reliable estimator must satisfy: accuracy and calibration on verifiable proxies, and sensitivity to evidence. Agreement with expert panels and reasoning quality serve as corroboration. Across two domains (AI-augmented cybersecurity risk, ice-sheet contribution to sea-level rise), three benchmarks, and three reproduced expert studies, the estimates pass these tests: they improve systematically as evidence is added, agree with expert panels on most quantities, and correlate strongly with ground truth (Pearson r=0.91-0.98).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scalable Delphi 把经典 Delphi 专家 elicitation 协议改造成 LLM 多专家 persona 迭代精炼加理由共享的流程，用于不可观测量的结构化风险估计。在 AI 增强的网络安全风险与冰盖对海平面贡献两个领域、三个 benchmark 和三项复现的专家研究上，估计随证据加入系统性改善，多数量与专家面板一致，并与 ground truth 强相关（Pearson r=0.91–0.98）。
Motivation: 定量风险评估依赖结构化专家 elicitation，但经典 Delphi 需要数月协调与专家工时，使严格的风险评估对多数应用不可及。
Method: 将 Delphi 协议适配到 LLM：多样化 expert personas、迭代精炼、rationale 共享；rationale 与修订历史记录每个估计的依据，可做证据消融并用新证据或不利情景重跑。评估框架基于任何可靠估计器必须满足的必要条件：在可验证 proxy 上的 accuracy 与 calibration、对证据的 sensitivity，另以与专家面板的一致性和推理质量作 corroboration。
Result: 在两个领域（AI-augmented cybersecurity risk、ice-sheet contribution to sea-level rise）、三个 benchmark 与三项复现专家研究上，估计通过这些检验：随证据加入系统性改善，多数量与专家面板一致，与 ground truth 强相关，Pearson r=0.91–0.98。
Conclusion: LLM 驱动的多 persona Delphi 能以更低成本产出可审计、可消融、可重跑的风险估计，且在可验证 proxy 上达到与专家面板和 ground truth 一致的校准水平。

papers.title: Trajectory Stitching for Solving Inverse Problems with Flow-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems. One option is to directly optimize the initial latent code (noise), such that the flow output solves the inverse problem. However, this requires backpropagating through the entire generative trajectory, incurring high memory costs and numerical instability. We propose MS-Flow, which represents the trajectory as a sequence of intermediate latent states rather than a single initial code. By enforcing the flow dynamics locally and coupling segments through trajectory-matching penalties, MS-Flow alternates between updating intermediate latent states and enforcing consistency with observed data. This reduces memory consumption while improving reconstruction quality. We demonstrate the effectiveness of MS-Flow over existing methods on image recovery and inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, and computed tomography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-Flow 把 flow-based 生成模型的整条轨迹表示为一串中间 latent 状态，而非单个初始噪声码，通过局部施加流动力学并用 trajectory-matching 惩罚耦合各段，交替更新中间状态与数据一致性约束。这样无需对整条生成轨迹反向传播，降低内存消耗并提升重建质量，在 inpainting、超分辨率和 CT 重建上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 直接优化初始 latent 码求解逆问题时，必须对整条生成轨迹反向传播，导致内存开销高且数值不稳定。
Method: MS-Flow 将轨迹离散为中间 latent 状态序列，局部强制 flow dynamics，并以 trajectory-matching 惩罚耦合相邻段；优化时交替更新中间 latent 状态与对观测数据的一致性约束，从而避免全程反传。
Result: 在图像恢复与逆问题（inpainting、super-resolution、computed tomography）上，MS-Flow 相对现有方法降低内存消耗并改善重建质量。
Conclusion: 把 flow 轨迹拆成可独立更新的中间状态并加一致性耦合，是求解逆问题时兼顾内存与重建质量的可行路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Graph of Concept Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for discriminative workloads is often limited by inference latency, compute, and API costs at scale. Active distillation reduces these costs by querying an LLM oracle to train small discriminative students, but most pipelines distill only final labels, discarding intermediate reasoning signals and offering limited diagnostics of what reasoning is missing and where errors arise. We propose Graph of Concept Predictors (GCP), a reasoning-aware active distillation framework in which the teacher's reasoning is elicited as a directed acyclic graph of intermediate concepts and mirrored in the student. GCP enhances sample efficiency through a graph-aware acquisition strategy that weights per-concept uncertainty, gradient diversity, and coverage by node centrality. Additionally, it improves training stability and efficiency by performing targeted sub-module retraining, which attributes downstream loss to specific concept predictors and updates only the most influential modules. Experiments on eight NLP classification benchmarks demonstrate that GCP enhances performance under limited annotation budgets while yielding more interpretable and controllable training dynamics. Code is available at https://github.com/Ziyang-Yu/GCP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理感知的主动蒸馏框架 Graph of Concept Predictors (GCP)，把教师 LLM 的推理显式抽取为中间概念的有向无环图并在学生模型中镜像，使学生在有限标注预算下学到概念级推理而非仅最终标签。图感知采集策略按概念不确定性、梯度多样性与节点中心度覆盖度加权选样，配合把下游损失归因到具体概念预测器的定向子模块重训练。在八个 NLP 分类基准上，GCP 在有限标注预算下提升性能，并给出更可解释、可控的训练动态。
Motivation: 用 LLM 做判别任务受推理延迟、算力与 API 成本制约；现有主动蒸馏管线只蒸馏最终标签，丢掉中间推理信号，也难以诊断缺了哪步推理、错误从哪来。
Method: GCP 先让教师 LLM 输出中间概念构成的有向无环图 (DAG)，再在学生侧镜像为对应的概念预测器子模块；采集策略按每概念不确定性、梯度多样性与节点中心度覆盖度加权挑选待标注样本；训练时把下游损失归因到各概念预测器，只对最有影响的子模块做定向重训练。
Result: 在八个 NLP 分类基准上，GCP 在有限标注预算下提升性能，并产生更可解释、可控的训练动态；代码发布于 github.com/Ziyang-Yu/GCP。
Conclusion: 把教师推理结构化为概念图并按概念做采集与定向重训练，可以在标注预算受限时同时改善判别学生的性能与训练过程的可诊断性。

papers.title: Aligning Language Model Benchmarks with Pairwise Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Language model benchmarks are pervasive and computationally-efficient proxies for real-world downstream performance. However, many recent works find that benchmarks often fail to predict downstream utility. While some works have begun diagnosing sources of misalignment, there remain no ways to systematically update benchmarks to align their scores with downstream usage. Towards bridging this gap, we introduce and study \textit{benchmark alignment}, where we use information about downstream model performance to automatically update benchmarks, specifically aiming to update static benchmarks so they generalizably rank models according to new pairwise preferences. Our experiments involving 4576 language models and 6 benchmarks show that reweighting benchmark items can successfully rank unseen models, even generalizing across model scales in most cases. And while naive alignment unsurprisingly requires large numbers of models and benchmark questions, an oracle experiment suggests this could be reduced to as few as 20 well-chosen models. Overall, our work takes a step towards efficiently aligning benchmark development with downstream tasks.\footnote{All of our code, models, and data are publicly-available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 benchmark alignment：用下游模型表现的信息自动重加权基准题目，使静态基准能按新的成对偏好 (pairwise preferences) 泛化地排序模型。在 4576 个语言模型、6 个基准上的实验显示重加权能排序未见模型，多数情形可跨模型规模泛化；oracle 实验表明所需模型数可降到 20 个精选模型。
Motivation: 语言模型基准是预测下游表现的常用代理，但近期工作发现基准常与下游效用错位，且此前没有系统更新基准、使其分数对齐下游用法的方法。
Method: 定义 benchmark alignment 任务：利用下游模型表现信息自动更新静态基准，具体做法是对基准题目重加权 (reweighting benchmark items)，目标是让基准对未见模型给出符合新成对偏好的排序；另做 oracle 实验估计所需的模型与题目规模。
Result: 实验覆盖 4576 个语言模型与 6 个基准：重加权后基准能成功排序未见模型，多数情形下泛化到不同模型规模；naive alignment 需要大量模型与题目，oracle 实验显示可减至低至 20 个精选模型。
Conclusion: 基准可以通过重加权对齐下游任务并泛化到未见模型，且所需模型规模在 oracle 设定下可大幅压缩；代码、模型与数据全部公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap with multipanda_ros2: A Real-Time ROS2 Framework for Multimanual Systems
papers.abstract_en: We present $multipanda\_ros2$, a novel open-source ROS2 architecture for multi-robot control of Franka Robotics robots. Leveraging ros2 control, this framework provides native ROS2 interfaces for controlling any number of robots from a single process. Our core contributions address key challenges in real-time torque control, including interaction control and robot-environment modeling. A central focus of this work is sustaining a 1kHz control frequency, a necessity for real-time control and a minimum frequency required by safety standards. Moreover, we introduce a controllet-feature design pattern that enables controller-switching delays of $\le 2$ ms, facilitating reproducible benchmarking and complex multi-robot interaction scenarios. To bridge the simulation-to-reality (sim2real) gap, we integrate a high-fidelity MuJoCo simulation with quantitative metrics for both kinematic accuracy and dynamic consistency (torques, forces, and control errors). Furthermore, we demonstrate that real-world inertial parameter identification can significantly improve force and torque accuracy, providing a methodology for iterative physics refinement. Our work extends approaches from soft robotics to rigid dual-arm, contact-rich tasks, showcasing a promising method to reduce the sim2real gap and providing a robust, reproducible platform for advanced robotics research.
papers.comment: Published at IEEE ICRA 2026. Source code available at https://github.com/tenfoldpaper/multipanda_ros2

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开源 ROS2 架构 multipanda_ros2 用单进程 ros2_control 控制任意数量 Franka 机器人，把控制频率稳定在 1kHz，并以 controllet-feature 设计模式把控制器切换延迟压到 ≤2 ms。集成高保真 MuJoCo 仿真并给出运动学精度与动力学一致性（力矩、力、控制误差）的量化指标，实机惯性参数辨识可显著提升力与力矩精度，从而缩小 sim2real 差距。
Motivation: 多机械臂实时力矩控制缺少统一的 ROS2 接口与可复现的仿真到实机评测手段，控制器切换延迟与动力学不一致阻碍接触密集任务的跨平台比较。
Method: 基于 ros2_control 提供单进程多机器人原生接口，围绕 1kHz 实时力矩控制设计 controllet-feature 模式实现快速控制器切换；集成 MuJoCo 高保真仿真，配套运动学精度与动力学一致性（力矩、力、控制误差）量化指标，并用实机惯性参数辨识做迭代物理精修。
Result: 控制频率维持 1kHz（安全标准要求的最低频率），控制器切换延迟 ≤2 ms；实机惯性参数辨识显著提升力与力矩精度；框架覆盖刚性双臂接触密集任务并支持可复现基准测试。
Conclusion: 把实时控制频率、快速切换与量化仿真指标、惯性辨识闭环放在同一 ROS2 平台里，可以系统性缩小 sim2real 差距，为多机械臂研究提供可复现底座。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LangMap: A Human-Verified Benchmark for Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Language-conditioned goal navigation (LGN) requires embodied agents to locate user-specified targets without step-by-step guidance. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on category-level goals or rely on instance descriptions generated by vision-language models, which often contain ambiguities and semantic errors, limiting systematic and reliable evaluation. We introduce HieraNav, an open-vocabulary LGN task with goals at four hierarchical semantic levels: scene, room, region, and instance. We present Language as a Map (LangMap), the first LGN benchmark to enrich real-world indoor 3D scans with human-verified semantic annotations supporting tasks across all four goal levels. Built on HM3D using a contrastive annotation protocol that compares same-scene regions and instances, LangMap provides region labels and discriminative region and instance descriptions covering 414 object categories and contains over 18K tasks. Each target has concise and detailed descriptions, enabling evaluation across instruction styles. Automated and human evaluations validate our annotation quality: our descriptions improve text-to-view matching accuracy over GOAT-Bench's by 23 points on all shared annotated instances, and an independent human audit yields 92.5% unique-and-correct matches. We also propose PlaNaVid, an RGB-only baseline that combines Bounded Diverse Memory with high-level planning to prime a reactive policy for multi-goal navigation, achieving top-tier success rates without depth, 3D scene representations, or object masks. Further analyses reveal that exploration and hierarchical disambiguation failures become more prominent at finer goal levels, while long-tail categories, small objects, distant targets, timely stopping, and multi-goal completion remain challenging. Benchmark and code: https://bo-miao.github.io/LangMap
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Benchmark and Code: https://bo-miao.github.io/LangMap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HieraNav 开放词表语言目标导航任务，把目标分为 scene、room、region、instance 四个语义层级，并发布 LangMap：在 HM3D 真实室内 3D 扫描上用对比式人工校验标注覆盖 414 个物体类别、超过 18K 个任务。描述使 text-to-view 匹配准确率比 GOAT-Bench 在全部共享标注实例上高 23 个百分点，独立人工审计得到 92.5% 唯一且正确匹配；目标层级越细，探索与层级消歧失败越突出。
Motivation: 现有语言目标导航基准多停留在类别级目标，或用视觉语言模型生成实例描述，带来歧义与语义错误，使系统性可靠评测受限。
Method: LangMap 基于 HM3D 扫描，采用对比式标注协议（比较同场景的 region 与 instance）产出 region 标签与具判别力的 region/instance 描述，每个目标配简洁与详细两种描述；另提出 RGB-only 基线 PlaNaVid，用 Bounded Diverse Memory 结合高层规划为反应式策略做多目标导航预热。
Result: 覆盖 414 个物体类别、超过 18K 个任务；描述在全部共享标注实例上把 text-to-view 匹配准确率比 GOAT-Bench 提高 23 个百分点，独立人工审计得到 92.5% 唯一且正确匹配；PlaNaVid 不用深度、3D 场景表征或物体掩码即取得顶级成功率。分析显示目标层级越细，探索与层级消歧失败越突出，长尾类别、小物体、远距离目标、及时停止与多目标完成仍是难点。
Conclusion: 人工校验的层级语义标注能显著提升语言目标导航评测的可靠性，而更细的目标层级会暴露新的失败模式；RGB-only 加高层规划足以达到顶级成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key driver of language model reasoning. Among RL algorithms, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is the de facto standard, avoiding the need for a critic by using per-prompt baselines and variance normalization. Yet why and when this normalization helps remains unclear. In this work, we answer both questions through the lens of local curvature of the sequence-level policy gradient: standard deviation normalization implements an adaptive gradient. Theoretically, we prove that under mild conditions GRPO attains an improved convergence rate over unnormalized REINFORCE, with gains characterized by the average within-prompt reward standard deviation across prompts and iterations. We further introduce IS-GRPO, an importance-sampling variant of GRPO whose expected update remains aligned with the full gradient, and prove a convergence guarantee of the same form as REINFORCE's, which is tighter in practice during real training runs by a factor we measure. Empirically, on GSM8K and MATH we validate the curvature--variance link and measure the quantities that govern our bounds along real training runs. At 1.5B scale, per-prompt normalization outperforms both unnormalized and globally normalized baselines, with gains that emerge in a middle phase of training where per-prompt variances become heterogeneous. At 7B scale, the normalization schemes become statistically indistinguishable while IS-GRPO retains a small lead, in line with the theory's prediction that the gains require heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从序列级策略梯度的局部曲率解释 GRPO 的 per-prompt 标准差归一化：证明其等价于一种自适应梯度，在温和条件下比未归一化的 REINFORCE 收敛更快，增益由各 prompt 内奖励标准差的异质性决定。1.5B 规模上 per-prompt 归一化优于未归一化与全局归一化基线，且优势在训练中期、prompt 间方差开始异质时出现；7B 规模方差趋于同质，各归一化方案统计上不可区分，IS-GRPO 仅保留小幅领先。
Motivation: GRPO 用 per-prompt 基线与方差归一化取代 critic 已成 RL 训练语言模型推理的事实标准，但归一化为何有效、何时有效缺乏理论解释，也无法预测规模变化时的收益。
Method: 以序列级策略梯度的局部曲率视角刻画标准差归一化为自适应梯度；理论上证明温和条件下 GRPO 相对未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛率改进，增益由跨 prompt 与迭代的平均 prompt 内奖励标准差刻画；提出 IS-GRPO（importance-sampling 变体），其期望更新与全梯度对齐，并给出与 REINFORCE 同形式的收敛保证；在 GSM8K 与 MATH 上验证曲率—方差联系并沿真实训练轨迹测量控制界的量。
Result: 1.5B 规模上 per-prompt 归一化同时优于未归一化与全局归一化基线，优势出现在训练中期、per-prompt 方差变得异质的阶段；7B 规模各归一化方案统计上不可区分，IS-GRPO 保持小幅领先，与理论关于收益需要异质性的预测一致；IS-GRPO 的收敛界在真实训练中比 REINFORCE 形式的界紧一个可测量的因子。
Conclusion: GRPO 归一化的收益来自 prompt 间奖励方差的异质性：异质时 per-prompt 归一化带来更快收敛，方差同质时收益消失，因此是否归一化应按训练阶段与规模上的方差异质性判断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Why Your Deep Research Agent Fails? On Hallucination Evaluation in Full Research Trajectory
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing failure patterns in Deep Research Agents (DRAs) remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks predominantly rely on end-to-end evaluation, obscuring intermediate hallucinations that accumulate throughout the research trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose a shift from outcome-based to process-aware evaluation by auditing hallucinations in the full plan-search-summarize trajectory. We introduce the PING Taxonomy, which categorizes DRA hallucinations into four complementary types: Propagation, Intent, Noise-induced, and Grounding. We further instantiate this taxonomy into a fine-grained evaluation framework that decomposes trajectories into atomic actions, claims, and sub-queries for rigorous verification, and we validate its reliability on standard fact-checking benchmarks and human-reviewed trajectories. Leveraging this framework to isolate 100 hallucination-prone tasks, including adversarial scenarios, we curate DeepHalluBench. Experiments on six representative DRAs show that, on our hallucination-prone stress-test set, all evaluated systems still exhibit non-negligible reliability gaps. Furthermore, our diagnostic analysis traces these failures to systemic deficits, especially hallucination propagation and cognitive biases, providing actionable insights for future architectural optimization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhao-zhan/DeepHalluBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Deep Research Agent 的评测从端到端结果判定改为全轨迹过程审计，提出 PING Taxonomy，将幻觉分为 Propagation、Intent、Noise-induced、Grounding 四类，并把轨迹拆成原子动作、主张与子查询逐条核验。据此筛出 100 个易幻觉任务（含对抗场景）构建 DeepHalluBench，六个代表性 DRA 在该压力集上均存在不可忽略的可靠性缺口，失败主要来自幻觉传播与认知偏差。
Motivation: 现有 DRA 基准几乎只做端到端评测，中间步骤累积的幻觉被结果掩盖，无法定位失败发生在计划、搜索还是总结环节。
Method: 提出过程感知评测框架：先用 PING Taxonomy 四分法标注幻觉类型，再把完整 plan-search-summarize 轨迹分解为原子动作、主张和子查询做细粒度核验；框架在标准事实核查基准与人工复核轨迹上验证可靠性，并据此筛出 100 个幻觉高发任务（含对抗场景）组成 DeepHalluBench。
Result: 在 DeepHalluBench 的幻觉压力测试集上，六个代表性 Deep Research Agent 全部表现出不可忽略的可靠性缺口；诊断分析把失败归因于系统性缺陷，尤其是幻觉传播 (hallucination propagation) 与认知偏差。
Conclusion: 端到端评测不足以暴露 DRA 的中间幻觉，按 PING 分类做全轨迹原子级核验才能定位系统性失败来源，并为架构优化给出可操作方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Rethinking Anonymity Claims in Synthetic Data Generation: A Model-Centric Privacy Attack Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Training generative machine learning models to produce synthetic tabular data has become a popular approach for enhancing privacy in data sharing. As this typically involves processing sensitive personal information, releasing either the trained model or generated synthetic datasets can still pose privacy risks. Yet, recent research, commercial deployments, and privacy regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) largely assess anonymity at the level of an individual dataset. In this paper, we rethink anonymity claims about synthetic data from a model-centric perspective, arguing that meaningful assessments must account for the underlying generative model and be grounded in state-of-the-art privacy attacks. This perspective better reflects real-world deployments, where trained models are often accessible for interaction or querying. We interpret the GDPR's definitions of personal data and anonymization under such access assumptions to identify the identifiability risks that must be mitigated and map them to privacy attacks across threat settings. We then argue that synthetic data techniques alone do not ensure sufficient anonymization. Finally, we compare the two mechanisms most commonly used with synthetic data -- Differential Privacy (DP) and Similarity-based Privacy Metrics (SBPMs) -- and argue that while DP can offer robust protections against identifiability risks, SBPMs lack adequate safeguards. Overall, our work connects regulatory notions of identifiability with model-centric privacy attacks, enabling more responsible and trustworthy assessment of synthetic data systems by researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 25th Workshop on Privacy in the Electronic Society, WPES 2026, part of ACM CCS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张合成表格数据的匿名性必须在模型层面而非单个数据集层面评估：在可查询已训练生成模型的现实部署下，把 GDPR 的个人数据/匿名化定义映射到各威胁模型下的可识别性隐私攻击。结论是仅靠合成数据技术不足以实现充分匿名化，差分隐私 (DP) 能对可识别性风险提供稳健保护，而基于相似度的隐私度量 (SBPMs) 缺乏足够保障。
Motivation: 近年研究、商业部署与 GDPR 都在单个数据集层面判定匿名性，但真实场景中已训练模型常可被交互或查询，数据集层面的评估无法反映模型本身带来的可识别性风险。
Method: 提出以模型为中心的视角：在给定访问假设下重新解释 GDPR 对个人数据与匿名化的定义，识别必须缓解的可识别性风险，并将其映射到不同威胁设定下的隐私攻击；随后对比合成数据最常用的两种机制 DP 与 SBPMs。
Result: 论证性工作：合成数据技术本身不足以确保充分匿名化；DP 能对可识别性风险提供稳健保护，而 SBPMs 缺乏足够保障；并给出监管层面的可识别性概念与模型中心隐私攻击之间的对应关系。
Conclusion: 合成数据系统的匿名性评估应以可查询的生成模型为对象、以最先进隐私攻击为依据，且必须叠加 DP 一类机制，单靠 SBPMs 不足以支撑匿名声明。

papers.title: DynamicVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating dynamic objects remains an open challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. Although recent VLAs generalize well in static manipulation, dynamic scenes introduce a latency-induced perception-execution mismatch: object states continue to evolve during inference, making actions predicted from past observations stale at execution time. We present DynamicVLA, a latency-aware VLA model for dynamic object manipulation. It combines a compact 0.4B architecture and convolutional vision encoder for efficient multimodal inference with a continuous inference schedule that overlaps reasoning and execution for non-blocking control. Latent-aware Action Streaming then discards latency-invalid action prefixes and executes only the temporally valid suffix of each predicted chunk, preserving action-time alignment under dynamic object motion. To fill the missing foundation of dynamic manipulation data, we introduce the Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, built with an automated collection pipeline that gathers 200K synthetic episodes across 2.8K scenes and 206 objects, and enables fast collection of 2K real-world episodes without teleoperation. Extensive evaluations in simulation and on real robots show that DynamicVLA improves dynamic manipulation success under changing object motion, perception-heavy instructions, and unseen motion patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynamicVLA 是面向动态物体操作的 latency-aware VLA：0.4B 紧凑架构加卷积视觉编码器做高效多模态推理，连续推理调度让推理与执行重叠，Latent-aware Action Streaming 丢弃已失效的动作前缀、只执行时间上仍有效的时间后缀，从而在物体持续运动下保持动作-时间对齐。配套发布 DOM benchmark，含 200K 合成 episodes、2.8K 场景、206 个物体，以及免遥操作采集的 2K 真实 episodes；仿真与真机评测显示其在物体运动变化、感知密集指令与未见运动模式下提升动态操作成功率。
Motivation: VLA 在静态操作上已能泛化，但动态场景中物体状态在推理期间继续演化，基于过去观测预测的动作执行时已过期，产生 latency 引起的感知-执行错位。
Method: 0.4B 紧凑架构 + 卷积视觉编码器支撑高效多模态推理；连续推理调度 (continuous inference schedule) 让推理与执行重叠实现非阻塞控制；Latent-aware Action Streaming 丢弃 latency 失效的动作前缀、只执行时间有效的 chunk 后缀。数据侧用自动化采集管线构建 DOM benchmark。
Result: DOM benchmark 含 200K 合成 episodes、2.8K 场景、206 个物体，并快速采集 2K 真实 episodes（无需遥操作）。仿真与真机评测中，DynamicVLA 在物体运动变化、感知密集指令 (perception-heavy instructions) 和未见运动模式下提升动态操作成功率。
Conclusion: 把 latency 显式建模进动作生成（丢弃失效前缀、只执行有效后缀）并配以重叠推理-执行的调度，是让 VLA 在动态物体操作上保持动作-时间对齐的可行路径，DOM 为此类训练提供数据基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hierarchy of discriminative power and complexity in learning quantum ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Distance metrics are central to machine learning, yet distances between ensembles of quantum states remain poorly understood due to fundamental quantum measurement constraints. We introduce a hierarchy of integral probability metrics, termed MMD-$k$, which generalizes the maximum mean discrepancy to quantum ensembles and exhibits a strict trade-off between discriminative power and statistical efficiency as the moment order $k$ increases. For pure-state ensembles of size $N$, estimating MMD-$k$ with arbitrary measurement schemes requires $Θ(N^{1-1/k})$ samples for constant $k$. At the same time, we prove that any stable distance metric with full discriminative power admits an $O(N\log N)$ upper bound and an $Ω(N)$ instance-gap lower bound. For quantum Wasserstein distance, with sufficiently large fixed state dimension, we establish a nearly linear lower bound in the ensemble size at constant additive accuracy, together with an $O(N\log N)$ upper bound. These results provide principled guidance for the design of loss functions in quantum machine learning, as we illustrate in training quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量子系综上的积分概率度量族 MMD-k，把 MMD 推广到量子态系综，并证明判别力与统计效率随矩阶 k 增大严格此消彼长：对 N 个纯态的系综，任意测量方案下估计 MMD-k 需要 Θ(N^{1-1/k}) 个样本（k 为常数）。同时证明任何具完全判别力的稳定距离度量都有 O(N log N) 上界与 Ω(N) 的 instance-gap 下界；该理论用于指导量子机器学习损失函数设计，并在量子去噪扩散概率模型 (quantum DDPM) 训练中演示。
Motivation: 量子测量约束使量子态系综之间的距离度量长期缺乏理解：判别力更强的度量往往需要更多样本估计，缺少刻画这一权衡的原理性结果。
Method: 构造一族积分概率度量 MMD-k，将 maximum mean discrepancy 推广到量子系综，随矩阶 k 变化；对纯态系综在任意测量方案下推导样本复杂度，并对量子 Wasserstein 距离在固定且足够大的态维度下给出上下界，再据此设计量子机器学习损失函数。
Result: 对规模 N 的纯态系综，任意测量方案估计 MMD-k 需要 Θ(N^{1-1/k}) 样本（k 常数）；任何具完全判别力的稳定距离度量有 O(N log N) 上界与 Ω(N) instance-gap 下界；量子 Wasserstein 距离在态维度足够大固定时，常数加性精度下有近线性下界与 O(N log N) 上界；并在量子去噪扩散概率模型训练中演示损失函数设计。
Conclusion: 量子系综距离的判别力与统计效率存在可证明的层级权衡，损失函数设计应按所需判别力选择相应阶数的度量。

papers.title: SONIC-O1: A Real-World Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models on Audio-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are a major focus of recent AI research. However, most prior work focuses on static image understanding, while their ability to process sequential audio-video data remains underexplored. This gap highlights the need for a high-quality benchmark to systematically evaluate MLLM performance in a real-world setting. We introduce SONIC-O1, a comprehensive, fully human-verified benchmark of 60 hours (231 clips) spanning 13 real-world conversational domains with 4,958 annotations and demographic metadata. SONIC-O1 evaluates three capabilities: open-ended summarization, multiple-choice question (MCQ) answering, and temporal localization with supporting rationales (reasoning). Across closed- and open-source models, we find that the MCQ accuracy shows the smallest gap between model families, but the best closed-source model outperforms the best open-source model by 22.6% on temporal localization. We further observe accuracy gaps of up to 21.4% on temporal localization across demographic groups, indicating persistent disparities in model behaviour. SONIC-O1 provides an open evaluation suite for temporally grounded and demographically robust multimodal understanding. SONIC-O1 is publicly available for research: Project page (https://vectorinstitute.github.io/sonic-o1/), Dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/vector-institute/sonic-o1), GitHub (https://github.com/vectorinstitute/sonic-o1), Leaderboard (https://huggingface.co/spaces/vector-institute/sonic-o1-leaderboard).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SONIC-O1 是一个全人工核验的音视频理解基准：60 小时、231 段真实对话片段、13 个领域、4,958 条标注，评测 MLLM 的开放式摘要、MCQ 与带理由的时序定位三项能力。MCQ 上模型家族差距最小，但最佳闭源模型在时序定位上比最佳开源模型高 22.6%，且不同人群组间时序定位准确率差距最高达 21.4%。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 评测多集中在静态图像理解，对连续音频-视频数据的处理能力缺乏真实场景下的系统化评测基准。
Method: 构建 SONIC-O1 基准：60 小时、231 段片段、13 个真实对话领域、4,958 条人工核验标注并附人群统计元数据；评测三项能力——开放式摘要、MCQ 问答、带支撑理由的时序定位 (temporal localization)，覆盖闭源与开源模型。
Result: MCQ 准确率在模型家族间差距最小；最佳闭源模型在时序定位上比最佳开源模型高 22.6%；不同人群组间时序定位准确率差距最高达 21.4%。
Conclusion: MLLM 在音视频理解上仍存在开源与闭源的时序定位能力鸿沟，且模型行为在人群组间存在持续性差异；SONIC-O1 作为开放评测套件用于时序接地与人群稳健性的多模态评测。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DisasterInsight: A Building-Centric Benchmark for Evaluating Vision--Language Models in Disaster Response
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models (VLMs) show promise for disaster-response remote sensing, but existing benchmarks mainly emphasize scene-level or damage-centric assessment. To study this building-centric gap, we introduce \method{}, a diagnostic benchmark built on xBD, a pre/post-disaster satellite dataset with building-level damage labels. \method{} enriches building instances with OpenStreetMap-derived functional labels and contains 134{,}108 task-specific instruction records across 15 task types, spanning instance-level assessment, scene-level counting, multi-instance reasoning, and structured report generation. The benchmark supports RGB pre/post-disaster imagery, single- and multi-view instance formulations, and scene-level RGB/SAR diagnostic inputs. Experiments with general-domain and remote-sensing VLMs show that models perform better on visible damage cues than on building-function understanding, multi-instance reasoning, counting, and grounded reporting. Instruction tuning improves performance on several tasks but does not close this building-centric gap.
papers.comment: Presented at the TerraBytes workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DisasterInsight 是以建筑为中心的灾害响应 VLM 诊断基准，基于 xBD 的建筑级灾前/灾后卫星影像，用 OpenStreetMap 功能标签扩充建筑实例，含 134,108 条指令记录、15 类任务。实验显示通用与遥感 VLM 在可见损伤线索上表现好于建筑功能理解、多实例推理、计数与有据报告；指令调优能提升若干任务但未弥合这一建筑中心差距。
Motivation: 现有灾害响应遥感基准偏重场景级或损伤级评估，缺少以单体建筑为对象、兼顾功能与推理的诊断任务，难以定位 VLM 在建筑中心理解上的短板。
Method: 在 xBD（含建筑级损伤标签的灾前/灾后卫星数据集）上构建基准，用 OpenStreetMap 派生功能标签标注建筑实例；覆盖 15 类任务（实例级评估、场景级计数、多实例推理、结构化报告生成），支持 RGB 灾前/灾后影像、单视与多视实例输入以及场景级 RGB/SAR 诊断输入，并对通用域与遥感 VLM 做实验与指令调优。
Result: 基准含 134,108 条任务指令记录、15 类任务；实验中模型在可见损伤线索上的表现优于建筑功能理解、多实例推理、计数与有据报告；指令调优在若干任务上提升性能，但未关闭这一建筑中心差距。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 的灾害响应能力主要停留在可见损伤识别，功能理解与推理类任务是系统性短板，仅靠指令调优不足以弥补。

papers.title: A Unified Kantorovich Duality for Multimarginal Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We study Kantorovich duality for multimarginal optimal transport (MOT) with bounded continuous cost functions. The main focus is not only the equality between the primal and dual values, but also the structure of optimal dual potentials. For compact metric spaces, we prove that the dual problem admits an optimizer in the class of mutually $c$-conjugate families. The proof combines a Fenchel--Rockafellar duality argument with equicontinuity estimates, a normalization of the dual potentials, and the Arzelà--Ascoli theorem. We then consider the non-compact case, where the marginal spaces are Polish. We first recover the Kantorovich duality identity by a truncation and tightness argument, using the boundedness of the cost and Prokhorov compactness. For dual attainment, we rely on the geometry of optimal supports. Under a natural support-splitting condition, we obtain a bounded Borel measurable dual optimizer in the canonical class of mutually $c$-conjugate families. Thus, the paper identifies mutually $c$-conjugate potentials as natural representatives of optimal dual families in the multimarginal setting. These results provide a structural basis for further work on stability, empirical multimarginal transport, and statistical limit theory.
