papers.title: Convergence Analysis of the Wasserstein Proximal Algorithm beyond Geodesic Convexity
papers.abstract_en: The proximal algorithm is a powerful tool to minimize nonlinear and nonsmooth functionals in a general metric space. Motivated by the recent progress in studying the training dynamics of the noisy gradient descent algorithm on two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime, we provide in this paper a simple and self-contained analysis for the convergence of the general-purpose Wasserstein proximal algorithm without assuming geodesic convexity of the objective functional. Under a natural Wasserstein analog of the Euclidean Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality, we establish that the proximal algorithm achieves an unbiased and linear convergence rate. Our convergence rate improves upon existing rates of the proximal algorithm for solving Wasserstein gradient flows under strong geodesic convexity. We also extend our analysis to the inexact proximal algorithm for geodesically semiconvex objectives. In our numerical experiments, proximal training demonstrates a faster convergence rate than the noisy gradient descent algorithm on mean-field neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不假设目标泛函测地凸性的前提下，证明 Wasserstein 近端算法在 Wasserstein 版 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 不等式下达到无偏且线性的收敛速率，优于强测地凸性下已有的 Wasserstein 梯度流近端算法速率；数值实验中该近端训练在 mean-field 神经网络上比带噪梯度下降收敛更快。
Motivation: Wasserstein 空间上的近端算法收敛分析通常依赖目标泛函的测地凸性，而 mean-field 两层神经网络训练动力学中的目标并不满足该条件，需要更弱条件下的收敛保证。
Method: 给出一般度量空间中 Wasserstein 近端算法的自足收敛分析，用 Euclidean Polyak-Łojasiewicz 不等式的 Wasserstein 类比替代测地凸性假设；并把分析推广到测地半凸 (geodesically semiconvex) 目标下的非精确 (inexact) 近端算法，动机来自 mean-field 状态下两层神经网络带噪梯度下降的训练动力学研究。
Result: 在 Wasserstein 版 PL 不等式下，近端算法取得无偏且线性的收敛速率，改进了强测地凸性下 Wasserstein 梯度流近端算法的已有速率；数值实验中 mean-field 神经网络上近端训练的收敛速率快于带噪梯度下降算法。
Conclusion: 测地凸性不是 Wasserstein 近端算法线性收敛的必要条件，Wasserstein-PL 型不等式足以给出比强测地凸性假设下更好的速率，并可扩展到非精确近端与测地半凸目标。

papers.title: Easier Said Than Done: Unpacking Intent-Behavior Gap in Jailbreaking LLM-Based Robots
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based robots use Large Language Models (LLMs) as planners to translate natural language instructions into policies such as grasp(), move_to(), and open_gripper(). Jailbreak attacks on these robots extend the threat from generating malicious content to executing harmful behaviors. However, we find that existing jailbreak attempts against LLM-based robots that produce malicious-looking policies (intent jailbreaks) often fail to induce harmful physical actions by robots (behavior jailbreaks), due to robot-specific constraints, such as logical errors and hallucinated control APIs. In this paper, we demystify the intent-behavior gap and investigate its root causes to inform effective defenses. Our measurement study finds that current LLM jailbreak methods overlook robot-specific syntax constraints (e.g., executable control APIs) and physical feasibility (e.g., ordering of policies and hardware/kinematic constraints). To bridge the gap, we introduce POEF (POlicy EFfective Jailbreak), an automated red-teaming framework that takes into account the robot-specific constraints during both the optimization and evaluation processes. Specifically, POEF employs the hidden-layer gradients from an unaligned LLM to guide the jailbreak prompt optimization and uses a multi-agent evaluator to assess the feasibility of the generated policies. Experiments on commercial robots, including the Unitree G1, the Franka robotic arm, and simulators, show that POEF achieves an 80% behavior jailbreak success rate and transfers across various LLMs. In addition, we propose two defense strategies that mitigate the behavior jailbreak risks. Our findings indicate an urgent need for stronger countermeasures before LLM-based robots are deployed at scale. The homepage is available at https://zjushine.github.io/poef.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 机器人越狱中「意图越狱成功但行为越狱失败」的 intent-behavior gap，提出自动化红队框架 POEF：用未对齐 LLM 的隐藏层梯度优化越狱提示，并用多智能体评估器判断生成策略的可执行性与物理可行性。在 Unitree G1、Franka 机械臂及仿真器上行为越狱成功率达 80%，且可跨多种 LLM 迁移。
Motivation: 现有针对 LLM 机器人的越狱方法只让模型产出「看起来恶意」的策略，却因机器人特有的语法约束与物理可行性限制而无法触发真实有害动作，导致攻击评估与防御设计都建立在错误的威胁模型上。

Conclusion: 意图越狱与行为落空之间的鸿沟源于机器人特有约束未被纳入攻击优化与评估，把这些约束放进红队流程才能真正打通；作者据此认为 LLM 机器人规模化部署前亟需更强的防御手段。

papers.title: Local Superior Soups: A Catalyst for Model Merging in Cross-Silo Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a learning paradigm that enables collaborative training of models using decentralized data. Recently, the utilization of pre-trained weight initialization in FL has been demonstrated to effectively improve model performance. However, the evolving complexity of current pre-trained models, characterized by a substantial increase in parameters, markedly intensifies the challenges associated with communication rounds required for their adaptation to FL. To address these communication cost issues and increase the performance of pre-trained model adaptation in FL, we propose an innovative model interpolation-based local training technique called ``Local Superior Soups.'' Our method enhances local training across different clients, encouraging the exploration of a connected low-loss basin within a few communication rounds through regularized model interpolation. This approach acts as a catalyst for the seamless adaptation of pre-trained models in in FL. We demonstrated its effectiveness and efficiency across diverse widely-used FL datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/ubc-tea/Local-Superior-Soups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Local Superior Soups 用带正则的模型插值 (regularized model interpolation) 做跨孤岛联邦学习的本地训练，让客户端在少数几轮通信内探索到连通的低损失盆地 (connected low-loss basin)，从而加速大参数量预训练模型在 FL 中的适配并降低通信开销。作者在多个常用 FL 数据集上展示了该方法的有效性与效率。
Motivation: 预训练权重初始化能提升 FL 性能，但当前预训练模型参数量大增，使其适配到 FL 所需的通信轮数成本显著上升，通信开销成为瓶颈。
Method: 提出基于模型插值的本地训练技术 Local Superior Soups：在不同客户端之间鼓励正则化的模型插值，使本地训练在少数通信轮次内探索连通的低损失盆地，作为预训练模型适配 FL 的加速手段；代码已开源。
Result: 在多个广泛使用的 FL 数据集上展示了有效性与效率，具体指标与基线对比见论文正文。
Conclusion: 通过正则化模型插值做本地训练，可以在少量通信轮内完成预训练模型的 FL 适配，从而同时缓解通信成本并提升性能。

papers.title: CHORDONOMICON: A Dataset of 666,000 Songs and their Chord Progressions
papers.abstract_en: Chord progressions encapsulate important information about music, pertaining to its structure and conveyed emotions. They serve as the backbone of musical composition, and in many cases, they are the sole information required for a musician to play along and follow the music. Despite their importance, chord progressions as a data domain remain underexplored; existing datasets lack the scale, structural annotation, and metadata diversity required for rigorous evaluation of music understanding models. In this work, we present Chordonomicon, the largest dataset of its kind, containing over 666,000 song-level symbolic chord progressions, annotated with structural parts (verse, chorus, bridge, etc.), genre, and release date, created by scraping various sources of user-generated progressions and associated metadata, showing strong similarity to well-established prior datasets. Beyond the dataset itself, we propose a reproducible benchmark suite for next chord prediction, evaluating three sequence modeling architectures (RNN, GRU, LSTM) across multiple context window sizes and data scales under strict exact-match evaluation. Our experiments reveal that structural part annotations consistently improve prediction performance. Chordonomicon is released as an open benchmark, providing split methodology, baselines, and evaluation protocols to enable fair and reproducible comparison for future work on chord prediction, classification, generation, and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Chordonomicon：666,000 首歌曲级符号和弦进行数据集，带结构段落（verse/chorus/bridge）、流派与发行年份标注，并配套下一个和弦预测基准。在 RNN、GRU、LSTM 三种架构、多上下文窗口与数据规模下用严格 exact-match 评测，结构段落标注一致提升预测性能。
Motivation: 和弦进行作为数据域研究不足，现有数据集在规模、结构标注与元数据多样性上不足以严格评测音乐理解模型。
Method: 从多个用户生成来源抓取和弦进行及元数据构建数据集，并与既有成熟数据集比对相似度；提出可复现基准套件，用 RNN、GRU、LSTM 三种序列架构在多个上下文窗口尺寸与数据规模上做下一个和弦预测，采用严格 exact-match 评测，随数据集发布划分方法、基线与评测协议。
Result: 数据集含超过 666,000 首歌曲级符号和弦进行，带结构段落、流派、发行日期标注，与既有成熟数据集高度相似；基准实验显示结构段落标注一致提升下一个和弦预测性能。
Conclusion: 和弦预测的收益来自结构段落这一标注粒度，Chordonomicon 以开放划分、基线与协议支持后续和弦预测、分类与生成工作的可比评测。

papers.title: Information propagation dynamics in Deep Graph Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graphs are a highly expressive abstraction for modeling entities and their relations, such as molecular structures, social networks, and traffic networks. Deep Graph Networks (DGNs) have emerged as a family of deep learning models that can effectively process and learn such structured information. However, learning effective information propagation patterns within DGNs remains a critical challenge that heavily influences the model capabilities, both in the static domain and in the temporal domain (where features and/or topology evolve). Given this challenge, this thesis investigates the dynamics of information propagation within DGNs for static and dynamic graphs, focusing on their design as dynamical systems. Throughout this work, we provide theoretical and empirical evidence to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed architectures in propagating and preserving long-term dependencies between nodes, and in learning complex spatio-temporal patterns from irregular and sparsely sampled dynamic graphs. In summary, this thesis provides a comprehensive exploration of the intersection between graphs, deep learning, and dynamical systems, offering insights and advancements for the field of graph representation learning and paving the way for more effective and versatile graph-based learning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇博士论文把 Deep Graph Networks (DGN) 的信息传播当作动力系统来设计，用理论与实验证据说明所提架构能在节点间传播并保持长期依赖，并从不规则、稀疏采样的动态图中学习复杂时空模式。适用范围是静态图与动态图的图表示学习，与降水、天气预报或资料同化无直接关系。
Motivation: DGN 内部的信息传播模式难以学好，直接制约模型在静态域与时域（特征和/或拓扑演化）上的表达能力，长期依赖尤其容易丢失。
Method: 将 DGN 的设计形式化为动力系统问题，针对静态图与动态图分别提出架构，目标是传播并保持节点间长期依赖，并处理不规则、稀疏采样的时空动态图；论文以理论与实验两方面证据支撑。
Result: 论文给出理论与实验证据，表明所提架构能传播并保持节点间长期依赖，并能从不规则、稀疏采样的动态图中学习复杂时空模式；摘要未列出具体数据集或指标数值。
Conclusion: 把图网络的信息传播按动力系统来设计，是同时解决长期依赖保持与稀疏采样动态图学习的一条路径，成果归入图表示学习。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: MaPa: Text-driven Photorealistic Material Painting for 3D Shapes
papers.abstract_en: This paper aims to generate materials for 3D meshes from text descriptions. Unlike existing methods that synthesize texture maps, we propose to generate segment-wise procedural material graphs as the appearance representation, which supports high-quality rendering and provides substantial flexibility in editing. Instead of relying on extensive paired data, i.e., 3D meshes with material graphs and corresponding text descriptions, to train a material graph generative model, we propose to leverage the pre-trained 2D diffusion model as a bridge to connect the text and material graphs. Specifically, our approach decomposes a shape into a set of segments and designs a segment-controlled diffusion model to synthesize 2D images that are aligned with mesh parts. Based on generated images, we initialize parameters of material graphs and fine-tune them through the differentiable rendering module to produce materials in accordance with the textual description. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our framework in photorealism, resolution, and editability over existing methods. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/MaPa
papers.comment: Corrected the spelling of the first author's name in the manuscript and metadata; no changes to the technical content
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaPa 用文本直接给 3D 网格生成分段式程序化材质图 (procedural material graph)，而非纹理贴图：先把形状拆成若干 segment，用 segment-controlled 扩散模型生成与网格部件对齐的 2D 图像，再据此初始化材质图参数并经可微渲染模块微调。在 photorealism、分辨率与可编辑性上均优于已有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法只合成纹理贴图，编辑灵活性差；而直接训练材质图生成模型又需要大量「网格—材质图—文本」配对数据，这类数据难以获取。
Method: 将形状分解为一组 segment，设计 segment-controlled 扩散模型合成与 mesh parts 对齐的 2D 图像，借预训练 2D 扩散模型作为文本与材质图之间的桥梁；再由生成图像初始化程序化材质图参数，并通过可微渲染模块微调以匹配文本描述。
Result: 在 photorealism、resolution 和 editability 三项上均优于已有方法（extensive experiments，摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 以预训练 2D 扩散模型为桥、分段控制加可微渲染微调，可在不依赖大规模配对数据的前提下生成高质量且便于编辑的 3D 材质。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Adaptation for Pretrained Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models -- including prominent zero-shot models -- are often trained on datasets whose labels are only a small proportion of a larger label space. Such spaces are commonly equipped with a metric that relates the labels via distances between them. We propose a simple approach to exploit this information to adapt the trained model to reliably predict new classes -- or, in the case of zero-shot prediction, to improve its performance -- without any additional training. Our technique is a drop-in replacement of the standard prediction rule, swapping argmax with the Fréchet mean. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis for this approach, studying (i) learning-theoretic results trading off label space diameter, sample complexity, and model dimension, (ii) characterizations of the full range of scenarios in which it is possible to predict any unobserved class, and (iii) an optimal active learning-like next class selection procedure to obtain optimal training classes for when it is not possible to predict the entire range of unobserved classes. Empirically, using easily-available external metrics, our proposed approach, Loki, gains up to 29.7% relative improvement over SimCLR on ImageNet and scales to hundreds of thousands of classes. When no such metric is available, Loki can use self-derived metrics from class embeddings and obtains a 10.5% improvement on pretrained zero-shot models such as CLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Loki 把分类预测规则中的 argmax 换成 Fréchet mean，利用标签空间自带的度量，在不重新训练的前提下让模型预测训练时未见过的新类。理论上给出标签空间直径、样本复杂度与模型维度的权衡，以及何时可能预测任意未观测类的刻画和最优选类过程；经验上用外部度量在 ImageNet 上相对 SimCLR 最高提升 29.7%，无度量时用类嵌入自建度量使 CLIP 等零样本模型提升 10.5%。
Motivation: 模型训练所用标签往往只占更大标签空间的一小部分，而该空间通常带有描述类间距离的度量；标准 argmax 预测规则无法利用这一结构来预测未见类或改进零样本预测。
Method: 提出 Loki：将标准预测规则中的 argmax 直接替换为 Fréchet mean，无需额外训练即可适配已训练模型。配套给出三部分理论分析——标签空间直径、样本复杂度与模型维度的学习论权衡；可预测任意未观测类的条件刻画；以及在无法预测全部未观测类时的最优 active learning 式下一类选择过程。度量可来自外部，也可从类嵌入自建。
Result: 使用易得的外部度量时，Loki 在 ImageNet 上相对 SimCLR 最高获得 29.7% 的相对提升，并可扩展到数十万类；无外部度量时，Loki 用类嵌入自建度量，在 CLIP 等预训练零样本模型上获得 10.5% 的提升。
Conclusion: 预测规则层面用 Fréchet mean 替换 argmax 就能利用标签度量来适配未见类，无需重新训练；当标签空间度量不可得时，类嵌入自建度量仍能带来零样本模型的性能提升。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: StoCFL: A Stochastically Clustered Federated Learning Framework for Non-IID Data with Dynamic Client Participation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning is a distributed learning framework that takes full advantage of private data samples kept on edge devices. In real-world federated learning systems, these data samples are often decentralized and Non-Independently Identically Distributed (Non-IID), causing divergence and performance degradation in the federated learning process. As a new solution, clustered federated learning groups federated clients with similar data distributions to impair the Non-IID effects and train a better model for every cluster. However, existing CFL algorithms are ineffective because they lack an information-sharing mechanism across clusters resulting in low data efficiency and model performance. Meanwhile, their performance is highly subjected to ideal client clustering results which are practically unavailable. This paper proposes StoCFL, a novel clustered federated learning framework for generic Non-IID issues. In detail, StoCFL implements a flexible CFL framework that supports an arbitrary proportion of client participation and newly joined clients for a varying FL system, while maintaining a great improvement in model performance. The intensive experiments are conducted by using four basic Non-IID settings and a real-world dataset. The results show that StoCFL could obtain promising cluster results even when the number of clusters is unknown. Based on the client clustering results, models trained with StoCFL outperform baseline approaches in a variety of scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: Neural Networks 187 (2025), 107278
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StoCFL 是面向 Non-IID 数据的随机聚类联邦学习框架：支持任意比例的客户端参与与新客户端加入，并在聚类数未知时仍得到可用的聚类结果，训练出的模型在多种场景下超过基线方法。
Motivation: 联邦学习中边缘设备数据呈 Non-IID，导致训练发散与性能下降；现有聚类联邦学习 (CFL) 缺少跨簇信息共享，数据效率低，且依赖实际拿不到的理想聚类结果。
Method: 提出 StoCFL：随机聚类的 CFL 框架，支持任意比例客户端参与和动态新客户端加入，跨簇共享信息，并在聚类数未知的条件下完成客户端聚类与各簇模型训练。
Result: 在四种基本 Non-IID 设置加一个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，StoCFL 在聚类数未知时仍能获得有希望的聚类结果，且基于该聚类训练的模型在多种场景下优于基线方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 跨簇信息共享加上对部分参与和未知簇数的容忍，使 CFL 在通用 Non-IID 场景下不必依赖理想聚类也能提升模型性能。

papers.title: How many labelers do you have? A closer look at gold-standard labels
papers.abstract_en: The construction of most supervised learning datasets revolves around collecting multiple labels for each instance, then aggregating the labels to form a type of "true" label. We question the wisdom of this pipeline by developing a (stylized) theoretical model of this process and analyzing its statistical consequences, showing how access to non-aggregated label information can make training well-calibrated models more feasible than it is with cleaned labels. The entire story, however, is subtle, and the contrasts between aggregated and fuller label information depend on the particulars of the problem, where estimators that use aggregated information exhibit robust but slower rates of convergence, while estimators that can effectively leverage all labels converge more quickly if they have fidelity to (or can learn) the true labeling process. The theory makes several predictions for real-world datasets, including when non-aggregate labels should improve learning performance, which we test to corroborate the validity of our predictions.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to Journal of the American Statistical Association (JASA) for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对监督学习数据集普遍采用的「多标注者投票聚合成金标准标签」流程提出质疑：在风格化理论模型下，直接使用未聚合的全部标签，只要估计器贴合（或能学到）真实标注过程，收敛比只用聚合标签更快；反之若不贴合，聚合标签给出更稳健但更慢的收敛率。理论给出非聚合标签何时改善学习性能的可检验预测，并在真实数据集上验证。
Motivation: 多数监督数据集把每条样本的多个标签聚合成一个「真」标签，这一清洗过程丢掉了标注者之间的分歧信息，其统计代价此前缺少刻画。
Method: 构建标注与聚合过程的风格化理论模型，比较使用聚合标签与使用全部非聚合标签的估计器的统计性质与收敛速率，并从理论推出若干可在真实数据集上检验的预测。
Result: 使用聚合信息的估计器收敛稳健但更慢；能有效利用全部标签的估计器在贴合真实标注过程时收敛更快。理论预测了非聚合标签应能改善学习性能的情形，并在真实数据集上检验以佐证预测的有效性。
Conclusion: 聚合标签并非总是最优：是否保留非聚合标签取决于问题的具体情形，关键在于估计器能否忠实于或学到真实标注过程。

papers.title: Roto-translated Local Coordinate Frames For Interacting Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Modelling interactions is critical in learning complex dynamical systems, namely systems of interacting objects with highly non-linear and time-dependent behaviour. A large class of such systems can be formalized as $\textit{geometric graphs}$, $\textit{i.e.}$, graphs with nodes positioned in the Euclidean space given an $\textit{arbitrarily}$ chosen global coordinate system, for instance vehicles in a traffic scene. Notwithstanding the arbitrary global coordinate system, the governing dynamics of the respective dynamical systems are invariant to rotations and translations, also known as $\textit{Galilean invariance}$. As ignoring these invariances leads to worse generalization, in this work we propose local coordinate frames per node-object to induce roto-translation invariance to the geometric graph of the interacting dynamical system. Further, the local coordinate frames allow for a natural definition of anisotropic filtering in graph neural networks. Experiments in traffic scenes, 3D motion capture, and colliding particles demonstrate that the proposed approach comfortably outperforms the recent state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为几何图 (geometric graph) 形式的交互动力系统提出逐节点局部坐标系 (local coordinate frames)，把旋转平移不变性 (roto-translation invariance / Galilean invariance) 直接注入图神经网络，并借此自然定义各向异性滤波 (anisotropic filtering)。在交通场景、3D 动作捕捉与碰撞粒子三类实验上，该方法明显超过近期 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 交互物体的动力学本应对旋转和平移不变，但几何图依赖任意选取的全局坐标系；忽略这种不变性会导致泛化变差。
Method: 为每个节点对象建立局部坐标系，使几何图获得旋转平移不变性；局部坐标系同时为 GNN 提供各向异性滤波的自然定义。实验覆盖交通场景、3D motion capture 与碰撞粒子三类系统。
Result: 在 traffic scenes、3D motion capture、colliding particles 三组实验中，所提方法明显优于近期 state-of-the-art；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把 Galilean 不变性通过逐节点局部坐标系内建到几何图 GNN 中，可提升交互动力系统的泛化并超过近期 SOTA。

papers.title: Neural Fourier Surrogates for Data Reuploading Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: For quantum machine learning, the exact boundary between classical and quantum advantage is still poorly understood. Direct comparison between quantum neural networks (QNNs) and existing classical models, which encompass fundamentally different function classes, often fails to provide broader insight into the difference between the two. Inspired by the techniques of Neural Quantum States and Random Fourier Features, this work introduces Neural Fourier Surrogates (NFS), a stochastic classical neural network architecture for efficiently learning coefficients over the same finite Fourier series support as quantum neural networks. Testing on a selection of tabular benchmark datasets, we find that NFS is an effective classifier architecture broadly competitive with established classical baselines, including a comparable Random Fourier Features model, and possessing comparable performance to data-reuploading QNNs; combined with additional analysis comparing the learned Fourier spectra of QNNs and NFS on synthetic data, these results establish NFS as a natural classical baseline for evaluating QNN performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neural Fourier Surrogates (NFS)：一个随机经典神经网络架构，学习与 data-reuploading QNN 相同的有限 Fourier 级数支撑上的系数，从而把 QNN 与经典模型的比较放到同一函数类里。在若干表格基准数据集上，NFS 分类性能与既有经典基线（含可比的 Random Fourier Features 模型）相当，并与 data-reuploading QNN 表现相当；结合合成数据上 QNN 与 NFS 学得 Fourier 谱的对比分析，NFS 被确立为评估 QNN 性能的自然经典基线。
Motivation: 量子机器学习中经典与量子优势的边界仍不清楚；QNN 与经典模型分属不同函数类，直接对比往往得不到关于两者差异的更广泛认识。
Method: 受 Neural Quantum States 与 Random Fourier Features 启发，构建随机经典架构 NFS，高效学习与 QNN 相同的有限 Fourier 级数支撑上的系数；在一组表格基准数据集上做分类测试，并在合成数据上比较 QNN 与 NFS 学得的 Fourier 谱。
Result: 在所选表格基准数据集上，NFS 是有效的分类架构，与既有经典基线（包括一个可比的 Random Fourier Features 模型）大体相当，且与 data-reuploading QNN 性能相当；合成数据上的 Fourier 谱比较用于支撑两者函数表达的对应关系。
Conclusion: NFS 可作为评估 data-reuploading QNN 性能的自然经典基线，使 QNN 与经典模型的比较落在同一 Fourier 支撑上。

papers.title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 RoBERTa 逐词增量重算 token 的 contextual word embeddings (CWEs)，构造 token-wise incremental trajectories，刻画句子展开时表征如何演化。轨迹在 garden-path 句的关键区出现扰动，并可靠区分 garden-path 句与配对的消歧对照；轨迹信息对句型高度可预测，且歧义信息不仅在 CLS，也分布在普通词表 token 中。
Motivation: garden-path 等歧义加工的动态意义建构发生在话语逐词展开的过程中，而静态句向量无法表示表征随增量上下文的位移路径。
Method: 对 RoBERTa 每加入一个新词就重算目标 token 的 CWE，得到 token-wise 增量轨迹；以 garden-path 句及其配对消歧对照为测试用例，引入多个度量量化跨 contextual increments 的 representational displacement，并用轨迹信息预测句型。
Result: 轨迹复现 garden-path 加工的已知特征，包括在关键区 (critical region) 附近的扰动，并可靠区分 garden-path 句与匹配的消歧对照；轨迹信息对句型高度可预测；歧义相关信息可从句级 CLS 与普通词表 token 中同时恢复；在其他歧义与误导类语言现象中探索性分析发现定性相似的轨迹结构。
Conclusion: token-wise incremental trajectories 可作为用 LLM 研究话语特异性意义建构的框架，且话语层信息分布在多个表征尺度上，不只集中在 CLS。

papers.title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHARPO 在 GRPO 之上做段级 (segment-level) 信用分配：把轨迹按面向环境的段切分，用 OPSD 式师生 log-probability 差构造有界乘子去缩放 GRPO advantage，同一段内 token 共享该乘子、段间信用可不同。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，SHARPO 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上超过 GRPO、SDAR、RLSD、StepOPSD 等基线。
Motivation: 长程多步 agentic RL 中单点失误即可导致整条轨迹失败，而轨迹级奖励无法把信用分配到具体决策上，梯度指导信号过粗。

papers.title: TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TrueMuse 用可控微调数据给文本到音乐生成的数据归因 (data attribution) 提供真值：在三个 diffusion 文本到音乐模型上微调已知纳入的样本，构成 133 个属性、648 个微调模型、95,456 个生成样本的基准。系统评测现有黑盒归因方法后发现归因仍然困难，且表现随评测设置大幅波动。
Motivation: 文本到音乐模型训练集庞大，需要量化单个训练样本贡献的归因方法，但缺少可靠真值使现有方法难以被严格评估。
Method: 精心挑选归因样本，微调三个 diffusion-based 文本到音乐模型，样本已知纳入微调即构成可控归因目标；覆盖旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家风格签名、流派共享模式四种归因设置与两类 prompt，沿微调改进、prompt 类型难度、多任务训练、微调数据规模四个维度评测黑盒归因方法。
Result: 基准含 133 个属性、648 个微调模型、95,456 个生成样本；评测显示归因仍然具有挑战性，现有方法在不同评测设置间表现差异显著。
Conclusion: 文本到音乐生成的归因方法需要更可靠、更可泛化；代码与数据集将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3
papers.abstract_en: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.
papers.comment: 17 pages. Accepted to the non-archival Interpreting Agent Behavior workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project: https://kepler-harness.vercel.app/ . Code and public traces available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kepler 把 ARC-AGI-3 的规则假设表示为可执行世界模型，用回溯转移检查与条件预测检查验证，在单一冻结的 Claude Opus 5 配置下于全部 25 个公开游戏取得服务器验证的 100.00 RHAE，且不做逐游戏模型选择或按分数重跑。183 个已完成关卡中 181 个的最终尝试动作数不超过人类中位基线，但作者同时报告三类评估失效，指出公开集分数单独的区分力有限。
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3 要求智能体从观察中推断环境规则与目标，而按分数反复重跑、逐游戏挑模型会让公开集分数失去区分力，掩盖成本与验证层面的失效。
Method: 开源 harness Kepler 将假设编码为可执行世界模型，用回溯转移检查 (retrospective transition checks) 与条件预测检查 (conditional prediction checks) 验证；在单一冻结 Claude Opus 5 配置下运行，保留本地 provider-session 记录以审计 token、缓存与成本，并额外报告控制条件与自主修复对照。
Result: 全部 25 个公开游戏服务器验证 RHAE 100.00；183 个已完成关卡中 181 个最终 Opus 尝试动作数不超过人类中位基线；保留棋盘运行共 8,256 次环境动作，其中 7,292 次发生在计分关卡；本地会话记录 858.0 million tokens、97.37% 缓存读取、按 2026-09-01 API 牌价折算成本 $777.72；最终 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 棋盘的 50 个游戏模型格中 48 个达到 100；报告三类评估失效：源码泄漏导致无效满分、控制条件下智能体重建被移除的 harness、自主修复掩盖损坏的 planner；单游戏观察案例显示动画帧含已稳定文本网格中缺失的任务相关信息。
Conclusion: 公开集分数单独区分力不足，评估应改为报告首次尝试、按成本条件化且经验证的结果；可执行世界模型加双重检查能在不逐游戏调参的情况下达到满分。

papers.title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/sachinkg12/yukti/releases/tag/veritygate-groundlm-2026-v1.0.0 Supplementary artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22668710
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VERITYGATE 是一个四门 (four-gate) 模式级忠实性检查器，只校验声明的 evidence ID、实体、数字与 claim 类型，不校验散文中的全部事实。在 r=0 与 r=1 各 900 个实例（450 个 grounded-ungrounded 对）上，GPT-4o-mini 有 80.3%、Claude Sonnet 4.6 有 47.9% 的 claim 被拒；一次修复把 mini 的 claim 存活率从 19.7% 提到 28.0%，但每例已验证 claim 数对 Llama 与 Sonnet 反而下降。
Motivation: 结构化证据系统之上的 LLM 解释可能流畅但不跟随证据，需要一个可执行的模式级契约来判定 claim 是否成立，同时区分验证器拒绝率与散文幻觉率。
Method: 四门检查器按固定 schema 校验声明的 evidence ID、实体、数字与 claim 类型；在 r=0 与 r=1 两种设置下各测 900 个实例（450 个 grounded-ungrounded 配对），覆盖 GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B、Claude Sonnet 4.6，并加入一次修复 pass、第二遍 Sonnet、人工小规模研究与带顺序效应的 GPT-4o 领域裁判测试。
Result: 修复前 mini 80.3%、Sonnet 47.9% 的 claim 被拒；一次修复使 mini 存活率 19.7%→28.0%、Sonnet 52.1%→54.3%；每例已验证 claim 变化为 mini +0.14、Llama -0.71、Sonnet -0.47；第二遍 Sonnet 无明显增益；r=1 时 Gate 4 覆盖失败 claim 的 97.0%（mini）、98.7%（Llama）、100%（Sonnet）。
Conclusion: 存活率与输出量必须一起报告，单看存活率会掩盖修复带来的产出缩水；模式检查与散文正确性之间仍存在差距，GPT-4o 裁判因顺序效应只能当作有用性检查。

papers.title: AnyJev Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Early report on work in development. Code: https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyJev 用预训练指令微调语言模型的一次 prefill 直接读出带类型决策（typed decision）的概率输出，把答案位置的 next-token 分布限制在选项 token 上，并在无梯度、不改参数的前提下修正两个缺陷：除掉无标签输入上估计的 label prior，以及对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转取 log-prob 平均。在两个 20 选项任务上，旋转把 order-flip rate 从 0.33 降到 0.14 和 0.18，并在两个任务的全部 11 个模型上都提升准确率。
Motivation: 需要返回概率而非文本的带类型决策系统目前只能靠专门训练的模型；直接从通用指令微调模型读概率会遇到标签先验偏置与选项顺序偏置两个系统性缺陷。
Method: 在答案位置把 next-token 分布限制到选项 token 上读出概率；用无标签输入估计的 label prior 做除法去偏，并对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转的 log-probabilities 取平均。另设停止规则：在一份无标签 split 上对照全旋转决策选阈值，在第二份 split 上给出分歧上界，从而少读旋转。
Result: 两个 20 选项任务上 order-flip rate 由 0.33 降至 0.14 与 0.18，准确率在两个任务的 11/11 个模型上均提升。全旋转需读 K=18 次 prefill；停止规则在四个 cell 中的两个上读 10.6 次旋转并给出已验证的 0.008 分歧上界；在单 split 上选择并定界的 serving run 读 7.3 次旋转，在 vLLM 上每秒可服务的决策数为 2.2 倍。
Conclusion: 无需梯度与参数改动，仅靠先验去除加选项循环旋转平均即可同时消除标签与顺序偏置；配合带分歧上界的停止规则可在保持已验证界的前提下大幅削减 prefill 次数。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 需要返回概率而非文本的带类型决策系统目前只能靠专门训练的模型；直接从通用指令微调模型读概率会遇到标签先验偏置与选项顺序偏置两个系统性缺陷。
summary_sections.method: 在答案位置把 next-token 分布限制到选项 token 上读出概率；用无标签输入估计的 label prior 做除法去偏，并对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转的 log-probabilities 取平均。另设停止规则：在一份无标签 split 上对照全旋转决策选阈值，在第二份 split 上给出分歧上界，从而少读旋转。
summary_sections.result: 两个 20 选项任务上 order-flip rate 由 0.33 降至 0.14 与 0.18，准确率在两个任务的 11/11 个模型上均提升。全旋转需读 K=18 次 prefill；停止规则在四个 cell 中的两个上读 10.6 次旋转并给出已验证的 0.008 分歧上界；在单 split 上选择并定界的 serving run 读 7.3 次旋转，在 vLLM 上每秒可服务的决策数为 2.2 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 无需梯度与参数改动，仅靠先验去除加选项循环旋转平均即可同时消除标签与顺序偏置；配合带分歧上界的停止规则可在保持已验证界的前提下大幅削减 prefill 次数。

papers.title: Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验 LLM 的口头化概率 (verbalized probability) 与内部采样概率是否对齐：通过干预训练数据与上下文中的不确定性来源，发现两种读数都同时受分布性不确定性 (distributional uncertainty) 和断言式不确定性 (asserted uncertainty) 影响，且二者的对齐程度超出各自独立追踪同一来源所能解释的水平，因此口头化置信度可用来探测模型内部分布。
Motivation: 已有工作认为内部概率追踪训练数据的相对频率、口头化概率追踪训练数据中的显式概率断言，但两者何时对齐并不清楚，这限制了把口头化不确定性当作训练数据频率或模型内部分布代理的可用性。
Method: 系统干预数据中底层不确定性来源（训练数据与 in-context 数据），分别操纵分布性不确定性与断言式不确定性，再同时读取模型的内部采样概率与口头化（文字或数值）置信度，比较两种读数的响应与对齐程度。
Result: 内部与口头化两种概率读数都同时受训练数据中的分布性不确定性与断言式不确定性影响；口头化概率与内部概率的对齐程度超出二者独立追踪相同不确定性来源时的预期。
Conclusion: 口头化概率与内部概率是耦合的，因此可以用口头化概率来探测模型的内部分布，而不必只在训练数据频率与概率断言恰好一致时才可信。

papers.title: Align Then Reason: A Multimodal Lip-Sync Judge for Dubbing
papers.abstract_en: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. Existing visual speech recognizers and video-language models are poorly suited to this setting: even when fine-tuned to recover spoken content from lip motion, they remain largely insensitive to temporal errors. We introduce $\textit{Align Then Reason}$ (ATR), a multilingual lip-sync judge that first establishes a monotonic alignment between frame-level lip representations and the phonetic units of the candidate line, then reasons over this alignment to make the final judgment. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. The gains generalize across LLM families, reaching mean AUC improvements of 45.9% and 46.6% over the best baseline for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, respectively. They also transfer across datasets to three unseen MuAViC languages. Furthermore, we evaluate on two downstream tasks built from real dubbing lines. On dub-line reranking, ATR-9B outperforms the best lip-reading baseline by 52.0%, while on script-to-clip assignment, ATR-9B improves over the best lip-reading baseline by 17.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATR 先在帧级唇形表征与候选台词的音位单元之间建立单调对齐，再让 LLM 基于逐音位局部证据与校准后的全局对齐分数同时判断内容与时序是否匹配。在七语言基准上，相对 Qwen3.5 SFT 基线的 mean AUC 提升 59.4%（2B）、50.2%（4B）、50.8%（9B），并迁移到三个未见过的 MuAViC 语言。
Motivation: 配音质检需要在配音音频尚不存在时，仅凭无声视频与文本判断台词在内容和时序上是否匹配；现有视觉语音识别器与视频语言模型即使微调也对时序错误不敏感。
Method: ATR 分两步：先用对齐打分器在帧级唇形表征与候选台词音位间做单调对齐，再把逐音位局部证据与校准的全局对齐分数一并交给 LLM 推理，联合判断内容与时序；reasoner 有 2B/4B/9B 规格，并跨 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 家族检验。
Result: 七语言基准上 mean AUC 相对 Qwen3.5 SFT 基线提升 59.4%、50.2%、50.8%（2B/4B/9B）；相对最佳基线在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上分别提升 45.9% 与 46.6%；增益迁移到三个未见 MuAViC 语言。下游任务上 ATR-9B 在 dub-line reranking 上超最佳 lip-reading 基线 52.0%，在 script-to-clip assignment 上提升 17.7%。
Conclusion: 先对齐再推理的两段式设计让 judge 同时对内容与时序错误敏感，且跨 LLM 家族与数据集泛化，可直接用于真实配音台词的质检与排序。

papers.title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.
papers.comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ARC-1D 受控测试床上，超网络 (hypernetwork) 从少量示范直接生成微型专用模型的权重，把少任务上下文即时编译成可执行参数。生成的权重构成结构化 weight space，所得专用模型对未见变换具备部分组合泛化；去掉显式任务标识符后，泛化进一步超出训练时见过的变换。
Motivation: 通用模型靠上下文适应任务但容量大，专用模型执行效率高却需逐任务训练或适配；问题是从少量示范直接生成专用模型是否可行。
Method: 以 ARC-1D 为受控测试床，用超网络从上下文（少量示范）生成微型专用模型的参数；对比保留与移除显式任务标识符两种设置，考察组合泛化与对未见变换的泛化。
Result: 个体变换可由微型专用模型表示，超网络能从上下文生成其参数并形成结构化 weight space；生成的专用模型表现出部分组合泛化及对训练未见变换的泛化；在保留与移除任务标识符两种设置中，移除显式任务标识符都使泛化超出训练变换范围。
Conclusion: 少任务上下文可即时编译为紧凑可执行模型参数，生成的 weight space 能支持对已知函数之外的复用与泛化——这是 ARC-1D 上的概念验证 (proof of concept)。

papers.title: PI-AMFM: Permutation-Invariant Learning for Variable-Cardinality AM-FM Mode Decomposition in Biomedical Signal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Physiological recordings often contain nonstationary oscillatory components whose number and dynamics vary across signals. Amplitude- and frequency-modulated (AM-FM) representations are well suited to characterizing such dynamics and have shown broad utility in biomedical signal analysis. Recent approaches have incorporated neural networks to learn mode decomposition patterns from data, but component cardinality is often predefined or determined through separate stopping or selection mechanisms. We propose a permutation-invariant neural framework for variable-cardinality AM-FM mode decomposition (PI-AMFM). PI-AMFM combines a multiscale temporal encoder, Mamba backbone, and component-presence estimation, with permutation-invariant Hungarian matching during training. On synthetic AM-FM signals, PI-AMFM achieved lower decomposition, instantaneous-frequency, reconstruction, and mode-count errors than the compared methods while preserving the overall trajectory pattern in a crossing-chirp example. On photoplethysmographic recordings, recovered modes captured cardiac and respiratory dynamics despite training only on synthetic signals. These results support the feasibility of PI-AMFM for variable-cardinality decomposition of nonstationary biomedical signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PI-AMFM 用多尺度时间编码器加 Mamba 主干与成分存在性估计，配合训练时的 Hungarian 置换不变匹配，实现分量个数可变的 AM-FM 模态分解。在合成 AM-FM 信号上其分解、瞬时频率、重构与模态计数误差均低于所比较方法，并在交叉 chirp 例中保持整体轨迹；仅用合成信号训练即可在 PPG 记录中恢复出心与呼吸动态。
Motivation: 生理信号中非平稳振荡成分的个数与动态随信号变化，而现有神经分解方法的成分基数需预先设定或依赖独立的停止/选择机制。
Method: PI-AMFM 组合多尺度时间编码器 (multiscale temporal encoder)、Mamba 主干与成分存在性估计 (component-presence estimation)，训练时用置换不变的 Hungarian 匹配对齐预测模态与真值；模型仅在合成 AM-FM 信号上训练。
Result: 在合成 AM-FM 信号上，PI-AMFM 的分解误差、瞬时频率误差、重构误差与模态计数误差均低于所比较方法，并在 crossing-chirp 示例中保持整体轨迹模式；在光体积描记 (photoplethysmographic, PPG) 记录上，恢复的模态捕捉到心与呼吸动态，尽管训练只用了合成信号。
Conclusion: 置换不变匹配加存在性估计可支持非平稳生物医学信号的可变基数模态分解，且合成到真实 PPG 的迁移可行。

papers.title: Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases
papers.abstract_en: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对维多利亚州 2020-01 至 2024-03 全州 EMS 的 2,850,575 次出车做探索性数据分析，量化 ambulance ramping（到院至交接的延误）的规模与运行关联：累计丢失 1,491,127 小时，约合每天损失 96 个十小时班次；年损失在 2022 年升 57% 而转运需求反降 3.7%，说明恶化来自单例交接而非需求增长。交接时长随同院前一小时到达的救护车数量单调上升、且与患者危重程度几乎无关，据此提出医院状态感知的救护车调度。
Motivation: ambulance ramping 是 EMS 的关键运行瓶颈，但其系统性规模与动态在全州尺度上缺乏刻画，无法支撑调度决策。
Method: 对维多利亚州 2,850,575 次出车做系统预处理后，取 59 家设急诊医院、79 个 LGA 的 2,026,569 例 ED 转运构成分析队列，用探索性数据分析 (EDA) 结合区间分解、Pareto 集中度、小时互相关、到院并发度与按优先级分层的运行比较。
Result: 累计 Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) 1,491,127 小时，约等于研究窗口内每天损失 96 个十小时班次；59 家医院中 10 家占丢失小时的 57.8%、对应 50.9% 的病例；年损失在 2022 年峰值上升 57%，同期转运需求下降 3.7%；交接时长随同院前一小时到达救护车数量单调上升且在全天每个小时内都成立，与患者危重程度关系很小；小时需求与 2–4 小时后的 ramping 中度相关 (r = 0.365)。

papers.title: TabJoinBench: A Benchmark for Joinable Table Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Join discovery aims to identify tables from large data repositories that can augment a query table with complementary information, enabling downstream tasks such as data exploration, feature engineering, and business intelligence. Although numerous join discovery methods have been proposed, existing studies rely on method-specific benchmark construction, making reproducible and fair comparison difficult. We present TabJoinBench, a benchmark for evaluating join discovery methods across semantic, relational, and hybrid data lake scenarios. TabJoinBench constructs query-candidate pairs using source-specific validation strategies, systematically introduces structural, representation, and semantic changes through composable perturbations while preserving reliable ground truth. We evaluate representative join discovery methods spanning set-based, feature-based, and learned approaches, together with general-purpose language-model embedding baselines, and publicly release the processed datasets, ground-truth annotations, and generation pipeline to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabJoinBench 是一个可复现的 join discovery 基准，用源特定验证策略构造查询-候选表对，并通过可组合扰动系统引入结构、表示与语义变化，同时保持可靠 ground truth。它统一评测 set-based、feature-based、learned 三类方法及通用语言模型 embedding 基线，覆盖语义、关系与混合 data lake 场景，并公开数据集、标注与生成管线。
Motivation: 现有 join discovery 研究各自构造方法特定的基准，导致方法之间难以公平、可复现地比较。
Method: TabJoinBench 在语义、关系与混合 data lake 场景下，用源特定验证策略 (source-specific validation strategies) 构造 query-candidate 表对；通过可组合扰动 (composable perturbations) 系统引入结构、表示与语义变化并保留可靠 ground truth；评测 set-based、feature-based、learned 三类 join discovery 方法与通用语言模型 embedding 基线。
Result: 基准覆盖语义、关系与混合三类场景，评测代表性的 set-based、feature-based、learned 方法及通用 LLM embedding 基线；公开处理后的数据集、ground-truth 标注与生成管线。
Conclusion: join discovery 方法应在统一、可复现且带受控扰动的基准上比较，作者据此公开数据、标注与生成管线以支持后续评测。

papers.title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Training-Aware Target Coverage (TATC)：先用线性理论刻画合成数据的边际价值权衡（何时只看输入覆盖足够、何时必须计入合成误差），再据此挑选能扩展目标相关方向覆盖的样本。在数学推理任务上用 TATC 选合成解微调 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct，各选择预算下 GSM8K 均优于其他合成数据选择方法。
Motivation: LLM 训练中加更多合成数据并不必然更好：样本价值随训练集增长而变，且合成误差可能抵消收益，缺少判定何时加、加多少的准则。
Method: 先建立刻画合成数据收益与误差权衡的线性理论，给出边际价值与输入覆盖充分性条件；再据此实现 TATC，先筛出对目标任务训练效应有益的候选，再在其中选择以扩展现有数据未覆盖的目标相关方向。
Result: 线性理论在文本与图像数据上得到实验验证；在数学推理任务中，TATC 为微调 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 选择合成解，在各选择预算 (selection budgets) 下于 GSM8K 上超过其他合成数据选择方法。
Conclusion: 合成数据选择可以按量化并对目标任务的价值来做：先判边际价值与覆盖充分性，再定向扩展目标相关方向，比无训练感知的覆盖式选择更有效。

papers.title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026-June, 2026. ISSN 2835-8856
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇视频生成模型后训练与对齐的综述，把 post-training 统一为一个框架，并按对齐信号的施加方式区分隐式对齐与显式对齐，将现有方法归为四类：监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励方法、推理时方法。综述同时梳理常用数据集、基准与评测实践，并指出可扩展奖励设计、长时序一致性、稳定性-表达性权衡与安全感知生成等开放问题。
Motivation: 预训练视频模型虽有强生成先验，却常不能可靠遵循人类意图、保持时序一致或满足物理与安全约束；相比图像与文本生成，视频对齐还叠加时序误差累积、运动-外观耦合、多目标权衡以及时序属性监督稀缺，需要不从头重训的系统性后训练策略。
Method: 以统一框架组织 post-training，按对齐信号的施加方式分为隐式对齐与显式对齐，再据此把方法归入监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励、推理时方法四大类；同时综述数据集、基准与评测实践。
Result: 综述给出四类后训练方法的分类体系，覆盖训练与部署两个阶段的对齐信号作用方式，并整理了常用数据集、基准与评测实践；摘要未给出定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 对齐信号的施加方式（隐式 vs 显式）是组织视频生成后训练方法的有效统一视角，可同时指导训练阶段与部署阶段的可控可靠生成；开放挑战集中在可扩展奖励、长时序一致性、稳定性-表达性权衡与安全感知生成。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Paying for Too Many Tokens? Valid and Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Annotation with Simple Heuristics
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines that can enable cost-aware VLM annotation in CSS.
papers.journal_ref: AACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对短视频 VLM 标注的省 token 启发式做系统评测，发现准确率与下游推断有效性会分叉：准确率最高的配置可能得出错误结论；单模态文本已足够强，加模态只加成本不加信号；用简单镜头切换检测构造的单个 2×8 图像网格可在约 15% token 成本下逼近全视频理解（κ 差距约 .05）。
Motivation: 60 秒短视频按每秒一帧处理需数百万 token，研究者常用抽帧、图像网格、单模态等启发式省钱，但哪些真正省钱、是否保得住下游结论一直不清楚。
Method: 在两个计算社会科学 (CSS) 任务（情感分类与主题分类）上系统评测多种省成本配置，沿三条轴打分：分类准确率、下游推断有效性 (validity)、每视频 token 成本。
Result: 准确率与有效性分叉，最高准确率配置可给出错误结论；仅文本即可取得强表现，加模态可能只增成本不增信号；单个 2×8 镜头切换图像网格以约 15% 的 token 成本达到接近全视频理解的效果（κ 相差约 .05）。
Conclusion: 成本感知的 VLM 标注应以有效性和 token 成本共同选配置，而非只看准确率；短视频标注的开销可与视频长度解耦。

papers.title: Spatially Gated Diffusion for Localized Counterfactual Chest Radiograph Editing
papers.abstract_en: Editing a chest radiograph requires completing the requested change while preserving unrelated content. We study a latent diffusion editor with an instruction-independent source trajectory and an instruction-conditioned editing trajectory. A learned gate mixes their post-sampler candidates at each executed step, and a separate image-space mask composites the decoded proposal with the source. On 2,400 MIMIC-derived requests, 2,244 outputs met the joint target, preservation, quality, and coverage rubric (93.5%), and target completion was 97.4%. Joint validity exceeded a matched composition-only control by 1.7 percentage points (paired patient-cluster 95% interval, 0.6--2.8). At a fixed learned mask, the learned-gate proposal improved joint validity by 1.6 points (0.8--2.4); at a fixed learned proposal, the learned mask improved it by 2.6 points (1.7--3.5). Across three training seeds, mean joint validity was 93.5% with a 0.3-point sample standard deviation. A blinded 240-request assessment yielded adjudicated joint validity of 93.3% for the full editor and 91.7% for composition only. Protected-region mean absolute error decreased from 0.0190 in the raw proposal to 0.0075 after composition. These findings distinguish recurrent-gating effects on the proposal from preservation through final composition in the assessed cohort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用于胸片 (chest radiograph) 局部反事实编辑的潜空间扩散编辑器：一条与指令无关的源轨迹和一条指令条件化的编辑轨迹，由学习到的 gate 在每个执行步混合采样候选，再用图像空间 mask 把解码结果与源图合成。在 2,400 条 MIMIC 派生请求上，2,244 条同时满足目标、保持、质量与覆盖评分（93.5%），目标完成率 97.4%。
Motivation: 胸片编辑要求完成指定改动同时保持无关区域不变，而单一轨迹的扩散编辑难以同时保证目标达成与非目标内容的保真。
Method: 潜扩散编辑器含指令无关的源轨迹与指令条件化的编辑轨迹；学习到的 gate 在每个执行步混合两条轨迹的采样后候选，独立的图像空间 mask 将解码提案与源图合成。消融分别固定 mask 只换 gate、固定提案只换 mask，并做三种训练种子与盲评。
Result: 2,400 条 MIMIC 派生请求中 2,244 条通过联合评分（93.5%），目标完成率 97.4%；联合有效性比 matched composition-only 对照高 1.7 个百分点（配对患者聚类 95% 区间 0.6–2.8）。固定 mask 时学习 gate 提升 1.6 点（0.8–2.4），固定提案时学习 mask 提升 2.6 点（1.7–3.5）。三种种子平均 93.5%，样本标准差 0.3 点。盲评 240 条请求：完整编辑器 93.3%，仅合成 91.7%。保护区 MAE 从原始提案的 0.0190 降到合成后的 0.0075。
Conclusion: 在该评估队列中，gate 决定提案质量、最终合成负责区域保持，两者对联合有效性的贡献可分离度量。

papers.title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sapien 是一个执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，用带状态谓词的正则表达式约束 AI agent 的工具调用序列，并支持延迟策略生成与作用域语义检查。即使 agent 被完全劫持，其策略在 AgentDojo 上排除 93–95% 的攻击、在 Toolathlon 上排除 62–85%，长程任务上拦截量约为工具白名单的两倍，同时只让 agent 效用比无约束状态低几个百分点。
Motivation: 上下文安全防御为每个任务合成策略并强制执行工具调用，但多步任务中动作是否合法取决于 agent 已做过和已学到什么，静态策略无法表达这种依赖。
Method: Sapien 策略用扩展正则表达式规定允许的工具调用序列，扩展项包括状态谓词 (stateful predicates)、延迟策略生成 (deferred policy generation) 和作用域语义检查 (scoped semantic checks)，在 agent 执行工具调用时在线强制。
Result: 在 agent 被完全劫持的设定下，Sapien 在 AgentDojo 上排除 93–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上排除 62–85%；长程任务上拦截数量约为工具白名单 (tool allowlists) 的两倍；效用相对无约束 agent 只低几个百分点 (a few percent)。
Conclusion: 有状态的序列级策略能在几乎不损失效用的前提下挡住大部分针对 agent 的劫持攻击，且在长程任务上明显强于静态工具白名单。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Inference for stochastic differential equations driven by weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion using neural networks and the Euler approximation
papers.abstract_en:
We consider the estimation of drift, diffusion, and noise covariance from discrete observations of stochastic differential equations driven by Gaussian processes. For a fixed observation horizon $T>0$ and a known initial state $x_0\in\mathbb R$, we study  egin{equation*} dX_t=a(X_t)\,dt+σ(X_t)\,dZ_t^{β,f}, \qquad X_0=x_0,\quad 0\leq t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip
oindent Here $a:\mathbb R	o\mathbb R$ is the drift coefficient, $σ:\mathbb R	o(0,\infty)$ is the diffusion coefficient, and $Z^{β,f}$ is a centered Gaussian process from the weighted sub-fractional Brownian family, with covariance  egin{equation*} \operatorname{Cov}(Z_s^{β,f},Z_t^{β,f}) =\int_0^{s\wedge t} f(r)q_β(s-r,t-r)\,dr, \qquad 0\leq s,t\leq T. \end{equation*} \smallskip
oindent Here $s\wedge t=\min\{s,t\}$. The temporal weight $f:[0,T]	o[0,\infty)$ is measurable, bounded, and positive almost everywhere, and $β\in(0,2)$ is the covariance exponent. For $u,v\geq0$, the kernel is $q_β(u,v)=[u^β+v^β-(u+v)^β]/(1-β)$ when $β
e1$. Its continuous extension at $β=1$ is $q_1(u,v)=(u+v)\log(u+v)-u\log u-v\log v$, with $0\log0=0$. Using the Euler approximation, we reconstruct the Gaussian driving increments from observed transitions and use their joint density to obtain a trajectory likelihood. Neural and radial-basis representations model the drift, diffusion, and normalized temporal weight, while a likelihood profile estimates the covariance exponent and diffusion scale. We compare the method with two neural alternatives on the same simulated trajectories in twenty coefficient settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对由加权次分数阶布朗运动 (weighted sub-fractional Brownian motion) 驱动的随机微分方程，用 Euler 逼近从离散观测重建高斯驱动增量，以增量联合密度构造轨迹似然，再用神经网络与径向基表示漂移、扩散和归一化时间权重，通过似然剖面估计协方差指数 β 与扩散尺度。在同一批模拟轨迹的二十组系数设置上与两种神经方法对比。
Motivation: 由非马尔可斯高斯过程驱动的 SDE 中，漂移、扩散、噪声协方差与时间权重需同时从离散观测估计，标准似然与神经替代方法在此类加权次分数噪声下缺少可比的推断框架。
Method: 对 dX_t=a(X_t)dt+σ(X_t)dZ_t^{β,f} 用 Euler 逼近从观测转移重建高斯驱动增量，取其联合密度作为轨迹似然；漂移 a、扩散 σ 与归一化时间权重 f 用神经网络和径向基 (radial-basis) 表示，协方差指数 β∈(0,2) 与扩散尺度由似然剖面 (likelihood profile) 估计，核 q_β 在 β=1 处取连续延拓。
Result: 在同一批模拟轨迹上、二十组系数设置 (twenty coefficient settings) 中与两种神经方法对比；摘要给出的设定为固定观测时域 T>0、已知初值 x0∈R、一维状态。
Conclusion: Euler 重建增量加轨迹似然配合神经/径向基参数化，可把加权次分数布朗驱动 SDE 的漂移、扩散、噪声协方差与 β 指数估计统一到一个可与神经替代方法直接对比的推断流程里。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Weather Jiu-Jitsu: Exploring the Feasibility of Control Paradigms in Weather Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Weather Jiu-Jitsu is a control paradigm for extreme climatological events, inspired by chaos theory. As a proposition, small, precise, targeted, and cost-inexpensive perturbations can redirect trajectories of a large dynamical system. This strategy has been demonstrated analytically in the Lorenz-63 system, where a naturally chaotic trajectory switching between two attractors can be confined to a single attractor, indefinitely, via arbitrarily small perturbations. This paper examines the feasibility of Microsoft's Aurora -- a 1.3 billion parameter global atmospheric model -- as a test bed for this strategy. This paper explores three questions: (1) Is Aurora a reliable enough simulation environment to serve as a meaningful testbed? (2) Are the perturbations required to redirect its trajectories small enough to be physically plausible? (3) Does Aurora's learned latent space (the parametric estimators on climatological attributes) yield any apparent, structured, and/or perhaps interpretable features that can convey a geo/atmospheric response to initial conditions? We find evidence consistent with all three: Aurora's modeled trajectories respond to perturbations beyond measurement drift, the perturbation magnitudes required are small relative to the model's own forecast uncertainty, and its latent representations exhibit directional structure that responds to Jiu-Jitsu-type interventions, even though that structure does not separate extreme from normal states outright. These results should be read as feasibility diagnostics rather than a demonstration of control: we do not implement or test an actual steering intervention on Aurora, and several of our findings, particularly around the model's latent-space geometry, are exploratory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把混沌控制里的「柔术」思路搬到天气基础模型上：以 Microsoft Aurora（13 亿参数全球大气模型）为试验台，检验用微小扰动重定向其轨迹是否可行。三项证据一致——Aurora 轨迹对超出测量漂移的扰动有响应，所需扰动幅度相对模型自身预报不确定性很小，潜空间表征对 Jiu-Jitsu 型干预呈现有方向的结构，但该结构并不能直接区分极端与正常状态。作者强调这是可行性诊断而非实际控制演示，未在 Aurora 上实现或测试真正的转向干预。
Motivation: 混沌系统中微小扰动可改变轨迹的命题（已在 Lorenz-63 上解析验证）能否迁移到真实规模的天气基础模型，取决于模型是否可靠、所需扰动是否物理上合理、潜空间是否携带可解释的初值响应信号，此前缺少检验。
Method: 以 Aurora 为试验台，围绕三个问题展开：其一，检验 Aurora 轨迹响应是否超出测量漂移；其二，衡量重定向轨迹所需扰动幅度相对模型自身预报不确定性的大小；其三，分析 Aurora 学习到的潜空间（气候属性上的参数估计器）是否呈现结构化、可解释且对初值敏感的特征，并观察其对 Jiu-Jitsu 型干预的方向性响应。
Result: 三项发现均与可行性一致：Aurora 建模轨迹对超出测量漂移的扰动产生响应；所需扰动幅度相对模型自身预报不确定性较小；潜空间表征对 Jiu-Jitsu 型干预呈现方向性结构，但该结构不能直接区分极端与正常状态。
Conclusion: Aurora 作为混沌控制范式试验台具备初步可行性，但结果应读作可行性诊断而非控制演示——作者未实现或测试实际转向干预，潜空间几何方面的发现属探索性。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states. ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization. The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy. ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出企业表示简化 (ERS) 与表示复杂度度量 ERC，用 Representation Objects、Interactions、Behaviors、Supporting Sources 四个维度刻画表示范围，并把任务级 ERC 下降与 AI 推理所需解释的表示范围直接挂钩。作者以 Text-to-SQL 研究为证据，主张降低 schema 与推理复杂度可提高推理准确率；ERC 被明确定位为可测的架构变量，而非通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标。
Motivation: 企业内由应用、项目、技术、组织边界和本地需求塑造的表示结构不断累积，形成必须由企业维护、并由信息消费者与 AI 系统解释的表示复杂度，缺少跨表示状态比较复杂度的中立模型。
Method: 定义 ERC 为表示中立的复杂度模型，按 Representation Objects、Interactions、Behaviors（三者构成依赖类别）与 Supporting Sources（刻画表示暴露）四个维度度量表示范围，并区分表示层与任务层两个层级，以区分架构简化与检索优化；配套给出区分全局重复表示成本、任务级重复成本与一次性转换成本的经济模型，用于给定时间跨度上的评估。
Result: 论文给出 ERC 的四维度量结构与表示/任务两级定义，以及区分三类成本的经济模型；引用 Text-to-SQL 研究作为证据，说明降低 schema 与推理复杂度可改善推理准确率。
Conclusion: ERS 的核心主张是任务级 ERC 下降会缩小 AI 系统必须识别、关联和解释的表示范围，从而可测地影响推理表现；ERC 只用于比较表示方案、转换效果、经济结果与 AI 推理表现，不是通用复杂度、性能或成本指标。

papers.title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTV-FM 把 flow matching 从一阶直线桥升级为二阶相空间动力学，用最小加速度能量的变分闭合 (variational terminal-velocity closure) 从静态数据补出缺失的终端速度，并让同一构造同时给出 OT 配对代价与训练用的加速度目标。在低维数据集、PDE 控制的物理场与 CIFAR-10 上，其输运几何与生成质量优于一阶与高阶 FM 基线。
Motivation: 一阶 FM 在源-目标配对后路径是匀速直线，无法表达弯曲运动、加速度与变向；改用二阶相空间动力学又需要静态数据集不提供的目标端终端速度。
Method: 提出 Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM)：通过最小化加速度能量推导缺失速度，得到适用于静态数据的闭式 closure；同一最小加速度变分构造同时定义 OT 配对代价与训练所用的加速度目标。
Result: 在低维数据集、PDE 控制的物理场与 CIFAR-10 上，VTV-FM 在输运几何与生成质量上均优于一阶与高阶 FM 基线。
Conclusion: 二阶 FM 的终端速度可用最小加速度变分闭合从静态数据中补出，从而在不需额外速度标注的前提下改善生成质量。

papers.title: Can we create a `race to the top' for weather forecasts to inform smallholder farmer decisions?
papers.abstract_en: Artificial-intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) models have made it possible to produce high-quality tailored forecasts with limited computational resources. This advance has the potential to benefit hundreds of millions of farmers in low- and middle-income countries who lack access to forecasts of critical weather phenomena. However, it can be difficult for key stakeholders to evaluate forecast quality, risking a "race to the bottom" as cheap but low-quality forecasts crowd out forecasts that would benefit farmers. We propose a set of principles and protocols for evaluating agriculturally-relevant forecasts as a starting point for standards that would let forecasters credibly convey their forecasts' quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIWP 让低成本定制化天气预报成为可能，但小农户的关键利益相关方难以判断预报质量，可能导致廉价低质预报挤出真正有用的预报，形成“逐底竞争”。作者提出一套评估农业相关预报的原则与协议，作为可信传达质量、促成“逐顶竞争”标准的起点。
Motivation: 中低收入国家数亿农民缺乏关键天气现象预报，而利益相关方难以评估 AIWP 预报质量，低质廉价预报可能挤出高质量预报。
Method: 提出一套评估农业相关预报的原则与协议 (principles and protocols)，作为可让预报方可信传达质量的标准起点；属提案性框架，非实验方法。
Result: 提出面向农业相关预报的评估原则与协议框架，作为质量标准的起点；摘要未给出定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 只有让预报质量可被可信评估与传达，才能避免“逐底竞争”，使 AIWP 的低成本定制预报真正惠及小农户。

papers.title: Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability
papers.abstract_en: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ReQRL，用有限时域可达性约束 critic 的价值梯度，把动力学可达性与边界几何解耦并双双从数据估计，使准度量 (quasimetric) 的局部约束同时反映控制复合的方向依赖效应与环境可行性。在 OGBench 上，该方法优于或持平现有准度量方法与其他离线 GCRL 方法。
Motivation: GCRL 中准度量学习的局部约束未反映有限时域内控制复合的方向依赖效应与环境可行性，导致局部约束与全局价值几何不一致。
Method: ReQRL 借鉴状态约束最优控制 (state-constrained optimal control)，将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦，二者均从数据估计，并以此约束 critic 的价值梯度。
Result: 在 OGBench 上，ReQDB 优于或持平现有准度量方法与其他离线 GCRL 方法（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 以有限时域可达性作为价值梯度约束，可让准度量局部约束同时承载方向依赖的控制复合与环境可行性，并在离线 GCRL 基准上具备竞争力。

papers.title: Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks
papers.abstract_en: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机输入输出映射的记忆化任务 (memorization tasks) 之间研究迁移：发现等价迁移（每个预训练 epoch 约省下游微调 1 个 epoch）与非等价迁移（在错配任务上预训练甚至比直接训练下游任务更高效）。消融把迁移分解为末层的幅度驱动 (magnitude-driven) 与其余层协方差部分归因的结构驱动 (structure-driven) 两种效应。
Motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题是预训练为何能加速或改善另一任务，但迁移机制在受控的记忆化任务上尚未被分解和定位。
Method: 以随机输入输出映射的记忆化任务为载体，比较等价与错配任务间的预训练-微调；用消融实验把迁移拆分为末层幅度驱动效应与结构驱动效应（后者部分归因于其他层的协方差）。
Result: 等价迁移下每个额外预训练 epoch 约节省 1 个下游微调 epoch；错配任务预训练可比直接训练下游任务更高效；迁移被分解为末层的 trivial 幅度驱动与 non-trivial 结构驱动两部分。
Conclusion: 迁移可被定位为末层幅度与深层结构两个独立效应，这为设计有原则的预训练策略提供了机制依据。

papers.title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 grafting：在预训练 checkpoint 上训练 SDF adapter，再把学到的权重更新加到已后训练的模型上，以近似忠实的 mid-training 干预而无需重跑后训练。在最高 284B 参数的多个模型族上，它安装目标信念的强度与在后训练模型上直接做 SDF 相当，但 reality drift 与偏好一致性损失平均各降低一半以上，且更接近忠实 mid-training 运行。
Motivation: 预训练语料的任何改动都要跟一次完整后训练才能测效，迭代极慢极贵；直接在已后训练模型上做合成文档微调 (SDF) 会留下伪影、损害能力，并让模型把与文档无关的虚构实体当真（reality drift）。
Method: grafting：在预训练 checkpoint 上训练 SDF adapter，把学到的权重更新叠加到后训练模型上，复用已有后训练结果；实验包括植入虚假事实、训练 misaligned model organisms、以及一次 constitutional mid-training 干预，覆盖最高 284B 参数的多个模型族。
Result: grafting 安装目标信念的强度与在后训练模型上做 SDF 相当；reality drift 与偏好一致性 (preference coherence) 损失平均各降低超过一半；相对忠实 mid-training 运行距离更近；同一 adapter 可复用到任意后续 checkpoint，代价仅为一次微调运行。
Conclusion: 把 SDF 的权重更新嫁接到后训练模型上，可以在不重跑后训练的前提下近似忠实的预训练干预，同时把 reality drift 和偏好一致性损失减半以上，使预训练干预的迭代成本降到单次微调。

papers.title: Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents
papers.abstract_en: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining. We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving source-policy performance in closely aligned environments and achieving 45.2% win rates when transferring policies whose source performance is 60.5%. In emulated virtual machine environments, transferred policies exhibit a Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.085 from native policies, indicating strong behavioral similarity. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RL-Transfer-between-env-4F47/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把跨网络模拟器的策略迁移统一为同一个对齐问题，提出将状态对齐 (state alignment) 与动作翻译 (action translation) 分离的框架，使在一个环境中训练的 RL 攻击策略无需重训练即可在另一个环境运行。在 CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel、NASim 四个平台上零样本迁移可行：紧密对齐的环境中完全保持源策略性能，源性能 60.5% 时迁移胜率 45.2%，NASim 虚拟机仿真部署下与原生策略的 Jensen-Shannon 散度仅 0.085。
Motivation: 网络攻击智能体通常只在单一模拟器中训练与评估，而各模拟器的状态表示、观测模型和动作空间差异很大，导致学到的策略能否跨环境迁移不清楚，也阻碍了部署与公平比较。
Method: 提出分离状态对齐与动作翻译的迁移框架：先对齐不同平台的状态表示，再把源环境的动作映射到目标环境动作空间，使源策略无需重训练即可在目标环境执行；在四个网络仿真平台上评估，并包含 NASim 的仿真虚拟机 (emulated) 部署。
Result: 在四个网络平台 (CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel、NASim) 上零样本迁移可行：紧密对齐的环境中完全保持源策略性能；源策略性能 60.5% 时迁移胜率达 45.2%；在仿真虚拟机环境中，迁移策略与原生策略的 Jensen-Shannon 散度为 0.085，行为高度相似。
Conclusion: 模拟器到模拟器与模拟器到真实的迁移本质上是同一个对齐问题，把状态对齐与动作翻译分开处理即可让策略跨网络环境零样本运行且行为接近原生策略。
Relevance: 0
