papers.title: Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出低秩假设下的多任务逆强化学习 (multi-task IRL)：在同一环境中汇总多个奖励不同的 agent 数据，使每个任务不必访问全部状态，只要其他任务覆盖即可。规划开销随秩而非任务数增长，任务增多时相对逐任务方法的计算优势扩大；在目标环境中转移 regret 低于基线，并给出奖励恢复与新环境策略学习的有限样本保证。
Motivation: 用可转移奖励做反事实评估时，目标环境会改变 agent 的状态占用，对数据覆盖提出严格要求；逐任务 IRL 的规划开销又随任务数增长，难以扩展到多任务多环境。
Method: 在同一环境中汇总多个不同奖励 agent 的数据，以低秩结构共享奖励表示；对每个任务做有限样本分析，给出奖励恢复与新环境下策略学习的保证，并把规划复杂度从随任务数降为随秩。
Result: 实验显示该方法对有限覆盖鲁棒，能在各任务 support 内外恢复奖励，向目标环境转移时 regret 低于基线，且相对逐任务方法的计算优势随任务数增加而扩大。
Conclusion: 低秩共享让多任务 IRL 同时放宽覆盖要求并把规划开销压到秩级别，因此可在新环境中低成本评估多个任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 token 预算下的视频证据索引 (Video Evidence Indexing, VEI)：先用低分辨率 Video Preview 提供廉价全局覆盖，再由策略选出紧凑高分辨率 Evidence Set 供最终 VQA 推理，把证据定位与预算分配作为联合决策。用答案感知教师做特权自蒸馏 (privileged self-distillation)，在学生生成的索引轨迹上训练测试时策略，支持每帧 1、6、12、24 个视觉 token 四种分辨率共用一个策略；实验显示 VEI 在有限视觉预算下提升 QA 准确率，自蒸馏进一步同时提升 QA 准确率与时间证据定位。
Motivation: 长视频问答受视觉 token 成本与 VLM 固定上下文宽度限制：问题需要广时间覆盖，但答案通常只由一小段时刻支撑，逐帧高分辨率编码代价过高。
Method: 推理管线分三段：低分辨率 Video Preview 提供全局覆盖，VEI 策略构建高分辨率 Evidence Set，Answer Generation 融合两者作答。针对缺少帧级监督，采用特权自蒸馏，由答案感知教师在学生生成的索引轨迹上指导测试时策略；训练单一策略同时支持每帧 1、6、12、24 个视觉 token。
Result: 实验显示 Video Evidence Indexing 在有限视觉预算下提高 QA 准确率；自蒸馏在此之上进一步同时提高 QA 准确率与时间证据定位精度；预览分辨率扫描覆盖每帧 1、6、12、24 个视觉 token 四档。
Conclusion: 把长视频问答拆成证据定位加预算分配的可学习策略，并用答案感知的特权自蒸馏补上帧级监督，可在固定 token 预算内同时改善作答与定位。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning to Price Electricity for Optimal Demand Response
papers.abstract_en: There is considerable interest in using time-varying electricity prices to shape consumer demand response, and better align energy demand with renewable production. However, optimal prices generally vary over time in response to complex signals such as weather forecasts, sunrise/sunset times, and day-of-week patterns; and existing methods are not able to make efficient use of such rich contextual information. Here, we propose a neural-network-based algorithm for contextual energy pricing, modeling pricing as a Stackelberg game and leveraging a mean-field solution representation from Mehrabi et al.~(2024). The approach learns constrained mappings from contextual features to feasible price signals. We validate our approach by simulating the energy grid in several US cities, and show that incorporating contextual information can considerably increase the value of the demand response programs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把电价设定建模为 Stackelberg 博弈，用神经网络从天气预报、日出日落、星期几等上下文特征直接映射到可行的价格信号，并借助 Mehrabi et al. (2024) 的 mean-field 解表示。在美国多个城市的电网模拟中，纳入上下文信息可显著提高需求响应 (demand response) 项目的价值。
Motivation: 最优电价随时间变化，需响应天气预报、日出日落、星期几等复杂信号，而现有方法无法有效利用这类丰富的上下文信息。
Method: 提出基于神经网络的上下文电价算法：将定价建模为 Stackelberg 博弈，利用 Mehrabi et al. (2024) 的 mean-field 解表示，学习从上下文特征到可行价格信号的受约束映射。
Result: 在美国多个城市的电网模拟中验证，纳入上下文信息可显著 (considerably) 提高需求响应项目的价值。
Conclusion: 上下文感知的神经定价能更有效地把电力需求与可再生出力对齐，其价值在多城市电网模拟中得到验证。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自监督卷积网络中，网络越宽，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练 (greedy layer-wise training) 的优势越小；在较浅且极宽的网络里，贪心逐层训练的性能反而更高，且其表征几何 (representational geometry) 更有利。结论是宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配 (credit assignment)。
Motivation: 局部优化、避免端到端误差反传的网络在何种架构条件下能学到与端到端训练相当的表征，此前并不清楚；该问题关系到大规模自监督预训练能否摆脱端到端反传。
Method: 在自监督学习框架下，系统考察网络宽度与深度对贪心逐层训练和端到端训练在卷积网络 (convolutional networks) 中效果的影响，并对训练所得网络的表征几何做后续分析。
Result: 更宽网络中端到端反传相对贪心逐层训练的收益缩小；在相对浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练模型性能更高；极宽的贪心训练网络表现出比端到端反传更有利的表征几何。
Conclusion: 宽度能够补偿受限的信用分配，而表征几何的差异是贪心训练性能提升的潜在机制。

papers.title: Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表征几何正则化框架下，信号-噪声因子分解 (SNF) 正则能提升含分布外失真任务的性能，而信号-信号因子分解 (SSF) 正则不能。SNF 正则化模型把噪声放进与类别信号分离的独立子空间，可在留出数据上估计主导失真方向并投影剔除，从而进一步大幅提升准确率。
Motivation: 近期理论指出 SNF 与 SSF 是影响深度网络推理能力的表征几何性质，但缺少在训练中强化这两者的手段，也未厘清二者对含分布外图像失真的任务各自是否关键。
Method: 构建强化 SNF 与 SSF 的训练正则项，与 L2 正则基线网络对比；在 CIFAR-100 分类与经 MedMNIST-C 五档失真处理的 BloodMNIST 上训练评估，并跨正则机制分析 nuisance 子空间几何。
Result: SNF 正则提升 CIFAR-100 分类性能，SSF 正则没有提升；在 BloodMNIST + MedMNIST-C 五个失真等级上 SNF 正则带来更大的性能增益。SNF 模型将噪声表征于与类别信号分离的独立子空间，在留出数据上估计主导失真方向并投影剔除后准确率获得 substantial 提升。
Conclusion: 强制信号-噪声因子分解的正则可在推理时含分布外失真的视觉任务上带来显著改进；把 nuisance 变量与类别变量隔离，比维持类别变量之间的因子化表征更重要。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中做通道消融：只用亮度监督训练几何、冻结位置/尺度/旋转/不透明度后重解外观，held-out 重建仅比 RGB 训练的几何低 0.085 dB；而只用色度监督得到的几何在同等外观求解后比亮度-only 差 3.9–5.5 dB。结论是 3DGS 的几何形成由亮度主导但非亮度独占，高阶球谐对亮度贡献 1.44 dB PSNR、对色度仅 0.19 dB，色度外观可在空间支撑形成后大部分恢复。
Motivation: 3DGS 从 RGB 联合学习几何与外观，亮度和色度各自对学到的表示贡献多少无法分离，几何形成阶段谁在起作用不清楚。
Method: 在不同通道监督（RGB、亮度-only、色度-only）下训练模型，冻结非外观参数（position、scale、rotation、opacity），用同一 solver 重新估计外观，再比较 held-out 重建；共十一个 benchmark 场景、每个四次独立运行。
Result: 亮度-only 训练的几何 held-out 重建平均比 RGB 训练低 0.085 dB；删除已训练模型的色度后，表达力足够的 solver 可在冻结几何上重拟合到原质量或略好；高阶球谐 (SH) 对亮度提升 PSNR 1.44 dB、对色度仅 0.19 dB；色度-only 监督的几何在相同外观求解后比亮度-only 差 3.9–5.5 dB，densification 解释了部分差距；镜面表面上色度仍随视角变化。
Conclusion: 标准 3DGS 的几何形成强烈由亮度主导但并非亮度独占，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成之后被恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StabilityArc: Decoding Protein Sequence Embeddings into Generalizable Stability Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Every protein has a unique stability landscape, but the physical consequences of mutation are governed by recurring biochemical constraints. We test whether a shared decoder, trained on measurements from diverse proteins, can interpret these constraints in an unseen target, enabling cross-protein transfer for initial experimental round prescreening. We present StabilityArc , which maps frozen ESMC-600M residue representations through a shared RoPE transformer to an Lx20 matrix of substitution effects; a symmetric, contact-aware residual aids in predicting epistasis in simultaneous substitutions. In 66 strict leave-one-protein-out evaluations covering 134,794 ProteinGym variants, StabilityArc achieves 0.7134 Spearman correlation, exceeding the strongest zero-shot baseline, ProSST-2048 (0.6526), by 0.0608. We further explore the utility of this method by providing the score as a prior for Kermut, achieving Spearman correlation of 0.8280 across three supervised split schemes, improving on Kermut's reported 0.8167.
papers.comment: Accepted to Representations for the Physical Sciences Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026; 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StabilityArc 用共享 RoPE transformer 把冻结的 ESMC-600M 残基表征解码为 L×20 突变效应矩阵，配合对称、接触感知的残差预测多位点上位性，在未见过的蛋白上做跨蛋白迁移以预筛实验轮次。在 66 次严格 leave-one-protein-out 评测、覆盖 134,794 个 ProteinGym 变体上，Spearman 达 0.7134，比最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048 的 0.6526 高 0.0608；作为先验接入 Kermut 后三种有监督划分下 Spearman 0.8280，超过 Kermut 原报的 0.8167。
Motivation: 每个蛋白的稳定性景观各不相同，但突变的物理后果受重复出现的生化约束支配；需要在完全未见的蛋白上做零样本突变效应预测，以支撑实验轮次的初步预筛。
Method: 冻结 ESMC-600M 的残基表征，经共享 RoPE transformer 解码为 L×20 替换效应矩阵；再加一个对称、接触感知 (contact-aware) 的残差项预测同时替换的上位性。评测采用 66 次严格 leave-one-protein-out，覆盖 134,794 个 ProteinGym 变体，并把打分作为先验接入 Kermut。
Result: 66 次 leave-one-protein-out、134,794 个 ProteinGym 变体上 Spearman 0.7134，最强零样本基线 ProSST-2048 为 0.6526，高出 0.0608；作为先验提供给 Kermut 后，三种有监督划分方案下 Spearman 0.8280，Kermut 原报 0.8167。
Conclusion: 跨蛋白共享的解码器能从冻结蛋白语言模型表征中读出可迁移的突变效应约束，在严格留一蛋白设定下超过专用零样本基线，并可作为先验进一步抬高有监督模型的 Spearman。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Q-MINO: A Minimal-Norm Method for Quantization-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: The Straight-Through Estimator (STE) is a widely used heuristic for Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), but its surrogate gradients can exhibit substantial mismatch with the underlying quantized objective, leading to noisy updates and parameter oscillations, particularly in ultra-low-bit regimes. We propose the Quantization-Aware Minimal-Norm Optimizer (Q-MINO), a temporal bundle method that combines gradient consensus, state-drift regularization, and an alignment constraint to construct stabilized, minimum-norm update directions from recent optimization states. Q-MINO solves the resulting constrained subproblem using a warm-started Frank--Wolfe procedure with a feasible fallback initialization. Theoretically, via a stochastic Lyapunov Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz (KL) framework, we show that Q-MINO achieves asymptotic neighborhood convergence. Moreover, we detail numerical experiments with Q-MINO at various quantizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-MINO 是面向量化感知训练 (QAT) 的最小范数优化器：用梯度共识、状态漂移正则与对齐约束，从近期优化状态构造稳定的最小范数更新方向，再用热启动 Frank-Wolfe 求解约束子问题。理论上经随机 Lyapunov–Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz 框架证明渐近邻域收敛，并给出多种量化位宽下的数值实验。
Motivation: STE 的代理梯度与真实量化目标存在较大失配，在超低比特下导致更新噪声与参数振荡，需要更稳的更新方向构造方式。
Method: Q-MINO 为 temporal bundle method：以梯度共识、state-drift 正则和 alignment constraint 组合出最小范数更新方向；约束子问题用 warm-started Frank-Wolfe 求解，并带 feasible fallback 初始化；收敛性由随机 Lyapunov–Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz (KL) 框架给出。
Result: 理论上得到 Q-MINO 的渐近邻域收敛 (asymptotic neighborhood convergence)；摘要说明在多种量化位宽下给出数值实验，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 用最小范数与对齐约束替代 STE 的原始代理梯度更新，可在超低比特 QAT 中换取更新方向的稳定性并保证渐近邻域收敛。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个基于用户历史（评论、帖子、图片、配文、元数据）的个性化图像生成统一基准，含个性化场景生成与个性化创意生成两个任务及多轴评测协议。方法 PEARL 用多模态 reasoner 与冻结图像生成器交替做 reason-reflect 循环，并以 differential data reward 优化，在两项任务上平均提升 15%。
Motivation: 现有个性化图像生成局限于从精选视觉样例做条件合成，无法刻画用户是谁；而真实用户历史包含多年积累的多模态上下文，缺少统一基准来衡量生成结果与用户生活方式、审美的一致性。
Method: 构建含两个任务的基准：Personalized Scene Generation（把给定物体放进反映用户偏好的场景）与 Personalized Creative Generation（按指定主题生成符合用户审美身份的新图）；评测协议覆盖 target fidelity、visual quality、user distinguishability、与历史的语义对齐、任务效用五个轴。提出 PEARL：多模态 reasoner 与冻结图像生成器交替的 reason-reflect 循环，用 differential data reward 优化。
Result: 在两个任务上 PEARL 均超过强基线，个性化相关指标平均提升 15%。
Conclusion: 把用户历史而非精选样例作为个性化条件，并用推理-反思交替加差分数据奖励，可以在场景与创意两类生成任务上一致提升个性化程度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReMILP 用 MILP 的等价重构（变量替换与冗余约束）做自监督信号，联合训练 GNN 与 hypernetwork 预测变量嵌入在换元下的变换方式。无需求解器标签，学到的表示在未见问题类上呈现预期的不变性与等变性，在二元解、约束活跃性与整数间隙预测上冻结可用、微调可作初始化。
Motivation: MILP 求解器加速依赖可复用的变量/约束表示，但监督标签需由求解器生成且跨问题类泛化差；MILP 本身存在大量保整数的等价重构，此前未被当作自监督信号。
Method: 先刻画对所有实例都成立的仿射重构，区分不改变变量的 re-descriptions 与可预测变换变量的 substitutions；再提出 ReMILP，联合训练图神经网络 (GNN) 与 hypernetwork，在换元下预测变量嵌入如何变换，属 equivariant self-supervised learning，不使用求解器标签。
Result: 在未见问题类上学到的表示呈现预期的不变性与等变性；在二元解预测、约束活跃性 (constraint activity) 与整数间隙 (integrality gap) 预测三类任务上，冻结时表示携带任务相关信息，微调时提供有用初始化。
Conclusion: MILP 的等价重构可作为免标签自监督源，产出跨问题类泛化且对换元等变的通用 MILP 变量与约束表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出只以奖励和动作为条件的 reward-based policy，使策略在观测空间完全不同的源域与目标域之间实现零样本迁移。在 Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing 上训练后，可零样本迁移到不同配色、3D 渲染以及 Habitat-Sim 中 Stretch 机器人导航等全新观测，并能进一步引导目标环境中基于观测的策略训练。
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略换到观测空间完全不同的新环境时难以适应，需要大量样本才能完成迁移；人类却能快速泛化。
Method: 训练一个只以 reward 和 action 为输入、完全不依赖观测的策略，作者讨论了这种策略的挑战与可行性并给出实用训练算法；随后在三个环境中训练并迁移到全新观测形态，还用它引导目标环境中 observation-based policy 的训练。
Result: 在 Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing 三个环境中训练的 reward policy，可零样本迁移到不同配色、3D 渲染以及 Habitat-Sim 中的 Stretch 机器人导航；同一 reward policy 还能进一步引导目标环境内基于观测的策略训练。
Conclusion: 把奖励本身当作观测，可以让策略跨完全不同的观测空间零样本迁移，并作为目标环境观测策略训练的引导信号。

papers.title: Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations
papers.abstract_en: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个在真实站点观测上受控评测生成式天气资料同化 (generative weather DA) 的基准：固定数据集、观测算子与网络结构，用 11,849 个 NOAA MADIS 站点和 4 个气象变量对比扩散 vs. flow matching、像素 vs. latent 空间、多种推理期条件化策略，并以 3D-Var 为基线。学习到的生成式先验相对 ERA5 的 RMSE 降幅 35.7%，高于 3D-Var 高斯先验的 33.3%，且推理时不使用 ERA5 背景场；full-gradient guidance 稳定优于 stop-gradient 与初始噪声优化，而扩散与 flow matching 几乎无差别、latent 空间变量混合无益，稀疏站点下生成式与 full-gradient 的优势更明显。
Motivation: 现有生成式 DA 只在合成观测或互不一致的数据集与评测方案下检验，无法判断哪些设计选择真正改善真实观测上的资料同化；而传统再分析依赖昂贵的 NWP 加 DA 流程。
Method: 在 11,849 个 NOAA MADIS 站点（覆盖美国本土、4 个气象变量）上固定数据集、观测算子与深度学习架构做受控基准，比较扩散与 flow matching、像素与 latent 空间表述、多种推理期条件化策略（含 full-gradient guidance、stop-gradient、初始噪声优化），并对照经典 3D-Var；另设稠密与稀疏站点两种设定。
Result: 学习到的生成式先验相对 ERA5 的 RMSE 降幅为 35.7%，3D-Var 高斯先验为 33.3%，且生成式方法推理时不用 ERA5 背景场；full-gradient guidance 一致优于 stop-gradient 与初始噪声优化；匹配条件下扩散与 flow matching 表现几乎相同，latent 空间变量混合无增益；稠密与稀疏站点两种设定下，生成式与 full-gradient 的优势在稀疏时更突出。
Conclusion: 生成式天气 DA 中真正起作用的是学习先验与 full-gradient guidance，而扩散还是 flow matching、是否用 latent 空间表述在匹配条件下可忽略；该基准为后续工作提供统一评测标准。
Relevance: 86

papers.title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CF-JEPA 把 JEPA 世界模型的隐空间拆成可控与不可控两个子空间，把干扰信息全部压进不可控区，只用与控制相关的隐变量做任务。在 2D 与 3D 控制任务上常规条件下性能与基线相当，干扰条件下性能提升，且是唯一不发生隐空间坍缩 (latent collapse) 的模型，并在模拟机器人任务上验证。
Motivation: 视觉控制需要把有用信息与背景干扰分开，JEPA 式隐空间世界模型不做像素重建，却仍对干扰信号敏感并出现隐空间坍缩。
Method: 提出 Controllability Factorized JEPA：将隐空间显式分解为可控与不可控子空间，干扰信息被约束到不可控区域，任务只依赖控制相关的隐表示；在 2D/3D 控制任务与一个模拟机器人任务上检验。
Result: 常规条件下在 2D 与 3D 控制任务上取得与基线相当的性能；干扰条件下性能提升，CF-JEPA 是唯一不发生隐空间坍缩的模型，并在模拟机器人任务的干扰条件下通过验证。
Conclusion: 把可控性做进隐空间分解可以同时保住常规控制性能并消除干扰下的隐空间坍缩，方案在模拟机器人任务上具备实用性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督分离语言模型输出中内容与风格表征的算法，在 9 个 teacher 模型的 10 万+ 条已验证数学推理轨迹上发现 6 种反复出现但分布不均的风格，再用 importance weighting 微调小模型按指定风格作答。在 6 个数学推理 benchmark 上 Pass@$k$ 高于同数据的标准微调，且请求风格与实际风格强对应；解题正确率随所条件化的风格而变，不同题目受益于不同风格。
Motivation: 语言模型把内容与风格联合学习，导致输出中的风格变化难以识别、也难以显式控制，风格作为可控且影响正确率的变量此前未被无监督地提取出来。
Method: 设计算法从模型输出中分离内容与风格的表征并在受控的数学题设定下验证；对 9 个不同 teacher 模型的 100K 以上已验证轨迹做无监督风格发现，得到 6 种风格；随后微调较小的 student 模型按显式风格条件作答，并用 importance weighting 平衡语料中各风格的贡献。
Result: 在 6 个数学推理 benchmark 上，该方法的 Pass@$k$ 高于在相同数据上的标准微调；请求风格与实际实现风格之间有强对应；正确率依赖于所条件化的风格，且不同题目受益于不同风格。
Conclusion: 模型生成数据中的风格变化可以被无监督地发现并显式化，风格因此同时成为控制手段和提升推理表现的来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
papers.abstract_en: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.
papers.comment: Accepted to World Models in Physical AI Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://jepa-ttt.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEPA-TTT 在测试期持续自监督更新预训练动作条件 JEPA 世界模型的 latent dynamics predictor，视觉编码器与 reward head 保持冻结，用 dense replay 在每个时间偏移构造预测窗口并存入增长 buffer 采样 minibatch。跨四个连续控制环境的八种动力学偏移上，500 个测试期 episode 后自回归 latent 预测误差平均降低 83%，规划性能相对冻结 JEPA 提升 153%，且规划不需要目标图像或在线环境奖励。
Motivation: 世界模型在测试期动力学与训练期不一致时预测失效，导致规划不可靠；同时在线适配往往需要目标图像或在线奖励信号。
Method: JEPA-TTT 只更新预训练动作条件 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture 世界模型的 latent dynamics predictor，视觉编码器与 reward head 冻结以保留预训练表征与任务目标；自监督更新跨 episode 累积，dense replay 在每个时间偏移生成预测窗口、存入不断增长的 buffer 并从中采样 minibatch 更新 predictor，规划过程无需目标图像或在线环境奖励。
Result: 在四个连续控制环境的八种动力学偏移上，JEPA-TTT 在每一种偏移上都改善规划；经过 500 个测试期 episode，自回归 latent 预测误差平均降低 83%，规划性能相对冻结 JEPA 世界模型提升 153%。
Conclusion: 持久的自监督测试期训练足以让预训练 latent 世界模型适应已改变的动力学，且无需在线奖励或目标图像。

papers.title: Outer Diversity of Condorcet Domains
papers.abstract_en: A Condorcet domain is a set of rankings over a given candidate set, such that every election that consists only of (an odd number of) votes from the domain has a transitive majority relation. We study outer diversity of Condorcet domains, i.e., a measure that quantifies expected swap distance from a random vote to a closest one in the domain. We numerically analyze outer diversity for maximal Condorcet domains with few candidates, and then we establish its asymptotic behavior for several special domains, mostly obtaining theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 Condorcet 域的 outer diversity——随机投票到域内最近投票的期望 swap 距离。对少量候选人的极大 Condorcet 域做数值分析，并对若干特殊域建立渐近行为，以理论结果为主。
Motivation: Condorcet 域刻画多数关系传递性的投票集结构，但其 outer diversity 这一量化随机投票与域内最近投票期望 swap 距离的度量此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 先对候选人数量较少情形下的极大 Condorcet 域 (maximal Condorcet domains) 做数值分析 outer diversity，再对若干特殊域推导其渐近行为，以理论推导为主。
Result: 给出少量候选人下极大 Condorcet 域 outer diversity 的数值分析结果，以及若干特殊域的渐近行为刻画，主要为理论结果（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: outer diversity 可对 Condorcet 域做数值刻画并对其特殊族给出渐近刻画，是衡量域与随机投票距离的可行度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions
papers.abstract_en: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FTC 把 LLM 注意力压缩从独立矩阵近似改成序贯结构化压缩：在固定存储预算下复用 Q/K/V 原生 head 结构，并让后续层的近似适应前面压缩造成的表示偏移，输出投影单独处理。在 6B–32B 的七个 decoder-only 模型上，五个现代 GQA 模型在所有测试 keep ratio 下 WikiText-2 perplexity 均为对比方法中最低，激进压缩时增益最大，且迁移到下游任务、在 32B 规模仍显著。
Motivation: 现有 post-training 注意力压缩把每个投影当独立矩阵近似，既忽略各注意力投影间的共享结构，也忽略先前压缩引入的表示偏移，导致固定存储预算下精度损失偏大。
Method: 提出 FTC（Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression）序贯结构化压缩框架：用 Tucker 分解在固定存储预算下联合利用 Q/K/V 的原生 head 结构，使近似随当前已压缩模型自适应；输出投影单独处理以适配注意力后表示的变化；全程不需要 fine-tuning，也不需要基于梯度的恢复。
Result: 在 6B 到 32B 参数的七个 decoder-only LLM 上，五个现代 GQA 模型在每个测试 keep ratio 下 WikiText-2 perplexity 都是所比较方法中最低，激进压缩时增益最大；改进迁移到下游任务，并在 32B 规模仍保持可观。
Conclusion: 把注意力投影当作共享结构、并显式补偿序贯压缩带来的表示偏移，可以在不微调、不走梯度恢复的前提下，把固定存储预算下的压缩精度推到对比方法之上，且该优势随模型放大到 32B 依然成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.
papers.comment: 38 pages, accepted at 2026 40th Advances in Neural Information Processing System (NeurIPS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Robust Nash Alignment：把对齐建模为博弈，主学习者在对抗竞争者与落在名义偏好歧义集内的任意 preference kernel 下最大化最坏情况胜率，歧义集刻画偏好不确定性时该鲁棒目标直接给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。为可优化性引入四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈与单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法，证明代理始终下界截断硬约束目标、给出代理到硬目标的间隙与精确性条件，并证明对偶间隙按 O(1/√T) 收敛。
Motivation: 偏好对齐通常只针对单一偏好模型优化，当成对偏好有噪声、异质或部署后发生偏移时容易失效，需要在偏好不确定下仍能给出最坏情况性能保证的对齐目标。
Method: 博弈论框架：主学习者策略、对抗竞争者与歧义集内的 preference kernel 构成鲁棒目标；因原问题难优化，构造含 leader policy、follower policy、adversarial kernel 与对偶变量的四玩家原始-对偶代理博弈，用单循环乐观镜像下降-上升 (optimistic mirror descent-ascent) 求解，并分析代理与硬约束目标的关系。
Result: 证明代理目标始终下界截断硬约束目标，量化代理到硬目标的间隙，并给出代理恢复鲁棒目标的精确性条件；证明代理博弈对偶间隙的平均迭代收敛为 O(1/√T)，从而得到原鲁棒目标的近最优鲁棒策略。在受控表格博弈与带不确定偏好的 LLM 对齐实验中验证了收敛理论，并相对名义基线 (nominal baselines) 表现出性能提升。
Conclusion: 把偏好不确定性写进歧义集的鲁棒纳什对齐既能给出可认证的最坏情况胜率下界，又能通过代理博弈与单循环算法在 O(1/√T) 收敛下求解，实验支持该理论并优于名义基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing
papers.abstract_en: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WOMBAT 提出 14 个手工设定消息传递权重的白盒 GNN，其判定规则（检测指定 SMARTS 基序）由构造已知，从而为 GNN 归因解释器提供归因真值。在数百万 PubChem 分子上验证后评测 GNNExplainer、PGExplainer、Integrated Gradients，并构造出一个让 Integrated Gradients 把归因摊到整图、但模型仍可靠检测目标基序的反例模型。
Motivation: GNN 解释器在分子上给出异常归因时，仅凭归因本身无法区分是解释器失效还是模型学到了捷径，缺少归因真值使 XAI 工具无法被系统检验。
Method: 构造 14 个白盒 GNN，消息传递权重手工设定为检测特定 SMARTS 基序，判定规则由构造已知；在数百万 PubChem 分子上验证模型，并据此评测事后解释器 GNNExplainer、PGExplainer、Integrated Gradients，再基于定性分析构造反例模型。
Result: 基准含 14 个白盒 GNN，在数百万 PubChem 分子上完成验证；评测覆盖 GNNExplainer、PGExplainer、Integrated Gradients；构造出的模型使 Integrated Gradients 将归因摊布到整图，而模型本身仍可靠检测目标基序。
Conclusion: 已知判定规则的白盒模型可作为归因真值，用来定位解释器误差与模型捷径，并可发布数据集、模型与评测代码支撑新一代 GNN XAI 工具开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. Across eight base language models, we investigate how model choice and harness design affect agent performance on such long-lived tasks. Our results show that how agents determine when to act arises as an important harness-design axis for long-lived tasks; and that the optimal design varies across tasks and sometimes model choices as well. We also evaluate how continuous learning from hindsight feedback affects performance and addresses failure modes observed in these long-lived tasks. These findings indicate model choice, action timing mechanism, and use of feedback as important considerations in the design of long-lived agents. Code: https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLiveGym 提出一个长生命周期 LLM agent 的诊断评测环境：agent 在按时间顺序回放的真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流上跨模拟数周稀疏行动，任务覆盖不同时间敏感度、推理强度与复发性。在八个基线语言模型上，行动时机 (when to act) 的判定方式成为关键 harness 设计轴，且最优设计随任务、有时随模型而变；hindsight feedback 的持续学习可缓解观察到的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有长时程 agent 工作多假设静态环境，无法覆盖需无人值守运行数周、须在正确时机行动并随动态环境自适应的持续监控类任务。
Method: 构建诊断评测环境 ReLiveGym，让 agent 在按时间回放的真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流上稀疏行动，任务按时间敏感度、推理强度与复发性分级；在八个基线 LLM 上系统改变模型选择与 harness 设计（含行动时机机制），并评估基于 hindsight feedback 的持续学习。
Result: 八个基线语言模型上的结果显示：行动时机判定方式是长生命周期任务的重要 harness 设计轴；最优设计随任务变化、有时也随模型变化；持续学习 hindsight feedback 影响性能并处理了该类任务中观察到的失败模式。
Conclusion: 长生命周期 agent 的设计需同时考虑模型选择、行动时机机制与反馈使用，不存在跨任务通用的最优 harness 配置。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry. We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations. We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可扩展的 pullback 几何从单高斯潜变量推广到高斯混合潜变量：度量取责任权重下的期望分量精度的矩阵平方，单分量时退化回已有构造。在混合流形上建立测地线方向 log-density 凹性条件与局部曲率关系，并在 normalizing flow 中做自适应分量学习；合成几何数据、可控多视角图像与 MNIST 上表现为传输畸变降低、路径支撑有竞争力、贴近参考轨迹、插值更真实。
Motivation: 现有可扩展 pullback 构造假设数据靠近单一高斯潜分布，多模态数据被压进同一高斯区域需要大幅传输形变，几何因此失真。
Method: 以高斯混合为潜分布，定义 Riemannian 度量为责任权重期望分量精度的矩阵平方，证明其光滑正定且单分量极限恢复已有高斯构造；对结构化重叠混合给出测地线上 log-density 凹的条件与局部曲率关系；再把它实例化进带 adaptive mixture learning 的 normalizing flow，让活跃分量数由数据决定，并支持分量级重建与局部有效维数估计。
Result: 在合成几何数据、带已知参考轨迹的可控多视角图像设定以及 MNIST 上，报告传输畸变 (transport distortion) 降低、路径支撑 (path support) 有竞争力、参考轨迹贴近恢复、插值真实感提升。
Conclusion: 混合潜变量的 pullback 几何能把可扩展 pullback 推广到不靠近单一流形的数据集，同时保留可处理且可解释的局部结构。

papers.title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 驱动的算法/定理/药物发现中，迭代种群的多样性会在中途骤降（mode collapse），而 SOTA harness 与延缓坍缩的多样性干预收益不稳定。作者提出先做一轮并行探索来初始化后续迭代优化，该初始化干预在多种 harness 与目标应用上带来一致增益。
Motivation: harness 设计对 LLM 迭代发现的成功与否高度敏感且脆弱，多样性坍缩是常见失败模式，而现有以延长坍缩为目标的干预收益不一致，缺少可靠提升发现成功率的通用手段。
Method: 将既有 harness 设计泛化为 12 个 Modular harness 套件，在 5 个不同发现任务上刻画其表现与迭代种群多样性；据此提出通用干预：先并行探索一轮，用所得结果初始化后续迭代优化。
Result: 在 5 个发现任务、12 个 Modular harness 上发现成功对 harness 设计敏感且脆弱，mode collapse（迭代多样性骤降）为常见失败模式；SOTA harness 与多样性干预收益不一致；早期发现的表现可预测最终成功；并行探索初始化在多种 harness 与目标应用上带来一致增益。
Conclusion: LLM 驱动发现的关键不在延长种群多样性，而在初始化：先并行探索再迭代优化，能跨 harness 与应用稳定提升发现成功率。

papers.title: AnchorPrompt: Self-Distilled Soft Prompts for Robust Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are sensitive to input perturbations, such as noise, waveform corruption, and adversarial injections. We propose AnchorPrompt, an efficient adaptation method that keeps the model frozen and learns a single block of prompt vectors inserted at the decoder input, between the audio and question embeddings. We train these vectors through self-distillation over diverse audio and text perturbations. To improve answer consistency and mitigate hallucination, we use the model's prediction on the clean recording as the target for answerable inputs, and assign a refusal target when the audio lacks sufficient evidence to answer. Furthermore, AnchorPrompt is perturbation-agnostic at inference, requiring no prior detection of perturbations and enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen distortions. We evaluate three LALMs across three benchmarks and show that AnchorPrompt improves answer consistency in most tested conditions. Clean accuracy improves in six of nine model-benchmark pairs, with minimal impact on the remainder of 1.2% at most. Crucially, AnchorPrompt reduces hallucinations under severe audio corruption while keeping false refusals on clean audio rare. Finally, these consistency gains transfer to unseen perturbations, such as choice permutations and reverberation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorPrompt 用单块可学习 soft prompt 插在解码器输入端（音频与问题嵌入之间），在模型全冻结下对多种音频与文本扰动做自蒸馏：以干净录音上的预测作为可答问题的目标、以拒答作为证据不足时的目标。在三个 LALM × 三个 benchmark 上多数条件答案一致性提升，干净准确率在 9 对中有 6 对提高、其余最多只降 1.2%，严重音频损坏下幻觉下降且干净音频上的错误拒答保持稀少，并能零样本迁移到未见扰动（选项重排、混响）。
Motivation: 大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 对噪声、波形损坏、对抗注入等输入扰动敏感，答案一致性差且易产生幻觉；全参数微调代价高，且需要事先检测扰动类型。
Method: 保持 LALM 冻结，只在解码器输入处插入一块 prompt 向量（位于音频嵌入与问题嵌入之间），用自蒸馏训练：对多样音频与文本扰动，以模型在干净录音上的预测作为可答输入的目标，音频证据不足时赋予拒答目标；推理时不需检测扰动，支持零样本迁移到未见失真。
Result: 在三个 LALM、三个 benchmark 上评估：多数测试条件下答案一致性提升；干净准确率在 9 个模型- benchmark 组合中的 6 个提高，其余组合最多下降 1.2%；严重音频损坏下幻觉减少，同时干净音频上的错误拒答保持稀少；一致性增益迁移到未见扰动（choice permutations、reverberation）。
Conclusion: 单块自蒸馏 soft prompt 即可在不改动模型权重的前提下同时改善 LALM 的一致性与抗扰动幻觉，且无需扰动检测即可泛化到未见过的失真类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把单智能体 meta-RL 的双层优化扩展到多智能体，提出 meta-MARL 框架在马尔可夫博弈 (Markov games) 分布上快速适应交互策略，并定义 meta-NE 作为期望解概念。证明了基于 gradient-play 的 meta-MARL 算法的平稳点与 meta-NE 等价的充分条件；在自动驾驶任务上，该方法比预训练 MARL 基线适应更快。
Motivation: 现有 meta-RL 基本局限于单智能体，而多智能体任务不仅由环境刻画、还由智能体间策略互动刻画，直接移植会失效。
Method: 将 MARL 建模为马尔可夫博弈 (MG)，用双层优化在 MG 分布上做策略快速适应；定义 meta-NE 解概念，并对 gradient-play-based meta-MARL 算法建立 meta-NE 与平稳点等价的充分条件。
Result: 在自动驾驶任务评估中，所提 meta-MARL 方法比预训练 MARL 基线达到更快适应；摘要给出等价性充分条件这一理论结果，未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 多智能体交互策略的快速适应可以沿 meta-RL 的双层优化路线实现，且 meta-NE 可作为该问题的解概念并由 gradient-play 平稳点刻画。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

papers.title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R-GroundBench 用真实专利 Markush 结构构建 R 基团定位诊断基准，含受控难度与模态划分的多选 VQA 轨道和开放式生成轨道。控制捷径后模型 Easy VQA 超过 90% 准确率，Hard VQA 降至 56–66%，化学领域 VLM 仅 25.7–46.2%；多数模型生成 Exact Match 低于 20%，需视觉输入时低于 8%，说明识别与分子定位之间存在巨大落差。
Motivation: 现有分子-语言基准只测完全确定结构的分子，Markush 结构中 R 基团占位符的跨分子、文本、化学信息定位能力基本未被评测。
Method: 从真实专利 Markush 结构构建 R-GroundBench，设两条轨道：受控难度与模态划分的 Multiple-Choice (VQA) 轨道，以及开放式 Generation 轨道；通过控制捷径 (shortcuts) 区分识别与定位。
Result: Easy VQA 准确率超过 90%；控制捷径后 Hard VQA 降至 56–66%；化学领域 VLM 尽管有领域预训练，Hard VQA 仅 25.7–46.2%；多数模型 Generation Exact Match 低于 20%，需要视觉输入时低于 8%。
Conclusion: 当前 AI 系统在 Markush 编辑上缺乏可靠的定位与执行能力，高 VQA 分数主要来自捷径而非真正的分子定位。

papers.title: Multifidelity Formulations for Triangular Transport
papers.abstract_en: We develop multifidelity methods for constructing triangular transport maps from samples, when high-fidelity data are scarce but lower-fidelity data are more abundant. Using this set of multifidelity data, we approximate a triangular transport map that bijectively maps between a tractable reference density and the high-fidelity target distribution. We introduce two strategies to leverage low-fidelity data: a hierarchical approach that composes maps between adjacent fidelity levels, and a non-hierarchical method that incorporates low-fidelity information through monotonicity-preserving corrections to the map parameterization. Numerical experiments compare these strategies with single-fidelity transport and demonstrate how the proposed multifidelity approaches can improve map estimation from limited high-fidelity data. To illustrate the broader utility of the learned maps, we also deploy them in a downstream amortized simulation-based inference task. This example shows that multifidelity improvements in map estimation can translate to improved conditional sampling and uncertainty quantification when high-fidelity data are scarce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高保真样本稀缺、低保真样本充足的条件下，为三角传输映射 (triangular transport map) 提出两种多保真 (multifidelity) 构造策略：分层复合相邻保真度层级间的映射，以及在映射参数化上施加保单调修正以吸收低保真信息。数值实验显示两种策略都能在有限高保真数据下改进映射估计，并在下游摊销式仿真推断 (amortized simulation-based inference) 中转化为更好的条件采样与不确定性量化。
Motivation: 从样本构造三角传输映射通常需要大量高保真数据，而高保真模拟或观测往往昂贵稀缺；低保真数据虽丰富却与目标分布有偏，直接混用会偏置映射。
Method: 两种利用低保真数据的策略：hierarchical 方法在相邻保真度层级之间复合 (compose) 映射；non-hierarchical 方法在映射参数化上加入保单调性 (monotonicity-preserving) 修正。学到的映射在可处理参考密度与高保真目标分布之间建立双射，并部署到下游 amortized simulation-based inference 任务。
Result: 数值实验将两种多保真策略与 single-fidelity transport 对比，表明多保真方法能在有限高保真数据下改进映射估计；在高保真数据稀缺的下游 SBI 示例中，映射估计的多保真改进转化为更好的条件采样与不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 多保真信息可以通过复合映射或保单调修正进入三角传输映射，并在高保真数据稀缺时把估计改进传递到下游推断的条件采样与 UQ。

papers.title: Progressive-Resolution Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Secure aggregation lets a server recover an aggregate of client updates without observing any individual update, but conventional protocols fix the aggregate precision when clients upload. We introduce and formulate a new progressive-resolution secure-aggregation functionality in which clients upload once and successively finer resolutions of the same aggregate can later be authorized without renewed client participation. To realize this functionality, we propose progressive-resolution secure aggregation (PSA): each clipped, dithered update is represented by compatible nested-lattice digits; separately releasable layers are protected by secure aggregation and an additional aggregate pad that remains unavailable to the server until a non-colluding release controller authorizes that layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出渐进分辨率安全聚合 (PSA)：客户端只上传一次，之后可由非合谋的 release controller 逐层授权同一聚合的更细分辨率，无需客户端再次参与。每个裁剪加噪 (clipped, dithered) 的更新用兼容的嵌套格 (nested-lattice) 数字表示，各可分离层由安全聚合与一个对服务器暂不可用的聚合 pad 保护。
Motivation: 传统安全聚合协议在客户端上传时就固定了聚合精度，服务器无法在不重新征集客户端的情况下获得更细分辨率的聚合结果。
Method: PSA 把裁剪加噪后的客户端更新编码为兼容的嵌套格数字位层；各层分别用安全聚合保护，并附加一个聚合 pad，在非合谋的 release controller 授权该层之前对服务器不可用。
Result: 给出并形式化了渐进分辨率安全聚合这一新功能，并提出 PSA 协议实现它：客户端单次上传，聚合的逐级细化分辨率可在事后授权释放。
Conclusion: 安全聚合的聚合精度可以与客户端上传解耦，通过嵌套格分层与受控 pad 释放实现事后按需细化。

papers.title: How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 压缩语言模型的报告用 KL 衡量与稠密模型的偏移，但部署方真正要知道的是有多少 arg-max 决策被改掉。论文证明总变差 (total variation) 直接给出翻转率 (flip rate)，中位比值 1.05 且无需拟合常数；KL 只能经平方根换算且因子跨模型语料变动四倍，导致 KL 在 11% 的成对比较中把更小的散度判给改动更多的压缩器，总变差仅 1%。
Motivation: 压缩报告里的散度指标与部署方关心的决策改变数不对应：KL 在取根前先对 token 求平均，换算到翻转率时需要一个跨模型语料变化四倍的因子，两个压缩器在不同模型语料上报告时会给出误导性排序。
Method: 在 19 个开放模型的 802 个压缩与扰动副本、五个语料、九类机制上互不相关的扰动族上，比较 KL、总变差、Hellinger 等散度与 arg-max 翻转率的对应关系；另设两项预注册检验（留出代码语料上的八个模型、三个带真实 kernel 的新模型的 38 个 checkpoint），并在 vLLM 投机解码中用 teacher forcing 下的总变差预测贪心 draft 接受率。
Result: 翻转率与总变差之比中位 1.05、无需拟合常数；KL 需先开平方根且换算因子跨模型语料变动四倍。翻转率至少差 10% 的成对比较中，KL 有 11% 的情形把更小散度判给改动更多者，总变差为 1%。留出代码语料上该比值对全部八个模型成立，而关于 KL 的三条预测各在半数及以上模型上失败；三个新模型的 38 个 checkpoint 中 37 个落在原区间内，仅代码上两个模型跌破 1。vLLM 投机解码中，teacher forcing 下的总变差预测贪心 draft 接受率的平均相对误差为 1.1%–2.4%，无需 KL 所需的任务相关校准。
Conclusion: 要报告压缩模型改了多少决策，就报总变差而不是 KL：它与翻转率成固定比例并可直接迁移到投机解码接受率预测，而 KL 的换算依赖模型与语料。

papers.title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedMAD 把骨干网络参数拆成全局共享部分与客户端私有部分，用轻量 modulation 模块和 local batch normalization 承载客户端特有特征，并按各客户端 modulation 更新的一致性动态调制聚合权重，从而在异构遥感数据分布下抑制冲突更新、放大行为一致客户端的贡献。在 BigEarthNet-S2 与 EuroSAT 上，该框架在异构分布设定下相对现有联邦学习算法表现出分类有效性。
Motivation: 遥感图像因地理差异、季节变化与成像/大气条件不同，客户端数据分布高度异构，直接做联邦学习会导致性能显著下降，全局模型难以兼顾各客户端的域特有特征。
Method: 提出个性化联邦学习框架 FedMAD：骨干网络中分离全局共享表示参数与客户端特有适配参数，前者通过轻量 modulation 模块与 local batch normalization 层实现并跨客户端协同优化，后者仅保留在本地；再引入 modulation-aware directional aggregation，按各客户端 modulation 更新的对齐程度动态调整其聚合重要性。
Result: 在 BigEarthNet-S2 与 EuroSAT 两个遥感分类数据集上，FedMAD 在异构遥感数据分布设定下相比 state-of-the-art 联邦学习算法展示了有效性；代码发布于 https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad。
Conclusion: 把域特有参数留在本地、只聚合全局共享参数并按 modulation 更新一致性加权，可以在异构遥感客户端上维持可迁移表示同时保留客户端特有特征。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
papers.abstract_en: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Soundwich 是一个 training-free 框架，把冻结的联合音视频 flow-matching 模型改造成可生成多条同步、可独立编辑音频 stem 的生成器：用共享场景表征传递全局音视频上下文以保持跨 stem 连贯，再把每个音频 stem 与其对应视觉声源做跨模态交互路由。生成的 stem 与视频保持同步，可单独重定时、静音、替换或重混。
Motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型只输出单条混合音轨，无法做源级控制，与实际音视频工作流中语音、音乐、音效、环境声分轨可编辑的做法不符。
Method: 在冻结的联合音视频 flow-matching 模型上做 training-free 改造：为每条音频 stem 加显式时间活动控制，引入共享场景表征在各 stem 间传递全局音视频上下文同时保留源级分离，并将每个 stem 与其对应视觉声源之间的跨模态交互做定向路由以提升音视频一致性。
Result: 实验与人工评测显示该框架在时间控制 (temporal control)、源分离 (source separation) 与自然度 (naturalness) 上均有改善，并在保持连贯音视频生成的同时实现灵活的源级编辑。
Conclusion: 分轨、可控的音频 stem 可以在不重训模型的前提下从冻结的联合音视频生成模型中得到，且同步性与连贯性可同时保持。

papers.title: Leto: Fast In-Place Recovery for LLM Training on Surviving Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Hardware-operable failures (HOFs) interrupt large language model (LLM) training but permit recovery on the same hardware without reset, repair, or replacement. Existing recovery systems nevertheless reload checkpoints, recompute lost progress, and rebuild process state, idling GPUs that could otherwise continue training. We present Leto, a fault-tolerant training system that leverages surviving hardware to enable efficient in-place recovery. Our key insight is that the state needed to resume training can be retained or prepared outside the active training process while remaining on the same hardware. Leto retains the working model state and the reusable process state, and preinitializes the remaining state in a shadow trainer. We devise two-tier erasure protection and chunk-level transactional updates to keep the retained model state recoverable and consistent, and reclaim the shadow state when active training needs its GPU memory. Evaluation on 6- and 72-GPU NVIDIA A100 clusters shows that Leto recovers 3.6--6.5$\times$ faster than the best-performing checkpointing baselines and improves productive training time by up to 13.7 percentage points. Large-scale simulation shows over 95% productive training time on a 131,072-GPU cluster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Leto 针对硬件可操作故障 (HOF) 做原地恢复：把恢复训练所需的模型状态与可复用进程状态保留在同一块存活硬件上，剩余状态在 shadow trainer 中预初始化，从而免去重载 checkpoint、重算进度与重建进程状态。在 6 与 72 卡 NVIDIA A100 集群上比最优 checkpointing 基线快 3.6–6.5×，productive training time 最多提升 13.7 个百分点；131,072 卡大规模模拟中 productive training time 超过 95%。
Motivation: LLM 训练中硬件可操作故障虽可在原硬件上恢复，但现有恢复系统仍要重载 checkpoint、重算丢失进度、重建进程状态，导致 GPU 空转。
Method: Leto 保留工作模型状态与可复用进程状态，并在 shadow trainer 中预初始化其余状态；用 two-tier erasure protection 与 chunk-level transactional updates 保证保留的模型状态可恢复且一致，并在活跃训练需要其 GPU 显存时回收 shadow 状态。
Result: 在 6 卡与 72 卡 NVIDIA A100 集群上，恢复速度比表现最好的 checkpointing 基线快 3.6–6.5×，productive training time 最多提升 13.7 个百分点；大规模模拟显示在 131,072 卡集群上 productive training time 超过 95%。
Conclusion: 把恢复所需状态留在存活硬件上并预先准备好，可以让 HOF 恢复绕过 checkpoint 重载路径，把 GPU 空转变为有效训练时间。

papers.title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemanTok 是面向自回归视频生成的可变长分词器：把冻结的 DINO 特征喂进编码器，并用轻量头从每个保留 token 前缀单独重建这些特征，使粗粒度 token 承载全局语义、细节推迟到后续 token。201M 参数的 SemanTok AR 模型打平或超过其 3.4 倍大小的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型，且短前缀更易预测、生成保真度更高。
Motivation: 现有可变长 coarse-to-fine 分词器只在解码器早期隐状态上施加表征对齐 (REPA) 损失，而解码器可部分从带噪输入本身满足该目标，导致语义对齐不足，影响 AR 与扩散式视频世界模型的保真度与语义质量。
Method: SemanTok 在编码器中注入冻结的 DINO 特征，并添加轻量重建头，要求每个保留的 token 前缀单独重建这些特征；分层 token 序列由粗到细，粗 token 携带片段全局语义，后续 token 补充细节，供自回归模型逐段预测。
Result: 201M 参数的 SemanTok AR 模型匹配或超过 3.4 倍大小的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型；更大的 SemanTok AR 模型进一步提升保真度。语义对齐在 out-of-distribution 类别上保持，并在包括纯噪声在内的每个噪声水平上给解码器更高的语义对齐；重建与生成两方面均表现良好，短 token 前缀预测成本更低且生成保真度更好。
Conclusion: 把语义对齐目标从解码器隐状态移到由冻结 DINO 特征监督的 token 前缀本身，可在更小 AR 模型上同时获得语义对齐与视频保真度，并让像素细节延后到后续 token。

papers.title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LoRA 微调 LLM 的后门净化，提出无需触发器先验、无需干净参考、无需重训的零空间投影法：通过数据筛选与特征近似提取高保真后门方向，在每层/每头的输入与输出通道上构造正交零空间，把 LoRA 更新投影上去。ASR 从接近 100% 降到 10% 以下，同时保住基座模型良性性能与适配器学到的下游能力。
Motivation: 现有后门净化方法至少依赖触发器先验知识、干净参考数据或激进重训中的一项，且评估不全面，实际可用性受限。
Method: 经数据筛选 (data curation) 与特征近似 (feature approximation) 提取高保真后门方向；对每层或每个注意力头，在输入通道与输出通道上分别构造正交零空间 (null space)，将 LoRA 更新投影到该零空间；通过消融研究从文本分类的单层设置逐步扩展到生成任务的全参数 LLM，且不重训可疑参数。
Result: 零空间投影使攻击成功率 (ASR) 从接近 100% 降至 10% 以下，同时保持基座模型的良性性能以及适配器在下游任务适配中学到的能力；评估覆盖文本分类单层设置到生成任务全参数 LLM 的逐级扩展。
Conclusion: 不依赖触发器先验、干净参考或重训，仅把 LoRA 更新投影到构造出的零空间即可大幅压低后门 ASR 并保留通用能力与下游技能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Grand Canonical Generators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Paris
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从任意充分公理化的 OWL 2 本体自动生成本体锚定、经 OWL reasoner 形式验证的多选题 (MCQ) 基准：正确答案由设计保证锚定本体，干扰项通过扰动类定义公理右端类表达式生成，并用蕴含检查验证其错误性。在 Pizza、PMDco、DOID 三个本体上分别生成 112、2,491、15,216 道题，六个 LLM zero-shot 准确率 41.1–76.8%，远高于 25% 随机基线。
Motivation: 科学 AI 中 LLM 的逻辑推理常出事实错误，而人工构造数据集难以扩展，LLM 生成基准又可能把待测缺陷本身嵌入题目，可靠评测因此受限。
Method: 流水线从 OWL 2 本体生成 MCQ：正确答案锚定本体公理，干扰项由扰动类定义公理右端类表达式产生，并由 OWL reasoner 以 entailment 检查形式验证其不正确；干扰项覆盖从类不可满足到弱化 subsumption 的四个语义类别，支持对具体推理失败的诊断评测。
Result: 在 Pizza（小、学术）、PMDco（复杂、材料科学）、DOID（大、生物医学）上分别生成 112、2,491、15,216 道 MCQ；LLM judge 平均分分别为 4.02、4.36、3.36（满分 5），正确答案与干扰项相似度高于 0.8；六个 LLM zero-shot 准确率 41.1–76.8%，随机猜测基线为 25%。
Conclusion: 以本体公理加 reasoner 验证来同时锚定正确与错误选项，可生成既流畅又具区分度的科学推理基准，作者视其为迈向更可靠科学 AI 逻辑推理评测的一步。

papers.title: Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure
papers.abstract_en: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurReps 2026: Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 hZACH-ViT（Euclidean/Poincare/spherical 三种 prototype head 的紧凑 ViT）上，把曲率当内在鲁棒性来源的解读被推翻：c=1 时 Poincare 在全部 12 个 dataset-budget 格上 PGD 攻击成功率最低但 clean MacroF1 也最低；把曲率降到 c=0.1 虽在 15 组配对 seed-dataset 比较中全部提升 clean MacroF1，却让 OrganAMNIST 强攻击成功率从 89.7% 升到 99.3%（+9.57 点，95% 分层 bootstrap CI [+5.52,+14.03]）。
Motivation: 曲率常被当作表示的内在属性，但其经验效果同时取决于坐标尺度、学到的 logit 温度与数值保护；双曲表示的对抗鲁棒性究竟来自几何还是实现细节，此前混淆。
Method: 在 hZACH-ViT 上固定 backbone、seed 初始化、每类 50 张训练子集与优化流程，跨三个 MedMNIST 数据集与五个 seed 做端到端曲率干预（c=1 vs c=0.1），配合 PGD 与更强的 CE+DLR multi-restart 攻击，并检查 hard clipping、radial Jacobian 与无量纲攻击轨迹；spherical head 作为尺度规范 (scale gauge) 对照。
Result: c=1 时 Poincare 在全部 12 个 dataset-budget 格上 class-macro PGD 攻击成功率最低，且在三个数据集上对 CE+DLR multi-restart 攻击同样最低，但 clean MacroF1 也最低；c=0.1 在 15 组配对 seed-dataset 比较中全部提升 clean MacroF1 并消除 hard boundary clipping，却使 OrganAMNIST 强攻击成功率由 89.7% 升至 99.3%（配对差 +9.57 点，95% 分层 bootstrap CI [+5.52,+14.03]）；c=1 时 40%–47% 的 clean Poincare 特征被 hard-clipped，继承映射的 radial Jacobian 近零，无量纲攻击轨迹异常长且低效；spherical head 的曲率变化在浮点精度内是精确 scale gauge，攻击差异小得多。
Conclusion: 这些结果不支持双曲内在鲁棒性：曲率、尺度与距 Poincare 边界的接近程度共同决定 clean 识别与对抗表示运动，且该 regime 对实现敏感。
Relevance: 2
