papers.title: Nonparametric Distribution Matching for Self-Supervised Whole-Slide Image Condensation
papers.abstract_en: Histological whole-slide images (WSIs) are central to computational pathology but pose severe computational challenges due to their extremely high resolution, often spanning several gigabytes per slide. To enable scalable learning, existing methods apply self-supervised data condensation to reduce computational cost, but typically rely on heuristic prototype learning and do not explicitly preserve learning-relevant feature distributions for downstream tasks. In response, we introduce a principled reformulation of WSI condensation as a distribution-matching problem under a fixed representational lens, and develop NICER, a tractable approximation framework based on a nonparametric prior with slide-adaptive capacity. Experiments on five histopathology datasets, together with clinical evaluation from a board-certified pathologist, show that NICER consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 7.44% while offering improved efficiency-accuracy trade-offs, highlighting the benefits of principled, distribution-aware condensation for scalable histological representation learning. Source codes are available in https://github.com/nmduonggg/NICER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全切片图像 (WSI) 自监督数据蒸馏重构为固定表示视角下的分布匹配问题，提出 NICER：基于非参数先验与随切片自适应容量的可解近似框架。在五个组织病理数据集上平均准确率较既有方法提升 7.44%，并经 board-certified 病理学家临床评估，取得更好的效率-准确率权衡。
Motivation: WSI 分辨率极高、单张数 GB，现有自监督数据蒸馏依赖启发式 prototype learning，不显式保留下游任务相关的特征分布，压缩后表示对下游不利。
Method: 将 WSI 蒸馏重构为固定表示透镜下的分布匹配问题，提出 NICER：用非参数先验加 slide-adaptive capacity 做可解近似，在自监督设定下压缩切片数据以降低计算成本。
Result: 在五个组织病理数据集上，NICER 一致优于既有蒸馏方法，平均准确率提升 7.44%，并给出更好的效率-准确率权衡；另含 board-certified 病理学家的临床评估。
Conclusion: 有原则、显式保分布的蒸馏比启发式 prototype learning 更适合可扩展的组织学表示学习，且在准确率与效率之间可同时改善。

papers.title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
papers.abstract_en: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.
papers.comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的 AR 内容质量评估与自动调整框架：先构建 RateAR 基准（跨场景与环境条件的 AR 图像和视频，各感知因子信度 ICC(2,5) ≥ .90），再用上下文提示 (contextual prompting) 让 VLM 预测用户感知的视觉保真度。11 个商用 VLM 的质量预测与人类主观评分 Spearman 相关最高达 0.8695，21 人用户研究中超过 90% 参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
Motivation: AR 头显受场景几何受限、空间抖动与时间不稳影响，而人工用户研究是评估画质的标准手段，成本高、可扩展性差、不灵活，卡住了迭代设计流程。
Method: 先发布 RateAR 基准，覆盖多样场景与环境条件，按物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因子标注并以 ICC(2,5) 检验信度；随后评测 11 个商用 VLM 在该基准上的质量预测，并做提示策略消融，比较上下文提示与其他策略；最后基于最佳预测构建自动 AR 内容调整系统，做 21 人用户研究。
Result: RateAR 各感知因子信度达 ICC(2,5) ≥ .90（good-to-excellent）；11 个商用 VLM 的质量预测与人类主观判断 Spearman 秩相关最高 0.8695；消融显示上下文提示比其他提示策略更对齐人类评分；21 人用户研究中超过 90% 参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
Conclusion: VLM 加上下文提示可以替代部分人工用户研究来预测 AR 场景的感知质量，并驱动自动内容调整，改善放置与尺寸连贯性。

summary_sections.motivation: AR 头显受场景几何受限、空间抖动与时间不稳影响，而人工用户研究是评估画质的标准手段，成本高、可扩展性差、不灵活，卡住了迭代设计流程。
summary_sections.method: 先发布 RateAR 基准，覆盖多样场景与环境条件，按物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因子标注并以 ICC(2,5) 检验信度；随后评测 11 个商用 VLM 在该基准上的质量预测，并做提示策略消融，比较上下文提示与其他策略；最后基于最佳预测构建自动 AR 内容调整系统，做 21 人用户研究。
summary_sections.result: RateAR 各感知因子信度达 ICC(2,5) ≥ .90（good-to-excellent）；11 个商用 VLM 的质量预测与人类主观判断 Spearman 秩相关最高 0.8695；消融显示上下文提示比其他提示策略更对齐人类评分；21 人用户研究中超过 90% 参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM 加上下文提示可以替代部分人工用户研究来预测 AR 场景的感知质量，并驱动自动内容调整，改善放置与尺寸连贯性。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出目标条件双模拟 (goal-conditioned bisimulation) 的无监督技能发现：先学满足函数等变性、又保留环境局部时间结构的动作感知时间表征，再让技能行为只依赖直接影响其执行的状态子集，从而在未见过的布局上保持不变行为。实验显示在某一环境中学到的技能可直接迁移到多种布局的下游任务，表现出强分布外泛化。
Motivation: 现有无监督技能发现要么依赖专家数据，要么泛化受限，学到的技能难以迁移到此前未见过的布局；关键难点是表征既要捕捉环境的时间结构，又要对布局变化鲁棒。
Method: 提出一个学习动作感知时间表征的目标函数，使其满足函数等变性 (functional equivariance) 并保留环境局部时间结构；在此嵌入之上用双模拟 (bisimulation) 做无监督技能发现，把技能条件限制在直接影响其执行的状态子集上，使技能跨布局行为不变。
Result: 在多种环境布局上的综合实证评估中，给定环境中学习到的技能可被直接用于求解不同布局的下游任务，展现出强分布外 (out-of-distribution) 泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把技能条件限制在与执行相关的状态子集上，是让无监督发现的技能跨布局迁移、无需专家数据的关键。

papers.title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LabBook 是一个单智能体 LLM 科学发现框架：由智能体维护一份完整实验日志记忆，同时承担检索相关证据与生成新程序两个职责，把完整历史保留与选择性上下文构造分开，无需显式种群或分支搜索结构。在 49 个 Frontier-CS 问题上，它相对所评估的进化基线改善了观测到的质量-成本权衡，并在另外九个数学、系统与启发式设计任务上保持竞争力。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的进化式发现只从少数被选中的祖先生成新程序，会丢掉其他实验里的有用证据；而把完整实验历史塞进上下文又会带来冗长与冗余。
Method: 构建围绕 LabBook 的单智能体发现框架：LabBook 是由智能体维护的记忆，既指导从完整实验日志中检索相关证据，也参与新解生成；每次迭代中同一智能体把记忆与检索到的证据合并，联合产出下一个程序和更新后的 LabBook，从而不依赖显式种群或分支搜索结构。
Result: 在 49 个 Frontier-CS 问题上，LabBook 相对所评估的进化基线改善了观测到的质量-成本权衡，并在两个 backbone 上重复该结果；在另外九个数学、系统与启发式设计任务上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把完整实验历史的保留与上下文的按需构造分离，用单智能体记忆即可在不维护种群的情况下取得优于进化基线的质量-成本权衡。

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为循环语言模型 (looped language model) 给出可复现的训练配方：从零训练把预算从 Ouro 的 7.7T token 压到 310B token 仍保持强推理表现，1.4B LoopLM 在同数据同 token 预算下于全部 12 个基准上超过参数匹配的 dense 模型（GSM8K +14、MATH +10、DROP +22），并给出把现成 dense 检查点转成循环模型的最小配方。
Motivation: 现有大规模循环模型训练需要跨数万亿 token 的多阶段流程，且循环带来的收益难以与数据和训练差异分离，阻碍了 recurrence 在实际中的采用。
Method: 三部分：一是从零训练管线，用预训练加高质量 mid-training、学习率 warmup 与更强的 exit-gate 正则实现稳定的循环训练，无需既有多阶段调度；二是受控对比下训练 1.4B LoopLM 与同数据同 token 预算的参数匹配 dense 模型；三是把 dense 模型转为循环模型的最小配方，只用一个可学习的 input-mixing 标量和平滑的 exit loss，不含 step 专用参数，应用于 Qwen3-1.7B-Base。
Result: 训练预算从 Ouro 的 7.7T token 降到 310B token；1.4B LoopLM 在全部 12 个评测基准上超过参数匹配 dense 基线，GSM8K +14、MATH +10、DROP +22；在匹配推理算力下以仅 36% 的参数量接近 3.9B dense 模型的数学推理与阅读理解表现；Looped Qwen 在两种数据 regime 的每个基准上都优于同条件继续训练的 dense 基线，在 curated mixture 上 GSM8K、MATH、MMLU-Pro 增益统计显著。
Conclusion: 循环结构本身的收益可以在受控对比下被分离出来，且循环模型从零训练显著更便宜、也能以极小改动接入现有预训练检查点。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2
papers.abstract_en: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations. An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORBIT-FMIB 用 Walsh 交互分解结合子集条件神经依赖估计，诊断 ESM-2 表征层级中一阶、二阶与高阶上位性 (epistasis) 信息的保留程度。初始生产运行给出 Δ(HO-LO)=-0.107，但在相同 GPU 与 critic 种子下独立复现整个测量网格后缩小到 -0.017，且符号在同一批已训练 critic 的不同评估配对选择间于 -0.011 到 +0.015 间摆动；作者据此判定 ESM-2 是否选择性丢失高阶上位性信息仍无稳健证据。
Motivation: 蛋白基础模型的预测性能本身无法说明模型深度中哪些形式的生物交互信息仍可访问，而针对表征的探测结论若缺乏充分功效的复现检查，容易被当作生物发现。
Method: 诊断框架结合 Walsh-based interaction decomposition 与 subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation；先在已知交互结构的合成景观上验证，再对稠密四位点 GB1 fitness landscape 上的冻结 ESM-2 表征施测，并记录一次移除 pooled critic 中位置子集捷径 (positional-subset shortcut) 的协议修正。
Result: 初始生产运行 Δ(HO-LO)=-0.107；在匹配 GPU 硬件与相同 critic 种子下独立复现完整测量网格后降至 -0.017；同一批已训练 critic 上不同评估配对选择给出 -0.011 至 +0.015 的不稳定符号。
Conclusion: 目前既无稳健证据表明 ESM-2 选择性丢失高阶上位性信息，也无证据表明各阶保留相等，方向性问题仍开放；测量协议本身（含移除 pooled critic 位置子集捷径）维持有效，此类表征探测需先做充分功效的复现检查。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.
papers.comment: Manuscript accepted at PRIMA 2026. Includes an additional appendix with proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个信念-道义逻辑 (doxastic deontic logic)：Chellas 极小道义逻辑的可经典归约片段，加入显式条件规范并与多智能体 KD45 组合，使规范可依赖智能体对事实与规范本身的信念。在此之上定义 Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem，即选择加权规范违反最小的决策，并给出主观最优与客观最优重合、以及最优决策可多项式归约到 weighted partial MaxSAT 的条件。
Motivation: 自主系统要在规范冲突且信息不完整、不可靠的条件下做决策，而现有道义逻辑难以让规范依赖智能体对规范自身的信念。
Method: 构造可经典归约的 Chellas Minimal Deontic Logic 片段，扩展显式条件规范并与多智能体 KD45 模态逻辑结合；定义 Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem，区分相对智能体信念的主观优化与相对真实事实的客观优化，并推导两者一致及归约到 weighted partial MaxSAT 的条件（附录含证明）。
Result: 给出两类理论条件：(i) 主观最优与客观最优重合的条件；(ii) 最优决策可归约到 weighted partial MaxSAT 且为多项式时间的条件。
Conclusion: 规范冲突与不可靠信息下的决策可被形式化为一个可归约到 weighted partial MaxSAT 的优化问题，前提是满足所给的一致性与可归约条件。

papers.title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
papers.abstract_en: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisionQ 把 CV 论文里的定性对比图变成可判分的基准：每道题先给出视觉判据，VLM 只有选中作者在该判据下认定的最佳输出才算对，作者称之为 criterion-conditioned visual discrimination。评测 20 个开源与闭源 VLM judge，最强者准确率仅 63.1%（随机 32.2%），且各判据间可靠性差异很大；DPO 微调的 Gemma-4-E4B judge VisionQ-Judge 把末位选项预测降低 7.0pp、留出测试集准确率提高 2.5pp。
Motivation: 现有 VLM-as-a-Judge 基准只打标量质量或整体偏好，judge 可能选对了图却因为错误的视觉理由而得分，无法衡量其判断是否真的对应具体视觉判据。
Method: 从 1,409 篇 CVPR/ICCV 论文中构建 1,800+ 张经校验的对比图与 3,911 条人工标注（method crop 对应作者陈述的视觉主张），配套六轴 51 叶的视觉判据 taxonomy；评测协议隐藏方法名、图注与论文身份并按判据分别报告准确率；VisionQ-Judge 用对称证据对 (symmetric evidence pairs) 做 DPO 微调，底座为 Gemma-4-E4B。
Result: 评测 20 个开源与闭源 VLM judge，最强者准确率 63.1%，随机基线 32.2%，且可靠性随判据剧烈波动；VisionQ-Judge 在留出测试集上把 last-option 预测减少 7.0pp、准确率提升 2.5pp。
Conclusion: VLM judge 的判断必须绑定到具名视觉判据才能被信任：即便最强模型也只比随机高出约 31 个百分点，且不同判据上的可靠性差异很大，按判据分项报告应成为定性对比评测的默认做法。

papers.title: Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 7 个蛋白语言模型 (ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1) 系统评测 4-bit 量化与 QLoRA 微调：多数模型-任务组合保住全量微调 90% 以上的性能，最大模型峰值显存节省接近 90%，且早期层表征基本保留、中后层出现任务特异改造。作者据此把 QLoRA 定为显存受限场景的首选适配策略，全量微调留给困难任务或低验证恢复率的架构。
Motivation: 蛋白语言模型体积大，微调与部署成本高，而量化和参数高效微调 (PEFT) 对性能、表征与生成的影响此前刻画不足，缺少跨模型跨任务的实证依据。
Method: 在 ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1 上评测 4-bit 量化与 QLoRA 低秩适配器微调，对比全量微调的预测任务表现、分层表征变化与显存/速度/功耗；另对 ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3 做无条件生成，比较预测的结构与序列级性质及 token 级自回归输出分布。
Result: 预测任务中许多模型-任务组合保留了全量微调 90% 以上的性能；最大模型峰值 GPU 显存节省接近 90%；QLoRA 常保留早期层表征、在中后层诱导任务特异改造，表征变化幅度小于全量微调；训练速度与功耗效应差异较大。生成端 4-bit 量化大体保留预测的结构与序列级性质，但 token 级分析显示自回归输出分布存在模型依赖的偏移。
Conclusion: QLoRA 与 4-bit 量化能显著降低 PLM 的计算需求（尤其是显存），应作为显存受限适配的首选、把全量微调留给困难任务；生成式 PLM 除下游预测指标外还需补充分布分析，因为序列级与结构指标可能掩盖量化引起的分布偏移，且结论需按模型与任务分别验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出第三类后门防御策略 learn-but-channel：不阻止后门形成，而是用正则引导的 MoE 结构把触发器行为隔离到指定专家，部署时只需把该专家路由权重置零。在两项任务、三种攻击、四个模型家族上，攻击成功率 (ASR) 从 100% 降到 0–10%，下游效用多数保持或仅轻微受损。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门防御要么在训练前/中抑制后门学习，要么在训练后修复权重或在推理时过滤输入，均需数据筛选、权重更新或触发器筛查；缺少让后门形成但可被随时关闭的中间策略。
Method: QES (Quarantined Expert Shutdown)：在 Transformer 语言模型上加入按路由分配的专家级 LoRA 分支与轻量 router，用辅助路由目标把触发条件下的行为吸引到指定隔离专家，同时保持良性能力；部署时仅将该专家路由权重置零，为常数时间操作，无需触发器筛查或再更新权重。
Result: 在两项任务、三种攻击、四个模型家族的多数设置上，ASR 从 100% 降至 0–10%，下游效用通常保持或仅受轻微影响。
Conclusion: learn-but-channel 是生成式 LLM 后门遏制中此前未被探索的可行策略：允许后门形成但将其隔离为可单步关闭的组件。

papers.title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的 RLVR 训练中终端奖励被复用于多个并行去噪决策的问题，提出 StepRS-GRPO：随去噪状态变化调整 group-advantage 变换的风险系数，其余训练器不变。在多个 dLLM 主干与数学推理基准上，它同时提升 pass@1 与 pass@k，并增加答案多样性，且在匹配优势 RMS 后增益仍在。
Motivation: dLLM 并行揭示多个 token，RLVR 的终端反馈要在条件上下文不断变化的多个决策间复用，固定风险系数的 group-advantage 变换无法适配不同去噪状态。
Method: StepRS-GRPO 沿去噪状态调度风险系数，保留原 GRPO 训练器；对二值奖励证明该变换等价于依赖 prompt 与状态的中心化结果优势重缩放；用 capability-based calibration 定系数尺度，并以 endpoint 与 interpolation 消融指导调度方向选择。
Result: 在多个 dLLM 主干与数学推理基准上，pass@1 准确率与 pass@k 覆盖率均优于 centered GRPO，答案多样性提升；mass-matched 对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，匹配优势 RMS 至 centered GRPO 后增益仍保持；reasoning-trace 诊断显示多样性增益超出最终答案字符串。
Conclusion: 按去噪状态分配风险系数的调度能同时改善 dLLM 数学推理的准确率、覆盖与多样性，且收益不来自优势幅度差异。

summary_sections.method: StepRS-GRPO 沿去噪状态调度风险系数，保留原 GRPO 训练器；对二值奖励证明该变换等价于依赖 prompt 与状态的中心化结果优势重缩放；用 capability-based calibration 定系数尺度，并以 endpoint 与 interpolation 消融指导调度方向选择。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 dLLM 主干与数学推理基准上，pass@1 准确率与 pass@k 覆盖率均优于 centered GRPO，答案多样性提升；mass-matched 对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，匹配优势 RMS 至 centered GRPO 后增益仍保持；reasoning-trace 诊断显示多样性增益超出最终答案字符串。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按去噪状态分配风险系数的调度能同时改善 dLLM 数学推理的准确率、覆盖与多样性，且收益不来自优势幅度差异。

papers.title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.
papers.comment: PREPRINT - SUBMITTED TO JOURNAL OF SERVICE RESEARCH (JSR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出生成式 AI 个性化中的「上下文充分性」理论：与客户当前意图相关的上下文质量比数量更重要，并定义 Context-Sufficiency Frontier 来定位最小相关上下文集。在一家大型家居零售商的生成式推荐器全因子实验中，相关上下文提升回答适当性 (appropriateness)，无关上下文则降低适当性并使检索不稳定。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 让服务方在响应生成时随手注入情境信息，但上下文一旦易得，「越多越好」不再成立：无关上下文会稀释相关信号并扰乱检索，个性化需要判断当前交互真正需要什么。
Method: 构建上下文充分性理论，划分四种状态——不足 (insufficiency)、充分 (sufficiency)、饱和 (saturation)、干扰 (interference)，并提出 Context-Sufficiency Frontier 定位最小相关上下文集；在大型家居零售商的生成式推荐器上做全因子实验 (full-factorial experiment)。
Result: 全因子实验显示：相关上下文提高回答适当性，无关上下文降低适当性并使检索 (retrieval) 不稳定；区分了客户证据 (customer evidence) 与服务方侧上下文两类输入。
Conclusion: 个性化应从「提供更多上下文」转向识别当前交互实际所需并全程施加约束，而非一味堆数据。

papers.title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
papers.abstract_en: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向稀疏不平衡 agent leaderboard 的贝叶斯方差分解框架，把「与目标结论相关的信号」和「仍会改变排名的噪声」分开，在 Holistic Agent Leaderboard 与 Harbor Index 的 22 个 benchmark 上给出可靠性上限。固定 model-scaffold 系统排名可靠度 0.935–0.994，而底层模型排名仅 0.148–0.841；当不确定性由 scaffold 覆盖不足主导时，再多同类任务最多只把模型排名可靠度提高 0.097，而合并多样 benchmark 可在同等任务预算下把 0.44 提到 0.75、成本最多降 83%。
Motivation: agent 评测排名同时混入模型、scaffold 与任务选择的影响，可靠性取决于结论是针对部署系统还是底层模型；现有 leaderboard 无法区分哪些结论可靠、加多少任务才有用。
Method: 构建针对稀疏、不平衡 agent leaderboard 的贝叶斯方差分解框架，将信号（与目标结论相关的性能差异）与噪声（会改变排名的无关变异）分离，并区分固定 model-scaffold 系统排名、底层模型排名与 inter-scaffold reliability 三类测量目标；应用于 Holistic Agent Leaderboard 与 Harbor Index 的 22 个 benchmark。
Result: 固定 model-scaffold 系统排名可靠度 0.935–0.994，底层模型排名可靠度 0.148–0.841；scaffold 效应在不同评测间差异显著，inter-scaffold reliability 显示 scaffold 会改变模型排名结论；当不确定性由 scaffold 覆盖有限主导时，无限多同类任务最多提升模型排名可靠度 0.097；同等任务预算下合并多样 benchmark 使跨任务排名可靠度从 0.44 升至 0.75，成本最多降低 83%。
Conclusion: 评测设计应先明确分数或排名要支撑的结论，再诊断限制可靠性的来源并把预算花在真正主导的不确定性上；加任务不能解决 scaffold 覆盖不足带来的排名不可靠，合并多样 benchmark 是更省成本的路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RuleEvolve 用 LLM mutator 对候选 coding rules 做变异、再由 judge 模块按表现筛选并回填规则池，使 AI coding agent 的规则不再手工固定。在两个 coding-agent 框架、四个 backbone LLM、三个 benchmark 上，其生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（如 token 用量）超过人工规则与既有 prompt optimization 基线。
Motivation: AI coding agent 的表现高度依赖底层 coding rules，而现有规则靠人工编写且固定不变，既费力又常非最优。
Method: 维护一个候选 coding rules 池并迭代改进：每轮用 LLM-powered mutator 从现有候选生成变体，再用 judge 模块评估变体并把表现最好的规则更新回池中。
Result: 在两个 coding-agent 框架、四个 backbone LLM、三个 benchmark 上，RuleEvolve 在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（如所用 token 数）方面超过人工工程与既有 prompt optimization 基线。
Conclusion: 编码规则可以像 prompt 一样被自动搜索与淘汰，自进化规则池在多个框架、模型和基准上比手工规则更优。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On Evaluating Quantum Kernel Robustness for Low-Resource Cross-Corpus Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic speech detection is critical for audio security, but performance can degrade when labeled data are scarce and evaluation conditions differ from training. This study examines quantum kernel methods and lightweight neural models for cross-corpus audio deepfake detection under limited training data. We compare a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM), a classical support vector machine (SVM), and a multilayer perceptron (MLP), all trained on frozen wav2vec 2.0 embeddings using a strict budget of 200 training samples. To match the qubit budget of near-term quantum hardware, embeddings are reduced to four dimensions using principal component analysis, and all models use the same reduced features. Experiments on ASVspoof 2019, ASVspoof 5, the ADD 2023 Challenge, and the In-the-Wild dataset show that under severe domain shift from ASVspoof 2019 to ADD 2023, the MLP degrades to near-random performance, with an area under the curve of approximately 50% and an equal error rate of 50.0%. In contrast, the QSVM maintains meaningful discrimination, achieving an area under the curve of 76.0% and an equal error rate of 27.0%. This advantage is not consistent across transfer directions. When trained on ADD 2023, the QSVM falls below chance on two of three transfers, while the MLP performs better. These results suggest that quantum kernel methods can be competitive under severe cross-corpus shifts and strict low-resource constraints, but do not provide a consistent advantage under near-domain transfer. We interpret these findings as an empirical characterization of quantum kernel inductive bias under distribution shift, rather than evidence of quantum advantage, since the four-qubit kernel can be simulated exactly on classical hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 200 训练样本、4 维 PCA 降维（对齐近期量子硬件 qubit 预算）的低资源跨语料音频深伪检测中，QSVM 在 ASVspoof 2019→ADD 2023 的严重域偏移下仍保持判别力（AUC 76.0%、EER 27.0%），而同特征的 MLP 崩到近随机（AUC≈50%、EER 50.0%）。但优势不随迁移方向一致：以 ADD 2023 训练时 QSVM 在三次迁移中的两次跌破随机水平，MLP 反而更好。作者把结论限定为量子核归纳偏置在分布偏移下的经验刻画，而非量子优势，因为四 qubit 核可在经典硬件上精确模拟。
Motivation: 标注数据稀缺且评测语料与训练条件不同时，音频深伪检测性能会大幅退化；需要判断量子核方法在此类低资源跨语料场景下是否真有相对经典模型的稳健性。
Method: 在冻结的 wav2vec 2.0 embedding 上训练三个模型做对比：Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM)、经典 SVM、多层感知机 (MLP)，统一用 200 个训练样本的严格预算，并用 PCA 把 embedding 压到 4 维以匹配近期量子硬件的 qubit 预算，三者共用同一降维特征；评测覆盖 ASVspoof 2019、ASVspoof 5、ADD 2023 Challenge 与 In-the-Wild 四个语料的跨语料迁移。
Result: 在 ASVspoof 2019→ADD 2023 的严重域偏移下，MLP 退化到近随机：AUC 约 50%、EER 50.0%；QSVM 保持有意义的判别力，AUC 76.0%、EER 27.0%。该优势不随方向一致：以 ADD 2023 训练时，QSVM 在三次迁移中的两次低于随机水平，而 MLP 表现更好。
Conclusion: 量子核方法在严重跨语料偏移加严格低资源约束下可以有竞争力，但在近域迁移下不提供一致优势；这些结果应读作量子核归纳偏置在分布偏移下的经验刻画，而非量子优势证据，因为四 qubit 核可被经典精确模拟。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are ubiquitous in engineering workflows amongst industry and academia. Yet, despite their use in app coding, relatively less attention has been paid to their ability to execute on production incident response. This emerging field, termed agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) contains benchmarks limited by (1) unrealistic environments, typically toy repositories (2) non-standard framework implementations and (3) simple static verifiers. We introduce Incident-Arena, a human-built benchmark of 20 carefully selected tasks grounded in real-world deployed open source software. Each task deploys a production application to an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster, injecting a fault from the config layer through underlying images, and a sustained load profile given the task requirements. We also present a novel verification method, going beyond static checks to functional verifiers, holding systems level metrics stable, while ensuring repairs are done safely. Agent trials run an average of 2.81M tokens and 41 turns, going beyond existing benchmarks, demonstrating agentic long horizon reasoning. Across 20 tasks and 3 application substrates, frontier models score below 64.3%, with failures extending from diagnosis/localization errors, through incomplete repairs and unsafe regressions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Incident-Arena 是一个面向生产事故响应的 agentic SRE 基准：20 个任务在临时 Kubernetes 集群部署真实开源生产应用，注入配置层到镜像层的故障并施加持续负载，用功能验证器（functional verifier）在保持系统级指标稳定的前提下判定修复是否安全。前沿模型在 20 个任务、3 种应用基座上得分低于 64.3%，失败涵盖诊断定位错误、修复不完整与不安全回归。
Motivation: 现有 agentic SRE 基准受限于不现实的玩具仓库、非标准框架实现和简单静态验证器，无法衡量 AI 编码代理在真实生产事故响应中的可靠性。
Method: 人工构建 20 个任务，每个任务把生产应用部署到临时 Kubernetes 集群，从配置层到下层镜像注入故障并按任务要求施加持续负载；验证方法超越静态检查，采用 functional verifier，在保持系统级指标稳定的同时确保修复安全。

papers.title: Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky
papers.abstract_en: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明只要某词族的共现统计在群 G 下不变，语言模型学到的词嵌入就由 G 的不可约表示 (irreps) 矩阵元构成；循环群时 irrep 即 Fourier 模式，因而出现圆与 Pringle 流形。在 Z12 月份、T/I 二面体群作用下的大小三和弦、以及天体的球谐嵌入三组设定中复现了对应几何。
Motivation: 已有工作只在交换格点上的平移对称下导出 Fourier 几何，一般对称性如何决定嵌入几何尚无刻画。
Method: 把共现统计的不变性条件推广到任意有限群、紧群与齐性空间，证明不变时嵌入由 G 的不可约表示矩阵元给出；再用三组实验设定验证 irrep 结构。
Result: 三个实验设定：Z12 对应月份恢复已知圆形几何；二面体群作用于大小三和弦，把音乐理论中 T/I 群结构与机器学习中 circle of fifths 的涌现统一为同一推论；用该理论解释并复现 LLM 中天体的球面表示，即球谐嵌入。
Conclusion: 学到的表征几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的直接后果，圆与 Pringle 只是循环群 irrep 的特例。

papers.title: Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory
papers.abstract_en: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对指数稳定系统的向量自回归 (VAR) 模型，在单条轨迹、重尾噪声下给出最小二乘估计的非渐近样本复杂度：有界 p 阶矩 (p>2) 时误差为 Õ(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})，且该框架可统一导出次指数与次高斯噪声的误差界。
Motivation: 单轨迹观测下，重尾噪声会破坏经典最小二乘的渐近误差刻画，需要在不假设高斯性、只假设矩有界的条件下给出随样本数 T、噪声维度 r 与矩阶 p 的显式非渐近界。
Method: 对指数稳定系统的 VAR 模型做最小二乘估计，假设噪声 i.i.d.、噪声协方差有界与持续激励 (persistent excitation)，推导单条轨迹上的非渐近样本复杂度；再用统一的矩生成函数式分析覆盖次指数与次高斯噪声，并特化到带外生输入的自回归 (ARX) 模型。
Result: 有界 p 阶矩 (p>2) 下估计误差为 Õ(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})，T 为样本数、r 为噪声维度，Õ 隐去对数项；同一方法给出次指数与次高斯噪声的误差界；对带外生输入的自回归模型，误差界的维数因子与模型阶数无关。
Conclusion: 重尾下单轨迹最小二乘的误差由矩阶 p 主导收敛速率，且该分析框架可跨噪声分布类复用；对 ARX 模型，维数代价不随模型阶数增长。

papers.title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompMat-Bench 把 94 个已发表计算材料研究的步骤预先复现，用固定规则而非 LLM judge 给 AI agent 打分，从而在评测中避开昂贵模拟。在完整方法指导的单任务条件下，基于三个 LLM 的 agent 通过率为 66.0–90.4%；长工作流与削减指导会拉低表现，但主要压垮较弱 agent，最强 agent 只在长工作流叠加削减指导时才下降，且多数失败源于科学错误而非软件使用错误。
Motivation: 在计算材料研究中评测 AI agent 需要重复昂贵的模拟，跨 agent、跨 trial 重跑使评测在时间与资源上不可行。
Method: 从近期发表的计算材料研究中抽取 94 个任务，每个任务要求 agent 完成通向原研究科学目标的一步；预先复现这些研究步骤的输入与输出作为 ground truth，用固定规则打分、不用 LLM judge。评测支持四种条件：单任务与相关任务组成的工作流，各自再分完整方法指导与削减指导。
Result: 完整指导的单任务下，基于三个 LLM 的 agent 通过率 66.0–90.4%（94 个任务）。更长工作流与削减指导都会降低通过率，但方式因 agent 而异：二者拉低较弱 agent，最强 agent 仅在长工作流叠加削减指导时下降。失败分析显示多数失败归因于科学错误而非软件使用错误。
Conclusion: 预先复现的输入与结果加固定规则打分，可作为比较真实材料研究步骤上 agent 表现并分析失败模式的基础；长工作流与指导削减对不同强度 agent 的限制方式不同。

papers.title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HAWK 针对视觉-语言模型 (LVLM) 的投机解码 (speculative decoding) 提出多模态草稿方案：用表征相似度挑选目标模型中信息量最大的层并学习组合其 hidden states，直接把压缩后的视觉 hidden states 而非原始视觉 token 交给浅层 drafter，并训练 drafter 预测目标模型在自身提议之后的分布变化。在 SmolVLM-256M 的十个多模态基准上，greedy 解码下平均接受长度从 3.32 升到 4.08、加速从 2.19x 升到 2.60x（对比 EAGLE-3），sampling 下从 2.89 升到 3.41、1.92x 升到 2.19x。
Motivation: 投机解码在 LLM 上已能无损加速，但在 LVLM 上效果差：轻量 drafter 用不好丰富多模态信息；且标准蒸馏只沿原始训练轨迹监督 drafter，不建模 drafter 自己提议后目标预测的偏移，导致多步起草后期分歧增大、接受率下降。
Method: HAWK 三部分：用 representation similarity 选择信息量最多的目标层并学习组合其 hidden states；把目标模型压缩后的视觉 hidden states 直接喂给 drafter，替代原始视觉 token；训练 drafter 捕捉目标预测在自身提议之后如何变化，以提升多步起草中与目标的一致性。
Result: 在 SmolVLM-256M 上跨十个多模态基准，greedy 解码下平均接受长度 3.32 → 4.08、加速 2.19x → 2.60x（相对 EAGLE-3）；sampling 下接受长度 2.89 → 3.41、加速 1.92x → 2.19x。
Conclusion: 让浅层 drafter 直接消费目标模型的压缩视觉表征并学习目标在自身提议后的响应，可以在 LVLM 上把投机解码的接受长度与加速都抬过 EAGLE-3。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
papers.abstract_en: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 mode connectivity 与低损失区域几何分析 grokking，提出其成因是训练集与验证集诱导的低损失区域错位；在对称保持的 train/validation 划分下，标准模运算任务不必然出现 grokking，而呈现验证集性能不再恢复的稳定 anti-grokking，且一旦两区域对齐，仅调训练超参无法再产生 grokking。
Motivation: grokking 自在小型算法任务上被观察到后机制仍无定论，且现有解释多为相关性；需要一个能给出反例并判定何时会出现/不出现 grokking 的分析框架。
Method: 构建基于 mode connectivity 和低损失区域几何的分析框架，用训练/验证划分诱导的低损失区域是否错位来判定 grokking，并在标准模运算 (modular arithmetic) 设计上考察对称保持划分这一条件。
Result: 框架预测标准模运算设定并不总是产生 grokking：在对称保持的 train/validation 划分下观察到稳定的 anti-grokking，验证集性能不恢复；当低损失区域良好对齐时，训练超参 alone 无法产生 grokking，动力学退化为可训练或不可训练两种行为。
Conclusion: grokking 的产生条件是训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域错位，区域对齐后超参不再起作用；该反例对若干现有相关性解释构成挑战。

papers.title: Beyond Supra-Competitive Outcomes: Collusive Behaviour in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Execution Games
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we extend earlier findings of supra-competitive outcomes in optimal-execution games by identifying a learned punitive mechanism that deters deviations and provides behavioural evidence of collusion. We investigate this mechanism in a two-player, finite-horizon Almgren-Chriss liquidation game. Independent proximal policy optimisation agents with access to within-episode price and action histories achieve costs below the Nash benchmark. We identify a profitable deviation by training against the mean learned liquidation schedule, then impose its first trade on one of the original agents. The opponent responds by accelerating liquidation. This response more than offsets the deviator's gain in every run and both player roles, while leaving the punisher's average payoff materially unchanged relative to not punishing under the same deviation. The punisher imposes greater losses on the deviator while preserving its own average payoff, despite the availability of more profitable, less punitive liquidation plans. Matching deviations and subsequent additional selling rise and later decline during training, while final policies retain an effective punitive response. We formalise two checks: whether punishment outweighs the gain from deviating, and whether the change in trading behaviour is large enough to account for the loss imposed. Both checks hold for the tested deviation. Together, these findings provide behavioural and economic evidence supporting a collusive interpretation of the learned supra-competitive outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两玩家有限期 Almgren-Chriss 最优执行博弈中，独立 PPO 智能体借助回合内价格与动作历史学到低于 Nash 基准的成本，并内生出惩罚机制：对偏离者施加首次偏离交易后，对手以加速清算回应，该回应在所有 run 与两种角色下都超过偏离者收益，而惩罚者自身平均收益基本不变。两项形式化检验（惩罚是否超过偏离收益、行为变化是否足以解释所施加的损失）对该测试偏离均成立，构成合谋解释的行为与经济证据。
Motivation: 此前最优执行博弈中观察到的 supra-competitive（超竞争）结果缺少机制解释；需要判定低成本是否来自可识别的惩罚性行为，从而支持合谋解读。
Method: 设定两玩家有限期 Almgren-Chriss 清算博弈，训练可访问回合内价格与动作历史的独立 PPO 智能体；先针对平均学习到的清算计划训练一个有利可图的偏离策略，再把其首次交易强加给原智能体之一，观察对手响应；并形式化两项检验：惩罚是否超过偏离收益、交易行为变化是否足以解释所施损失。
Result: PPO 智能体成本低于 Nash 基准；对手以加速清算回应偏离，该回应在每个 run、两种玩家角色下都超过偏离者收益，同时惩罚者在相同偏离下的平均收益相对不惩罚基本不变；训练中匹配偏离及随后的额外卖出先升后降，最终策略保留有效惩罚响应；两项形式化检验对所测试偏离均成立。
Conclusion: 学到的 supra-competitive 低成本由内生惩罚机制支撑：惩罚者能对偏离者施加更大损失而保住自身平均收益，即便存在更有利可图、惩罚性更弱的清算计划，因此这些结果支持合谋 (collusion) 解释。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions
papers.abstract_en: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay. While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions. Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 深线性残差网络学恒等函数时，零权重解只是总体损失极小值流形上的一点，SGD 会可复现地偏好其中特定分解：各向异性标签噪声下学到的层呈现噪声依赖的谱，即使加 weight decay 也不回到零权重；仅把每个权重矩阵改写成两个矩阵的乘积，权重就会坍缩到零。用 entropic loss（总体损失加上与 minibatch 梯度期望平方范数成正比的项）可在恒等流形上解析刻画极小值，训练结果与之吻合。
Motivation: 总体损失在同一输入输出函数的多种层间分解上完全相同，无法解释 SGD 为何稳定选中某一个；需要一个能在等价解之间做出区分的判据。
Method: 把总体损失加上 minibatch 梯度期望平方范数的 entropic loss（Ziyin et al., 2025）作为分析工具，在恒等函数的解流形上解析求其极小值，并据此推导 SGD 所偏好解的结构预测；实验对象是深线性残差网络学恒等函数，扰动包括各向异性标签噪声、weight decay 与把权重矩阵分解为两矩阵乘积的重参数化。
Result: 各向异性标签噪声下学到的层具有噪声依赖的谱，且加 weight decay 时 SGD 一般也不恢复零权重解；仅改变参数化（权重矩阵写成两矩阵乘积）而不改变可实现函数集，即使不加显式 weight decay 权重也会坍缩到零。entropic loss 在恒等流形上总体损失为常数、熵项区分不同分解，其极小值的解析预测与 SGD 训练结果紧密吻合。
Conclusion: SGD 在同一函数的多个分解之间并非任意选择，而是被 entropic loss 项所刻画的偏好决定；重参数化通过改变该偏好直接改变训练结局。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Spatial Strategies, Not Actions: Vector-Quantized Geodesics as Tools for LLM-Driven Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) based agents are often criticized for lacking spatial understanding and mainly exploiting statistical text patterns. We investigate their spatial comprehension through an architecture combining geometrical tools with a LLM serving as a high-level orchestrator in grid-world environments. The agent first collects geodesic trajectories, which are then vector-quantized to extract a representative subset. Offline, the LLM associates a natural language description of the underlying behavioral patterns to each selected trajectory, making it a tool. Online, the LLM chooses the appropriate tool conditioned on the current state and goal. Low-level control is handled by primitive actions that execute the trajectory associated with the tool. From an agentic AI perspective, this approach separates learning into two levels: tool discovery is handled through unsupervised quantization of trajectories, while reasoning and decision-making are handled by the LLM. We test the approach in a partially observable dynamic 2D grid environment with an open vision-language model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Pairing the geometry-derived tool library with an agent-centered zoom tool and a collision detection tool lets a fast, non-reasoning configuration match the goal-reaching rate of a much more costly chain-of-thought version, while cutting the cost of a decision from minutes to seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分可观测动态 2D grid-world 中，把几何工具与 LLM 编排器结合：先收集测地线轨迹并做 vector-quantization 提取代表性子集，离线为每条轨迹配自然语言描述使其成为工具，在线由 LLM 按状态与目标选工具、底层用原始动作执行轨迹。配合 agent-centered zoom 与 collision detection 工具，快速非推理配置的目标达成率追平昂贵的 chain-of-thought 版本，单次决策成本从分钟级降到秒级。
Motivation: LLM 智能体常被批评缺乏空间理解、只依赖统计文本模式，需要在受控环境中检验其空间推理并降低决策开销。
Method: 架构分两层：无监督 vector-quantization 从测地轨迹 (geodesic trajectories) 中挑代表性子集做工具发现，离线由 LLM 为每条轨迹写自然语言行为描述；在线 LLM 依据当前状态与目标选工具，底层原始动作执行对应轨迹。测试环境为部分可观测动态 2D grid，使用开放视觉-语言模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，并搭配 agent-centered zoom 与 collision detection 两个工具。
Result: 几何工具库加 zoom 与碰撞检测后，快速非推理配置的目标达成率 (goal-reaching rate) 与成本高得多的 chain-of-thought 版本相当，单次决策耗时从分钟级压缩到秒级。
Conclusion: 把空间能力下沉到几何工具库、把推理留给 LLM 的两层分工，可以在 grid-world 中以远低的决策成本换取与 CoT 相当的目标达成表现。

papers.title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
papers.abstract_en: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 IEEE BigData 2026 Cup 可解释自杀风险评估竞赛，用 Qwen2.5-Instruct 的 QLoRA 微调配合 answer-masked 因果语言模型目标，同时处理风险分级、证据短语抽取与多标签风险/保护因素识别三项任务。官方榜单综合分 0.7738（Task 1 为 0.8089，Task 2 为 0.6919），且三项任务各自最优的训练与聚合方式不同：Task 1a 用三任务联合训练、Task 1b 用 1a+1b 联合、Task 2 用单独训练，概率平均在组件模型错误互补时进一步提升 Task 1a。
Motivation: 可解释自杀风险评估不仅要给出风险等级，还要指出支撑证据短语与帖文中风险/保护因素，单一输出结构的模型无法同时满足这三类异构输出。
Method: 对 Qwen2.5-Instruct 做 QLoRA 微调，训练目标为 answer-masked causal language-model objective；风险分级在 32B 与 72B 模型上联合三任务训练并平均风险等级概率，证据抽取联合 Task 1a/1b 并用 cross-fold consensus 合并短语，因素识别单独适配 Task 2 并按 out-of-fold 工作点做 rate matching 校准。
Result: 官方榜单综合分 0.7738，Task 1 得 0.8089，Task 2 得 0.6919；各配置对比中三任务训练在 Task 1a 最优，1a+1b 联合训练在 Task 1b 最优，任务专属训练在 Task 2 最优；当组件模型错误互补时概率平均进一步提升 Task 1a。
Conclusion: 在同一语言模型框架内，训练目标与聚合策略应按每个任务的输出结构分别定制，而不是对三项任务统一处理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Legal Research Bench (LRB) 用 413 道专家撰写的美国法律研究开放题、金标准答案与二元评分 rubric，配合全通过 (all-pass) 评分加来源核验，衡量长程法律研究 agent 的端到端可靠性。十三个前沿模型中最强的 Claude Opus 4.8 仅 42.9% 完全正确，且更多对话轮次、工具调用与推理成本都不预测更高准确率。
Motivation: 法律研究 agent 只要漏掉一项权威依据、引用失效判例或结论错误，答案就不可用；现有评测缺少按专家标准逐条核验来源的端到端可靠性度量。
Method: 构建 LRB：413 道专家撰写的美国法律研究题，每题配金标准答案、支撑权威与二元评分 rubric；在含 web search、case-law search、页面解析与检索工具的 harness 中评测十三个前沿模型，用 all-pass 评分加来源核验判定正确性，并将 LLM judge 与专家律师的判断做对齐验证。
Result: 最强模型 Claude Opus 4.8 在 42.9% 的问题上完全正确；各法律领域 all-pass 率差异明显，需要调和冲突权威 (reconciliation of conflicting authorities) 的题目正确率更低；跨模型看，更多轮次、更多工具调用与更高推理成本都不预测更高准确率。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在长程法律研究上仍远不可靠，且可靠性不由算力与工具调用规模换来；评测须以逐条来源核验的全通过标准对齐律师判断。

papers.title: End-to-End Historical Music Restoration in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Historical music restoration (HMR) has almost exclusively focused on constrained problems such as Super-Resolution or the restoration of solo pieces, under-exploring the general task of restoring orchestral historical music, which has multiple instruments. This under-exploration is largely because the HMR domain, early-20th-century recordings, has no pre-degradation ground-truth pairs, making the restoration task unsupervised and more challenging. This paper presents a supervised end-to-end orchestral HMR benchmark by exploring both the synthetic degradation functions and the end-to-end generative deep-learning restoration methods. We simulate the historical recording degradation chain more faithfully than prior work, which makes orchestral restoration into a tractable supervised problem. A latent flow-matching model trained on the resulting synthetic pairs outperforms existing HMR baselines on intrusive, non-intrusive, and subjective evaluations. We also curate and release a 9.3-hour license-free, unpaired, historical classical-music test set, along with code and audio demos.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and audio demos available at the project repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把历史录音退化链更忠实地模拟成合成退化对，使管弦乐历史音乐修复 (HMR) 从无监督变成可监督的端到端问题；latent flow-matching 模型在侵入式、非侵入式与主观评测上均超过现有 HMR 基线，并发布 9.3 小时无许可、非配对的历史古典音乐测试集。
Motivation: HMR 几乎只做超分或独奏修复，管弦乐多乐器场景未被探索；早期 20 世纪录音没有退化前的 ground-truth 对，任务只能无监督进行。
Method: 构建监督式端到端管弦乐 HMR benchmark：更忠实地模拟历史录音退化链生成合成退化对，再在其上训练 latent flow-matching 生成式修复模型。
Result: 在侵入式、非侵入式与主观评测三类指标上均超过现有 HMR 基线；发布 9.3 小时无许可、非配对的历史古典音乐测试集，附代码与音频 demo（5 页、2 图、3 表）。
Conclusion: 忠实的合成退化链能把管弦乐历史修复变成可监督的 tractable 问题，latent flow-matching 端到端修复在多类评测上取得优势。

papers.title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多语言 QA 基准 Waldo，用 Wikipedia 构造 12K 组知识缺口与知识冲突问答对，检验 LLM 在跨语言知识不一致时的查询语言偏好 (query-language preference)。当某语言版本只是缺失事实时，模型会跨语言取用证据；当各版本说法冲突时，回答强烈倒向查询语言对应的文档，使语义相同的查询因用户语言不同而得到不同说法；消融相关 attention head 与 LoRA 训练可把偏好差距最多缩小 61.5%。
Motivation: 既往研究的查询语言偏好结论建立在各语言知识等价的前提下；一旦不同语言来源对同一事实记载不完整或相互冲突，用户拿到什么就取决于模型选了哪语种的来源，而这一情形此前缺少刻画工具。
Method: 从 Wikipedia 构建多语言 QA 基准 Waldo，含 12K QA 对，分知识缺口（某事实仅存在于一种语言）与知识冲突（各语言版本说法不一）两类；在五种语言上评测八个模型，并测试两种缓解手段：消融与查询语言偏好相关的 attention head 的机制干预，以及 LoRA 训练。
Result: Waldo 含 12K QA 对，覆盖知识缺口与知识冲突两类；八个模型、五种语言的评测显示，仅缺失事实时模型一般跨语言取用证据、不受查询语言左右，存在冲突时回答强烈对齐查询语言文档；LoRA 训练使偏好差距最多降低 61.5%。
Conclusion: 查询语言偏好主要由跨语言知识冲突触发而非知识缺失触发，机制干预与 LoRA 训练都能削弱这一偏好，其中 LoRA 可把差距压到原来的约四成以下。

papers.title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIKASA-Robo-VLA 是一个含 90 项语言条件操作任务的记忆基准，其中 80 项隐藏动作所依赖的线索、10 项作为反应式对照保留线索可见；28 项任务的信息间隙超过所调查最宽固定上下文 VLA 的 16 帧窗口。发布 22,500 条 oracle 轨迹（10 种记忆类型，RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3 格式），π0.5 基线在 14 项任务微调后平均成功率仅 0.211 ± 0.044，说明无历史观测与显式记忆模块的 VLA 难以利用消失的信息。
Motivation: VLA 策略通常只看最近一帧或几帧，任务中已消失的信息如何被使用无从评估；现有基准缺少按信息间隙显式构造的记忆依赖任务。
Method: 重建 MIKASA-Robo（32 项任务）为 90 项全语言条件任务：记忆依赖任务隐藏任务相关线索，反应式对照保持线索可见；70 项由环境阶段时序定义信息间隙，其中 28 项间隙超过 16 帧窗口。发布 22,500 条 oracle 轨迹覆盖 10 种记忆类型，格式为 RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3。
Result: π0.5 参考基线（输入当前图像与本体感知，无观测历史与显式记忆模块）在 14 项任务上微调，平均任务成功率 0.211 ± 0.044；其在所评估 Long-split 任务上的更低成功率受开环分块 (open-loop chunking) 与该子集所含记忆类型混杂。
Conclusion: 按信息间隙构造的记忆依赖任务加反应式对照，可把 VLA 的记忆使用与开环分块等因素分离开来度量；当前无记忆模块的 VLA 平均成功率仅约两成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

papers.title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JAx 把扩散训练的辅助对齐从表征空间搬到预测空间：对齐不同噪声水平下的干净图像预测，用保持 JiT 输入分布的 Markov degradation 耦合含噪学生与更干净观测。理论上 oracle 预测对齐在保持总体 JiT 目标（差一常数）的同时给出更低方差的训练目标；在 ImageNet 256x256 上对 JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16 一致改善 FID 并加速收敛，且不引入外部 encoder。
Motivation: 表征对齐能加速扩散训练，但这一收益不能可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测：在 JiT 中辅助特征对齐在增强语义特征访问的同时削弱了预测图像变化所需的信息，辅助目标与去噪任务错配。
Method: JAx 通过 Markov degradation 把含噪学生观测与更干净观测耦合，保持原 JiT 输入分布；oracle 预测与最优 JiT 目标条件均值相同、条件目标协方差不大。实际实现中用真值监督加 reliability-gated coupling band，按预测风险挑选邻近的 EMA teacher 状态。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，JAx 在 JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16 三个规模上一致改善 FID 并加速收敛，不依赖外部 encoder、不改架构与采样流程；梯度诊断显示 minibatch 梯度方差下降，消融表明收益不能仅由 time reweighting 解释。
Conclusion: 对预测本身而非表征做辅助监督，是像素空间生成模型中替代表征对齐的简单且有原理支撑的路径。

papers.title: Mean Spatial Frequency Decoupling for Learning-Based Uplink-to-Downlink Covariance Conversion in FDD Massive MIMO
papers.abstract_en: In frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, the uplink (UL)-to-downlink (DL) channel covariance matrix (CCM) conversion problem is studied to relieve the heavy burden of DL training and feedback required for channel estimation. Learning- based methods perform well up to a certain array size, but for a fixed dataset size their accuracy deteriorates with the number of antennas, to the point where simple model-based methods outperform them. This paper identifies a key cause of this behavior and addresses it. The mean angle of arrival (AoA) induces a phase ramp along the lags of the CCM. Since the oscillation rate of this ramp grows with the number of antennas, a dataset of fixed size becomes increasingly sparse relative to the variation that must be captured. We propose estimating the slope of this ramp from the UL CCM separately and mapping it to the DL band in closed form, leaving the learner with a residual that is largely insensitive to the mean AoA, which substantially reduces the performance degradation with an increasing number of antennas. The proposed scheme, termed deramping, is a combination of pre- and post-processing steps that applies to learning-based conversion methods without altering their internal structure, as demonstrated on three structurally different learners. Simulation results show that deramping reduces the covariance estimation error of all three learners under uniform, Laplacian, and Gaussian angular power spectra,keeps the interpolation-based learners ahead of a model-based benchmark at large array sizes, and improves downlink channel estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FDD massive MIMO 的 UL→DL 信道协方差矩阵 (CCM) 转换中，学习方法精度随天线数增加而退化到被模型基线反超，根因是平均到达角 (mean AoA) 在 CCM 各 lag 上诱导的相位斜坡振荡率随天线数增长，使固定规模数据集相对所需刻画的变化越来越稀疏。deramping 先从 UL CCM 单独估计该斜坡并以闭式映射到 DL 频段，再把对 mean AoA 基本不敏感的残差交给学习器，在均匀、Laplacian、高斯角度功率谱下均降低三个学习器的协方差估计误差。
Motivation: 固定数据集规模下，学习式 CCM 转换的精度随天线数增大而恶化，甚至被简单模型基线反超；需要定位这一退化的成因并加以修复，以减轻 DL 训练与反馈负担。
Method: 提出 deramping：从 UL CCM 单独估计 mean AoA 引起的相位斜坡斜率，用闭式公式映射到 DL 频段并去除，作为预处理与后处理步骤叠加在学习式转换方法之上，不改动其内部结构；在三个结构不同的学习器上验证其通用性。
Result: 仿真显示 deramping 在均匀、Laplacian、高斯三种角度功率谱下均降低全部三个学习器的协方差估计误差，并让基于插值的学习器在大阵列尺寸下保持领先于模型基线基准，同时改善下行信道估计。
Conclusion: 把 mean AoA 诱导的相位斜坡从学习问题中剥离、只让学习器拟合对其不敏感的残差，可以缓解学习式 CCM 转换随天线数增加的性能退化，且对任意学习式转换方法可即插即用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALER 把部分可观测 RL 中的记忆需求形式化为 rewriting（新观测直接覆盖旧内容）与 experience fusion（按新观测给定的规则变换旧内容），用 LSTM 加 slot memory 实现：独立寻址的 Gumbel-Softmax 写入把权重集中到单个 slot 以完成覆盖，学习到的 gate 在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。配套提出 Rune-Mazes 三套环境，在七个基线上，ALER 在全部 16 个 Endless T-Maze 配置成功率至少 0.82、全部 5 个 Rune T-Maze 组合至少 0.99。
Motivation: 现有记忆架构与 RL 基准主要测 retention（信息保持不变直到被用到），但部分可观测环境中后续观测会让已存信息过期或改变其对下一步决策的含义，rewriting 与 experience fusion 这两类需求未被形式化和度量。
Method: ALER 由 LSTM 与 slot memory 组成：独立寻址的 Gumbel-Softmax 写入将权重集中于一个 slot 从而覆盖它，学习到的 gate 把检索内容与循环状态融合后再送入 policy 和 value head。同时提出 Rune-Mazes 三套环境，rune 观测对隐藏线索的更新做 invert、cancel、reset 或 repeat，含 vector 与 pixel 两种观测；并按所需记忆状态数对任务组合做计数。
Result: 对七个基线，ALER 在全部 16 个 Endless T-Maze 配置上成功率至少 0.82，在全部 5 个 Rune T-Maze 组合上至少 0.99；在带 Invert rune 的四分支 Rune Multi-Corridor 上平均成功率最高；在 pixel 版 Rune MiniGrid Memory 的 10 个配置中 8 个平均成功率高于 PPO-LSTM。计数分析显示若干基线在需要更多记忆状态的组合上成功率最低。
Conclusion: 把覆盖与规则化融合显式做进记忆写入和读出，能在需要多状态记忆的部分可观测任务上稳定取胜，而只测 retention 的基准不足以暴露基线在状态数更多组合上的失败。
