papers.title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs
papers.abstract_en: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单隐层 MLP 上用可控交互阶数与干扰输入 (nuisance inputs) 的合成任务，展示拟合训练样本与恢复生成规则的分离：order-3 时 SGD/Adam/Muon 峰值测试准确率分别为 96.25%/50.87%/76.82%，冻结连到独立干扰输入的首层权重把 AdamW epoch-10 准确率从 44.73% 提到 95.07%，而仅在测试时移除这些输入只到 48.38%。
Motivation: 网络能拟合训练样本却学不到生成标签的规则；需要在可控交互阶数与干扰输入的合成任务上，弄清优化算法与干扰权重学习如何限制浅层网络实现的高阶规则。
Method: 用单隐层 ReLU MLP 与合成 parity 任务，可控交互阶数 (order 2–11) 及独立干扰输入；对比 SGD、Adam、AdamW、Muon，配合首层权重冻结干预与 bias 干预，并给出纯 parity 的精确 Bayes 后验与宽度-k 表示等基准性质。
Result: order-2 三种优化器均 100% 峰值测试准确率；order-3 为 SGD 96.25%、Adam 50.87%、Muon 76.82%；order-4 Muon 达 99.21%。混合阶任务中冻结干扰输入首层权重使 AdamW epoch-10 准确率 44.73%→95.07%，仅测试时移除为 48.38%。紧凑 signal-only 设定下 SGD 与 Muon 均学到 order 5–8，order 9–11 上 SGD 峰值准确率更高。
Conclusion: 优化算法与对干扰输入的学习共同约束浅层网络最终实现的高阶规则，干扰权重的学习对训练结果的影响超出其对预测的直接作用；目标对称性与浅层 ReLU 表示存在联系。

papers.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost. These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮 agent 攻击把各自允许的动作组合成有害结果，其信号表现为内部表征跨上下文更新的累积跃迁；DART 对对比安全方向做去噪（把良性流量锚在 0 并剔除其主变化方向），运行时检测、归因并插入定向提醒。在六个模型与两个多轮基准上，MT-AgentRisk 攻击成功率 84%→25%（平均误报率 12%），ASEval 97%→52%，良性不拒答代价分别为 8% 与 0%。
Motivation: 多轮攻击由单步看均合规的动作累积而成，按孤立动作或状态判定的防御抓不住；而直接聚合表征跃迁会被良性漂移污染，因为对比安全方向对良性转移并不输出 0。
Method: DART 运行时框架：从跨上下文更新的表征跃迁中提取对比安全方向，做去噪——把良性流量锚定在 0 并移除其主要变化方向——再检测、归因并施加定向提醒；无需辅助模型，每步仅增加 0.14–0.56 秒开销，同一监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入。
Result: 六个模型、两个多轮基准：MT-AgentRisk 攻击成功率 84%→25%，捕获全部攻击、平均误报率 12%；ASEval 97%→52%，良性不拒答代价 8% 与 0%。同协议下 MT-AgentRisk 上全面优于 SOTA 多轮防御 ToolShield（其仅达 55%）。去噪是关键：ASEval 上未去监控器仅捕获 7%–40% 攻击，去噪后 60%–85%。
Conclusion: 多轮 agent 的累积表征跃迁是可检测、可归因的攻击签名，去噪后的对比安全方向能在几乎不牺牲良性行为的前提下做轻量运行时拦截，作为计算密集型推测式防御的补充。

papers.title: Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory
papers.abstract_en: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MERITED 框架，用 Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) 的经验决策模型，根据 Energy Based Model (EBM) 的不确定性动态分配推理计算量，实现元认知式的推理努力控制。贡献为训练并开放权重的 191M 参数推理 EBM，以及基于 IBL 模型的动态计算分配实现。
Motivation: 依赖 LLM 的 AI 系统必须先作答才能估计输出不确定性，无法在生成前按置信度分配时间与算力，使这类元认知资源分配过程难以实现。
Method: 以 IBLT 建模类人经验决策，结合 EBM 的可解释不确定性与动态算力分配能力，构建 MERITED 框架；训练一个 191M 参数的推理 EBM 并开放权重，再用 IBL 模型按不确定性控制 EBM 中投入的计算努力。
Result: 产出两项：一个 191M 参数的推理 EBM（训练并开放权重），以及 MERITED 框架的动态计算分配实现，可在保持计算效率的同时按不确定性调节推理努力。
Conclusion: EBM 的不确定性估计加 IBLT 的经验决策，可以把算力分配做成受控的元认知过程，而不必先完整作答再评估置信度。

papers.title: WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography
papers.abstract_en: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Structured Data for Health, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/felix-oury/WIPSNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WIPSNet 用 3D ResNet 直接吃整夜阻抗呼吸图 (IP) 信号的连续小波变换 scalogram 堆叠图，做儿童夜间喘息 (wheeze) 的夜级分类，AUC 达 0.783±0.026，超过把每晚压成单标量的临床读出 EVI（AUC 0.633）以及 Mamba 状态空间模型和两种睡眠分期架构。性能在时间上下文对应 32 分钟体元深度时达到峰值，说明多尺度时间聚合对建模夜间呼吸动态关键。
Motivation: 整夜 IP 监测的临床读出 EVI 把每晚压缩成一个标量，夜级喘息分类 AUC 仅 0.633，丢失了长程、不规则生理时间序列中的时间结构。
Method: 对整夜 IP 信号做连续小波变换得到 scalogram，堆叠后送入 3D ResNet 做夜级分类；扫描体元深度以改变时间上下文长度，对照基线包括 EVI、Mamba 状态空间模型与两种现代睡眠分期架构。
Result: 在 15 名患者、60 夜、281 小时的队列上，WIPSNet AUC 为 0.783±0.026，高于 EVI 的 0.633，也优于 Mamba 与两种睡眠分期架构；性能在时间上下文为 32 分钟的体元深度处达到峰值。
Conclusion: 结构化时频表示加 3D 卷积是从长而不规则的生理时间序列学习的有效路径，且建模夜间呼吸动态需要约 32 分钟尺度的多尺度时间聚合。

papers.title: NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEUROTOKEN 用共享 EEG 前端的三头网络做鸡尾酒会问题的联合源与方向听觉注意力解码 (AAD)，核心是条件流匹配头 ATTUNEFLOW，以积分速度-残差似然比给候选语音流打分。在 KU Leuven、DTU、NJU 的 5 秒窗口上，ATTUNEFLOW 比最强非生成基线把逐段 source-AAD 提升 9%–16%，被试间方差缩小约 3 倍；trial 级融合在三个数据集中的两个上超过 93%。
Motivation: 现有 AAD 文献割裂：方向 AAD 只分类左右不映射到语音流，回归式 source-AAD 依赖 1–5 秒窗口上本就嘈杂的单一 Pearson 相关，包络重建又没有原生 AAD 判据；真实设备需要的短窗口下这些统计量都不稳。
Method: 单网络三头共享一个 EEG 前端：ATTUNEFLOW 用 conditional flow matching 对给定 EEG 的注意包络建条件似然，以 integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio 给候选流打分；推理时用两个集成 QUADTRACK（四个互补统计量）与 ENV-FLOW（z 归一化的 QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW）吸收单统计量的失效模式。
Result: 在 KU Leuven、DTU、NJU 三个数据集的 5 秒窗口上，ATTUNEFLOW 使逐段 source-AAD 相对最强非生成基线提升 9%–16%，被试间方差缩小约 3 倍；trial 级融合在三个数据集中的两个上超过 93%。并行复现显示，方向 AAD 常被引用的 95%–97% 数字在严格 trial-disjoint 协议下塌落 17%–45%。
Conclusion: AAD 的正确对象是给定 EEG 的注意包络条件似然而非任何单一统计量；严格 trial-disjoint 协议揭示的真实上限说明基于似然的表述是必要的。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/WangLuran/Specificity-Aware-Diffusion-Steering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把扩散模型的 specificity-aware steering 写成目标分布设计问题：由 overlap 目标推出只在期望分布显著优于非期望分布的区域才保留期望参考分布的目标，得到 specificity 的似然比解释。配套提出局部提议方差最小化的 SMC 采样器与基于期望/非期望 score 场 Jacobian-vector products 的固定噪声优化，在合成任务、类对比生成、文生图与 p-MHC binder 上比 negative-guidance 基线更有效地压制非期望区域、减少 mode shift，并通过降低 SMC 权重坍缩提升采样稳定性。
Motivation: 推理期 steering 不重训就能给预训练扩散模型加约束，但把样本推离负参考分布时会连带侵蚀正负重叠区的正分布；难点是在压制负质量的同时最小扭曲正分布。
Method: 将 specificity-aware steering 归结为目标设计问题，从 overlap 目标推导时变目标分布（似然比形式的 specificity）；为采样该目标路径开发局部提议方差最小化的 Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 采样器，并加入用期望与非期望 score 场做 Jacobian-vector products 的固定噪声优化流程。
Result: 在合成任务、class-contrastive generation、text-to-image 与 peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder 实验中，相比 negative-guidance 基线更有效地压制非期望区域、减少 mode shift，并通过降低 SMC weight collapse 改善采样稳定性。
Conclusion: 把 specificity 当作目标分布设计问题（只在期望分布足够占优处保留它）并配合方差最小化的 SMC，可以在不重训的前提下比 negative guidance 更好地抑制非期望区域同时保住正分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. We also observe forking in short-budget, heavily repeated SFT and RL-like regimes. The contributions of this paper are twofold: (1) Forking reveals yet another curious phenomenon in deep learning, in addition to grokking and double descent. (2) Forking is an unexpected and unpleasant by-product of tricks proposed by autoresearch agents. While these agents produce an enormous number of results that seem useful, we should always be careful with their results.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 22 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/forking/tree/release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据重放 (data replay) 下，带过编码 n-gram 记忆分支的 NanoGPT 会在 epoch 边界出现训练与验证损失的陡然分叉，作者命名为 forking。机制上重复更新锐化训练中见过的续写、压低未见续写的概率，n-gram 模块的弱耦合上下文子空间放大该效应；低频上下文贡献最大，而更大训练预算与重度拥挤的表会抑制它。
Motivation: NanoGPT autoresearch 中发现的一种泛化失败：重放训练时验证损失在 epoch 边界突然与训练损失分离，此前的 grokking、double descent 之外的新现象，且是 autoresearch 代理所提技巧的意外副产物。
Method: 在受控 vanilla NanoGPT 设定下研究该现象，并在带 Engram 的 DeepSeek 风格模型上复现；机制分析区分训练中见过与未见的续写概率变化，并考察 n-gram 模块的上下文子空间、上下文频率、训练预算与表拥挤度的作用，另观察短预算、重度重复的 SFT 与 RL-like 设定。
Result: 训练与验证损失在 epoch 边界出现形似分叉的陡然分离，且在 vanilla NanoGPT 与带 Engram 的 DeepSeek 风格模型上均可复现；每次重放使未见续写的损失递增，低频上下文贡献大部分差距，更大训练预算与重度拥挤的表则抑制该现象；短预算、重度重复的 SFT 与 RL-like 设定中也观察到 forking。
Conclusion: Forking 是重放训练加过编码 n-gram 记忆分支时的泛化失败，属于 autoresearch 代理所提技巧的不受欢迎副产物，因此对这些代理产出的大量看似有用的结果需保持警惕。

papers.title: Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
authors: Dimitris K. Iakovidis (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science and Biomedical Informatics
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzification to produce clinically coherent numerical values. The approach natively handles mixed data types, and domain constraints common in health records. Experimental evaluation on UCI medical benchmark datasets demonstrates competitive performance under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) protocol. The proposed method achieves accuracy of up to 0.81 and AUROC of up to 0.90 on the Heart Disease dataset, matching or exceeding TVAE and Gaussian Copula baselines while running exclusively on CPU. Fidelity metrics including KS Complement (up to 0.91) and Correlation Similarity (up to 0.95) confirm strong statistical coherence, and DCR Baseline Protection scores consistently exceed those of TVAE, confirming adequate privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that causally grounded, interpretable fuzzy modeling offers a computationally efficient and transparent alternative to deep generative models for trustworthy synthetic data generation in CBMSs.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用模糊认知图 (Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, FCM) 生成带显式因果结构的合成医学表格数据：临床特征映射为语言化模糊集，特征间依赖由模糊集交集算出 FCM 边权，随机初始化的激活向量在图上传播至收敛后去模糊化为数值记录。在 UCI 医学基准的 TSTR 协议下，Heart Disease 数据集准确率最高 0.81、AUROC 最高 0.90，匹配或超过 TVAE 与 Gaussian Copula，且仅用 CPU 运行。
Motivation: 隐私与数据可得性限制使临床真实数据难以共享，而现有概率与深度生成模型缺乏可解释性、难以保持临床上有意义的依赖关系，在安全关键场景中不够可靠。
Method: 以语言化模糊集描述临床特征，用模糊集交集计算 FCM 边权编码特征间依赖；随机初始化语言激活向量在 FCM 中传播至收敛，再去模糊化生成数值记录，原生处理混合数据类型与病历常见领域约束；在 UCI 医学基准上以 Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) 协议评测。
Result: Heart Disease 数据集上准确率最高 0.81、AUROC 最高 0.90，匹配或超过 TVAE 与 Gaussian Copula 基线，且仅在 CPU 上运行；KS Complement 最高 0.91、Correlation Similarity 最高 0.95；DCR Baseline Protection 分数持续高于 TVAE。
Conclusion: 因果接地、可解释的模糊建模可作为深度生成模型的计算高效且透明的替代方案，用于 CBMS 中可信的合成数据生成。

papers.title: MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatrixReward 用 rollout×rubric 的胜率矩阵替代逐点评分：对同一 prompt 的每对采样回答按每条 rubric 比较，列内离散度衡量该 rubric 的区分力、列间相关揭示 rubric 重复，二者合成数据依赖权重并与先验权重合并，再经列归一化定义正负理想解，以各 rollout 到两理想的相对贴近度作为质量奖励。在 Qwen3-8B 上评测四个开放式问答 benchmark，平均分 63.02，比最强基线高约 2.0%。
Motivation: 开放式 query 生成没有标准答案，逐点评分的 rubric 无法给出同 prompt 下回答的相对优劣，把多条 rubric 判断合并成单一分数还会掩盖回答之间的差异。
Method: 构造 rollout-by-rubric 胜率矩阵：对每个 prompt 的所有采样回答两两按每条 rubric 比较；用每列的 spread 表示该 rubric 对当前 rollouts 的区分力、用列间相关检测 rubric 重复，二者导出数据依赖的 rubric 权重并与 rubric 先验权重结合；列归一化加权后取每列观测最大最小值定义正负理想 profile，按每个 rollout 到两理想的距离给出相对贴近度 (relative-closeness) 质量奖励。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上于四个开放式 query-answering benchmark 评测，MatrixReward 平均分 63.02，比最强基线高出约 2.0%。
Conclusion: 由相对比较导出的矩阵可以更合理地构造开放式生成强化学习的奖励，前提是让 rubric 权重随 rollout 区分力与冗余度自适应。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T2SPO 用成功轨迹里“到目标的剩余距离”做步级监督：以轨迹中的状态-剩余距离对为上下文，用预训练 TabPFN 回归器在新 rollout 的每个状态估计剩余距离，相邻状态的差值转成步级 credit，与任务级奖励一起训练策略。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上用 1.5B 和 7B 语言模型实验，任务成功率相对 GRPO 一致提升。
Motivation: 许多交互任务的奖励只反映最终结果，无法指出哪些中间决策真正推进了任务，多步 agent 的信用分配信号过稀。
Method: 从成功轨迹导出剩余距离目标并与沿途状态表征配对，作为 TabPFN 回归器的上下文；对新 rollout 逐状态估计剩余距离，取相邻状态差值作为步级辅助 credit，叠加任务级监督做策略优化；训练中新完成的轨迹刷新回归器上下文，不更新其参数。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，1.5B 与 7B 语言模型的 T2SPO 相对 GRPO 一致提升整体任务成功率。
Conclusion: 把成功轨迹压缩成可随经验刷新的剩余距离估计，可以在不改奖励的前提下为 LLM agent 提供步级信用分配并稳定优于 GRPO。

papers.title: FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAER 把 LLM 后训练回放 (replay) 的轨迹选择从格式反馈等缓存级指标转为下游学习效用，在 GSM8K + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上，128 步更新下固定选择器 quality 0.6329，高于 uniform 的 0.5482 与 format-feedback 的 0.6037；FAER-UTILITY 完成行达 0.6624。缓存级正确性与下游排序相反：format-feedback 选中记录正确率 0.6953，固定选择器仅 0.3594。
Motivation: 回放选择器常按格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或响应长度排序缓存轨迹，但缓存级正确性与下游学习者效用是两个不同目标，存在 selection-to-learning gap。
Method: FAER 是可审计的全轨迹回放框架：training-free 固定选择器作协议基线；FAER-UTILITY 在不相交的校准块上拟合学习者感知选择器，以归一化梯度对齐为基线，并用一次性的 optimizer-aware 虚拟更新给出幅度感知的效用面；审计契约在接入评估标签前冻结观测字段与回放轨迹。
Result: GSM8K + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、128 updates：固定选择器 quality 0.6329，uniform 0.5482，format-feedback 0.6037。metadata-only 交叉拟合校准 0.6476±0.0139（8 seeds，中位数 0.6481，配对 95% 区间 [+0.079, +0.122]），目标运行 63,276 tokens，含校准全成本 189,642 tokens 与 3.48 GPU-hours；FAER-UTILITY 完成行 0.6624，62,844 target-run tokens，4.26 GPU-hours。format-feedback 所选记录正确率 0.6953，固定选择器 0.3594，与下游排序相反。
Conclusion: 缓存级正确性不能替代下游学习效用，学习者感知选择器在匹配预算下给出更高的 quality；审计契约使选择与评估标签解耦，成本以 tokens 与 GPU-hours 显式记录。

summary_sections.method: FAER 是可审计的全轨迹回放框架：training-free 固定选择器作协议基线；FAER-UTILITY 在不相交的校准块上拟合学习者感知选择器，以归一化梯度对齐为基线，并用一次性的 optimizer-aware 虚拟更新给出幅度感知的效用面；审计契约在接入评估标签前冻结观测字段与回放轨迹。
summary_sections.result: GSM8K + Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、128 updates：固定选择器 quality 0.6329，uniform 0.5482，format-feedback 0.6037。metadata-only 交叉拟合校准 0.6476±0.0139（8 seeds，中位数 0.6481，配对 95% 区间 [+0.079, +0.122]），目标运行 63,276 tokens，含校准全成本 189,642 tokens 与 3.48 GPU-hours；FAER-UTILITY 完成行 0.6624，62,844 target-run tokens，4.26 GPU-hours。format-feedback 所选记录正确率 0.6953，固定选择器 0.3594，与下游排序相反。
summary_sections.conclusion: 缓存级正确性不能替代下游学习效用，学习者感知选择器在匹配预算下给出更高的 quality；审计契约使选择与评估标签解耦，成本以 tokens 与 GPU-hours 显式记录。

papers.title: RIQE: a NIQE-style reference model for Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: The Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores an image by its statistical distance from a model fitted on pristine images, and its distributed model is fitted on photographs. We release the Radiology Image Quality Evaluator (RIQE), a NIQE-style model fitted on 3,792 full-dose slices from 158 patients of the public LDCT-and-Projection-data collection, with a declared intensity mapping, a manifest of every slice and a script that reproduces the fit. On 40 held-out patients, RIQE ranks reduced-dose reconstructions, simulated by projection-domain noise insertion, worse than the full-dose reconstruction of the same slice in 240 of 240 chest and 230 of 240 abdominal pairs, and ranks images with 20% more noise worse than their source in 97.5-100% of cases. Its preferences among filtered images, however, do not follow lesion signal. With a 4 mm, +10 HU lesion inserted in noisy abdominal slices, RIQE prefers bilateral filtering to the unfiltered image in every image up to a 32 HU residual, at which 29% of the lesion's matched-filter signal remains and its detectability index falls from 0.51 to 0.33; it never prefers Gaussian smoothing, which at the same 32 HU residual leaves 70% of the signal and a detectability index of 0.48. Fitted on photographs with the parameters published for NIQE, the same code ranks every simulated reduced-dose abdominal image better than its full-dose counterpart. RIQE is suited to ranking a degraded image against its source; under the conditions tested it should not be the sole criterion for selecting, comparing or tuning denoisers.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code and model: https://github.com/Metallogik/RIQE, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23055559
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIQE 是把 NIQE 的自然图像统计模型搬到 CT 上的无参考质量评价器，用 3,792 张全剂量切片（158 例患者）拟合，能稳定把降剂量重建排在同层全剂量之下（胸部 240/240、腹部 230/240），但它的偏好与病灶信号脱钩：在插入 4 mm、+10 HU 病灶的腹部切片上，它在残余噪声高达 32 HU 时仍偏好双边滤波，此时只剩 29% 匹配滤波信号、可探测性指数 d' 从 0.51 降到 0.33，却从不偏好在同样 32 HU 残留下保留 70% 信号、d'=0.48 的高斯平滑。作者结论是 RIQE 只适合把退化图与其源图排序，不应作为去噪器选择、比较或调参的唯一判据。
Motivation: NIQE 的分布模型拟合在自然照片上，直接用于 CT 会失真；而 CT 去噪器的选型需要一个能反映病灶可探测性的无参考指标，现有统计型指标与任务信号可能背离。
Method: RIQE 沿用 NIQE 的统计距离打分框架，改用 LDCT-and-Projection-data 公开集的 3,792 张全剂量切片（158 例患者）拟合分布模型，声明强度映射、逐切片 manifest 并附复现拟合脚本；测试在 40 例留出患者上，用投影域加噪模拟降剂量重建，并在腹部切片插入 4 mm、+10 HU 病灶，以匹配滤波信号与可探测性指数 d' 对照 RIQE 的排序偏好。
Result: 在 40 例留出患者上，RIQE 把降剂量重建排在同层全剂量之下：胸部 240/240 对、腹部 230/240 对；噪声多 20% 的图像在 97.5–100% 的情形中被排在其源图之后。病灶实验中，双边滤波在残余噪声至 32 HU 时仍被 RIQE 偏好（每个图像），此时病灶匹配滤波信号仅余 29%，d' 从 0.51 降至 0.33；高斯平滑在同样 32 HU 残留下保留 70% 信号、d'=0.48，却从未被 RIQE 偏好。用 NIQE 已发表参数在照片上拟合的同一代码，会把每一张模拟降剂量腹部图像都排在全剂量之上。
Conclusion: 统计型无参考指标能可靠完成退化图对源图的排序，但在所测条件下与病灶可探测性不一致，因此不应作为去噪器选择、比较或调参的唯一标准。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). Trace aggregates evidence across stochastic executions, uses failure attribution as a search prior to focus candidate updates, and progressively re-attributes residual failures to coordinate evolution across responsibilities, while No-Patch and held-out validation prevent unnecessary or harmful updates. Across GenEval2, T2I-CompBench++, and WISE, EvoGen-Harness improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by +0.2633, +0.0720, and +0.0752, respectively, while achieving 87.9-91.4% attribution recall, 94.8% No-Patch accuracy, and only 1.9% regression. These results demonstrate that attribution-guided multi-responsibility evolution can substantially enhance frozen T2I systems beyond single-dimension adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoGen-Harness 让冻结 T2I 生成器外部的多职责 harness（prompt、路由、工作流等）协同进化，用 Trace（Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution）把跨随机执行的证据聚合、以失败归因作为搜索先验并逐步重归因残余失败。在 GenEval2、T2I-CompBench++、WISE 上相对最强已评估基线分别提升 +0.2633、+0.0720、+0.0752，归因召回 87.9-91.4%，No-Patch 准确率 94.8%，回归仅 1.9%。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 外部适配只优化预定义的单一维度（prompt、路由或工作流），生成失败可被纠正的空间受限；而视觉反馈只显示哪里失败，不指示应在哪个职责上持续进化、如何高效探索。
Method: Trace 聚合多次随机执行的证据，用失败归因作为搜索先验聚焦候选更新，并对残余失败逐步重归因以协调多职责进化；No-Patch 与 held-out 验证阻止不必要或有害的更新。框架为 generator-agnostic，不改动生成器参数。
Result: 在 GenEval2、T2I-CompBench++、WISE 上相对最强已评估基线分别提升 +0.2633、+0.0720、+0.0752；归因召回 87.9-91.4%，No-Patch 准确率 94.8%，回归率 1.9%。
Conclusion: 归因引导的多职责进化能显著增强冻结 T2I 系统，效果超出单维度适配。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量化会改变模型反演攻击的效果，且这种影响在 4 bits 附近对数据分布最敏感。提出的隐私感知训练后量化方法用 Fisher 型任务敏感度代理做位宽分配，并联合优化权重/激活 scale 与舍入：ResNet-50 上 Palm 4 bits 把 RL-MIA 严格成功率从 54% 压到 26%，精度 99.01%→96.55%；Iris 4.5 bits 加 SSD (epsilon=0.1) 后 BREP-MI 从 63.33% 降到 37.33%，精度 92.8%→87.6%。
Motivation: 量化降低存储与计算开销，但量化如何影响模型反演攻击、数据特性如何调制这一关系，两个问题都未解决；需要把量化引起的信息论变化与攻击优化障碍区分开。
Method: 对输入与由预测概率定义的类别变量之间的互信息给出量化诱导变化的界；识别特征分布与反演结果的数据依赖变化；据此提出隐私感知 PTQ：Fisher 型任务敏感度代理做预算感知位宽分配、校准激活范围，并以任务恢复与几何保持目标加 scale/舍入正则联合优化权重与激活 scale 及权重量化舍入。
Result: ResNet-50 上 Palm 4 bits 使 RL-MIA 严格成功率 54%→26%，精度相对 FP32 由 99.01%→96.55%；Iris 4.5 bits 上叠加 Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon=0.1) 使 BREP-MI 严格成功率 63.33%→37.33%，精度相对仅量化 92.8%→87.6%。量化敏感度差异在 4 bits 处最显著，实验覆盖多种指标、网络架构与人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务。
Conclusion: 量化可作为反演防御手段且能回收效用，位宽与输出级防御叠加时按数据分布选择；4 bits 是量化敏感度差异最突出的位置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
papers.abstract_en: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself. Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities rather than task-specific strings. In an interface-controlled comparison against a generative baseline trained on the same backbone, data and schedule, OmniMed-Jev's reported probabilities track observed correctness far more closely, reducing calibration error by up to an order of magnitude and reliability error by up to two, while point-prediction performance remains comparable; counting is the one family where the generative baseline stays ahead. Making the decision distribution the model's output is not a format change but what turns reported numbers into probabilities that mean what they say. These results support explicit decision modeling as a way to make reported confidence meaningful within the evaluated tasks, and they are not evidence of clinical readiness: the comparison cannot separate the interface from associated training differences, which we state alongside the results. Code is available at github.com/lytang63/OmniMed-Jev.
papers.comment: We introduce OmniMed-Jev, a decision-native interface based on Jev that outputs Choice, Noul or Score decisions with calibrated probabilities
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniMed-Jev 把医疗 LVLM 的每个决策表示为候选集上的 Choice、Noul 或 Score 决策并直接输出完整概率分布，使报告置信度与实际正确率对齐。在同骨干、同数据、同训练日程的生成式基线对照下，校准误差最多降低一个数量级、可靠性误差最多降低两倍，点预测性能相当，仅计数任务仍落后于生成式基线。
Motivation: 通用多模态医疗模型以生成文本表达诊断、发现或细胞计数等有界决策，报告的概率反映下一个 token 而非决策本身，导致置信度与实际正确率脱节。
Method: 提出决策原生接口 OmniMed-Jev：把每个医疗决策表示为运行时候选集上的 Choice（互斥类别）、Noul（发现的二元存在性）或 Score（有界有序值），用统一的候选条件概率模型返回候选集上的完整分布，覆盖多种影像模态与预测任务；对照实验用相同骨干、数据与训练日程的生成式基线做接口控制比较。
Result: 接口控制比较中，OmniMed-Jev 报告概率与观测正确率贴合得多，校准误差最多降低一个数量级，可靠性误差最多降低两倍；点预测性能与生成式基线相当，计数是生成式基线仍领先的一类任务。
Conclusion: 把决策分布本身作为模型输出，才能让报告的数字成为名副其实的概率；该结论限于所评估任务，且对照无法把接口与伴随的训练差异分离，不构成临床就绪的证据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy
papers.abstract_en: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. We then propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on fused TF representations. \textcolor{black}{We use a primary dataset of 15 patients and a secondary dataset of 46 patients. We run two sets of experiments. The first set uses segment-level 10-fold cross-validation. In this setup segments from the same patient can appear in both training and testing. The Montage CWT\_ST fusion reaches 99.90\% accuracy on the primary dataset and 91.90\% on the secondary dataset. The second set uses strict subject-disjoint cross-validation. All segments of a patient stay in one fold and no patient appears in both training and testing. Performance collapses. We test four time-frequency methods, six fusion mechanisms, and fourteen model architectures. With one exception, every configuration on both cohorts falls between AUC 0.31 and 0.54 and every 95\% confidence interval contains 0.5. A patient-level permutation test on the best standalone method returns $p = 0.703$. The best subject-level result is Montage CWT\_ST on the primary cohort, which reaches AUC $0.874 \pm 0.183$ and 82.7\% accuracy.
papers.comment: Published in the Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 EEG 时频图 (TF image) 的 montage 与 blending 两种融合加轻量 CNN 预测 rTMS 抑郁治疗响应：按 segment 划分的 10 折交叉验证下 Montage CWT_ST 在 15 人主数据集达 99.90% 准确率、46 人次级数据集 91.90%，但换成严格 subject-disjoint 划分后性能崩塌，除一例外全部配置 AUC 落在 0.31–0.54 且 95% 置信区间都含 0.5。
Motivation: rTMS 治疗响应预测受被试间高变异性与单域特征有限所限；segment 级划分会让同一患者的片段同时进训练与测试，虚高结果掩盖真实泛化能力。
Method: 从 EEG 提取时频图，提出 montage 与 blending 两种融合技术生成更丰富特征，再训练轻量定制 CNN；测试 4 种时频方法、6 种融合机制、14 种模型架构，分别做 segment 级 10 折与严格 subject-disjoint 交叉验证，并对最佳独立方法做患者级置换检验。
Result: segment 级 10 折下 Montage CWT_ST 主数据集准确率 99.90%、次级数据集 91.90%；subject-disjoint 下除一例外所有配置在两个队列 AUC 均在 0.31–0.54 且 95% CI 均含 0.5，最佳独立方法患者级置换检验 p = 0.703；最佳被试级结果为主队列 Montage CWT_ST，AUC 0.874 ± 0.183、准确率 82.7%。数据集为 15 人主数据集与 46 人次级数据集。
Conclusion: 段级划分的高准确率来自同一患者片段跨折泄漏，rTMS 响应预测在严格被试不相交评估下基本不优于随机，报告该任务结果必须用 subject-disjoint 划分。

papers.title: STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/STCFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STCFormer 在每个 temporal patch 内按站点局部演化动态分组，用 Cluster-Guided Attention Block 同时做簇内细粒度局部注意力与跨区域状态摘要的全局注意力，让每个站点能取到簇外信息。在三个真实气象数据集的八个温度与风速预报任务上，24 小时 MSE 全部最低，48 组指标×时效对比中 47 组排名第一或第二。
Motivation: 站点气象预报需要刻画站点间复杂空间依赖；稠密交互代价高，而跨整个观测窗口共享的固定分组会掩盖站点关系的局部变化，仅靠簇内交互又丢掉全局上下文，选择性交互相对稠密连接的理论优势也不清楚。
Method: 提出自适应时空 Transformer STCFormer：在每个 temporal patch 内按站点局部演化动态分组；Cluster-Guided Attention Block 组合簇内细粒度局部注意力与基于区域状态摘要的全局注意力；对簇条件局部注意力推导 Lipschitz 上界并说明其不大于全连接对应物，据此设计 InfoLoss。
Result: 在三个真实天气数据集、八个温度与风速预报任务上，STCFormer 在全部八个任务取得最低 24 小时 MSE，并在跨指标与时效的 48 组比较中 47 组排名第一或第二；消融与案例研究支持局部自适应分组与局部-全局互补交互的收益。
Conclusion: 按 temporal patch 动态分组加局部-全局互补注意力，既能保留选择性交互的理论稳健性（Lipschitz 上界不大于全连接），又不牺牲全局上下文，是站点气象预报中优于稠密交互与固定分组的建模方式。

papers.title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CESNET-QUICEXT-25 上用前十个包的大小、方向与到达间隔做十类应用流分类，40 条固定标注样本把 Jev 的准确率从 9.80% 提到 28.42%，扩到 150 条在首个测试周达 34.50%。但用 8,000 条记录训练的 Random Forest 与 Extra Trees 分别为 69.95% 与 66.80%，且每周都高于 Jev；与 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 100 条配对子集上 Jev 为 29%、中位请求 0.750 s，GPT 为 37%、6.036 s，该子集不足以判定任一方准确率占优。
Motivation: 通用决策模型（以 Jev 为代表）能否用于网络流应用分类尚无实证研究；同时需要在固定标注预算与推理成本下，与传统树集成和生成式大模型公平比较。
Method: 在 CESNET-QUICEXT-25 上取十个 dataset 定义的应用标签，仅用每条流前 10 个包的大小、方向和 inter-packet time 作为特征；测试集为训练期之后 26 个采集周的 52,000 条记录，用固定数量的标注样本（40 条与 150 条）驱动 Jev，并与用 8,000 条记录训练的 Random Forest、Extra Trees 对比；另在 100 条配对子集上与经 Azure 调用的 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol（high reasoning effort）比较准确率、请求时间与 API 费用。
Result: Jev 用 40 条固定标注样本准确率 9.80% → 28.42%（52,000 条记录、26 个测试周）；扩到 150 条样本在首个测试周为 34.50%。Random Forest 69.95%、Extra Trees 66.80%（各 8,000 条训练记录），且每周都高于 Jev。100 条配对子集上：Jev（40 样本）29%、中位请求时间 0.750 s；GPT-5.6 Sol（high reasoning）37%、6.036 s，Jev 的 API 费用更低；该子集不确立任一服务的准确率优势，计时反映不同服务配置。
Conclusion: 标注样本能显著抬升 Jev 的应用分类准确率，但在所测配置下仍不及训练好的树集成；由于监督预算不等与配置固定，差距不能归因于单一原因。

papers.title: Faithful Chart Generation for Multimodal Deep Research: Frame-Evidence Co-Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Analytical charts in multimodal deep research encode quantitative claims, requiring every visualized value to be faithfully grounded in supporting evidence. Unlike retrieved images that mainly provide contextual information, charts require numerical fidelity: visualized values should not only match retrieved evidence quantitatively but also preserve its original meaning and scope. However, achieving such fidelity remains challenging because current systems usually construct visualization plans before knowing what quantitative evidence can actually be retrieved from the web. As a result, predefined plans may require entities, temporal ranges, or comparison dimensions that the retrieved evidence only partially supports. Existing approaches mainly address this issue through post-hoc verification after chart plans are fixed, enabling unsupported values to be identified but leaving the underlying visual frames unchanged. To address this challenge, we propose Frame-Evidence Co-Adaptation (FECA), an evidence-adaptive visual planning framework for multimodal deep research. Inspired by the bidirectional sensemaking process in Data-Frame Theory, FECA models chart generation as an iterative interaction between visual frames and retrieved evidence. Each visual frame is adaptive: the frame guides evidence acquisition, while retrieved evidence determines whether the frame should be accepted, revised, or dropped before rendering. By coupling visualization planning with evidence availability, FECA shifts chart generation from fixed-plan verification to adaptive evidence-grounded visual reasoning. Experiments on 100 real-world research topics show that FECA substantially improves numerical fidelity while preserving report quality and chart utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FECA 把多模态深度研究中的图表生成改成视觉框架与检索证据的迭代互适应：框架引导证据获取，检索到的证据再决定该框架在渲染前被接受、修改还是丢弃。在 100 个真实研究主题上，该方法显著提升数值保真度，同时保持报告质量与图表可用性。
Motivation: 图表要求可视化数值与检索证据定量一致且保留原意，但现有系统先定可视化计划再检索，计划所需的实体、时间范围、对比维度常被证据部分支持；已有做法只做事后核验，能发现无支撑数值却改不动已固定的视觉框架。
Method: 提出 Frame-Evidence Co-Adaptation (FECA)，一个证据自适应的可视化规划框架，受 Data-Frame Theory 的双向意义建构过程启发，把图表生成建模为视觉框架与检索证据的迭代交互，每个框架在渲染前按证据判定接受、修订或丢弃，使规划与证据可用性耦合。
Result: 在 100 个真实研究主题上的实验中，FECA 显著提升数值保真度 (numerical fidelity)，同时保持报告质量与图表可用性。
Conclusion: 把图表生成从固定计划的事后核验转为证据驱动的自适应视觉推理，可在不牺牲报告质量与图表可用性的前提下提高数值保真度。

papers.title: When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls
papers.abstract_en: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.
papers.comment: Code available in the accompanying repository. 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GPT-2 small 上证明注意力头消融 (attention-head ablation) 的因果推断很脆弱：post-projection 置零与修正的 pre-projection 置零几乎不相关 (Pearson r = 0.057)，top-5 头完全不重叠。用 discovery/held-out 划分加 1,000 次匹配对照后，修正的逐头效应排序跨划分高度稳定 (Spearman rho = 0.974)，top-5 显著超过两类对照 (Monte Carlo p = 0.001)；但任务特异性证据在 GPT-2 上不稳健。结论是单头消融本身不足以支撑因果主张，必须同时满足正确的干预位置、非饱和的连续指标与匹配的留出对照。
Motivation: 注意力头消融被广泛用来推断语言模型中哪些组件因果地负责某行为，但干预语义、评估指标与对照是否可靠缺少系统检验，错误实现会让因果结论建立在无关的头集合上。
Method: 在 GPT-2 small 上对比 post-projection 与修正的 pre-projection 置零两种干预语义，比较逐头效应相关性与 top-5 重叠；用 discovery/held-out 划分并各做 1,000 次匹配随机头与层匹配头对照抽样，以 Monte Carlo 检验 top-5 头是否超出对照分布，同时比较二值准确率与 gold-token log-probability 两种指标，并在 DistilGPT2 上复现。
Result: post-projection 与修正的 pre-projection 消融相关性仅 Pearson r = 0.057，top-5 头集合完全不相交；修正的逐头效应排序跨划分 Spearman rho = 0.974，top-5 显著高于随机头与层匹配头两类对照 (Monte Carlo p = 0.001，各 1,000 次抽样)；二值准确率在行为地板与天花板附近掩盖效应而 gold-token log-probability 保持连续；任务特异性证据在 GPT-2 上不稳健，DistilGPT2 复现了干预语义与匹配对照两项发现。
Conclusion: 单头消融本身不能支撑因果主张，可辩护的解释需要正确的干预位置、非饱和的连续指标与匹配的留出对照三者同时到位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的 harness 恢复 (recovery) 从平均任务成功率改写成因果决策问题：从同一执行状态比较做与不做干预，拆开 rescue 与 harm，再用轻量策略 CIR 依据干预前信息决定何时介入。在 ALFWorld 长程任务、Qwen3-14B 上，CIR 把成功率从 70.33% 提到 73.33%（+3.00 个百分点），且所有观测本就正确的轨迹保持不动。
Motivation: 恢复只按平均任务成功率评估，掩盖了同一操作既能救回失败轨迹、也能破坏本会成功的轨迹这一矛盾，导致干预时机无法判断。
Method: 将 recovery 形式化为因果决策问题，从相同执行状态做干预与不干预的对照，分离 rescue 与 harm 并考察恢复价值随时间的变化；据此提出 Causal Intervention Router (CIR)，一个只用干预前可得信息的轻量介入策略。
Result: 在长程 ALFWorld 任务、Qwen3-14B 上，CIR 将成功率从 70.33% 提升至 73.33%，即 +3.00 个百分点；所有被评估且观测正确的轨迹保持不变；附加对照显示恢复的收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。
Conclusion: 恢复的价值应按因果方式逐轨迹评估并选择性施加，CIR 提供了一种可实践的评估与按需介入方式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Deny Without Disabling: Authorization-Paired Evaluation and Control for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems derive their capabilities from sharing evidence, delegating tasks, and combining information across agents. The same process creates a safety problem: contributions that are admissible in isolation can jointly enable a prohibited use. Blocking every sensitive action avoids disclosure but defeats the purpose of collaboration. We introduce authorization-paired evaluation, which makes blocking prohibited uses and completing required authorized uses a joint success criterion, and FlowReview, a framework connecting object resolution, permission ranking, and deterministic enforcement. In controlled composition experiments, reviewing combined artifacts reduces the denied-commit rate from 86.0% to zero with no loss of authorized supply. Our findings show that preserving information and lineage alone does not ensure correct permission attribution. Object identity and permission must remain connected to execution through components whose outputs can be verified. Together, these findings establish a system-level requirement for multi-agent safety: govern composed information flows while preserving the authorized capabilities that make collaboration useful.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/yunbeizhang/FlowReview
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出授权配对评估 (authorization-paired evaluation)：把「拦截被禁止用途」与「完成必需的授权用途」作为联合成功标准，并给出 FlowReview 框架，把对象解析、权限排序与确定性执行串起来。在受控组合实验中，审查组合产物使 denied-commit 率从 86.0% 降到零，且授权供给无损失。
Motivation: 多智能体共享证据、委派任务时，单独合规的贡献组合后可能共同促成被禁止用途；而一律阻断敏感动作虽避免泄露，却使协作失效。
Method: FlowReview 框架包含对象解析 (object resolution)、权限排序 (permission ranking) 与确定性执行 (deterministic enforcement) 三个组件，配合把拦截禁止用途与完成授权用途并列的授权配对评估准则，在受控组合实验中审查组合产物。
Result: 在受控组合实验中，审查组合产物将 denied-commit 率从 86.0% 降至零，同时授权供给 (authorized supply) 无损失。
Conclusion: 仅保留信息与血缘 (lineage) 不足以保证权限归属正确；对象身份与权限必须通过输出可验证的组件与执行保持连接，多智能体安全需要在保留协作能力的前提下治理组合信息流。

papers.title: M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/M2-Weather.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M²Weather 把多站点与多变量关系放进同一基准：经多准则质量控制与站点分层收集 2809 个高质量站点、5 个物理耦合气象变量，覆盖 France、Europe、Global 三个空间尺度，并给出统一训练与评测协议。系统评测 16 个代表性模型显示联合建模站点与变量关系有益；用轻量即插即用 adapter 补全缺失关系后，三个数据集上所有被适配模型的 MSE 均进一步下降。
Motivation: 现有研究把站点间空间依赖与变量间物理耦合分开处理，且数据集与实验设置各异，无法系统评估两者各自的贡献与联合作用。
Method: 通过多准则质量控制与站点分层构建 2809 站、5 变量、France/Europe/Global 三尺度数据；设计统一训练与评测协议以公平比较不同站点-变量建模范式；再提出轻量 plug-and-play adapter，在已训练模型上引入缺失的站点或变量关系而无需重训。
Result: 系统评测 16 个代表性模型，显示联合建模站点与变量关系带来收益；补全缺失关系后，三个数据集上所有被适配模型的 MSE 均下降。
Conclusion: 跨站点与跨变量的互补信息是提升站点天气预报的重要资源，且可在不重训模型的前提下通过 adapter 注入。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium
papers.abstract_en: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Reanalysis of publicly available generator-by-selector matrices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 重建 Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) 的 5×5 生成器×选择器矩阵（21,828 个有效试次），用双向固定效应模型加 own-model 项 γ，并对选择器的 120 种重标号做精确置换检验，发现 LLM 并不偏爱自己写的文本：products +0.013 (p=0.24)、papers −0.010 (p=0.74)、films +0.054 (p=0.07)、合并 +0.019 (p=0.14, 95% 区间 −0.008 至 0.046)。结论是「AI-AI 偏好」由生成器与选择器主效应解释，而非自模型溢价。
Motivation: Laurito et al. 展示 LLM 选择器大 margin 偏好模型撰写的描述，但其交叉设计还隐含一个未被正面回答的问题：选择器是否在生成器与选择器主效应之外，额外偏好自家模型的文本。
Method: 从作者公开仓库的逐条计数重建三份 5×5 矩阵（每格与已发表值一致），拟合含 own-model 项 γ 的双向固定效应模型，用选择器 120 种重标号的精确单侧置换检验做显著性；另用 Tan et al. (ACL 2024) 的 4×4 矩阵（24 种重标号）做对照，并量化位置偏置与剔除顺序驱动条目后的稳健性。
Result: own-model 溢价：products +0.013 (p=0.24)、paper abstracts −0.010 (p=0.74)、films +0.054 (p=0.07)、pooled +0.019 (p=0.14, 95% 区间 −0.008 至 0.046)；GPT-3.5/GPT-4 同厂商项在三个数据集均为负。位置偏置可使单格移动至多 0.42 share points，剔除顺序驱动条目后 own-model 对比不变。对 0.05 溢价的检验功效为 82%/88%/42%/97%（products/papers/films/pooled），80% 功效下最小可检测效应为合并 0.034。Tan et al. 4×4 矩阵给出 γ=+0.148（其 24 种重标号允许的最小 p），同族项同量级。原研究主结论仍在：products 上每个选择器选 GPT-4 描述的比例为 77% 至 95%。
Conclusion: 模型确实共享对模型文本的偏好，但数据不支持模型识别并偏爱自己的文风；该否定结论在约 0.04 share points 以上有信息量，低于此幅度则无检测力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 重建 Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) 的 5×5 生成器×选择器矩阵（21,828 个有效试次），用双向固定效应模型加 own-model 项 γ，并对选择器的 120 种重标号做精确置换检验，发现 LLM 并不偏爱自己写的文本：products +0.013 (p=0.24)、papers −0.010 (p=0.74)、films +0.054 (p=0.07)、合并 +0.019 (p=0.14, 95% 区间 −0.008 至 0.046)。结论是「AI-AI 偏好」由生成器与选择器主效应解释，而非自模型溢价。

papers.title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
papers.abstract_en: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepJEPA 把世界模型的转移深度当作测试时可分配的计算轴：权重共享的 joint-embedding 预测模型逐转移学习「再做一次 recurrent update 是否值得」，平均每个转移只花 1.00–1.26 次更新，计算集中在接触起始与持续物体交互等决策关键事件上。在五个视觉控制设定中，它追平或超过最强的固定深度规划器，而均匀加深每个转移反而浪费算力并损害规划。
Motivation: 世界模型规划器惯用的外扩手段是滚得更远、采更多轨迹、优化更久，且对每个想象转移分配相同算力；但有用的精化只集中在少数决策关键事件上，均匀加深既浪费计算也可能让规划变差。
Method: DeepJEPA 是权重共享 (weight-tied) 的 joint-embedding 预测世界模型，把转移深度作为内层测试时扩展轴，按候选与 rollout 步逐个学习是否值得再算一次 recurrent update；额外计算被导向接触起始与持续物体交互处，因为这些位置的 latent 修正会改变哪些候选进入规划器 elite set 以及最终选哪个动作。
Result: 在五个视觉控制设定上，DeepJEPA 改进或匹配最强的固定深度规划器，而平均每转移仅 1.00–1.26 次更新；其额外计算集中在 contact onset 与 sustained object interaction。表征探针 (representation probes) 显示规划提升并不要求物体状态可解码性 (object-state decodability) 全面变好。
Conclusion: 世界模型的扩展应是把内部计算分配到能改变规划决策的转移上，即在决策关键转移处想得更深，而不是让每个 rollout 均匀更深或更长。

papers.title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoRA 用可学习的 router bias 加路由多样性正则来挑选要剪掉的 MoE 专家，并在剪枝后用仿射变换让保留专家近似被剪专家的输出。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight-16B-A3B 上各剪掉每层 25% 与 50% 的 routed experts，九个 zero-shot benchmark 上超过现有 SOTA 剪枝算法。
Motivation: MoE 部署仍需把完整专家池载入显存；现有结构化专家剪枝要么排序准则与模型性能不对齐，要么子集搜索开销大，且普遍忽略保留专家之间的路由行为冗余。
Method: 为每个专家引入可学习 router bias，用语言建模损失加 routing-diversity regularizer 优化，使路由分布变尖锐以识别关键专家并鼓励路由偏好多样的专家；剪枝后再用 expert approximation 机制，通过仿射变换用剩余专家逼近被剪专家输出。
Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight-16B-A3B 三个 MoE 模型上分别移除每层 25% 与 50% 的 routed experts，在九个 zero-shot benchmark 上优于 SOTA 剪枝算法。
Conclusion: 把 router bias 学习与剪枝后专家近似结合，可以在大幅削减专家内存的同时保持甚至提升被剪 MoE 的 zero-shot 性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.
papers.comment: Code available in the accompanying repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出流式回忆基准 (streaming-recall benchmark)，把记忆评估中混在一起的保留 (retention) 与选择 (selection) 两个决策拆开，在同一组 300 个 seeded episodes 上交叉两种规则。固定访问范围时 query-aware 选择把必需事实召回率提高 15.5 个百分点 (95% CI 12.8–18.2)；而同时改变历史访问的混合对比报出 68.7 点优势，其中 53.2 点来自访问差异而非选择本身。
Motivation: 持久化 agent 的记忆评测常把保留规则与选择规则一起改动，导致性能差异无法归因，读者分不清收益来自存了什么还是取了什么。
Method: 构建交叉保留规则与选择规则的流式回忆基准，所有条件在相同 300 个 seeded episodes 上评测；对比 query-aware、dense、oracle、recency 等选择策略，并在 SQuAD 上复跑以检验自然文本上的检索行为。
Result: 固定访问下 query-aware 选择提升必需事实召回 15.5 个百分点 (95% CI 12.8–18.2)；混合对比报出 68.7 点优势，其中 53.2 点归因于访问差异。有界保留下 query-aware、dense、oracle 均触及保留上限，bounded recency 条件下全部 319 个失败由淘汰 (eviction) 而非排序错误造成；目标退得足够远时召回降至 0%。SQuAD 复跑保持保留上限，并显示 dense retrieval 在自然文本上可胜过 lexical retrieval。
Conclusion: 有界记忆评测应固定访问范围并分别报告 retention 与 selection，否则选择方法的表面优势大部分是访问差异的假象。

papers.title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeNOVA 在蒸馏/流图模型带来的确定性单步或少步生成设定下，用无梯度方式优化初始噪声以对齐黑盒奖励：退火软值引导 (annealed soft-value guidance) 提供方向，流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学 (manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics) 与 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃保证采样稳定。在图像与视频生成模型上，它比全部被评估的零阶基线更稳定地把初始噪声推向更高奖励。
Motivation: 现有初始噪声优化方法依赖一阶梯度信息，在黑盒奖励场景下要么不可用，要么不稳定且低效，限制了奖励对齐分支的适用范围。
Method: 三个组件配合：annealed soft-value guidance 在无梯度下构造引导信号；manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics 把搜索约束在高斯先验的超球面几何上；Metropolis-Hastings jumping 提升跳跃接受与稳定性，整体面向黑盒奖励。
Result: 在图像与视频生成模型上的大量实验中，ZeNOVA 在所有被评估的零阶 (zeroth-order) 基线上取得更高奖励，且优化过程显著更稳定，同时利用高斯先验的几何结构。
Conclusion: 利用高斯先验几何的无梯度初始噪声优化，可以在黑盒奖励对齐中同时获得稳定性与效率，适用于多种生成模型的奖励对齐场景。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.
papers.comment: Survey paper. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (EAAI), 2026
papers.journal_ref: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Volume 181, Part 7, Article 115776, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇铁路系统深度学习异常检测的结构化综述，用异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性四个维度建立统一分类法，并把 CNN、RNN、注意力网络、autoencoder、GAN、Transformer 归入分类式、预测式、重建式与混合式四类学习范式。最终给出一个面向决策的框架，把异常特征、数据属性与运营约束映射到可选的检测范式和部署配置（edge-cloud、算力约束、硬件感知优化）。
Motivation: 铁路车辆与基础设施的异构传感数据快速增长，但现有深度学习异常检测方法散落在不同架构与传感模态中，缺少统一分类与从异常特征到部署配置的选择依据。
Method: 以异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性四轴建立分类法；将卷积、循环、注意力架构、autoencoder、GAN、Transformer 按分类式、预测式、重建式、混合式四种学习范式组织；同时梳理数据层面挑战、评估实践、性能指标与 edge-cloud 部署、计算约束、硬件感知优化，并以决策框架把异常特征、数据属性、运营约束连到检测范式与部署配置。
Result: 综述给出四轴分类法、四类学习范式的结构化梳理，以及一个连接异常特征、数据属性与运营约束到检测范式和部署配置的决策导向框架；摘要未给出定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 铁路异常检测的选择应按异常特征、数据属性与运营约束三者共同决定检测范式与部署配置，而非按架构本身；可靠与可扩展的智能监测仍是开放挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DexPolicy 把灵巧操作 RL 的探索噪声幅度做成训练步数的显式函数，从宽到窄退火，而损失、结构、奖励、优化器全部固定。在 ViViDex 轨迹引导设定下，五个 YCB 物体三种种子上 mean deterministic Target success 由 49.4% 升到 68.1%（FPO）、14.1% 到 45.4%（GRPO）、32.0% 到 35.7%（PPO）；真机 RealMan RM75 加 Inspire/RH56 手 360 次试验中由 25.0% 升到 85.0%（FPO）。作者主张按任务与策略优化设定、以目标执行条件下的终局任务成功率来评判探索调度。
Motivation: 轨迹引导灵巧操作里，动作噪声既要帮助发现手指-物体接触又要不妨碍精确控制，两者互相冲突；基线 PPO 在 5M 步附近收敛到初始噪声水平，探索尺度缺少显式控制。
Method: 将探索尺度设为训练步数的显式函数并从宽到窄退火，保持损失、架构、奖励与优化器不变；在三种策略优化设定上对比：PPO、critic-free GRPO continuation、以及 flow-parameterized PPO 变体 (FPO)，并做 PPO 组件筛选（噪声控制 vs 优化器收缩）与调度形状对比（所选调度 vs 同端点线性衰减）。
Result: 五个 YCB 物体、三个训练种子上 mean deterministic Target success：FPO 49.4%→68.1%，GRPO 14.1%→45.4%，PPO 32.0%→35.7%。RealMan RM75 臂 + Inspire/RH56 手、三个物体共 360 次试验：FPO 25.0%→85.0%，GRPO 10.0%→63.3%，PPO 8.3%→43.3%，每物体-方法条件一个训练模型。PPO 组件筛选偏向噪声控制而非所测优化器收缩；所选调度在三个测试物体上 mean Target success 高于同端点线性衰减。
Conclusion: 训练回报、确定性 Target 成功率与对执行噪声的容忍度三者解耦，因此探索调度应按任务与策略优化设定、在预期执行条件下的终局任务成功率来评判。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models with prompt and reference image-guided editing have seen rapid progress, yet they remain too coarse for pixel-level control. One promising direction is to incorporate a soft mask that specifies spatially varying edit strengths but training such fine-grained control demands expensive pixel-wise annotations, while existing zero-shot methods often yield unsatisfactory results. We introduce SoftPaint, a new zero-shot sampling method that leverages soft masks to enable a continuous spectrum of edits, from fully preserving the original content to completely re-synthesizing the masked region. Going beyond zero-shot inpainting methods, we design a Langevin-iteration-based sampler that respects per-pixel soft mask strengths, which applies universally to image and video diffusion models, enabling tasks such as video editing. The method is gradient-free, memory-efficient, and achieves smooth, pixel-level edits across multiple image and video backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本采样方法 SoftPaint，用软掩码给出逐像素可变的编辑强度，通过基于 Langevin 迭代的采样器让掩码内每个像素在“完全保留原内容”到“完全重新合成”之间连续取值，适用于图像与视频扩散模型并支持视频编辑任务。该方法免梯度、显存高效，可在多个图像与视频骨干网络上实现平滑的像素级编辑。
Motivation: 扩散模型的提示与参考图引导编辑粒度太粗，无法做像素级控制；而训练这种细粒度控制需要昂贵的逐像素标注，现有零样本方法效果又不理想。
Method: SoftPaint 是零样本采样方法：输入软掩码指定空间变化的编辑强度，用基于 Langevin 迭代的采样器逐像素遵守掩码强度，超越常规零样本 inpainting；流程免梯度 (gradient-free)、显存高效，可直接套用到图像与视频扩散骨干上。
Result: 在多个图像与视频骨干网络上实现平滑的像素级编辑，并支持视频编辑等任务；摘要给出的特性为免梯度与显存高效，未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 像素级编辑强度不必靠逐像素标注训练获得，用软掩码约束采样过程即可在零样本下实现从保留到完全重合成的连续编辑谱，且对图像与视频扩散模型通用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LoopGlitch26/Proof-Gated-Signing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Proof-Gated Signing (PGS)：对拟议交易做模拟并抽取效果，用 SMT 求解器在 oracle 不确定性带内逐价格核验声明式价值与权限策略，再编译成链上后置条件（余额界、收款、授权上限、所有权）由智能合约钱包原子执行，使保证在任意 state drift 下仍成立。在 260 场景测试台上，PGS 拦下 93.6% 的 140 个有害场景、放行 97.5% 的良性场景，50 个 drift 场景无一让攻击者获利。
Motivation: 钱包代理的签名前检查（静态 allowlist、LLM 审核、交易模拟）只描述检查时刻的链状态，而交易在更晚的状态执行，攻击者可用 front-running、合约升级或代币参数改动塑造该状态，即 state drift，使检查失效。
Method: PGS 先模拟拟议交易并抽取其效果，用 SMT 求解器在 oracle 不确定性带内的每个价格上核验声明式的 value-and-permission 策略；随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额界、payee 收款、allowance 上限、ownership），证明满足后置条件的任何执行都满足策略，由代理的智能合约钱包原子强制执行。
Result: 在 260 场景开放测试台（14 个攻击族含 5 个 drift 族与 2 个 adaptive 族，12 个良性族，危害按攻击者余额而非策略判定）上：PGS 拦下 140 个有害场景的 93.6%，放行 97.5% 的良性场景；仅模拟检查拦下 57.9%，静态 allowlist 为 71.4%；50 个 drift 场景在 PGS 下无一产生攻击者获利；唯一未拦下的 in-policy drain 被单次会话预算限制；给 LLM 审核者一份干净的 pre-drift 模拟反而使其更可能批准 drift 攻击；每次检查开销约 41k gas 与 0.1–0.2 秒。
Conclusion: 把策略保证编译成链上后置条件并原子执行，才能让签名前检查在任意 state drift 下依然成立；仅靠模拟或 allowlist 不足以覆盖 drift，而给 LLM 审核者看干净模拟会适得其反。
Relevance: 1
