papers.title: Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 attention manifolds：在标准 transformer 注意力上为每个 value 维度学习二维 B-spline 曲面 S_d(q_d,k_d)，按 query-key 交互调制所提取的内容，而非只决定注意多少。在 LLaMA 3.2-1B/3B-Instruct 上以 0.3% 参数开销把 WikiText-2 验证困惑度降低 2–2.5 点，112 条提示中贪心解码输出改变 69%（1B）至 83%（3B），歧义与多义输入改变率达 94–100%；反转某层系数可改变 9/10 条提示的输出（KL 0.010），把系数设为 -1 形成 attention walls 阻断该维度的 value 流。
Motivation: 标准注意力中源 token 对所有接收方发送同一个 value 向量，query 只决定注意多少而不决定提取什么，因而缺少按 query-key 交互调制内容、以及可机械编辑以实现模型转向的机制。
Method: 为每个 value 维度学习二维张量积三次 B-spline 曲面 S_d(q_d,k_d)，初始化为零以保持预训练行为，按 query-key 交互调制 value；应用于 LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct 与 3B-Instruct，参数开销 0.3%。曲面系数可直接编辑：反转某层系数，或设为 -1 形成 attention walls。
Result: WikiText-2 验证困惑度降低 2–2.5 点（参数开销 0.3%）；112 条多样提示中贪心解码输出改变 69%（1B）至 83%（3B），歧义与多义输入改变率 94–100%；输出质量改善包括纠正事实错误、提高精确性、补充具体出处（Saint Augustine 引用，两个规模一致）；反转一层系数改变 9/10 条提示的输出，KL 0.010；预实验中层宽 wall 把爆炸装置提示从具体操作转向通识教育内容。
Conclusion: 把 value 调制写成可学习、可几何编辑的 B-spline 曲面，既能以极小参数开销改善语言模型输出，又提供通过反转或置 -1 系数实现转向与阻断的机制；安全导向的 manifold shaping 目前只有初步实验支持。

papers.title: Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus
papers.abstract_en: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; code and raw experimental records: https://github.com/shi1720/verification-pulses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异步二元寄存器 (asynchronous binary register) 中，外部验证脉冲的时机与寻址决定固定验证预算能否把群体从错误共识的吸引域中拉出：主项为 N·log(x0/b)、修正为 O(√N)，且重复验证目标与验证停止后的自主放大分别贡献方差。16 个多数更新槽位、14 个初始错误时，9 次随机检查越过平均场阈值，但精确模型需 23 次才能达到 95% 最终恢复；作者据此主张在明确的更新契约下做风险校准的重置调度 (risk-calibrated reset scheduling)。
Motivation: 外部验证可以纠正单个输出，却可能让自强化群体仍停留在错误共识的吸引域内；固定验证预算在何时、对谁施加验证才能触发恢复，缺少定量的临界预算刻画。
Method: 对一般非线性响应推导在峰值验证约束下跨越吸引域边界所需的最小燃料；对有限群体用精确 birth–death 计算给出脉冲后仍达错误共识的概率，并导出临界预算窗口的渐近式（主项 N·log(x0/b)，O(√N) 修正，方差分解为重复验证目标与验证后自主放大两部分）；另设前瞻性实验记录 13,392 条语言模型响应，含校准与 108 条 held-out 轨迹。
Result: 16 个 majority-updated 槽位、14 个初始错误时，9 次随机检查越过平均场预算阈值，而精确模型需 23 次才能达到 95% 最终恢复。校准产生不同的拟合响应 regime，但四个 adjusted schedule-comparison 区间全部包含零。分布审计显示中等的均值预测误差可能掩盖对终端共识占据 (terminal consensus occupancy) 的大幅低估。
Conclusion: 平均场阈值会系统性低估达到给定恢复概率所需的真实验证预算，因此重置调度必须按风险校准并绑定明确的更新契约，同时与 distinct-target checking 和无限制证据广播区分开。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能调用精确线性优化 oracle 的投影无关在线凸优化 (projection-free OCO) 中，刻画了维度无关的 minimax 期望 regret：凸 G-Lipschitz 损失、直径 D、总预算 Q 次 oracle 调用、每轮上限 B 次时，regret 为 Θ(GD·max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。下界对任意随机算法成立，上界由带交错块的计数近似梯度法匹配。
Motivation: 投影无关 OCO 中 oracle 调用预算受限（总量与每轮上限）时可达到的 regret 缺少紧的刻画，且需要在每轮都保持可行的严格约束下给出上下界。
Method: 下界先用通用可行性把每个动作限制在给定内切球与此前 oracle 回复的凸包内，再用 fixed-body 构造把新相位方向耦合到共享 simplex，使所有损失共享同一最优点时 oracle 回复仍反复昂贵；上界用带交错块的计数近似梯度法 (counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks)。光滑情形另给解析构造得到依赖曲率 β 的下界。
Result: 维度无关 minimax 期望 regret 为 Θ(GD·max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})；特例包括每轮 1 次调用时的 T^{3/4} 速率，以及达到 √T regret 所需的二次总预算；对给定光滑度 β 得到曲率依赖下界并识别出一般刻画仍保持紧的阈值。
Conclusion: 受限 oracle 预算下投影无关 OCO 的 regret 由 √T 与预算修正项共同决定，上下界匹配，且下界覆盖任意随机算法。

papers.title: System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用字符 n-gram 分类器对单条 LLM 回答做系统归属：截到前 800 字符即可在五个已部署端点间达到 97.84% 准确率，且屏蔽品牌名与大写词后仍有 97.72%。但把回答聚合成 50 个模型×领域×条件单元后，十二项行为特征只分离四个系统到 66.53%，跨领域迁移时把 22 个 gift 单元全部判错——单条回答的表层形式可跨查询领域归属系统，聚合品牌画像不能。
Motivation: AI 可见性审计把已部署语言模型的品牌推荐汇总成 per-system 画像，但这种画像是否真的描述了产生回答的系统本身，此前未经检验。
Method: 在 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 2 月间从五个已部署端点（GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash with search、Grok、Perplexity sonar-pro）采集 6,475 条回答（6,324 条可分析），覆盖 gift-recommendation、corporate-reputation、category-ownership 三类查询；用字符 n-gram 分类器按 prompt 分组交叉验证做系统归属，并与仅长度、24 项格式统计、屏蔽品牌名等消融对比；聚合侧用 50 个模型×领域×条件单元的十二项行为特征加分组交叉验证，对照标签置换零假设。
Result: 单回答归属准确率 97.84%（5,028 条回答、383 个 prompt、多数类 31.5%、30 个 split seeds）；长度单独只有多数类水平，24 项格式统计 95.79%，屏蔽品牌名与大写 token 后 97.72%；留出查询条件下按规模加权 97.43%、不加权 88.0%，检索增强臂中 Grok 回答 0/120 被归给 Grok。聚合画像在分组交叉验证下四个系统仅 66.53%，置换零假设均值 33.71%、95 分位 46.0%；category-ownership 训练的森林把全部 22 个 gift 单元判错，与品牌量反转一致（gift 每回答 8.41 对 0.94 个品牌，category ownership 3.01 对 3.91），而单回答迁移保持 89.92% balanced accuracy。采集截断严重：1,024 token 上限下 83.1% 的 Gemini 3 Flash category-ownership 回答中途截断。
Conclusion: 回答的表层形式（字符 n-gram）携带系统身份并可跨查询领域迁移，聚合的品牌行为不迁移；未交叉的设计无法把系统与领域或 harness 分开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Code and measurement outputs at https://github.com/sushovan4/memorization-audits
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成模型记忆化审计目前只把相似度分数对阈值读，没有零分布，结论会错：按 MemBench 规则约减半的记忆化，在 FDR 控制下有三分之二认证图像在随机 prompt 扰动下不再被检出，六分之五在 attention rescaling 下失效，embedding 优化下全部失效。作者给出两个精确零假设：整模型层面用训练/留出图像的置换检验（留出为随机划分时对任意统计量精确），单图像层面用匹配对照校准；据此 61 张 MemBench 图像在 5% FDR 下认证 36 张，校准分裂中留出对照仅 0.01% 被认证。
Motivation: 记忆化审计普遍拿相似度分数对固定阈值读，没有零分布，导致把不复制的生成器也判为复制、或把缓解措施的效果读错。
Method: 整模型层面：给定模型样本后训练图与留出图可交换，重贴标签即置换检验，在留出图为随机划分时对任意统计量精确；单图像层面：用匹配对照（random images、independent generations）校准零分布，并推荐用 Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile 的小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量。
Result: MemBench 规则下 Stable Diffusion 记忆化约减半，但 FDR 控制下三分之二认证图像在随机 prompt 扰动、六分之五在 attention rescaling、全部在 embedding 优化后不再检出；数据复制检验按自身零分布把 24 个生成器中的 10 个标为复制但其实什么都没复制。置换检验下最近邻偏好在 24 个中仍有 7 个触发，尺度受限计数为 0 个（McNemar p=0.016）。单图像朴素零假设失效：在 2,365 个对照中随机图像排序产生 596 个假发现，独立重采样使零分布窄三倍。校准后 61 张 MemBench 图像在 5% FDR 下认证 36 张，留出对照在 0.01% 的校准分裂中被认证，每图两次生成即可复现该计数；校准最大值统计量认证 46 张。
Conclusion: 记忆化的关键是零分布而非阈值：置换检验加匹配对照校准能把假发现压到可控水平，且应报告尺度受限的 IEC Profile 小尺度质量，它还能统计被复制的不同图像并检验两个模型是否复制同一批。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/shi1720/contingent-exposure-routing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 金融 AI 故障切换 (failover) 会改变共享同一决策错误的机构集合：对称构造下，共享备份在主端点数增长时留下量级为 O(1) 的风险集中下限，而均衡回退风险随存活端点数反比下降。在 60 个合成组合网络、11,340 次情景评估中，保持端点数的 swap 过程在中心反馈设定与独立误差下使风险较独立随机路由分别降低 6.57%（单端点移除）和 10.53%（双端点移除）；1,024 条真实 API 响应回放的再平衡任务上留出集降幅为 3.30%（配对 bootstrap 区间 2.07–4.57%）。
Motivation: 模型 failover 恢复了可用性，却改变了哪些金融机构共享同一决策错误；不可分决策下独立随机路由与分数分配之间的差距缺少可审计的刻画。
Method: 用局部市场冲击响应矩阵形式化 outage 条件下的路由，考察期望平方价格位移；对独立随机路由推导精确二阶矩与有效暴露粒度 (effective-exposure granularity)，用条件期望取整给出无耦合配额的有限智能体界，并设计保持端点计数的 swap 过程，对照对偶下界评估。
Result: 60 个合成组合网络、11,340 次情景评估中，swap 过程在中心反馈设定、独立误差下较独立随机路由降低风险 6.57%（单端点移除）与 10.53%（双端点移除）；1,024 条记录的 API 响应回放到构造的再平衡任务上，留出集降幅 3.30%，配对 bootstrap 区间 2.07–4.57%。强对齐误差、劣质端点与不可分性都会削弱分散化收益。
Conclusion: 作者主张贡献是一套可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析，而非对真实市场崩盘概率的估计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAVE-Mem 把经验记忆从“检索相似经验”改为带类型的经验干预算子 (typed intervention operator)，只有当算子与当前记忆基底、答案契约、证据边界以及交叉拟合效用同时匹配时才改写基础答案，否则弃答 (abstain)。在长期对话记忆、多跳问答与长文档叙事推理三类任务上，相比仅按相关性复用经验取得一致增益。
Motivation: 现有经验记忆系统只优化相关性，把与当前状态相似的搜索经验注入 prompt；但当记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界变化时，相关经验反而有害。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 框架：先得到基础记忆搜索答案，再由经验算子携带 applicability、boundary、utility 三类条件，经交叉拟合 (cross-fitted) 效用判定是否允许改写答案，不匹配即弃答。
Result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答 (multi-hop QA) 与长文档叙事推理三类实验设置上，相对仅按相关性复用经验的策略取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 经验复用的正确门槛不是相似度，而是基底、答案契约、证据边界与效用的联合匹配；不满足时弃答比强行注入更安全。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Compositional Embedding Architecture for Physical Field Prediction in Componentized Aerospace Systems
papers.abstract_en: Spacecraft thermal design requires repeated evaluation of how variations in the number and spatial arrangement of heat-generating components and in thermal boundary conditions affect the temperature field. High-fidelity numerical simulations are computationally expensive and therefore difficult to use for large-scale design screening. Although surrogate models can accelerate temperature-field prediction, existing approaches generally encode each complete configuration as a whole and do not explicitly exploit the reusability of local physical constituents across configurations, which limits their accuracy for component counts and combinations not covered during training. To address this issue, we propose the Tree-Structured Factor Composition Network (TFCN), which decomposes complex spacecraft thermal configurations into reusable local physical factors and employs a tree-structured composition module to learn the global temperature-field response associated with different factor combinations. TFCN is evaluated on two-dimensional steady-state spacecraft thermal-analysis cases with prescribed-temperature and radiative-flux boundary conditions. The model is trained exclusively on configurations containing no more than 15 heat-generating components and evaluated on unseen configurations containing 16-25 components. For the prescribed-temperature and radiative-flux cases, TFCN achieves component-count out-of-distribution RMSE values of 4.21 K and 18.62 K, respectively, representing reductions of 65.6% and 33.6% relative to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that TFCN improves the reliability of temperature-field prediction under variations in component count and provides an efficient surrogate for rapid spacecraft thermal-design evaluation and large-scale configuration screening.

papers.title: How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结 DINOv2+PCA 残差排名的少样本异常检测上，证明任何确定性、一致有效、分布无关的 95% UCB 在 α=0.20/0.10/0.05 下至少需要 14/29/59 个 iid 类别抽样，且只是必要条件。目标类 LOIO 校准受 1/(k+1) 分辨率下限约束，α=0.20 时高斯腐蚀 MVTec、k=4 的经验 FAR 达 0.341，为名义值的 1.7 倍；CRESS 协议在仅 3–4 个认证类别时全部 960 个冻结配置都返回 fail-closed 阈值 τ*=0。
Motivation: 少样本异常检测只用排序指标评价，但部署需要可控误报率 (FAR) 的报警阈值；目标类自身图像校准受排名分辨率与分布偏移限制，而跨类迁移的可靠性声明缺少分布无关的可行性判据。
Method: 用冻结 DINOv2 特征加 PCA 残差排名器，在 15 个 MVTec 与 12 个 VisA 类别、四种腐蚀类型上做目标类 leave-one-image-out (LOIO) 校准；推导类别计数可行性下界（全零类别损失、不计多重性下的确定性一致有效分布无关 95% UCB）；提出 CRESS 协议，把源类别拆成 reference、proposal、certification 三个不相交角色。
Result: LOIO 排名值下限为 1/(k+1)，在可达的 α=0.20 下，高斯腐蚀 MVTec、k=4 的经验 FAR 为 0.341，是名义水平的 1.7 倍。分布无关 95% UCB 所需 iid 类别抽样数至少为 14（α=0.20）、29（α=0.10）、59（α=0.05），且仅为必要条件。CRESS 在 3–4 个认证类别下全部 960 个冻结配置返回 τ*=0，最小类别级 UCB 为 0.950；同一档案的图像单元分析在 36.7%–60.3% 的目标单元选出正阈值。
Conclusion: 类别级分布无关可靠性声明在少类别预算下不可行，fail-closed 是正确输出；图像单元的正阈值只对选定源混合成立，不能外推为新类别抽样的边际风险。

papers.title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
papers.abstract_en: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一语料用两种互不相容但都正确的约定书写，学习率调度本身就是排序效应的平均算子：衰减调度把大步长与未收缩余项隔开，恒定调度则在最后一步同时给出二者。恒定速率下十种排序的 allocation 跨度 0.2221、11.63 个 contrast floor 且随 block 程度单调；单一 cosine 下同样十臂只剩两个可分辨状态。acc_A+acc_B 在十二臂内守恒到 9.7% 以内而 allocation share 从 0.04 到 0.87，故 12.29σ 的排序开关在约定无关指标下恰为零；在 prompt 中标注约定可消除该开关并达到 union ceiling 的 87.5%。
Motivation: 在两种互不相容约定上训练时，排序究竟写进参数什么，此前只被当作背景条件的 learning-rate schedule 实际决定答案；exact-match 类基准看不见模型倒向哪个约定。
Method: 对同一语料构造十种排序，固定预算、除路径外一切不变，按 lr_scheduler_type 分族各跑两遍；证明一个界，使 arrangement（以 block period 出现）与 schedule（以端点权重出现）作为相乘因子分离，并对两半分别做受控测量。
Result: 恒定速率下 interior 跨度 0.2221 allocation、11.63 contrast floors，且随排序被 block 的程度单调；单一 cosine 下同样十臂只落在两个可分辨状态，而其自身分辨率本可分辨约十个。十二臂中 acc_A+acc_B 守恒在 9.7% 以内，allocation share 从 0.04 到 0.87，对应 12.29σ 的 arrangement 效应在约定无关指标下恰为零；prompt 中标注约定后开关消失，达到 union ceiling 的 87.5%。
Conclusion: 路径写进参数的是模型承诺哪个约定而非能力，'order matters' 与 'order does not matter' 是同一旋钮的两端；守恒量取自 decayed 家族，恒定速率族噪声更大。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
papers.abstract_en: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带说服预算 β 的对抗性信号博弈中，随着 β 增大，最优信号从后验最大化选项转向边际最大化（salience）选项；在 200,000 条池上两者仅在 2,748 条上不同，且恰好落在先验 salience-to-Bayes 坐标未定义处。作者据此指出：评估对抗感知时若稳健目标与启发式目标在评测项上重合，任何测量都无法区分二者，应先做这一廉价诊断。
Motivation: 受限信号通道中引入知情对抗者后，稳健最优与既有工作的 salience 极点可能重合，使对抗感知的实证评估在结构上无法区分两种解释。
Method: 把对抗者引入 forced-choice 任务（抽象自 Deception: Murder in Hong Kong）：对抗者知道目标、观察信号并以说服预算 β 为最强错误答案辩护；β=0 时退化为原 oracle 模型（听众温度 τ=1）。在 108 条确证项与 200,000 条池上计算各条的临界预算，并用七个语言模型做对抗框架干预。
Result: 108 条确证项上对抗稳健最优与先验 salience 极点完全对齐；200,000 条池上两者仅在 2,748 条不同；18.2% 的池在有限预算下最优会移动，且每条的临界预算是精确的。两种对抗框架使七个语言模型在 108 条中的 30 到 77 条上改变所选答案，超出精确的无效应率。
Conclusion: 稳健最优与 salience 目标在评测项上重合是结构性限制而非空结果；评估对抗感知前应先检查稳健目标是否与启发式目标重合。

papers.title: Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定大小循环记忆在 32 KiB 矩阵状态下可学会 32 组新 key-value 配对的高精度召回：三随机种子平均准确率 99.95%，前置填充扩到 1,798 token 仍接近完美，而清零首个记忆块后召回消失。参数匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线（含额外训练搜索后）仍接近随机，作者据此判定无法做记忆效率对比。
Motivation: 固定尺寸循环记忆的存储不随推理增长，但召回能否成功取决于任务与训练方式；参数匹配的基线为何失败尚未解释，直接阻碍记忆效率的公平比较。
Method: 研究一个小型 DeltaNet 变体，为每个 token 固定专属 key bias，在序列上训练记住 32 组新 key-value 配对；用 32 KiB 循环矩阵状态做召回，配以清零首个记忆块的消融、48-pair 探索性测试，以及参数匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线（含额外训练搜索）。
Result: 32 KiB 状态下三训练种子平均准确率 99.95%；前置填充使查询前上下文达 1,798 token 而不增加配对数时召回仍接近完美；清零首个记忆块后召回消失；48-pair 探索测试在主训练预算四分之一后仍接近随机且未定位容量上限；参数匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线接近随机，Transformer 经额外训练搜索后依旧如此。
Conclusion: 固定矩阵状态足以在 32 配对任务上实现近乎完美的召回，且首个记忆块是必要条件；但基线的未解失败使记忆效率比较无法成立，48-pair 上也尚未看到容量上限。

papers.title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
papers.abstract_en: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).
papers.comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Data paper. Dataset openly available at https://zenodo.org/records/20451474. Under review at the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Build2SPARQL 是面向建筑知识图谱 (KG) 的大规模 text-to-SPARQL 基准：SPARQL 查询完全由图遍历代码生成并校验，LLM 只负责把查询改写成自然语言问题，从而让查询正确性独立于模型行为。在 201 个建筑 KG 上产出 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 与 30,680 个问题；检索增强评测中三个开源模型的 exact-match 准确率从零样本 0.2–20% 提到三样本检索式 56–65%。
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统正被表示为 Brick、ASHRAE 223P 等本体下的语义 KG，但自然语言/SPARQL 大规模基准稀缺，制约了用语言代理查询这些建筑图谱的进展。
Method: KG-grounded 生成流水线：SPARQL 查询由图遍历代码生成并校验，LLM 仅生成自然语言问题；挖掘六类查询模式（linear chains、branching、UNION、aggregation、OPTIONAL、attribute-filtered），每条查询用五种词汇语域 (vocabulary registers) 表述，应用于 201 个建筑 KG（180 Brick、21 ASHRAE 223P）。
Result: 产出 6,136 条可执行 SPARQL 查询与 30,680 个问题；双评审对 300 个问题的人工验证得到语义保真度 98.8%、自然度 98.8%、操作合理性 84.0%；在三个开源模型上的检索增强评测中 exact-match 准确率由零样本 0.2–20% 提升至三样本检索式 56–65%。
Conclusion: 把查询生成与校验完全交给图遍历代码、只让 LLM 负责语言表述，可以在不牺牲查询正确性的前提下规模化建筑 KG 的 text-to-SPARQL 基准；检索式 few-shot 显著抬高开源模型的 exact-match 表现。

papers.title: Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner
papers.abstract_en: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用冻结子集、只改训练学习者的干预证明：easy-first 与几何覆盖两类 coreset 选择准则之间的预算 crossover 边界由学习者决定而非数据本身。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上把 ResNet-18 宽度加倍，crossover 从每类 57 个样本移到 85 个；换成 ViT 后覆盖准则在全部测量范围内获胜。作者的直接建议是：选择策略偏好的预算区间必须针对目标学习者来评估。
Motivation: Coreset 选择默认样本价值是数据的固有属性，但 easy-first 与几何覆盖准则各有胜出的预算区间，这个边界是否随目标学习者变化并不清楚。
Method: 受控实验冻结被选子集、只操纵训练学习者：改变 ResNet-18 宽度、输入网格分辨率与 stride（含仅去掉最后一次下采样 stride），并在 ImageNet-100 低分辨率与 ImageNet-1k native-224px 两种协议下用 LFrac、EL2N 探针测量，最后把卷积学习系统换成 ViT。
Result: 低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上 ResNet-18 宽度加倍使 crossover 从每类 57 移到 85 个样本；放大输入网格（图像信息不变）使边界左移，且该左移随宽度增加而减弱；stride 操纵可复现并反转网格效应，仅去掉最后一次下采样 stride 即足以恢复左移。ImageNet-1k native-224px 下宽度效应更小且依赖探针：LFrac 几乎持平，EL2N 温和右移。换成 ViT 后覆盖准则在测量范围内全程胜出，即使 easy 子集来自卷积代理。
Conclusion: 样本价值只相对于学习者定义，网络结构（宽度、输入网格、stride、架构族）能移动 crossover 边界；这些结果不构成普适 scaling law，实践上选择策略的预算偏好必须按目标学习者评估。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviGraph 把公共服务推荐中的决策需求分成「必须证实的关键项」与「可悬置的未决项」，由语言 agent 在时序知识图谱上把关键项链接到证据，再用确定性 checker 判定推荐是否被证据支撑。在香港双语公共服务基准上，这一区分减少了不必要的弃权；但继续追加验证会撤回本已受支撑的推荐，却不提升决策质量。
Motivation: 公共服务推荐要求证据与所请求的服务、范围和日期对齐，而把每个缺失细节都当成决定性条件会扣住本可用的推荐；同时盲目堆叠验证又会误撤正确推荐。
Method: EviGraph 区分关键决策需求与可保持未决的信息，由语言 agent 将这些需求链接到时序知识图谱 (temporal knowledge graph) 中的证据，并由确定性 checker 判定推荐是否被证据支撑；评测使用带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准。
Result: 在带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上，关键/非关键需求的区分减少了不必要的弃权；追加验证会撤回已受支撑的推荐，且决策质量没有提升。
Conclusion: 可靠的证据式导航取决于事先说清哪些内容必须为决策建立，而不是简单叠加更多验证环节。

papers.title: Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DP-SGD 训练的扩散式能源时间序列插补中，cosine 调度的后期低 SNR 步会使 ε-prediction 产生大 pre-clipping 梯度并被裁剪，损失有效信号。改用 v-prediction 配合 diffusion-schedule-aware 动态损失加权（静态加权作对照），在五个真实能源数据集的四类缺失场景下，插补效用一致优于 ε-prediction 基线，且 pre-clipping 梯度范数上尾更小、裁剪比例更低。
Motivation: 能源细粒度时间序列含敏感时间信息，需用 DP-SGD 训练的扩散模型做隐私保护插补；但固定阈值 DP-SGD 下目标函数与裁剪的相互作用使后期低 SNR 步的优化信号被裁剪掉。
Method: 把目标-裁剪相互作用形式化为固定阈值 DP-SGD 下的目标优化问题，提出 timestep-aware objective conditioning：用 v-prediction 缓解后期梯度放大，静态损失加权作统一缩放对照，并引入 diffusion-schedule-aware 动态加权在裁剪前更强衰减。
Result: 在五个真实世界能源时间序列数据集上，覆盖随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续中断及多种缺失严重度；在匹配的 DP-SGD 设置下，该方法插补效用一致优于 ε-prediction 基线，梯度诊断显示 pre-clipping 梯度范数上尾更低、裁剪比例下降、低 SNR 后期步衰减更强。
Conclusion: clipping-aware objective conditioning（v-prediction 加调度感知动态加权）能在不改 DP-SGD 阈值的前提下保住更多优化信号，从而提升隐私训练扩散模型的能源序列插补质量。

summary_sections.motivation: 能源细粒度时间序列含敏感时间信息，需用 DP-SGD 训练的扩散模型做隐私保护插补；但固定阈值 DP-SGD 下目标函数与裁剪的相互作用使后期低 SNR 步的优化信号被裁剪掉。

summary_sections.conclusion: clipping-aware objective conditioning（v-prediction 加调度感知动态加权）能在不改 DP-SGD 阈值的前提下保住更多优化信号，从而提升隐私训练扩散模型的能源序列插补质量。

papers.title: ShatterQuant: Breaking Uniform Precision with Block-Wise Mixed-Precision on a Systolic Transformer Hardware Accelerator
papers.abstract_en: Due to limited support for intra-tensor heterogeneous precision in conventional accelerators, neural network quantization remains largely restricted to per-tensor precision assignment. We present ShatterQuant, a hardware-software co-designed framework enabling mixed-precision quantization within each tensor by assigning independent bit-widths to blocks of a weight projection. ShatterQuant couples precision granularity with PE configuration, such that each precision determines an effective block height. We introduce (1) a hardware-aware post-training method that assigns intra-tensor precision based on block-level standard deviation and weight sensitivity; (2) the ShatterQuant Transformer Accelerator supporting 1/2/4/8-bit weight precision, precision-dependent PE configuration, block rescaling, and integrated softmax and piecewise-linear nonlinearities; and (3) an evaluation of model-hardware tradeoffs using an implementation in the TSMC 16nm PDK operating at 1 GHz, achieving 1.5 TOPS, 760 GOPS/$mm^2$ area efficiency, and 2.8 TOPS/W energy efficiency. On DeiT and ImageNet-1K, ShatterQuant achieves accuracy within $3.3\%$ of state-of-the-art mixed-precision techniques while using a 2 bit lower effective bitwidth, while for PixelDiT demonstrates comparable generation quality. ShatterQuant demonstrates how fine-grained intra-tensor mixed-precision can be realized through hardware-software co-design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShatterQuant 把混合精度从 per-tensor 推进到张量内部 block 级：按 block 标准差与权重敏感度分配 1/2/4/8-bit，并让每种精度决定 PE 的有效 block 高度，硬件与量化粒度耦合。在 TSMC 16nm、1 GHz 下达到 1.5 TOPS、760 GOPS/mm²、2.8 TOPS/W；DeiT 与 ImageNet-1K 上精度与 SOTA 混合精度方法相差 3.3% 以内，但有效位宽低 2 bit，PixelDiT 生成质量相当。
Motivation: 常规加速器缺少张量内异构精度支持，量化只能停在 per-tensor 位宽分配，细粒度混合精度因此难以落到硬件上。
Method: 硬件-软件协同设计：(1) 硬件感知的 post-training 方法，依据 block 级标准差与权重敏感度分配张量内精度；(2) ShatterQuant Transformer Accelerator，支持 1/2/4/8-bit 权重、随精度变化的 PE 配置、block rescaling，以及集成 softmax 与分段线性非线性；(3) 在 TSMC 16nm PDK、1 GHz 上做模型-硬件权衡评估。
Result: 硬件指标：1.5 TOPS、760 GOPS/mm² 面积效率、2.8 TOPS/W 能效。DeiT 与 ImageNet-1K 上精度在 SOTA 混合精度技术的 3.3% 以内，同时有效位宽低 2 bit；PixelDiT 上生成质量相当。
Conclusion: 细粒度张量内混合精度可以通过硬件-软件协同设计实现，把精度粒度与 PE 配置绑定即可在更低有效位宽下保持精度。

papers.title: Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding
papers.abstract_en: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉 token 压缩从「选哪些 token 留下」改写成「全部留下、按率失真分配码率」：对每个 token 建立实测 distortion–rate 曲线，用精确整数率失真优化在固定比特预算下分配码率，全程不引入文本。在两个数据集、两种模型容量、等比特预算下，该方法比均匀码率编码、闭式 water-fill 和按失真排序的剪枝更能保持模型输出分布与答案；在按问题调优的那个问题上与 attention 排序剪枝打平，一旦同一压缩图像要回答另一个问题则反超。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩几乎都当作选择问题，且按语言模型给 token 的 attention 排序，排序结果依赖所提的问题；这在单轮基准里看不出来，但在压缩表示写一次、读多次的场景（跨对话轮次缓存、设备与服务器之间传输）是决定性的。
Method: 取经典 transform coding 的另一半：保留全部 token 而改变其码率。对每个 token 暴露实测的 distortion–rate 曲线，在固定比特预算下用精确整数率失真优化 (exact integer rate–distortion optimisation) 在这些曲线上分配码率；流水线中不使用任何文本，因此同一压缩表示可服务任意查询。
Result: 在两个数据集、两种容量、等比特预算下，该方法在保持模型输出分布与其答案上优于 uniform-rate coding、闭式 water-fill 和 distortion-ranked pruning；在 attention 排序剪枝被调优的那个问题上与之持平，当压缩后的图像需要回答同一图像的另一个问题时超过它。
Conclusion: 视觉 token 压缩在写一次读多次的场景下应按率失真分配码率而非按 attention 选择 token：不依赖问题的压缩表示在换问题后比按问题调优的剪枝更稳。

papers.title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 RLVR 合成干扰项语料的因果审计：在 GooseReason-0.7M 上，仅用 5 个表层统计量的分类器在 315,499 个选项上 AUROC 只有 0.562，但代码子集降到 0.416（低于随机），因为代码干扰项是金标准答案的单算子突变而非自由撰写。配对改写对照语料、固定训练集规模与预算的干预实验中，未修改数据臂的 exploitation gap 为 0.021，反而低于对照臂的 0.027——可检测的伪影在该预算下未被策略利用。
Motivation: RLVR 管线用「遮蔽真实文本再让模型编错误答案」造数据，正确项是真人散文、干扰项全是合成的，正确性与来源纠缠，策略可能学到来源而非正确性；需要区分「伪影可检测」与「模型真的在用它」。
Method: 在 GooseReason-0.7M 上先做可检测性审计：只用 5 个表层统计量（不看语义）训练分类器，覆盖 315,499 个选项并按域拆分；再做干预——构建 paraphrase-matched 对照语料，保持两臂训练集规模一致，在同一固定预算下训练两个策略，比较 exploitation gap。审计协议以 CPU 为主并连同代码与数据一同发布。
Result: 表层分类器整体 AUROC 0.562（315,499 个选项，仅略高于随机）；代码子集 AUROC 0.416，低于随机，人工检查显示代码干扰项是金标准答案的单算子突变。干预中 exploitation gap 为 0.021（未修改数据臂）对 0.027（对照臂），差距不偏向未修改数据臂。
Conclusion: 在该预算下可检测的数据伪影并未被策略利用，正确性与来源的纠缠不等于捷径学习；语料构建方式是域相关的（代码干扰项构造机制不同），审计应按域拆开看而非只看聚合指标。

papers.title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
papers.abstract_en: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对对话幽默的自动奖励，检验两类奖励（基于 embedding 的 surprise 与预测观众笑声）的可利用漏洞及对策：surprise 奖励把打乱词序的回复与机智回复同等接受，笑声预测则被任一方消息中的笑声线索攻破。跨说话人归一化这些线索可挡住已覆盖攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可利用；最终一轮 RL 训练把综合评分提高 0.0903、零分 session 减少 40%，仍低于预注册目标。
Motivation: 用自动奖励训练语言模型的对话幽默时，奖励本身可被捷径利用，而反制措施可能误伤本应鼓励的机智行为，需要在阻断漏洞与保留目标行为之间取舍。
Method: 设计两类奖励：embedding-based surprise reward 与预测观众笑声的 audience model；用受控测试（词序打乱回复、笑声线索注入）探测漏洞，依次加入 fluency filter 与跨说话人线索归一化，并以三轮强化学习训练评估逐版修订的奖励。
Result: 受控测试显示 surprise 奖励同等接受词序打乱与机智回复；fluency filter 能检出打乱但会拒绝部分机智回复且未通过进一步验证；跨说话人归一化阻断已覆盖攻击，未匹配表达仍可利用。三轮 RL 中最终一轮使综合评估分提高 0.0903、零分 session 减少 40%，幽默专项改进低于预注册目标。
Conclusion: 自动奖励设计的普遍难题是反制措施必须封堵可利用捷径，同时保留奖励原本想鼓励的行为；本例中最终奖励修订仍未达到预注册的幽默改进目标。

papers.title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

TL;DR: 在心脏超声视频描述生成中，GPEC 作为 pre-LLM 模块插在 VideoChat2 的视觉投影层与语言模型之间，用稀疏变分高斯过程学一个残差修正，把投影后的视觉表征拉向由结构化标注构造的参考描述嵌入。相比原版 VideoChat2，描述相似度与内容对齐均提升，每段视频推理开销增加不足 0.05 秒，且骨干网络全程冻结。
Motivation: 多模态大模型在超声心动图这类专科医学影像域上描述性能下降，而端到端微调整个预训练骨干代价高，需要一种轻量的表征级修正手段。

Conclusion: 在专科医学视频域上，冻结骨干、仅在 LLM 之前做高斯过程残差修正即可提升描述生成质量，且计算开销极小，无需端到端微调。

papers.title: GS-PQM: A Parameter-Domain Quality Metric for Compressed Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Gaussian Splatting (GS) compression have enabled substantial reductions in GS model size. Reliable objective quality assessment is therefore essential for comparing compression methods and guiding the development of more efficient GS codecs. Existing GS quality assessment typically relies on image and video quality metrics, requiring rendering of predefined viewpoints and making the quality estimate dependent on the selected views. This paper introduces GS-PQM, a novel full-reference quality metric for post-training GS compression that operates directly in the GS parameter domain. GS-PQM estimates perceptual quality from a set of parameter-domain distortion errors using a Support Vector Regression model. Experimental results show that GS-PQM outperforms 25 existing image, video, and point-cloud quality metrics in assessing compressed GS content, providing an accurate and computationally efficient alternative to rendering-based quality assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GS-PQM：一个直接在 Gaussian Splatting 参数域上计算的全参考质量指标，用参数域失真误差经 Support Vector Regression (SVR) 估计感知质量，无需渲染预设视角。在压缩 GS 内容评估上，GS-PQM 超过 25 个现有图像、视频与点云质量指标，且计算更高效。
Motivation: GS 压缩已能大幅缩减模型体积，但现有 GS 质量评估依赖图像/视频指标，必须渲染预设视角，质量估计随所选视角变化而不可靠。
Method: GS-PQM 面向 post-training GS 压缩，直接在 GS 参数域取一组失真误差作为特征，用 Support Vector Regression 模型映射为感知质量分数，属于全参考 (full-reference) 指标，绕开渲染环节。
Result: 在压缩 GS 内容的质量评估上，GS-PQM 优于 25 个现有图像、视频与点云质量指标，并被描述为比基于渲染的评估更准确且计算更高效。
Conclusion: 参数域失真加回归建模可以替代渲染视角采样，成为压缩 Gaussian Splatting 的质量评估路径。

papers.title: Improving scoring functions for protein-protein docking with LambdaLoss
papers.abstract_en: Modeling protein-protein interactions requires accurate scoring functions that can rank potential poses (conformations) of a protein-protein complex to differentiate near-native poses from incorrect ones. Here, we propose a general framework for improving protein-protein pose ranking and other biomolecular interaction models using the LambdaLoss loss function from the Learning-to-Rank field. We test this framework by fine-tuning the energy prediction head of DFMDock with the LambdaLoss on an augmented dataset of 2.9M decoy poses derived from the DIPS dataset. On targets from the CAPRI score set benchmark, our fine-tuned ranking model LambdaDockScore is better at identifying correct poses in its top-1 and top-5 predictions compared to EuDockScore, a state-of-the-art method. LambdaDockScore also improves upon baseline DFMDock ranking performance for scoring antibody-antigen complexes and protein-protein complexes with very large or small binding interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Learning-to-Rank 的 LambdaLoss 用于蛋白-蛋白对接打分：在 2.9M decoy poses（源自 DIPS）上微调 DFMDock 的能量预测头，得到 LambdaDockScore。在 CAPRI score set 上，其 top-1 与 top-5 识别正确构象的能力优于 SOTA 方法 EuDockScore，并在抗体-抗原及界面极大/极小的复合物上提升基线 DFMDock 排序。
Motivation: 对接需要打分函数把近天然构象 (near-native poses) 与错误构象排序区分开，而现有能量预测模型在 CAPRI 类基准上的 top-k 命中仍有差距。
Method: 以 Learning-to-Rank 中的 LambdaLoss 微调 DFMDock 的能量预测头，训练数据为由 DIPS 数据集扩充得到的 2.9M decoy poses，得到排序模型 LambdaDockScore。
Result: 在 CAPRI score set 上，LambdaDockScore 的 top-1 与 top-5 正确构象识别优于 SOTA 方法 EuDockScore；相对基线 DFMDock，抗体-抗原复合物以及界面非常大或非常小的蛋白-蛋白复合物排序性能均有提升。
Conclusion: Learning-to-Rank 损失可作为通用框架改进蛋白-蛋白对接及其它生物分子相互作用模型的构象排序，尤其在界面尺度极端与抗体-抗原场景。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.
papers.comment: To appear at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于语义熵、几何曲率与纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并用强化学习 agent 在用户给定的显存预算下学习细分策略，替代手工阈值。生成的多分辨率 TSDF 在合成与真实数据集上相对 MAP-ADAPT 和固定分辨率基线取得更高几何精度、更好语义一致性与更优的内存-精度权衡。
Motivation: 固定分辨率体素网格在平坦区域浪费内存、在复杂区域丢失细节；MAP-ADAPT 等自适应方法依赖几何与人工语义类别表，需专家调参、对未见物体泛化差，且没有显式控制内存占用的机制。
Method: 以语义熵（标签不确定性）加上几何曲率与纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索决定体素细分，不依赖语义分类表；再训练一个 RL agent 在用户指定的目标内存预算下学习细分策略，把手工阈值换成单一控制参数，输出多分辨率 TSDF。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，相对 MAP-ADAPT 与固定分辨率基线取得更高几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把复杂度线索与预算约束下的 RL 策略结合，可以在不依赖语义类别表的前提下按显存预算显式控制体素分辨率分配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: White Men Without Degrees Receive the Lowest Ratings from Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: White men without an undergraduate degree receive the lowest average ratings among eight gender-race-education groups in controlled large-language-model evaluations of credit, hiring, and rental applications. We conduct full-factorial vignette experiments with 18 models from 12 developer groups, varying gender, race, age, citizenship, and education while holding stated financial or occupational circumstances constant within each setting. Each model evaluates all 32 profiles ten times per setting, yielding 17,280 ratings. Averaging over models, age, and citizenship, ratings for White men without degrees are the lowest among the eight groups, at 75.87 in credit, 92.71 in hiring, and 86.62 in rental housing on a 0-100 scale. Black women with degrees receive the highest average ratings, with corresponding gaps of 2.94, 3.66, and 3.56 points. Separate attribute effects favor women, Black applicants, and degree holders in all three settings. White men without degrees have the lowest or second-lowest mean in 46 of 54 model-scenario combinations (85.2%). This pattern connects to evidence of growing economic and health vulnerabilities among White men without degrees, highlighting a group whose disadvantages can be obscured by broad racial or gender categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 18 个大模型在信贷、招聘、租房三类申请情境做全因子 vignette 实验，无本科学历的白人男性在八个性别-种族-学历组合中平均评分最低，信贷 75.87、招聘 92.71、租房 86.62（0–100 分）。在 54 个模型-情境组合中有 46 个（85.2%）该组均值排最低或次低，说明按宽泛的种族或性别类别统计会掩盖这一群体的劣势。
Motivation: LLM 决策偏见评估多按单一属性切分，种族与性别、学历的交互可能让某个具体子群体的系统性低分被聚合类别掩盖。
Method: 全因子 vignette 实验：32 份档案在性别、种族、年龄、公民身份、学历上变化，同时固定陈述的财务或职业状况；覆盖 18 个模型、12 个开发方，每个模型在每个情境下对全部 32 份档案各评 10 次，共 17,280 次评分，情境为信贷、招聘、租房申请。
Result: 跨模型、年龄与公民身份平均后，无学历白人男性评分最低：信贷 75.87、招聘 92.71、租房 86.62（0–100）；有学历黑人女性最高，对应差距 2.94、3.66、3.56 分。三个情境中单独的属性效应均偏向女性、黑人申请人与有学历者；该组在 54 个模型-情境组合中的 46 个（85.2%）均值最低或次低。
Conclusion: LLM 在受控条件下对无学历白人男性给出系统性最低评分，作者据此指出这一群体的劣势会被宽泛的种族或性别类别掩盖。

papers.title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
papers.abstract_en: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing. The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero. The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate. Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 tables. Code and measurement scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718897
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一协议下比较四种让分类器边训练边增长的决策，证明其中最自然的一种——把软决策树叶子变成门、两个子节点继承父节点类别分布——新增门的梯度恒为零，因而该层永远学不到东西；对子节点加一个很小的随机扰动即可修复。
Motivation: 构造式增长（加层、加单元、分裂叶子）被广泛使用，但每种增长决策到底带来什么收益缺少统一测量，其中一种增长方式可能在数学上根本无法学习。
Method: 在树结构与构造式模型上用固定协议比较四种增长决策；对软决策树加深给出梯度恒零的证明，并与 Net2Net 的噪声破对称、分裂最速下降的二阶信息逃逸鞍点对比；修复方式是对子节点加小幅随机扰动；实验为三个随机种子的五折交叉验证，代码与测量脚本已发布。
Result: 继承父节点类别分布的加深方式相对同深度从头训练，Iris 准确率损失 19.6 点、Wine 19.1 点、Digits 55.6 点；对残差拟合新隐单元在所有数据集上得到更小网络但不更准，且在 Digits 上显著损失准确率；按最大期望误差分裂叶子以 3.7 次分裂达到 0.885 稀疏度（完整深度六树需 63 次分裂），但在更难问题上损失 4.3 点；要求统计显著性才允许更富表达力的分裂则让树更大且更不准确。
Conclusion: 新增参数后必须断言其梯度非零——此处一阶信息不是弱而是完全缺失，随机扰动的大小几乎不敏感。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种加权关联规则分类方法用于乳腺癌诊断，含 Rule Generation、Rule Pruning、Rule Prediction 三个核心算法：先挖掘频繁项集生成规则，再按对训练数据的影响把规则分成主/次组并剪枝，最后用剪枝后的规则对测试样本分类。在若干测试样本上检验了可行性与性能。
Motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡的主要原因之一，早期检测需求迫切；关联规则挖掘的结果对医务人员可读性好，但需要改进分类方式以兼顾准确性与规则可解释性。
Method: 基于加权分类思路的关联规则数据挖掘流程：Rule Generation 识别频繁项集并生成关联规则；Rule Pruning 按特定准则剔除规则，并依据规则对训练数据的影响力分为 major 与 minor 两组；Rule Prediction 用剪枝后的规则对测试数据做分类。
Result: 最终预测算法在若干测试样本上得到检验，用于展示该方法的可行性与性能；摘要未给出具体准确率或对比数值。
Conclusion: 加权关联规则分类配合分组剪枝可作为乳腺癌分类的可解释方案，其卖点是规则对医学专业人员易于理解。

papers.title: When the AI Leaves the Tailorshop: Measuring What an LLM Advisor Leaves Behind in Complex Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Complex problem solving depends on acting effectively and understanding how a system works. AI advice may support these outcomes unequally. Two preregistered experiments compared participants managing a simulated clothing factory with and without an LLM advisor. Across studies, AI-supported participants reported greater confidence and understanding with less effort. In the first study (N=200), assistance increased company value but produced no detectable prediction-accuracy difference. After withdrawal, previously supported participants outperformed controls when decisions were scored against repeating previous choices, but not default settings. Within the AI-supported group, more frequent recommendation alterations predicted better unaided performance. In the second study (N=198), AI-supported participants went bankrupt less often and showed a small knowledge advantage in the registered analysis, largely associated with remaining solvent. More frequent recommendation alterations predicted higher knowledge within the AI-supported group. Applied HAI evaluation should assess users' understanding and independent capability alongside the performance achieved with AI support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两项预注册实验让被试经营模拟服装厂，比较有无 LLM 顾问：AI 辅助者自信与理解更高、投入努力更少，第一项 (N=200) 中企业价值上升但预测准确度无可检测差异，第二项 (N=198) 中破产更少、注册分析显示小幅知识优势。顾问建议被修改得越频繁，撤除辅助后的独立表现与知识越好；作者主张 HAI 评估应同时考核用户理解与独立能力，而不只看有 AI 时的成绩。
Motivation: AI 建议可能不均衡地支撑结果表现与对系统的理解，而应用型 HAI 评估通常只看有 AI 辅助时的成绩，忽略用户撤除辅助后的独立能力。
Method: 两项预注册实验，被试在模拟服装厂管理任务中有或没有 LLM 顾问；第一项 N=200，第二项 N=198，撤除辅助后按重复先前选择与默认设置两种计分方式打分，并在 AI 辅助组内回归建议修改频率对独立表现与知识的预测作用。
Result: 第一项 N=200：辅助提高公司价值，预测准确度无可检测差异；撤除后按重复先前选择计分优于对照，按默认设置计分不优；辅助组内建议修改频率越高，无辅助表现越好。第二项 N=198：AI 辅助者破产更少，注册分析显示小幅知识优势（主要来自保持偿付），组内建议修改频率越高知识越高。两项研究中 AI 辅助者自信与理解更高、努力更少。
Conclusion: AI 辅助能提升结果与主观信心，但独立能力的证据依赖计分方式且幅度小；应用 HAI 评估应把用户理解与独立能力同有 AI 时的成绩一起考核。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Symmetry Discovery in Quantum Learning: Observable-Level and Task-Level Inference from Finite Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry reduces the capacity of a quantum learning model, but the imposed group must match both the measured information and the label transformation. We establish a finite-measurement theory for inferring this group from candidate transformations. The central structural result identifies observable-invisible transformations with the stabilizer of a projected state whenever the probe span is invariant. It turns recovered generators into a valid subgroup and identifies the continuous invisible space with its Lie algebra. For finite dictionaries, an unbiased shadow statistic distinguishes zero from positive squared expectation discrepancies with an inverse-gap measurement rate, improving the inverse-square-gap rate of uniform discrepancy estimation. A commuting qubit lower bound proves the gap dependence optimal at fixed snapshot scale, and simultaneous intervals support data-dependent tolerances. Task validation then tests either the joint distribution through a characteristic kernel or its encoded mean through a classical--quantum discrepancy. An exact group-average identity relates the latter to joint-state asymmetry and specifies its conversion to binary task breaking mass. Projection bias quantifies the cost of excessive symmetry, while an $\ell_1$ readout bound quantifies the capacity gained by relaxing it. At an invariant pure-state backbone, retained and nontrivial breaking sectors are Fisher-orthogonal. Ising-chain calculations connect finite-shot recovery, label-dependent symmetry, and physical sector drift. These results determine which symmetry the measurements support and provide the statistical and geometric basis for a subsequent release decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文为量子学习中的对称性发现建立有限测量理论：把测量不可见的变换刻画为投影态在探针张成不变时的 stabilizer，恢复出的生成元构成合法子群，其连续不可见空间即该子群的 Lie 代数。有限候选字典上，unbiased shadow statistic 以 inverse-gap 测量率区分零与正的平方期望差异，优于均匀差异估计的 inverse-square-gap 率；对易 qubit 下界证明该 gap 依赖在固定 snapshot 规模下最优。
Motivation: 对称性约束能压缩量子学习模型容量，但所施加的群必须同时匹配可观测信息与标签变换；从有限测量中判定测量究竟支持哪个群，此前缺少统计与几何层面的判据。
Method: 建立有限测量下从候选变换推断群的理论：以探针张成不变性把 observable-invisible 变换等同于投影态的 stabilizer，由恢复的生成元生成子群并对应其 Lie 代数；用 unbiased shadow statistic 做差异检验并给出 simultaneous intervals 支持数据依赖容差；任务侧用 characteristic kernel 检验联合分布，或用 classical--quantum discrepancy 检验编码均值，经精确群平均恒等式换算为二元任务破坏质量；再以 projection bias 量化过度对称的代价、以 ℓ1 readout bound 量化放松对称的容量收益。
Result: 有限字典下 shadow statistic 的测量率为 inverse-gap，改进均匀差异估计的 inverse-square-gap 率；对易 qubit 下界证明 gap 依赖在固定 snapshot 规模下最优。在不变纯态 backbone 上，保留扇区与非平凡破坏扇区 Fisher-正交；Ising-chain 计算把有限 shot 恢复、标签依赖对称性与物理扇区漂移联系起来。
Conclusion: 这些结果确定测量所支持的对称性究竟是哪个群，并为后续 release decision 提供统计与几何依据；过度对称有可量化的代价，放松对称则有可量化的容量收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Per-Node Activation Function Evolution in Indirectly Encoded Substrates: Solvability, Limits, and Emergent Diversity
papers.abstract_en: Biological neurons achieve computational diversity through specialized types: tonic, bursting, adapting, and fast-spiking cells coexist within the same circuit. Artificial neural networks, by contrast, apply a single activation function uniformly to all nodes, which limits what they can represent. We show that this uniformity creates hard limits for evolutionary search: across sparse evolved substrates, monotonic functions fail to solve parity beyond its smallest instance, XOR, while a single oscillatory unit suffices at all tested scales. The gap is one of search and sparsity, not representation: monotonic networks can represent parity with a modest number of hidden units, and gradient descent recovers that solution. We evolve, to our knowledge for the first time in indirect encoding, per-node activation function assignments from an 18-function palette across more than 4,500 experimental runs spanning Boolean logic, regression, and spatial classification. Testing each of the 18 functions individually on Parity-4 reveals a three-tier solvability structure: oscillatory functions achieve 100%, intermediate functions 6.7-80%, and all 9 monotonic functions 0%. This divide is not universal. Recurrence collapses it, and gradient descent inverts it entirely, showing that the barrier is specific to evolutionary search in sparse substrates. What activation functions a network can use, beyond its topology and weights, determines what evolutionary search can solve. Indirect encoding discovers heterogeneous per-node activation assignments unlikely to be chosen by hand.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Published in ALIFE 2026 (MIT Press). This is the version of record, posted under CC BY 4.0
papers.journal_ref: ALIFE 2026: Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference, MIT Press, 2026, p. 80
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在间接编码 (indirect encoding) 的稀疏演化基底上，逐节点进化激活函数（18 个候选函数的 palette），超过 4,500 次实验覆盖布尔逻辑、回归与空间分类。Parity-4 上单函数测试呈三层可解结构：振荡类函数 100%，中间类 6.7–80%，全部 9 个单调函数 0%；但引入循环或改用梯度下降即可消除甚至反转该差距，说明障碍属于演化搜索而非表达能力。
Motivation: 人工网络对所有节点统一使用同一激活函数，限制了可表达内容，也给演化搜索带来硬上限：单调函数在稀疏演化基底上连 parity 的最小实例之外都解不了。
Method: 在间接编码的稀疏演化基底上，首次逐节点进化激活函数分配，候选来自 18 函数 palette；实验超过 4,500 次，任务含 Boolean logic、regression 与 spatial classification；另将 18 个函数逐一单独在 Parity-4 上测试，并对照循环 (recurrence) 与梯度下降两种设定。
Result: Parity-4 单函数测试：振荡函数 100%，中间函数 6.7–80%，9 个单调函数全部 0%；单调网络用少量隐藏单元即可表达 parity 且梯度下降能恢复该解；recurrence 使该分层塌缩，梯度下降则完全反转它。
Conclusion: 除拓扑与权重外，网络可用的激活函数本身决定了演化搜索能解什么；该障碍特异于稀疏基底上的演化搜索，而间接编码能发现人工难以想到的异质逐节点激活分配。

summary_sections.motivation: 人工网络对所有节点统一使用同一激活函数，限制了可表达内容，也给演化搜索带来硬上限：单调函数在稀疏演化基底上连 parity 的最小实例之外都解不了。
summary_sections.method: 在间接编码的稀疏演化基底上，首次逐节点进化激活函数分配，候选来自 18 函数 palette；实验超过 4,500 次，任务含 Boolean logic、regression 与 spatial classification；另将 18 个函数逐一单独在 Parity-4 上测试，并对照循环 (recurrence) 与梯度下降两种设定。
summary_sections.result: Parity-4 单函数测试：振荡函数 100%，中间函数 6.7–80%，9 个单调函数全部 0%；单调网络用少量隐藏单元即可表达 parity 且梯度下降能恢复该解；recurrence 使该分层塌缩，梯度下降则完全反转它。
summary_sections.conclusion: 除拓扑与权重外，网络可用的激活函数本身决定了演化搜索能解什么；该障碍特异于稀疏基底上的演化搜索，而间接编码能发现人工难以想到的异质逐节点激活分配。

papers.title: Multi-Behavioral Evolved Substrates Through Neuromodulation and Activation Selection
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended artificial life systems must acquire diverse competencies from a single evolving genotype. Biological brains combine neuromodulation, which reconfigures circuits without changing connections, with diverse neuron types matched to specific computational roles. Can artificial evolution achieve something analogous in indirectly encoded substrates? Using indirectly encoded substrates evolved via CPPNs, we show through more than 10,000 experiments that neuromodulation alone is insufficient: under evolutionary search, monotonic activation functions impose a 75% ceiling on parity tasks that persists regardless of capacity, topology, or population size. This is an evolutionary search barrier, not a representational limit, since Adam gradient descent achieves 100% on the identical architecture. We combine neuromodulation with per-task activation function selection, matching oscillatory primitives to parity tasks and monotonic to threshold tasks, producing multi-behavioral evolved substrates. The result: 100% simultaneous 5-task success across all 30 seeds (median 14 generations). This generalizes across the oscillatory activation class: all four functions reach 100% (30 seeds each). Neither mechanism suffices alone. The barrier extends to higher-arity and asymmetric tasks, while multi-layer depth provides an alternative path. For open-ended evolution, the computational primitive should itself be an evolvable trait. At inference, one evolved genotype expresses many behaviors.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published version of the paper presented at ALIFE 2026: Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference (MIT Press). Code and data: https://github.com/RomainClaret/emr-hyperneat
papers.journal_ref: ALIFE 2026: Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference, MIT Press, 2026, p. 78
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CPPN 间接编码基底上证明：仅靠神经调制 (neuromodulation) 不够，单调激活函数在进化搜索中对 parity 任务形成 75% 的天花板，且不随容量、拓扑或种群规模改变。把神经调制与逐任务激活函数选择结合（振荡原语配 parity、单调配 threshold），30 个种子全部达到 5 任务同时 100% 成功（中位 14 代），四个振荡激活函数各自 30 种子均 100%。
Motivation: 开放式人工生命系统要从单一演化基因型获得多样能力，但间接编码基底中神经调制能否像生物大脑那样重组回路而不改连接，缺少证据；且进化搜索本身可能被激活函数卡住。
Method: 用 CPPN 演化间接编码基底，比较仅神经调制、单调激活、以及神经调制加逐任务激活函数选择（振荡原语对 parity、单调对 threshold）；超过 10,000 次实验，并用 Adam 梯度下降在同一架构上区分搜索障碍与表示极限。
Result: 超过 10,000 次实验中，单调激活函数在进化搜索下对 parity 任务封顶 75%，与容量、拓扑、种群规模无关；同一架构上 Adam 梯度下降达 100%，说明是搜索障碍而非表示极限。组合机制在 30 个种子上 5 任务同时 100% 成功，中位 14 代；四个振荡激活函数各 30 种子均达 100%。
Conclusion: 神经调制与激活函数选择缺一不可，计算原语本身应作为可演化性状；该障碍也延伸到更高元数与非对称任务，多层深度提供另一条路径。

papers.title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Anti-UAV300 的 RGB 模态上施加十个等级的合成雾，构建首个雾强度受控的反无人机检测基准：从晴天到最浓雾 mAP@0.5:0.95 下降 96%，退化集中在轻到中等雾（beta 约 0.05–0.10）的前段，主要由召回率与置信度丢失造成。雾感知训练在所有强度上提升检测（最高 +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），代价是晴天精度下降 9.1%，且仍无法阻止极端雾下的崩溃。
Motivation: 反无人机视觉系统需在低能见度下工作，但现有基准几乎只用晴天素材，既有的鲁棒性研究又把恶劣天气当作有/无二值条件，雾强度对地对空 UAV 检测的影响因此缺乏刻画。
Method: 对 Anti-UAV300 的 RGB 模态施加十个强度等级的合成雾，对比晴天训练的 YOLOv5m 基线与在晴天加雾天图像上共同训练的雾感知模型，按 mAP@0.5:0.95 与 mAP@0.5 度量退化。
Result: 从晴天到最浓雾 mAP@0.5:0.95 下降 96%，退化前置于轻到中等雾（beta 约 0.05–0.10），主因是召回与置信度丢失；在可比指标 mAP@0.5 上，该崩溃幅度超过最近先前基准报告的最极端降雨退化。雾感知训练在全部强度上提升检测，最高 +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95，晴天精度仅降 9.1%。
Conclusion: 可靠性在很窄的能见度区间内即丢失，简单的晴天/恶劣二分测试会低估运行风险；雾感知训练能抬高可靠检测的阈值但不能阻止极端雾下的崩溃。

papers.title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.
papers.comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇可复现的教学性研究，比较图像与文本分类器在逃逸攻击 (evasion attack) 下的脆弱性：MNIST 上的紧凑卷积网络在 FGSM ε=0.30 时准确率从 98.63% 崩到 1.72%，PGD 下到 0.41%，而 SMS Spam 上微调的 DistilBERT 在字符替换、空白噪声与良性后缀的受控扰动序列下没有出现 spam→ham 翻转。结论是对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态，鲁棒性必须实测而不能由干净准确率推断。
Motivation: 干净测试准确率常被当作模型可靠性的代理，但图像与文本两类分类器对白盒逃逸攻击与受控扰动的响应差异很大，需要可复现的对照实验来说明这种推断为何不成立。
Method: 图像实验：在 MNIST 上训练一个紧凑卷积网络，用 FGSM 与 PGD 两种白盒攻击在多个 ε 上评测，并测试 bit-depth-reduction 防御。文本实验：在 SMS Spam Collection 上微调 DistilBERT，施加预先定义的受控扰动序列（字符替换、空白噪声、良性后缀），观察垃圾邮件概率变化。
Result: MNIST 卷积网络干净测试准确率 98.63%；FGSM 下 ε=0.15 降至 60.20%、ε=0.30 降至 1.72%；PGD 下对应降至 32.47% 与 0.41%；bit-depth-reduction 防御只挽回部分损失。SMS Spam 上 DistilBERT 准确率 98.75%、F1 94.96%，受控扰动在多数展示样例上只造成温和的概率偏移，没有 spam→ham 翻转。
Conclusion: 对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态：MNIST 实验是清晰的逃逸演示，文本实验则是受控的鲁棒性评估；模型鲁棒性必须通过实测确定，不能从干净准确率推断。
