papers.title: The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions. IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Includes formal proofs, transition taxonomy, and benchmark schema appendices. Reference verifier and reproducible evaluation artifacts available at https://github.com/openkedge/cctbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出认知连续性测试 (Cognitive Continuity Test, CCT)，把持久 AI agent 的状态转移当作策略相对的合同来验证，用作用域授权、来源追溯、确定性应用、语义谓词与候选持久性回执区分「已验证可容许」「明确违规」「需补证据未决」三态。IdentityLineageBench 上参考验证器对 576 个规范留出标签全部匹配，而词法状态相似度与仅血缘诊断基线分别放行 60.0% 和 80.0% 的无效样例。
Motivation: 持久 agent 会改信念、合并记忆、替换执行底座，相似的后继状态可能对应授权完全不同的转移声明，而合法开发又可能大幅改状态；现有手段无法在策略层面判定一次转移是否被授权。
Method: CCT 以策略相对合同形式定义转移验证：作用域授权加来源追溯、确定性应用、语义谓词与候选持久性回执，输出三值判定；配套 IdentityLineageBench（24 个生成转移族）、参考 post-resolution 验证器与可复现评测工件，含形式化证明、转移分类学与签名对抗回归（伪造交互计数、无据信念变更、缺失与矛盾证据混合）。
Result: 参考验证器匹配全部 576 个规范留出标签；词法状态相似度基线放行 60.0% 无效样例，仅血缘诊断基线放行 80.0%；18,000 次执行的合法路径研究测得常驻输入上默认中位延迟 6.21 ms。
Conclusion: 作者主张这些对比只确立合成一致性 (synthetic conformance)，不构成对已部署的策略感知系统的优势；SIT 行为与真实模型迁移仍未测量，并给出部署所需的额外激活与恢复义务。

summary_sections.result: 参考验证器匹配全部 576 个规范留出标签；词法状态相似度基线放行 60.0% 无效样例，仅血缘诊断基线放行 80.0%；18,000 次执行的合法路径研究测得常驻输入上默认中位延迟 6.21 ms。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张这些对比只确立合成一致性 (synthetic conformance)，不构成对已部署的策略感知系统的优势；SIT 行为与真实模型迁移仍未测量，并给出部署所需的额外激活与恢复义务。

papers.title: A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging
papers.abstract_en: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). The optimizer was correct, but the verifier had already disclosed the answer. We replace solver-first evaluation with a support-gated verification contract. A clean reference map must first show repeated component exposure; a matched reference/current gate must then establish comparable runtime evidence; only afterward may an independently calibrated signal rule return a detection. In a preregistered heldout comprising 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows, 55/72 regime-component units passed the reference gate, 54/55 passed the runtime gate, and stable false admission was 0/20 represented components with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic predicted detection better than nominal fault-cell fraction. The main lesson is structural: verify evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector. Otherwise a stronger solver can merely certify a stronger verifier artifact.
papers.comment: Submitted to Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 7 pages, 0 figures, 2 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 闭环智能体调试中，验证器的探针或谓词若编码了目标身份，精确优化器会显得有效却未解决任何真实歧义：exact-anchor 谓词在 9/9 例中直接产出被植入的故障对。作者因此把评估从 solver-first 改为 support-gated 验证契约，先验证证据资格与非泄露 (non-revelation)，再优化组件选择器。
Motivation: 用模拟器接地的验证器比较 prompt、工具、策略与诊断算法时，验证器本身可能泄露答案，使求解器对比失去意义；先优化选择器会把更强的求解器变成更强验证器伪影的认证器。
Method: 在 aggregate-trace 调试器上审计 exact minimum hitting set (MHS) 与 propagation-aware greedy 的支持集输出，定位 exact-anchor 谓词泄露；随后提出三段式 support-gated 验证契约：干净参考图先证明重复组件暴露，reference/current 匹配门建立可比运行时证据，最后由独立校准的信号规则给出检测。
Result: MHS 与 greedy 在 12/12 开发例中返回相同支持集、9/9 中恢复相同植入故障；审计发现 exact-anchor 谓词在 9/9 例直接产出植入对。移除 anchor 后总体植入对恢复 8/9，hard-probe singleton 对仍 9/9 命中，传播后无例保留非空残余冲突族 (0/9)。预注册 heldout 含 1,440 例、21,600 partition 行：55/72 regime-component 单元过参考门，54/55 过运行时门，稳定错误接纳为 0/20，单侧精确 95% 上界 0.1391；在接纳单元内 affected clean traffic 比 nominal fault-cell fraction 更能预测检测。
Conclusion: 优化组件选择器之前必须先验证证据资格与非泄露，否则更强的求解器只是在认证更强的验证器伪影。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 PRISMA 引导的 One-Pixel Attack (OPA) 综述，覆盖 2017–2026 年研究，给出跨算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合与程序合成攻击、防御、可解释性与领域脆弱性的多轴分类。核心发现是 Differential Evolution 类方法占主导，效率优化与显著性引导方法兴起，而数据集多样性、可迁移性与标准化评测仍存在持续缺口。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击综述对 OPA 覆盖零散或流于表面，而单像素即可在医学诊断、自动驾驶、生物识别等领域诱发高置信误分类，需要统一的分类与评测框架。
Method: 采用 PRISMA 流程筛选 2017–2026 年高质量研究，构建覆盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具与领域脆弱性的多轴分类，并归纳防御范式（像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换、鲁棒训练）在鲁棒性、不可察觉性与计算开销上的权衡。
Result: 综述分析揭示 Differential Evolution 类策略占主导，效率优化与显著性引导方法上升，数据集多样性、可迁移性与标准化评测存在持续缺口；防御范式在鲁棒性、不可察觉性和计算开销之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: OPA 研究需要补齐数据集多样性、可迁移性与标准化评测，并推进选择性像素恢复、Transformer 特定脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化与真实领域自适应防御；作者同时提出强调鲁棒性测试、事件披露与 AI 安全治理的监管框架。

papers.title: Loading history and window geometry bound compact-state slip ranking during granular shear startup
papers.abstract_en: Granular slip forecasting can conflate material state, loading progress, and the geometry of event-centered sampling. We separated these contributions in slowly sheared two-dimensional frictional disks using a compact neural score of stress, pressure, coordination, non-affine motion, and force-network observables. The model was developed on 36 trajectories and frozen efore testing on 18 new trajectories under two nested stress-drop definitions. Inspection of held-out results revealed post-event sampling asymmetry; recovery-aware analyses are therefore descriptive. With trajectories weighted equally, the compact score ranked near-slip windows above both prevalence and within-trajectory circular-phase controls under both definitions (representative average precision 0.310 versus prevalence 0.173; phase-null upper bound 0.257). Loading-history coordinates ranked more strongly, reaching 0.534 for causal elapsed strain. The recovery-aware rule retained 78.4\% of activity-gated events and preferentially selected longer preceding intervals; ranking by time since the previous catalogued event remained compatible with a count-conditioned geometry null. Compact observables thus contain temporally aligned slip information, but stronger loading-history baselines and window-geometry sensitivity bound that evidence. These startup data do not isolate a state-specific short-horizon precursor beyond loading history or support a renewal interpretation of elapsed-strain ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在二维摩擦盘缓慢剪切中，用应力、压力、配位数、非仿射运动与力网络观测构成的紧凑神经评分对临近滑移窗口排序，held-out 上平均精度 0.310，高于 prevalence 基线 0.173 与相位 null 上界 0.257。但加载历史坐标更强（因果经过应变达 0.534），且按距上次事件时间排序仍与计数条件化的几何 null 相容，因此这些 startup 数据未分离出超出加载历史的、状态特异的短时前兆。
Motivation: 颗粒滑移预报把材料状态、加载进程与事件中心采样窗口的几何混在一起，无法判断紧凑状态量是否真含独立于加载历史的短时前兆信息。
Method: 在缓慢剪切的二维摩擦盘上，用涵盖应力、压力、配位数、非仿射运动与力网络观测的紧凑神经评分 (compact neural score) 排序临近滑移窗口；模型在 36 条轨迹上开发后冻结，再在 18 条新轨迹、两种嵌套的 stress-drop 定义下测试，并与 prevalence、轨迹内 circular-phase 控制及加载历史坐标对比。
Result: 轨迹等权下，紧凑评分在两种定义下平均精度 0.310，高于 prevalence 0.173 与 phase-null 上界 0.257；因果经过应变 (causal elapsed strain) 达 0.534。recovery-aware 规则保留 78.4% 的 activity-gated 事件并偏向更长的前置区间；按距上次编目事件时间排序仍与计数条件化几何 null 相容。
Conclusion: 紧凑观测量含时间对齐的滑移信息，但更强的加载历史基线与窗口几何敏感性限定了这一证据：startup 数据不支持超出加载历史的状态特异短时前兆，也不支持对经过应变排序的 renewal 解读。

papers.title: Generalized Biomedicine Discovery
papers.abstract_en: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAN 用预测抑制滤掉正常解剖的预期模式，再以惊讶驱动显著性突出细微异常，并通过互补顺应把偏移整合进全局表征，从而在开放世界医学影像中发现新概念。它在长尾、异常与层级分类三类发现任务上提升新概念发现，同时大体保留既有临床知识，且可插入现有架构。
Motivation: 临床医学影像存在长尾罕见病、被正常解剖淹没的细微病变与层级分类三类开放世界偏移，而现有开放世界范式假设平坦均衡的标签空间，无法覆盖这些需求。
Method: 提出 GBD 框架与统一 benchmark，覆盖长尾、异常检测与层级感知发现三类任务；核心方法 SCAN 按认知式感知进程分三步：预测抑制过滤预期正常、惊讶驱动显著性 (surprise-evoked salience) 高亮意外偏离、互补顺应 (complementary accommodation) 将偏移并入全局表征，且可插入现有架构。
Result: 实验显示 SCAN 提升新概念发现，同时大体保留已建立的临床知识，并在已知-未知权衡 (known-unknown trade-off) 上表现更好；代码已开源至 github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery。
Conclusion: 把发现新概念建模为对预期模式的预测抑制加惊讶驱动再整合，可以在医学影像开放世界设定中同时推进新概念发现与既有知识保留，并作为即插即用模块嵌入现有架构。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

Motivation: 客户流失预测文献普遍报告 95% 以上测试准确率（最常被引用的研究报 99.01%），但 accuracy 与 F1 中心的报告方式掩盖了数据泄漏、冗余特征解释失真、校准失效与成本阈值错配四类问题。

papers.title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
papers.abstract_en: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态模型评审器 (model judge) 的图像反事实接地探针，作者形式化出 Verdict Grounding Score 并证明该分数被编辑的可感知性 (perceptibility) 封顶，且误差单向：分数只会让评审器显得比实际更不接地。审计九个评审器后给出规则——图像侧反事实分数绝不能单独报告，必须同时给出未编辑图像上的检测探针作为上界。
Motivation: 模型评审器被用于过滤训练数据、挑选输出、提供多模态推理模型的奖励信号，但对其接地性的反事实审计可能测的不是它声称要测的东西，导致审计者丢弃本可用的评审器（假警报）。
Method: 探针编辑图像使真值翻转、固定推理轨迹，看判决是否跟随；形式化为 Verdict Grounding Score，并论证其受编辑可感知性约束、误差单向；再证明缺失量可由同一审计协议已采集的三个量识别，从而可直接测量假警报率。
Result: 在九个评审器的审计中，预测的排序在整个主池上严格成立；典型评审器对其本可分辨属性的编辑只响应约一半。用保守拒绝阈值可把若干格子直接认证为假警报，最清楚的一例是某评审器几乎每次都能检测到注入错误、却仍得分像完全没用图像。
Conclusion: 图像侧反事实分数必须与未编辑图像上的检测探针一起报告：后者给出上界、认证假警报，且额外成本为零。

papers.title: SyntheticHLS: Building Diverse Synthetic High-Level Synthesis Datasets using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning and large language models (LLMs) are rapidly gaining adoption in semiconductor design, driving demand for training datasets. Most efforts focus on hardware description languages (HDLs) while designs for high-level synthesis (HLS), a popular approach to domain-specific accelerators, remain scarce. HLS dataset efforts emphasize manual curation or design parameterization, seldom addressing high-quality LLM-based generation or diversity in code length, hierarchy, design-space size, latency, resource utilization, and application domain, potentially limiting model generalization. We propose SyntheticHLS, a framework for generating large-scale, complex, diverse synthetic HLS datasets using LLMs. Its two key ideas are: 1) an iterative feedback-guided mutation loop that uses paired HLS source code and design-space specifications to incrementally transform seed designs into more complex, scalable designs; and 2) quantitative metrics of HLS design complexity and design-space scalability that serve as measurable objectives for LLM-guided mutation. We systematically cross-validate an HLS Quality-of-Results (QoR) deep learning model trained and tested across common HLS benchmarks, zero-shot synthetic designs, and iteratively mutated synthetic designs. Synthetic designs transfer well to common benchmark test sets while the reverse does not hold. SyntheticHLS's iteratively mutated designs provide the most generalizable training corpus among the datasets studied. Analysis of the mutation process and dataset shows that metric-guided trajectories consistently improve targeted complexity and scalability objectives without regressing non-target metrics. Mutated designs span a substantially broader, more diverse design space than zero-shot generated designs. Our framework, dataset, and evaluation are open-source: https://github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls.
papers.comment: Accepted and to be presented at the International Conference on Field Programmable Technology (FPT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyntheticHLS 用 LLM 迭代反馈式变异循环，把种子 HLS 设计逐步改写成更复杂、可扩展的合成数据集，并以 HLS 复杂度与设计空间可扩展性的量化指标作为变异目标。跨数据集交叉验证显示，合成设计能迁移到常见 HLS benchmark 测试集而反向不成立，迭代变异设计给出所研究数据集中最可泛化的训练语料，且目标指标提升不回退非目标指标。
Motivation: 面向 HLS 的训练数据稀缺，现有工作多靠人工整理或参数化，缺少高质量 LLM 生成与在代码长度、层次、设计空间规模、延迟、资源占用和应用领域上的多样性，可能限制模型泛化。
Method: 两个核心组件：一是迭代反馈引导的变异循环，用成对的 HLS 源码与设计空间规格把种子设计逐步变换为更复杂、可扩展的设计；二是 HLS 设计复杂度与设计空间可扩展性的量化指标，作为 LLM 引导变异的可测目标。随后对一个 HLS Quality-of-Results (QoR) 深度学习模型在常见 HLS benchmark、零样本合成设计与迭代变异设计上做训练/测试的系统交叉验证。
Result: 合成设计能良好迁移到常见 benchmark 测试集，反向迁移不成立；迭代变异设计在所研究数据集中提供最可泛化的训练语料；变异过程分析显示指标引导的轨迹持续提升目标复杂度与可扩展性目标且不回退非目标指标；变异设计的设计空间比零样本生成设计显著更广更多样。
Conclusion: 以量化复杂度指标驱动的 LLM 迭代变异能造出比零样本生成更可泛化的 HLS 训练语料，框架、数据集与评测已开源（github.com/sharc-lab/synthetic-hls），论文被 FPT 2026 接收。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出保留各专家区间标签的不确定性感知学习框架：先把异质标签词汇统一到公共概率标签空间，再用 Beta 混合分布配合 proper Cramér 距离目标建模各专家区间，最后把预测不确定性分解为 within/between/model 三部分并用 decomposition matching 对齐到对应的标签侧来源。在海冰密集度 (sea-ice concentration) 任务上，相对硬标签将 MAE 降低 31%，并优于聚合、区间分布与区间回归基线。
Motivation: 专家标签既有个体内区间不精确又有专家间分歧，现有方法把两者分开处理：多专家方法压成共识、区间目标方法只出单一预测、预测不确定性方法很少用真实专家分歧校验其不确定性估计。
Method: 三步流程：将异质标签词汇协调到公共概率标签空间以区分编码差异与专家判断；保留各专家区间并用 Beta 分布混合建模，训练目标为 proper Cramér 距离；把预测不确定性分解为 within-component、between-component 与 model uncertainty，再引入 decomposition matching 将三者对齐到 within-label、between-label 与 model error 三个标签侧来源。
Result: 在 sea-ice concentration 上，相对硬标签 MAE 降低 31%，并优于 aggregation、interval-distribution 与 interval-regression 三类基线；分解出的三个预测不确定性分量分别与标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性和模型误差对应。
Conclusion: 同时保留专家区间并显式匹配不确定性分解，可以在标签本身含双重不确定性时得到更准的预测和可校验的不确定性分量；分解与标签侧来源的对应关系并非天然成立，需要 decomposition matching 来保证。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Weighted Data Selection: Sharp Upper-Half and Five-Dimensional Laws
papers.abstract_en: How much risk does a small reweighted training support retain? For finite weighted least squares with the minimum-norm learner, we prove the exact law $Γ_d(n)=3-n/d$ throughout $\lceil3d/2\rceil\leq n\leq2d-1$. The guarantee covers every observed feature rank and uses selections that preserve the full feature span. Balanced simplex anchors reduce dimension; positive-weight lifting and independent-line compression close the risk bound. Shifted coordinate pairs attain the matching lower bound. The complete dataset-level upper bound and sharpness construction are verified in Lean 4. papers.title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DramaAgent 在不改动视频生成骨干的前提下，加一层分层 agentic 控制：把长视频生成拆成故事规划、角色持续条件化、逐场景合成与反思式定向修复，并跨场景维护可复用的故事与角色状态。它诊断身份漂移、场景语义缺失、时间不连续与跨模态错配，再按阶段修复问题片段；在多个视频骨干上均提升长时程连贯性、角色一致性、叙事忠实度与场景级音画一致性。
Motivation: 长篇故事视频生成中，叙事漂移、角色身份不稳、跨场景连续性弱与音画错配随序列变长而累积，而直接改进视频骨干难以同时解决这些问题。
Method: 分层、agentic、模型无关的上层控制框架：故事规划、持久角色条件化、逐场景合成、反思引导的定向修复；跨场景维护故事与角色状态，按阶段诊断并修复问题片段，可套在不同视频生成骨干之上。
Result: 在多个视频生成骨干上的实验显示，相比直接生成与强基线，DramaAgent 改善长时程连贯性、角色一致性、叙事忠实度与场景级音画一致性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 分层 agentic 控制是可控长篇音视频生成的可行路径，其价值在于上层编排与修复而非替换底层骨干。

papers.title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
papers.abstract_en: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一掌握阈值在不同知识追踪 (KT) 模型下含义不同：对 6 个 KT 模型、4 个公开教育数据集评测 12 个阈值（0.50–0.99），BKT 对阈值变化不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高显著收紧放行。最优平衡阈值跨模型与跨设置差异大，半数设置中神经模型与 BKT 选定阈值相差超过 0.10；更严阈值并不稳定缩小成绩差距，先验强的学生放行频率可达先验弱学生的 3.26 倍。作者主张换模型或换教学优先级时必须重标定阈值，并按表现、练习量、放行与可及性四维评估。
Motivation: 辅导系统用固定掌握阈值决定学生何时停止练习并晋级，但同一数值在不同 KT 模型下对应不同的晋级决策，且可能加剧不同先验成绩群体间的放行不平等。
Method: 在 4 个公开教育数据集上比较 6 个 KT 模型（含 Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) 与神经模型），评测 12 个阈值（0.50–0.99），用晋级后表现、晋级覆盖率、练习负担、以及不同先验成绩群体间的差异四个维度打分；在 30 个预定义教学设置下寻找平衡表现、额外练习与晋级的阈值。
Result: BKT 对阈值变化相对不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高变得明显更挑剔；最优平衡阈值跨模型与设置差异显著，在半数测试设置中神经模型与 BKT 选定阈值相差超过 0.10，当更重视减少额外练习并允许更多学生晋级时该差距缩小。更严阈值不能可靠缩小表现差距，且先验强的学生晋级频率最高可达先验弱学生的 3.26 倍。
Conclusion: 掌握阈值不是模型无关的常数：换 KT 模型或换教学优先级时必须重标定，并同时按表现、练习、晋级与可及性四个后果来评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 3 figures; code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/tree/main/research/decision-certification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nous 把 agent 记忆的「学习决策、校准来源、修订认证」三件事分开，证明在四模型 HMM 族上学习未知 Bayes 决策只需 Θ(l⁻²) 条记录、认证其相对信息性在位策略的改进只需 O(l⁻²) 条同分布新记录，而固定精度的来源估计要 Θ(l⁻⁴) 条——即学习并认证有用决策可比来源校准少二次方量级的记录。在未知 identity-plus-background 报告信道下给出策略改进的 sharp identified interval 与基于可观测 witness region 的有限样本证书，无需 pure-class anchors。
Motivation: belief 式 agent 记忆的证据可能含噪、复制或过期，通常被要求先校准来源可靠性才能改进决策；本文质疑这一先后顺序是否必要。
Method: 分离 learning / calibration / revision certification 三个阶段；在四模型 HMM 族上做记录复杂度的上下界分析，并推广到更宽的模型类；对未知 identity-plus-background 报告信道刻画策略改进的 sharp identified interval，用可观测 witness region 构造有限样本证书，扩展到有界历史依赖误设与条件复制，split-trained witnesses 适用于任意历史空间；证书与 Nous Dimensions 集成。
Result: 学习未知 Bayes 决策需 Θ(l⁻²) 条记录，认证其改进需 O(l⁻²) 条同观测律新记录，固定精度来源估计需 Θ(l⁻⁴)（l→0）；更宽模型类保持该决策速率与来源下界。在 45,000 条 held-out mutable-state histories 与三个带 noisy-report 接口的外部 MiniGrid 记忆环境共 9,000 episodes 上，新证书接受 9/9 相对 constant incumbent 的改进、4/9 相对 last-write-wins 的改进，而早期证书在 MiniGrid 中一个都不接受；强 established inference 基线仍具竞争力或更好。
Conclusion: 记忆决策可以在不恢复来源可靠性的情况下被学习和论证，其记录代价可比来源校准低二次方量级；作者明确这是统计性说明而非普适更优的记忆算法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.
papers.comment: Survey paper; 80 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://xaddwell.github.io/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Agent-Safety/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于自进化智能体 (self-evolving agent) 安全的综述，提出以“状态转变”为中心的 SAVER 框架：Substrate 定位可复用影响、Adaptation 刻画其变化、Violation 识别被破坏的安全属性、Exposure 标记失效可见处、Response 评估遏制/修复/撤销。核心论断是，合法状态在适应过程把其持久性、权限或作用范围扩展到原有效条件之外时就会变得不安全；现有工作对准入、检索、激活、暴露与局部遏制证据较强，对适应恢复后的后代修复与评估证据明显不足，因此主张做可追溯到起始转变、跨后代验证修复、并检验持续演化下是否复现的纵向评估。
Motivation: LLM 部署后参数固定，无法从新交互中学习；自进化智能体把经验固化为可复用状态（参数、记忆、工具、技能、工作流），使过去事件成为未来原因，一次无害信息可能以更强持久性、权限或范围影响后续决策，传统单次对齐/授权式安全评估因此失效。
Method: 提出 SAVER 这一以转变 (transition) 为中心的五段框架：Substrate 定位可复用影响，Adaptation 刻画影响如何变化，Violation 识别被破坏的安全属性，Exposure 标记失效可被观察的位置，Response 评估遏制、修复或撤销；综述按该框架组织现有工作并比较证据强弱。
Result: 综述发现失效不必源于有害信息本身：合法状态在适应扩大其 persistence、authority 或 scope 超出原有效条件时即变得不安全。现有工作对 admission、retrieval、activation、exposure 与 local containment 提供了相对较强的证据，而对 adaptation 恢复后的 descendant repair 与评估证据少得多。全文 80 页、6 图、13 表。
Conclusion: 作者主张转向纵向评估：把不安全影响追溯到起始转变、跨后代验证修复，并测试其在持续演化下是否会重新出现；安全属性必须在经验的累积、泛化与跨上下文复用中保持，而非只在单次响应上成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudgetSchemaBench 是一个执行验证的 Text-to-SQL schema 上下文预算诊断基准：用 80 个数据库的合并目录，扫四个 schema 上下文预算、比较三种序列化表示，并固定检索器的表排序。主结果是当检索受覆盖率限制时，执行准确率对 schema 预算的敏感度远高于对序列化表示的敏感度——预算从目录的 2.5% 提到 50%，词法检索下执行准确率升 18 个百分点，稠密检索只升 3 个百分点。
Motivation: 数据 agent 要把数据库 schema 塞进上下文窗口，大目录跨多库、上千列，成本约束迫使在表覆盖度与序列化细节之间取舍，而这一取舍在上下文窗口用满之前就已发生；此前缺少针对该设定的执行验证诊断。
Method: 构造 BudgetSchemaBench：相关性标签直接由 gold SQL 机械推导，不经人工或 LLM 标注；用合并的 80 数据库目录扫四个 schema 上下文预算，比较三种表示，同时固定每个检索器的表排序；加入 source-namespace 检查，剔除从错误数据库得到正确结果的查询；评测三种条件——端到端检索、frozen-gold（保证必需表在场）、以及移除必需表的 probe。
Result: 在 1,279 道 held-out 问题上，主 solver 用原始序列化时，预算从 2.5% 升到 50%，词法检索执行准确率提高 18 个百分点，稠密检索只提高 3 个百分点（稠密检索在最小预算下已找到大部分必需表）。移除必需表后，94.6% 的正确预测会精确点名其中一张表。frozen-gold 条件下两个主 solver 的三种表示差异至多 2 个百分点，最宽的配对 95% 置信区间把差异界定在 ±4 个百分点内；换用另一模型家族的一个 reasoning 模型仍观察到相同定性模式。
Conclusion: 当检索受覆盖率限制时，执行准确率对 schema 预算比对所测序列化表示更敏感；移除必需表后模型仍能凭参数化知识重建缺失 schema。诊断与构建、评测代码均公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Published in Artificial Intelligence and Law
papers.journal_ref: J. Lee, Artificial Intelligence and Law (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在十类韩国性犯罪判决书分类上，微调 KLUE-BERT 的准确率达 99.3%，超过 GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0 与传统机器学习模型，说明领域适配与微调比模型规模更关键。XAI 分析进一步指出模型在 KICS 真实案件数据上难以捕捉隐含语境线索。
Motivation: 法律文本复杂、类别间差异细微，通用大模型与传统机器学习在法律文档分类上准确率不足，且预测过程缺乏可解释性。
Method: 在十类韩国性犯罪判决书上对比传统机器学习、通用 LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）与微调小模型（KLUE-BERT），并用 XAI 技术分析预测与误分类案例，再以贴近真实案卷的 KICS 数据检验泛化。
Result: KLUE-BERT 微调后准确率 99.3%，为最高，优于 GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0 及传统机器学习模型；XAI 识别出影响决策的语言特征及其在细微文本线索上的局限；在 KICS 数据上模型难以解释隐含语境线索。
Conclusion: 对法律文档分类，领域适配与微调比扩大模型规模更有效，但性能需与可解释性并重，XAI 可提升法律文本分类的透明度。

papers.title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.
papers.comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 503 个职业化 AGENTS.md 系统提示在九个文本类科学基准（4,531 题、100 个匹配 profile）上做五条件对照，发现完整职业提示相对最小基线平均准确率差 -0.6 个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间 [-1.5, +0.2]），无任何基准出现统计上明确的提升，而输出 token 为 1.5–2.3 倍、每次成功调用成本 2.2–4.5 倍。结论是默认加载完整职业 profile 不划算，唯一例外是 API 频繁掉线时长提示把 SuperGPQA 首答正确率从 54.0% 抬到 71.6%，但该增益来自长度而非领域专长。
Motivation: 职业化 system prompt 被广泛当作提升科学任务表现的手段，但其对准确率、token 消耗与成本的净效应缺少受控对照，且需要区分领域知识增益与单纯的长度/格式效应。
Method: 评测 Scientific Agents 开源语料（503 个职业化 AGENTS.md profile），模型为经 OpenRouter 调用的 Gemini 3.8 Flash，运行于 Pi agent harness；每个 profile 与四种对照比较：最小基线 "You are a helpful assistant"、profile 开头角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域 profile。九个文本类科学基准共抽样 4,531 题，4,488 题在 API 错误重试后完成全部五条件，采用自动化规则式评分；另在 60 道工具使用型 BioMysteryBench 生物信息学问题上各跑三次（基线与 profile）。
Result: 平均 profile-基线准确率差 -0.6 个百分点（固定任务上 95% bootstrap 区间 [-1.5, +0.2]），九个基准无一出现统计上明确的提升；匹配 profile 输出 token 为基线的 1.5–2.3 倍，每次成功调用成本高 2.2–4.5 倍。BioMysteryBench 60 题三次运行的平均解题率 profile 46.7% vs 基线 56.7%，差 -10.0 个百分点（95% 区间 [-16.7, -3.3]），主因是 profile 下 token 与时间上限导致的中止更频繁。SuperGPQA 上因 provider API 频繁掉线，短基线首答正确仅 54.0%，profile 为 71.6%；通用与错配提示可靠性相近，说明该增益来自提示长度或格式而非领域专长。
Conclusion: 对所测模型与任务，默认加载完整职业 profile 不提升准确率且成本显著更高；选择性检索 profile 片段或开放式科学任务是否改变结论仍待检验。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 对所测模型与任务，默认加载完整职业 profile 不提升准确率且成本显著更高；选择性检索 profile 片段或开放式科学任务是否改变结论仍待检验。

papers.title: "very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 LLM 的言语不确定性标记（如 possible、likely）所编码的数值水平与人类显著不一致，并提出基于优化的算法 METHODNAME：直接从 LLM 输出学习言语标记到不确定性的最优映射，通过拟合标记-不确定性关系来解释经验正确率，从而量化每个标记应承载的概率质量，而非依赖重复采样。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 不确定性量化多依赖似然或一致性信号，而人类用言语标记表达不确定性以体现元认知监控；LLM 的言语标记是否可靠量化其不确定性、与人类语义是否一致，此前缺少基准。
Method: 先从心理学与决策科学文献整理人类不确定性标记语料作为基准，将 LLM 与之对比；再引入优化算法 METHODNAME，直接从 LLM 输出学习言语标记上的最优不确定性剖面，通过拟合标记-不确定性映射来最好地解释经验正确率，以替代重复采样式的不确定性估计。
Result: 观察到 LLM 用言语标记编码的不确定性数值水平与人类存在显著差异；METHODNAME 通过拟合标记-不确定性映射给出每个言语标记应传达的概率量，并实现人类与 LLM 在置信语义上的标记级直接比较，从而分离不匹配并揭示言语表达中系统性的置信差异。
Conclusion: 言语不确定性标记可以作为量化 LLM 不确定性的直接通道，但 LLM 与人类在标记的置信语义上存在系统性错位，需通过学习得到的标记-不确定性映射来校准而非默认沿用人类语义。

papers.title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
papers.abstract_en: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 8 figures plus a graphical abstract; includes benchmark prompts, scoring rubric, and per-prompt scores. Code: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是本地运行、自带模型密钥的开源科研助手，用不可被 agent 改写的只增日志记录实际操作，并维护只追加的 Living Lab Notebook，使结论可核验而非被禁止。在 20 个跨学科研究 prompt、预先固定评分规则下，它在科学质量与研究执行两项上领先两个托管平台，且是唯一记录所运行软件、通常附带可复现命令的交付物。
Motivation: 通用聊天助手与编码 agent 的最常见失败是模型过度声称 (overclaiming)，且托管平台的交付物不记录运行环境、难以事后复现。
Method: 本地运行的开源应用，用户自带模型（托管或本地）；内置书面科研流程库、工作流模板、数据源目录与 reviewer/writer 角色；Living Lab Notebook 条目只增不删并链接成论证链；日志由观察 agent 行为生成，agent 没有可写该日志的工具。评测用 20 个跨学科 prompt 与预先固定的评分 rubric，对照两个托管平台。
Result: 在 20 个跨学科研究 prompt 上，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个托管平台；其交付物是唯一记录所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现命令的；其中一个托管平台运行同一前沿模型却两者皆无。环境记录是 agent 写的文件，不在观测日志内，该日志尚未覆盖软件环境。
Conclusion: 让声称可核验比禁止声称更能对付 overclaiming；本地文件夹式项目与只增记录保证多年后仍可脱离应用阅读，MIT 许可开源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Dynamic Spatial Bayesian Machine Learning Model: Applications to Intergenerational Economic Mobility and Geographic Income Inequality in the United States
papers.abstract_en: We develop a Dynamic Spatial Panel Bayesian Additive Regression Trees model with Horseshoe shrinkage (DSP-BART-HS) for high-dimensional spatio-temporal panel data. We jointly evaluate the model against a comprehensive suite of structural spatial econometrics, non-parametric machine learning methods, and small-area estimators across nine data-generating scenarios spanning 200 replicates each, including irregular spatial topologies, dense policy effects, and non-linear individual-level interactions. DSP-BART-HS is the best or statistically indistinguishable from the best estimator in every scenario. Conventional region-time-aggregate comparators suffer severe performance degradation -- trailing by a factor of three or more -- whenever individual-level non-linearity drives outcome variance, a limitation this framework's tree-ensemble design directly addresses. The model also maintains strong predictive accuracy under a zero-training-region spatial holdout via its spatial diffusion mechanism. We demonstrate practical utility across two U.S. county-level panel applications -- intergenerational economic mobility and geographic income inequality -- under genuine unseen-region, random, and temporal holdouts, with results validated through repeated-split uncertainty quantification and paired significance testing against every comparator. One clear limitation emerges: under temporal extrapolation specifically, a lighter per-region autoregressive specification (MTS-CAR-X) achieves a robust, and consistent advantage. DSP-BART-HS nonetheless establishes strong predictive performance, automated variable selection, and flexible inference for hierarchical spatio-temporal panel data.
papers.comment: Manuscript submitted to the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DSP-BART-HS：把动态空间面板回归树 (BART) 与 Horseshoe 收缩结合，用于高维时空面板数据。在九个数据生成场景（各 200 次重复）中，它在每个场景都是最优或与最优统计不可区分；当个体层面非线性主导结果方差时，区域-时间聚合类基线落后三倍以上。唯一例外是时间外推，MTS-CAR-X 这一更轻的逐区域自回归设定有稳定优势。
Motivation: 高维时空面板中，区域-时间聚合类比较方法在个体层面非线性驱动方差时性能严重退化，且零训练区域的空间留出场景下预测能力难以保持。
Method: 构建 Dynamic Spatial Panel BART with Horseshoe shrinkage (DSP-BART-HS)，以树集成处理非线性个体层面交互，用 Horseshoe 做自动变量选择，并通过 spatial diffusion 机制支撑零训练区域留出；与结构空间计量经济学、非参数机器学习和小区域估计器在九个数据生成场景（各 200 次重复，含不规则空间拓扑、密集政策效应、非线性个体交互）上联合比较，并在美国县级面板上做重复切分不确定性量化与配对显著性检验。
Result: 九个场景各 200 次重复中，DSP-BART-HS 在每个场景均为最优或与最优统计不可区分；当个体层面非线性主导结果方差时，区域-时间聚合比较方法落后三倍以上 (factor of three or more)；零训练区域空间留出下仍保持强预测精度；在代际经济流动与地理收入不平等两个美国县级面板应用中，于未见区域、随机与时间三类留出上验证；时间外推下 MTS-CAR-X 取得稳健且一致的优势。
Conclusion: 树集成加 Horseshoe 的动态空间面板框架在非线性与未见区域场景下给出强预测、自动变量选择与灵活推断，但时间外推应改用更轻的逐区域自回归设定 (MTS-CAR-X)。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Framework for Egocentric and Exocentric Procedural Understanding via Temporal Segmentation and Semantic Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon ego/exo data contains rich procedural evidence, but are redundant, noisy, and costly to process or retain. We propose a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Procedural State Memory, implemented as a Work Environment Model (WEM). Inspired by event segmentation theory, we detect boundaries using changes in visual context, location, motion, narration, gaze/object interaction, and optional exocentric workspace evidence, rather than fixed windows or visual novelty alone. Each segment is abstracted into an evidence-linked event card containing actor, interval, location, action, objects/tools, pre/post state, confidence, and provenance. These event cards incrementally update the WEM, enabling compact, auditable documentation and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints. We instantiate the design with frozen DINOv2 and VJEPA-2 encoders and a local language model, and outline evaluation criteria for segmentation quality, memory compression, retrieval fidelity, and long-horizon QA.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral and poster presentation at the ACVR Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival abstract; not published in the workshop proceedings. 8 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把长时程第一人称/第三人称工作场景多模态视频压缩成可审计的 Procedural State Memory（Work Environment Model, WEM）：按事件分割理论用视觉上下文、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互的变化检测边界，而非固定窗口或仅凭视觉新颖度；每段抽象成带 actor、区间、位置、动作、前后状态、置信度与来源的事件卡，增量更新 WEM。实例化用冻结的 DINOv2 与 VJEPA-2 编码器加本地语言模型，仅给出分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真与长时程 QA 的评估标准。
Motivation: 长时程 ego/exo 工作场景视频冗余、含噪且处理与存储成本高，需要在本地隐私约束下做紧凑、可审计的记录与检索。
Method: 以事件分割理论为依据，用视觉上下文、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互以及可选的第三人称工作区证据的联合变化检测事件边界；每段生成证据关联的事件卡（actor、时间区间、位置、动作、物体/工具、前后状态、置信度、provenance），事件卡增量更新 WEM。实例化采用冻结的 DINOv2 与 VJEPA-2 编码器加本地语言模型。
Result: 提出的设计为紧凑、可审计的工作场景文档与检索，支持在本地隐私约束下运行；论文给出面向分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真与长时程 QA 的评估标准。
Conclusion: 多模态证据联合的事件分割加事件卡抽象，可以把连续工作视频变成可增量维护、可溯源的结构化程序记忆，而非依赖固定窗口或仅视觉新颖度。

summary_sections.result: 提出的设计为紧凑、可审计的工作场景文档与检索，支持在本地隐私约束下运行；论文给出面向分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真与长时程 QA 的评估标准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态证据联合的事件分割加事件卡抽象，可以把连续工作视频变成可增量维护、可溯源的结构化程序记忆，而非依赖固定窗口或仅视觉新颖度。

papers.title: Robust Online Aero-Engine Blade Defect Detection via Dual-Alignment Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual inspection is essential for quality assurance in aero-engine blade manufacturing, where defect appearance may vary across production lines, imaging conditions, blade poses, and surface backgrounds. Such domain shifts cause a mismatch between training and deployment data and degrade the reliability of deep defect detectors in online inspection. This problem is particularly challenging because aero-engine blade images usually contain sparse defects, making pseudolabel-based adaptation vulnerable to noisy or missing predictions. To address this issue, we propose Aero-engine Blade Defect Detector (ABDD), an online adaptive detection framework based on test-time adaptation. ABDD introduces a Dual-Alignment Strategy to jointly adapt global visual style and local defect morphology by combining feature-statistics alignment with pseudo-box alignment. To reduce error accumulation from unreliable pseudo labels, an Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering mechanism evaluates pseudo boxes using classification confidence, classification entropy, and localization entropy. In addition, a lightweight Sparse Dilated Mona module enables parameter-efficient delta tuning while limiting source-domain forgetting. ABDD is evaluated on CD-AeBD and HD-AeBD under multiple domain-shift scenarios, with TTA strategies compared under a unified RT-DETR + Swin-T architecture. Experiments show that ABDD consistently improves detection robustness under domain shifts, and its practicality is further validated on an industrial inspection platform.
papers.comment: This manuscript is Accepted at conference PRCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向航空发动机叶片缺陷在线检测的测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 框架 ABDD，用双对齐策略同时对齐全局视觉风格与局部缺陷形态，并以不确定性盒过滤抑制稀疏缺陷下伪标签的噪声累积。在 CD-AeBD 与 HD-AeBD 的多种域偏移场景下，ABDD 在统一的 RT-DETR + Swin-T 架构上一致提升检测鲁棒性，并在工业检测平台上验证可用性。
Motivation: 产线、成像条件、叶片姿态与表面背景变化造成训练与部署数据的域偏移，使深度缺陷检测器在在线检查中失准；叶片图像缺陷稀疏，基于伪标签的自适应容易被噪声或漏检带偏。
Method: ABDD 为在线自适应检测框架：Dual-Alignment Strategy 结合 feature-statistics alignment（全局视觉风格）与 pseudo-box alignment（局部缺陷形态）；Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering 用分类置信度、分类熵与定位熵评估伪框以减少错误累积；Sparse Dilated Mona 模块做参数高效的 delta tuning 并限制源域遗忘。TTA 策略在统一的 RT-DETR + Swin-T 架构下比较。
Result: 在 CD-AeBD 与 HD-AeBD 上、多种域偏移场景下，ABDD 一致提升检测鲁棒性，且在工业检测平台上验证了实用性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 同时对齐风格与形态、并用不确定性过滤伪框，是稀疏缺陷在线检测在域偏移下保持可靠的一条可行路径，且可参数高效地接入现有检测器。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners
papers.abstract_en: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 9th ICAPS Workshop on Planning and Robotics. ICAPS 2021
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种面向任意 PDDL 域的概率化计划可读性 (plan legibility) 方法，用现成规划器 (off-the-shelf planners) 而非定制规划器生成能区分目标的计划，并用二阶心智理论 (second-order theory of mind) 估计观察者视角。在多个 PDDL 规划域的基准上，可读性与计划效率存在权衡，且不同域能提升可读性的幅度不同，必须引入正则化因子来平衡两者。
Motivation: 既有可读性研究多依赖为特定问题定制的规划器，难以迁移到任意 PDDL 域；而机器人要在人机团队中隐式传达目标，就需要在不牺牲太多效率的前提下让计划可被观察者解读。
Method: 把可读性目标接到经典规划框架上，直接调用现成规划器求解，无需构造 ad-hoc planner；观察者视角通过连接规划者与观察者任务空间的二阶心智理论估计；并加入一个正则化因子在可读性与效率之间做权衡。
Result: 在若干 PDDL 规划域上给出基准结果：可读性与计划效率总体呈权衡关系，不同规划域提升可读性的空间不一致，正则化因子被证明是必要的。
Conclusion: 可读性可以作为通用 PDDL 规划的附加目标由现成规划器实现，但必须显式用正则化因子平衡可读性与效率，且收益依域而异。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. In deployment, systems routinely encounter novel combinations of familiar components, yet an atomic action classifier assigns every unseen combination exactly zero probability by construction. The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. Code: https://github.com/hisalaheiyo/assembly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 装配动作识别中，verb–noun 分解虽能突破原子动作分类器对未见组合概率为零的上限，但泛化只部分超出该上限：未见组合性能仍强烈依赖训练数据的共现结构，收益多来自稠密支持区内的插值而非无约束重组。失败集中在词表更大的分量上，共享编码器带来的分量纠缠使独立重组的调和平均最高领先 6.0×。
Motivation: 部署中系统常遇到熟悉部件的新组合，原子分类器按构造给未见组合零概率；主流的 verb–noun 分解虽被广泛采用，其在组合偏移下的泛化机制此前理解不足。
Method: 在 MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT 三个装配动作数据集上系统分析 verb–noun 分解，比较共享编码器训练与独立分量重组，从 primitive support、词表不对称、分量纠缠三个来源诊断泛化失败。
Result: 分解越过原子上限但仅部分泛化；未见组合表现与训练数据共现结构强绑定；失败持续集中在词表更大的分量，IMPACT 以动词为主的词表把瓶颈从名词反转为动词；共享编码器的分量纠缠在调和平均上落后独立重组最多 6.0×。
Conclusion: 分解只取得部分组合泛化，误差源自 primitive support、词表不对称与分量纠缠三者相连；作者给出可迁移的诊断框架，用于在聚合准确率之外研究组合识别。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pushing CPU Speech Synthesis to the Wall: Extreme Inference Tuning under Serverless Architecture and Billing
papers.abstract_en: Instance-billed serverless platforms charge for CPU and memory over the lifetime of a warm instance, making idle inference state a direct serving cost. We present billing-aware neural text-to-speech (TTS) serving on serverless CPUs, optimizing CPU-seconds and GB-seconds rather than throughput or latency alone. Conventional runtimes are poorly suited to this setting: per-request parallelism causes CPU contention under concurrency, while warm instances retain gigabytes of billable inference and page-cache state. We address these costs with request-sized concurrent inference, which bounds per-request CPU parallelism, and a reclaimable instance lifecycle, which releases inference state and page-cache memory after idle periods while retaining the server process and compile cache. On Kokoro-82M, our system achieves 2.71 audio-seconds per CPU-second versus 0.89 with ONNX Runtime defaults and reduces cost per audio-hour from $0.0631 with PyTorch to $0.0153, a 4.1x reduction. Idle billed memory falls from 8.7 GB to 1.33 GB, while restoration reaches first audio in 2.2 s versus 7.7 s for a PyTorch cold start. Under bursty traffic, lifecycle reclamation is essential for translating inference efficiency into lower serverless cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向按实例计费的 serverless CPU 语音合成，提出计费感知的 TTS 服务方案：用 request-sized concurrent inference 限制每请求 CPU 并行度，用可回收实例生命周期在空闲期释放推理状态与 page-cache，同时保留 server 进程与编译缓存。在 Kokoro-82M 上每 CPU-second 产出 2.71 audio-seconds（ONNX Runtime 默认 0.89），每 audio-hour 成本从 PyTorch 的 $0.0631 降到 $0.0153（4.1 倍），空闲计费内存从 8.7 GB 降到 1.33 GB。
Motivation: serverless 平台按 warm 实例的 CPU 与内存生命周期计费，空闲推理状态直接变成成本；常规运行时的每请求并行在并发下造成 CPU 争用，warm 实例又保留数 GB 可计费的推理与 page-cache 状态。
Method: 两个组件：request-sized concurrent inference 为每个请求限定 CPU 并行度以避免并发争用；reclaimable instance lifecycle 在空闲一段时间后释放推理状态与 page-cache 内存，但保留 server 进程和编译缓存，恢复时不必冷启动。优化目标是 CPU-seconds 与 GB-seconds，而非单纯吞吐或延迟。
Result: 在 Kokoro-82M 上：每 CPU-second 产出 2.71 audio-seconds，ONNX Runtime 默认为 0.89；每 audio-hour 成本从 PyTorch 的 $0.0631 降至 $0.0153，为 4.1 倍下降；空闲计费内存从 8.7 GB 降至 1.33 GB；恢复到首帧音频耗时 2.2 s，PyTorch 冷启动为 7.7 s。突发流量下生命周期回收是把推理效率转化为 serverless 成本下降的必要条件。
Conclusion: 在按生命周期计费的 serverless CPU 上，把优化目标改成 CPU-seconds 与 GB-seconds，并同时约束请求级并行与空闲状态驻留，才能把推理效率真正兑换成成本；突发流量场景下生命周期回收不可或缺。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAP-DPO 把个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化：分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向的一阶交互，指出在 off-policy 采样下，当偏好 margin 与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO 更新从纯纠错信号转为类强化更新。据此做效用感知、几何对齐的配对选择，并用逐 epoch 重生成控制分布偏移，在个性化文本生成基准上稳定提升文风保真、偏好对齐与生成质量。
Motivation: DPO 在个性化设定下的效果高度依赖偏好对的选取，而现有方法多用似然极值等启发式准则，把优化与显式用户效用割裂，导致个性化退化。
Method: GAP-DPO：分析期望用户效用梯度与 DPO 更新方向的一阶交互，把配对选择建模为几何决策；迭代执行效用感知、几何对齐的 pair selection，并通过 epoch-wise regeneration 控制分布偏移 (distribution shift)。
Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO 相比标准 DPO 变体在文风保真 (stylistic fidelity)、偏好对齐与生成质量上均一致提升；摘要给出的是定性比较方向，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 梯度对齐是个性化偏好优化的统一原则：配对选择属于优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

papers.title: The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating
papers.abstract_en: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 LLM judge 首 token logits 直接读判定（不生成）会系统性夸大位置偏差：在三个 Qwen3 judge 上 12%–49% 的 pair 中 judge 并未以判定 token 开头，此时强制读取返回的是先展示的那侧而非判断。924 个未表态 pair 上交换响应后强制读取翻转 89.7%，而生成后读取仅 47.5%（配对差 +0.422，95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）；作者建议任何位置偏差数字都同时报告 judge 以判定 token 开头的比率（一次前向、无需标注）。
Motivation: 受约束解码与 likelihood-scoring 评测框架普遍从首 token logits 读取 judge 判定，但这种读法是否忠实反映 judge 的真实判断、会如何扭曲位置偏差审计，此前没有检验。
Method: 在三种 Qwen3 judge 与 Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-3.5-mini 上，对比首 token logits 强制读取与生成后读取两种 readout；对响应顺序做交换（swap）以测量位置偏差，并统计 judge 以判定 token 开头的比率，另检查先给一个字母再推理到另一字母的情形。
Result: Qwen3 judge 有 12%–49% 的 pair 不以判定 token 开头，Llama-3.1-8B 与 Phi-3.5-mini 低于 3%；924 个未表态 pair 上强制读取在交换后翻转 89.7%，生成后读取为 47.5%，配对差 +0.422（95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）。该失真使位置偏差移动 42 个百分点，而 judge accuracy 在十种条件中的七种里变化不足 1 个百分点；即便 judge 以判定 token 开头，先给一字母再推理到另一字母的情形占 0–5.5%，且与 compliance 无关。
Conclusion: 首 token 读取得到的位置偏差数字应视为上界，会误导审计 judge 的人而非使用 judge 的人；报告判定 token 开头比率（一次前向、无需标签）应与位置偏差数字一并给出。

papers.title: Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining
papers.abstract_en:
Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global 
vfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local 
vfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine 
vfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出格式感知融合 (format-aware fusion)，把每个量化生产者与其 scale 域、消费端 layout 一起协同设计，用于原生 mxfp4、全局 nvfp4 与 CTA 局部 nvfp4 的 FP4 预训练。在 Llama-3 系 8B、160B token 预训练中，最快自定义路径达 37.9K tokens/s/GPU，mxfp4 加行梯度随机舍入与固定符号 32 点 Hadamard 权重梯度预处理达 37.2K（86.3% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization），训练损失终点比原始 bfloat16 高 2.11%。
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core 的矩阵乘加速会被 scale 计算、操作数打包、layout 构建与反向保存状态抵消，需要在算子融合层面把这些开销一并设计掉。
Method: format-aware fusion 对每个量化生产者协同设计 scale 域与消费端 layout，覆盖原生 mxfp4、全局 nvfp4、CTA 局部 nvfp4；配合 bfloat16 输出投影与编译版 cross entropy，训练 Llama-3 系 8B 至 160B token，并加入行梯度随机舍入与固定符号 32 值 Hadamard 权重梯度预处理。
Result: 同加速器对比下 bfloat16 与 Transformer Engine nvfp4 分别为 18.8K 与 27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快自定义路径 37.9K；mxfp4 路线 37.2K tokens/s/GPU、86.3% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization，训练损失终点比 bfloat16 高 2.11%；含四个最终 bfloat16 块的 Transformer Engine 配方 27.1K tokens/s/GPU、终点比 bfloat16 高 0.87%。下游排序与训练损失排序不一致。
Conclusion: FP4 预训练结果同时取决于 scale contract、操作数与执行路径，单看训练损失会给出与下游排序不同的结论。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Data, code, and collector at github.com/Rankfor/rankfor-open (research/lotto-models)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个语言模型配置各用四种英文提示词请求 1-49 中六个不重复随机数，1,200 次调用中 1,184 次给出有效彩票号码，输出高度集中：号码频率的有效多样性仅 9.9–18.0，而独立均匀六选四九抽样在同等样本量下的第五百分位阈值为 46.6–46.7。众数彩票占有效回答的 22.5–68.0%，作为对照的两份波兰 Lotto 实体开奖样本有效多样性为 41.1 和 41.4。
Motivation: 语言模型被当作随机数生成器使用时，输出分布是否接近均匀抽样缺少直接检验；本研究用彩票号码这一可与实体开奖对照的场景量化其集中程度。
Method: 评测六个语言模型配置，用四种英文提示变体请求 1-49 中六个互异整数，共 1,200 次调用；统计号码频率的有效多样性、无序彩票组合的去重数与众数占比，并以同等样本量下独立均匀六选四九模拟的第五百分位阈值及两份波兰 Lotto 历史开奖样本作对照。
Result: 1,200 次调用中 1,184 次返回有效彩票；有效多样性 9.9–18.0，对照模拟第五百分位阈值 46.6–46.7；各系统产出 8–93 个不同无序组合，众数组合占有效回答的 22.5–68.0%；两份波兰 Lotto 样本在更小样本量下有效多样性为 41.1 与 41.4。
Conclusion: 在所测部署设置下语言模型的六选四九输出显著集中，与实体开奖的分散度差距明显；作者明确指出该结果不识别成因，也不代表其他提示词、温度或工具配置下的表现。

papers.title: SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.
papers.comment: 22 pages, Code and pretrained models available at: https://github.com/amirhoseinazarpour/SW-KAN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SW-KAN 用定义在半无限区间 (0,∞) 上的 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替换 KAN 边上的可学习单变量函数，配合 smooth exponential-of-tanh 映射弥合无界输入与多项式支撑域的错配，并用数值稳定的三项递推在 O(N) 复杂度内求值、无需调用特殊函数。在图像分类与连续函数逼近实验中，它在精度-效率权衡上超过已有 polynomial KAN 基线，且在降维与少样本等资源受限条件下仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 多项式版 KAN 虽缓解了 B-spline 的计算开销，但无界实值输入与正交多项式的有界或半无限支撑之间存在域错配，这一问题尚未被充分处理。
Method: 提出 Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN)：边上用 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式（含可学习 q 参数与 log-normal 权重结构）；smooth exponential-of-tanh 映射稳定桥接域差并保持良态梯度；数值稳定的三项递推以 O(N) 次运算求值多项式展开，不调用特殊函数。
Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近两类任务的综合实验中，SW-KAN 在精度-效率权衡上优于既有 polynomial KAN 基线；在特征维度降低与训练数据有限等资源受限条件下表现稳健，并能用极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。
Conclusion: 作者主张 SW-KAN 是资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的一个有竞争力的替代方案，其归纳偏置来自 Stieltjes-Wigert 多项式的 log-normal 权重结构与可学习 q 参数。

summary_sections.result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近两类任务的综合实验中，SW-KAN 在精度-效率权衡上优于既有 polynomial KAN 基线；在特征维度降低与训练数据有限等资源受限条件下表现稳健，并能用极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张 SW-KAN 是资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的一个有竞争力的替代方案，其归纳偏置来自 Stieltjes-Wigert 多项式的 log-normal 权重结构与可学习 q 参数。

papers.title: Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GB200 上用 3 或 4 次多项式程序替换 LLM 内核中的 sigmoid、tanh、SiLU 等超越函数，靠解析对称性、目标格式舍入与打包 FMA 在消费内核内求值。隔离路径在 L2 提速 1.19–2.19x、HBM 提速 1.00–1.70x；四项集成任务的完整训练步吞吐提升 2.7%、2.9%、8.0%，sigmoid attention 的完整 attention 前向提升 7.4% 但整步仅 0.3%。约 1000 亿 token 处最终平滑训练损失差（多项式减原生）在四个任务上介于 −0.107 到 +0.079。
Motivation: GPU 各代的矩阵、特殊函数与内存流水线扩展速率不同，瓶颈随硬件迁移；FlashAttention-4 已在 NVIDIA Blackwell 上暴露 attention 内部的这种失衡，需要检验短多项式程序能否加速 LLM 中其他 SFU 操作。
Method: 先在 IEEE binary16 (FP16) 下对比原生 PyTorch 求值与打包 FMA 程序，覆盖 L2 常驻与 HBM 常驻工作集；再把原生 sigmoid、tanh、SiLU 换成 degree-3 或 degree-4 的 bfloat16 (BF16) 程序，嵌入四个 GB200 集成任务：dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU，程序结合解析对称、目标格式舍入与消费内核内的打包算术。另做同 checkpoint 开放权重消融与每任务一次配对预训练对比以考察模型行为。
Result: 隔离路径在 L2 提速 1.19–2.19x、HBM 提速 1.00–1.70x；dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、routed-expert 三项替换的完整训练步吞吐分别提升 2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid attention 替换使完整 attention 前向提升 7.4%、完整 GPU step 提升 0.3%。在约 1000 亿 token 的常见训练长度上，四项任务的最终平滑训练损失差（多项式减原生）范围为 −0.107 到 +0.079。
Conclusion: 短多项式程序可在 GB200 上把 LLM 的 SFU 超越函数替换为打包 FMA 并带来实际吞吐收益，但收益幅度取决于该函数在整步中的占比，且训练损失在不同任务上可正可负。
