papers.title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
papers.abstract_en: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 PRM 剪枝后的高分前缀原样嫁接给仍在解码的兄弟链（PPFG）这一最省成本的跨轨迹迁移机制单独隔离出来测试，在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd、MATH500 全集（n=500，3 seeds）上，其 stagnation 与 random 两变体在所有测量轴上都与独立 parallel-CoT 基线统计不可区分。322 次注入事件中仅 14% 落在真正卡住的链上，其余落在已成功、近完成或 PRM 平台期的链上；随机对照以 2.4 倍触发率得到同样的平局，说明惰性并非启发式特有。
Motivation: 并行 chain-of-thought 存在多样性坍缩，已有片段嫁接工作报告收益但依赖额外补偿性组件；作者要隔离 PPFG 这一最简操作化本身是否在该工作点上真的有效。
Method: 定义 PPFG（PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting）：PRM 剪掉一条链时，把其高 PRM 前缀逐字作为 in-context demonstration 注入仍在解码的兄弟链；设 stagnation-targeting 与 random-targeting 两变体，并设计无复合门控的对照与 hindsight oracle 上界分析，用 two-one-sided-tests (TOST) 做等价性检验。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Math-Shepherd、MATH500 全集（n=500，3 seeds）上两变体与 independent parallel-CoT 在每个测量轴统计不可区分；322 次 stagnation 注入事件四桶分类仅 14% 打中真正挣扎的链；random 对照在 2.4 倍触发率下同样平局；结果在 3 个基座 LM、6 个 benchmark、第二个 PRM 与兼容门扫描上复现，TOST 把 12 个 Qwen/LLaMA 单元的平局提升为正等价；被注入链以 2.75 倍匹配步速率被剪，但 surviving-sibling 反事实显示无总体补偿；hindsight oracle 给出 PPFG 相对 independent 的单题收益上界 +0.13 pp。
Conclusion: 在所测工作点上 PPFG 是惰性机制：门控无法同时做到精准触发与足够密度，且惰性非启发式特有；作者贡献一套用于确立推理时机制零效应的等价性检验模板，所有论断限定在其测试的工作点。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Delegation Danger Band: Why Mid-Capability Sub-Agents Over-Trust Inherited Stale State
papers.abstract_en: Agent frameworks increasingly delegate work by forking sub-agents; a common default makes the child inherit the parent's full working context. We measure how the effect of inherited state changes with capability, where $C_m$ denotes clean fork-fresh accuracy. We compare 3 inheritance policies: Reset (fork fresh: base evidence only), Selective (curated handoff: + the useful prior conclusion), and Full (implicit fork: + the useful conclusion and $d$ copies of a superseded conclusion) over a same-family ladder (Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B) on a frozen, closed-set, action-scored benchmark. Every task is solvable from the base evidence, so performance loss can be attributed to reliance on stale state. (1) Deference to superseded state falls sharply with measured capability $C_m$ (the slope's confidence interval, CI, excludes zero on every family) across 2 synthetic primitives plus MuSiQue and HotpotQA. (2) On the Qwen3 synthetic ladder, net inheritance harm follows a nonmonotone pattern: a mid-capability model (Qwen3-1.7B) is a statistically significant local minimum of net harm, falling below its fork-fresh baseline ($Δ(32)=-0.19$ [-0.25, -0.12]) and both neighbors, while the weakest model stays near-neutral and the strongest models stay robust. We call this harmful capability range a danger band. A within-model counting-difficulty sweep shows that the effect depends on model class even at matched $C_m$, and a live parent-to-child fork reproduces the mid-model harm. (3) Curated Selective handoff improves average accuracy over Full on all 3 datasets, largest at the in-band model, while the fixed-threshold capability router fails on the other datasets; a transferable router would need to predict the balance between reuse benefit and stale-context penalty. The benchmark is frozen and version-hashed.
papers.comment: Preprint. Under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的闭集、动作打分基准上比较三种子代理上下文继承策略（Reset/Selective/Full），发现对被取代旧结论的顺从随模型能力 Cm 上升而锐减，而净继承危害在 Qwen3-1.7B 这一中等能力处出现非单调局部最小值 Δ(32)=-0.19 [-0.25,-0.12]，低于其 fork-fresh 基线与两侧邻居，作者称之为 danger band。Selective 精选交接在全部 3 个数据集上平均准确率高于 Full，且在带内模型上增益最大，而固定阈值能力路由器在其余数据集上失效。
Motivation: Agent 框架默认让子代理继承父代理完整工作上下文，但继承状态的危害如何随模型能力变化、是否可预测，此前缺少受控测量；任务全部可由基础证据解出，性能损失才能归因于对陈旧状态的依赖。
Method: 在同一族 Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B 阶梯上对比三种继承策略：Reset（fork fresh，仅基础证据）、Selective（精选交接，附有用前结论）、Full（隐式 fork，附有用结论加 d 份被取代结论）；基准冻结、版本哈希、闭集动作打分，任务含 2 个合成原语加 MuSiQue 与 HotpotQA，并做计数难度扫描与真实 parent-to-child fork 复现。
Result: 对被取代状态的顺从随 Cm 锐减，斜率置信区间在每个族上都排除零；Qwen3 合成阶梯上净继承危害非单调，Qwen3-1.7B 为统计显著局部最小，Δ(32)=-0.19 [-0.25,-0.12]，低于 fork-fresh 基线与两侧邻居，最弱模型近中性、最强模型稳健；同 Cm 下计数难度扫描显示效应依赖模型类别；Selective 在 3 个数据集上平均准确率均高于 Full，带内模型增益最大，固定阈值能力路由器在其余数据集上失效。
Conclusion: 继承陈旧状态的危害集中在中等能力区间而非随能力单调下降，可迁移的能力路由器必须预测复用收益与陈旧上下文惩罚的平衡，而非按单一能力阈值切换。

papers.title: DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSSR-3D 是一个推理时框架，把视角依赖指代分割解耦为两个接口——位姿不变的语义定位与位姿条件化的空间推理——用温度锐化的 softmax 定位加投影式方向打分、经无训练轻量融合即可实例化，无需重训语义场也不依赖 bounding box 等离散几何代理。在新提出的 ViewRef-GS 基准与增强版 Ref-LERF 上，对现有 3DGS 指代方法取得一致增益，并零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场。
Motivation: 现有 3D Gaussian 指代场把语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法解析依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如 to the left of），而这类关系正是视角依赖指代的核心。
Method: 将问题形式化为两个接口：位姿不变语义定位与位姿条件化空间推理，任意满足约束的函数对均可实例化。具体用温度锐化的 softmax 定位机制与基于投影的方向打分函数，通过一个轻量、无训练的步骤融合；同时提出 ViewRef-GS 基准，并与增强的 Ref-LERF 联合评测。
Result: 实验显示相对现有 3DGS-based referring 方法取得一致增益，且除基础语义场外无需额外训练；两个接口实例可零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场而无需适配。
Conclusion: 视角依赖指代可以在推理时通过解耦语义定位与位姿条件空间推理来解决，不必重训语义场，也不必依赖 bounding box 等离散几何代理。

papers.title: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
papers.abstract_en: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在学生风险预测上把 RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件化超网络 (preference-conditioned hypernetworks) 组合成多目标框架，用一个用户定义的偏好标量连续调节预测性能与 Equalized Odds 的权衡。结果是两种超网络变体都出现 mode collapse：调偏好权重几乎不沿预期的公平性-性能前沿移动，失败归因于目标主导、经条件机制的梯度传播弱以及动态生成参数间的相互作用。
Motivation: 教育交互数据上的学生风险预测需要既准又可解释以支撑干预，而人口统计信息会引入不公平预测的风险；如何用一个标量连续控制性能与公平的权衡是待验证的缺口。
Method: 以 RL-MIL 为基础：每个学生表示为弱标签交互的 bag，RL agent 挑选有信息量的 instance 送入下游分类；叠加 adversarial debiasing，并评测两种超网络变体，检验偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与 Equalized Odds 的折衷。
Result: RL-MIL 基线取得强分类性能；两种超网络扩展均出现 mode collapse，改变偏好权重在预期公平-性能前沿上几乎不产生系统性移动；失败与目标主导、经条件机制的弱梯度传播、动态生成参数间的交互相关。
Conclusion: 公平目标可以并入可解释的 RL-MIL 流水线，但仅靠偏好条件化不能保证可控的多目标行为；稳健的 fair RL-MIL 需要显式的梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性分析机制。

papers.title: Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在七个城市属性、五个公开数据源和三个 VLM 上做同单元对照，发现街景图像并非普遍增益：道路损坏、缘坡坡道、房价上既有城市数据持平或更好，人口上邻近官方统计几乎追平最佳图像结果，只有建筑类型、建筑功能、低层楼层数上图像更有信息量。楼层数的图像优势随到最近标注建筑距离每翻倍增加 5.7 个百分点，高层建筑因屋顶线出画而优势下降；模型还常跟随冲突记录。
Motivation: 街景图像推断城市属性只报预测精度，无法说明一张照片相对同地点已有数据到底多贡献了什么，导致图像采集与派生城市地图的来源标注缺乏依据。
Method: 在同一城市单元上分别用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录四类输入喂三个 VLM，覆盖五个公开资源的七个属性；再用图像替换与冲突记录测试模型对各来源的依赖，并对比 OpenFACADES 楼层标注（由 OpenStreetMap 楼层值生成）与纯图像重跑的误差模式。
Result: 道路损坏、缘坡坡道、房价上既有城市数据持平或超过纯图像模型；人口上邻近官方统计几乎追平最佳图像结果；建筑类型、建筑功能、低层楼层数上图像更有信息量。楼层数的图像优势随到最近标注建筑距离每翻倍增加 5.7 个百分点，高层建筑上优势下降。模型常跟随冲突记录，OpenFACADES 楼层标注呈现与纯图像重跑相反的随高度变化的误差模式。
Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可读性与本地数据覆盖，把图像与既有城市数据对照可以指导图像采集并厘清派生城市地图的来源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap
papers.abstract_en: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向目标检测的域泛化 (DG) 综述，把合成数据的角色拆成三面：作为 enabler 通过多样化与对齐策略提升对分布偏移的鲁棒性，作为 probe 支持受控实验定位失效模式，以及作为 synthetic-to-real gap 这一特定域偏移。综述据此指出当前面向检测的 DG 方法存在局限，主张未来方法必须是 representation-aware 的，同时处理域偏移下的定位与分类。
Motivation: 目标检测模型在天气类型、作业环境或目标外观变化引起的分布偏移下性能退化，而专门针对检测模型的 DG 研究稀缺——检测还额外面临定位与多尺度表征的困难。
Method: 以目标检测为中心综述 DG，从三个互补视角考察合成数据：多样化与对齐策略（enabler）、受控实验识别失效模式（probe）、以及合成到真实的域偏移；最后归纳现有方法的局限。
Result: 综述识别出当前面向目标检测的 DG 方法的局限，并论证未来研究需要显式同时处理域偏移下定位与分类的 representation-aware 方法；摘要未给出实验数字。
Conclusion: 合成数据同时是 DG 的使能器与诊断探针，但检测场景的域泛化必须把定位和分类一起纳入表征层面的设计，单靠分类鲁棒性不够。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model
papers.abstract_en: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency, memory, energy, and real-time factor were not measured. All evaluation speech and targets are synthetic, references are model-proposed, and the judge is uncalibrated. The evidence shows that a compact model can acquire a narrow audio-to-structure transformation from a few hundred provenance-linked synthetic examples; it does not establish clinical validity, real-speech transfer, or superiority to a clean cloud system.
papers.comment: Submitted to On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 182 条可审计的日语护理交接合成语音，对 1.47B 音频模型做全量微调与 rank-16 LoRA，直接生成六字段结构化记录。在 39 条场景种子不重叠的合成测试上，事实性召回分从未适配的 0.0500 升到全量微调 0.8664、LoRA 0.8461，LoRA 达到全量微调聚合值的 97.7%，可训练参数 12.4M（约骨干的 0.85%）。
Motivation: 私域语音难以收集与再分发，而紧凑模型需要任务专属监督；护理交接这类场景既缺数据又要求可审计。
Method: 构建可审计的合成管线，把日语护理交接语音直接映射到六字段结构化笔记；用 182 条合成训练/开发片段，对 1.47B 音频模型分别做全量微调与 rank-16 LoRA 两种适配，评测用模型判定的事实性召回分。
Result: 39 条场景种子不重叠合成测试上，未适配模型事实性召回分 0.0500，全量微调 0.8664，LoRA 0.8461；LoRA 聚合值为全量微调的 97.7%，可训练参数 12.4M（约骨干 0.85%）。两种适配相对同一基座均有大幅配对增益，全量与 LoRA 的区间跨零，且优化设置不同故不作等价断言；评测语音与目标全为合成，参考由模型提出，判定器未校准，未测延迟、内存、能耗与实时率。
Conclusion: 紧凑模型能靠几百条带溯源的合成样本习得窄域音频到结构的转换，但结果属于参数高效能力获取，不构成临床有效性、真实语音迁移或优于干净云端系统的证据。

summary_sections.conclusion: 紧凑模型能靠几百条带溯源的合成样本习得窄域音频到结构的转换，但结果属于参数高效能力获取，不构成临床有效性、真实语音迁移或优于干净云端系统的证据。

papers.title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).
papers.comment: Preprint. under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 15 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 agent harness 中围绕前沿 LLM planner 的微任务，构建含 4 个微任务、固定 prompt 与预设阈值 τ 的基准，用 CI-aware 资格判定规则检验现成 SLM 是否达标。Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B 在 FP16 greedy 最佳设置下 16 个配置 0 通过，Llama-3.x 12/12 不合格，4-bit 量化不改变结论；作者建议把 SLM 放在已达阈值的基线之后，仅在基线不达标处使用。
Motivation: agent harness 希望用 SLM 承担自动审批 shell 命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次等微任务，但缺少以实践者预设阈值为准的合格性判定，也说不清失败是能力不足还是解码阈值问题。
Method: 构建 4 个微任务基准，固定 prompt、自动指标，每个任务设锚定廉价非 LLM 基线的阈值 τ，并用 CI-aware 规则判定（置信界越过 τ 才通过）；对 Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B 做 FP16 greedy 扫描，用 logprob 决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4，T2 用 context-length/cascade probe）区分能力缺陷与解码阈值可修复的失败，并测试 RTN/GPTQ/AWQ 4-bit 量化、τ-sweep 与 prompt 改写。
Result: Qwen3 4 模型 × 4 任务共 16 个配置 0 通过；Llama-3.x 12/12 不合格；4-bit 量化不使任何配置进入合格集，损伤随模型规模变化；τ-sweep 与 3 个中性改写 prompt 下 112 个单元 0 合格；诊断把失败分为 4 类 regime；4B re-ranker 相对 BM25 shortlist 提升 +0.047 [0.020, 0.073]，但自身未获资格认证。
Conclusion: 现成 SLM 的合格性缺口主要随模型规模而非精度变化，量化补不上；实践上应把 SLM 放在满足 CI 阈值的基线之后，只在基线不达标处使用。

papers.title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
papers.abstract_en: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B 三个 VLM 上，POPE 错误的中层残差流里 68–91% 编码了正确答案，但残差流 patching 在层级上产生 0% 非平凡翻转，说明该信号被编码却不对最终预测起因果作用。尽管如此，错误仍可按三种失败模式（Perception Failure、Encoded-but-Disconnected、Prior-Override）在三个架构上以 60% 以上准确率学出，且架构的 prior 方向能预测两类干预中哪一类会引发类别特异响应。
Motivation: 中层可解释性研究常把“探针能读出答案”当作该信息参与了决策，但探针精度与因果活性是两回事；需要在统一基准上判定中层信号是否真的驱动最终预测。
Method: 在三个 VLM 架构共有的 POPE 基准上，先用探针度量中层对真值答案的编码比例，再用 residual-stream patching 做层级与逐头（per-head）因果干预，统计非平凡翻转率；随后把错误分类为三种失败模式并学习分类器，用 oracle 标签下的缓解效应检验类别是否机制上真实。
Result: 中层在 68–91% 的错误中编码真值答案，但层级 patching 在三个架构上均为 0% 非平凡翻转，逐头层面两个架构同样为 0（Qwen 0/12,600 次 patched forward）；唯一例外是 InternVL3 layer-20 head-2，为非词表、自注意力头，效应局限在该头（p < 1e-4）。三种失败模式在三个架构上均可 60% 以上准确率学出，架构 prior 方向可预测干预的类别特异响应。
Conclusion: 中层可解码的答案信号普遍不具因果活性，中层可解释性方法应区分编码与因果作用；错误仍可操作性地分解为三种机制上真实的失败模式，oracle 标签下的缓解效应仅作机制证据而非可部署方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
papers.abstract_en: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在角色分工 QA 中，reasoner 传给 verifier 的 rationale 实际是一个可被操纵的验证消息：固定证据与候选答案、只改动 rationale 的干预显示，忠实 rationale 对答案准确率几乎无增益，而被破坏的 rationale 会大幅扭转 support 判断。作者据此主张把 rationale 共享当作验证消息机制来评估，而不是当作提升答案准确率的路径。
Motivation: 角色分工 QA 流水线普遍在 reasoner 与 verifier 之间传递 rationale，但这条消息究竟带来更好的答案、更强的支撑判断，还是新的失败面，此前不清楚。
Method: 提出 message-intervention 诊断：固定证据与候选答案，只改变跨 reasoner-to-verifier 边界传递的 rationale；在 MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 共 400 个样例上，以 DeepSeek 同时作 generator 与 verifier，对比无 rationale、忠实 rationale、被破坏 rationale 与无害改写，并设置 blind verifier prompt 与显式 rationale-checking prompt 两种条件，辅以人工审计与跨模型、任务边界检查。
Result: 忠实 rationale 相对无 rationale 几乎不提升答案准确率；被破坏 rationale 强烈改变 support 判断：blind prompt 下无害改写仅使 support 变化 0--2.5%，被破坏 rationale 变化 10--22%，显式 rationale-checking prompt 把同一模式放大到 34--55%。最终答案变动较小（2--30%），且仅 2.9--35.3% 的被破坏 support 翻转伴随答案改变。人工审计中 42 个有效破坏里 16 个属 corruption-overtrust；10 条被审计的被破坏 rationale 中，模型接受而人类拒绝或判为不清楚的有 9 条。
Conclusion: rationale 通道是一个活跃且可被放大的验证消息机制，其风险在于支撑判断被操纵而非答案准确率，因此应按验证消息机制而非准确率路径来评估 rationale 共享。

papers.title: Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spatial Lifting (SL)：把 2D 图像等标准输入升维到高维空间，再用 3D U-Net 一类的高维网络处理，靠升维本身换取基准任务上的良好性能，同时降低推理开销并大幅削减参数量。升维维度上自然涌现的结构让训练可做 dense supervision，测试时单次前向即可给出自洽性 (self-consistency) 的质量与不确定性估计。
Motivation: 稠密预测中常规 2D 架构在性能、推理成本与参数量之间难以兼顾，且测试时的不确定性估计通常需要额外前向或外部模块。
Method: SL 把标准输入（如 2D 图像）升维到更高维空间，用面向该维度的网络（如 3D U-Net）处理；升维维度上的内在结构用于训练期的 dense supervision，并支撑测试期单次前向的自洽性质量与不确定性估计。
Result: 在基准稠密预测任务上取得与常规方法相当的良好性能，同时降低推理成本并显著减少模型参数量；输出沿升维维度具有内在结构，可单次前向完成质量与不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 升维处理是一种通用且简单的稠密预测建模策略，可同时改善视觉稠密预测网络的效率、精度与可靠性。

papers.title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

papers.title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedCausalCompose 用模块内动作的干预-响应证据来恢复跨模块因果接口，结论是因果世界模型只在接口同时统计可辨识、且以行动时可用的形式呈现给 agent 时才真正起作用。结构化工具环境（API 签名暴露前置条件与下游效应）中因果接口收益最大；对话与叙事环境里原始边表常被忽略，除非加一个短的 attention anchor 让因果信息与决策相关。
Motivation: 模块化 LLM agent 中一个模块的动作会改变另一模块的有效转移，而观测拟合的世界模型无法区分 payment 授权 shipment、inventory 中介还是隐藏触发同时导致两者，干预时规划所需的量与观测轨迹不一致。
Method: 提出 FedCausalCompose：以模块局部动作的干预-响应证据识别跨模块接口的因果组合；先给出理论结果（未阻断的后门路径导致观测世界模型存在不可约的干预误差、接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖率改进、oracle 因果组合在覆盖率与局部机制误差受控时可超过非因果下界），再在诊断性 agent 设定中检验该预测。
Result: 理论侧给出三条判定：观测世界模型在未阻断后门路径下有不可约干预误差；接口恢复质量随干预-响应覆盖率提升；覆盖率与局部机制误差受控时 oracle 因果组合可击败非因果下界。实验侧为定性结果：结构化工具环境中因果接口帮助最大，对话与叙事环境需 attention anchor 才让因果信息进入决策。
Conclusion: 因果结构对 LLM agent 是否有用取决于两个条件同时成立：跨模块接口统计可辨识，且以 agent 在行动时能使用的形式呈现；仅提供原始边表在对话/叙事环境中不起作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长时程语言 agent 的记忆使用呈重尾分布：语义 LLM 策略下检索集中于小核心、稀有状态落入长尾并累积预测误差。据此提出按秩分配 prompt 预算的 Core–Tail World Model (CTWM)，用单一指数 τ 控制核心并保留摘要化尾部，在 Synthetic Graph World 上保持全状态与转移覆盖、prompt token 减 5.9%、尾部下半段预测误差降 13.6%，LongMemEval 上 token 减 24.48% 且聚合准确率持平。
Motivation: 长时程语言 agent 依赖外部记忆作为冻结世界模型，但现有记忆系统只用任务成功率或 token 成本评价，缺少对记忆使用形态的刻画，稀有状态在长尾处的预测误差因此被忽略。
Method: 先做保守的尾部审计 (conservative tail audit)，比较随机游走 agent 与语义 LLM 策略下的检索分布形态；再提出 CTWM，一个基于秩的记忆控制器，用单指数 τ 分配 prompt 预算并保留摘要化的尾部，在 Synthetic Graph World、ALFWorld、LongMemEval 上与 graph-memory 基线做配对比较。
Result: 审计发现集中现象可复现且依赖策略：随机游走产生与 log-normal 相容的检索伪影，语义 LLM 策略给出最强的、与截断幂律相容的核心—尾部痕迹。CTWM 在 Synthetic Graph World 保持全状态与转移覆盖，prompt token 减少 5.9%，尾部下半段预测误差相对 graph-memory 基线降低 13.6%；ALFWorld 上同配对比较给出一致的 token 节省，LongMemEval 上 token 减少 24.48% 且聚合准确率持平。
Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹既是有限检索的诊断量，也可直接当作控制信号，用一个秩指数同时换取 token 效率与尾部预测精度，而不牺牲聚合准确率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
papers.abstract_en: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FourierQK 把 Q/K 点积换成在可学习频率上的带通滤波内积，用 TinyShakespeare 字符级语言建模（6 层 GPT）的受控消融检验五种滤波器性质。DC 与 Nyquist 分量有害（val ≈ 2.0，等价于相位随机化），最优单尺度带宽 σ ≈ 2 bins、中心在段落尺度（约 70 tokens），相对 BASE-DOT 净增 Δ = +1.15 nats；双边 FFT 泄漏随谱覆盖单调上升，窄带（gap > +4）干净、宽带（gap < +2）泄漏。结论是 FourierQK 适用于双向注意力（encoder 式，如 BERT），自回归生成需因果谱变体 MorletQK。
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力已证明带通滤波内积优于标准点积，但哪种滤波器形状最优、为何最优尚无受控答案；需要区分增益究竟来自振荡带通结构还是任意低维谱摘要。
Method: 在字符级语言建模 TinyShakespeare、6 层 GPT 上做受控消融，逐一检验五个滤波器性质假设：DC 抑制、Nyquist 抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖；对照 BASE-DOT 点积基线，并比较可容许滤波器（零均值 Mexican Hat DOG m = 2）与同尺度非可容许 Gaussian，另测因果时域 Morlet。
Result: DC 与 Nyquist 分量 val ≈ 2.0，等价于相位随机化；最优单尺度带宽 σ ≈ 2 bins、中心约 70 tokens（段落尺度），相对 BASE-DOT 净增 Δ = +1.15 nats；零均值 Mexican Hat DOG m = 2 优于同尺度非可容许 Gaussian，并对双边 FFT 泄漏提供部分保护；泄漏随谱覆盖单调变化，narrowband gap > +4 干净、wideband gap < +2 泄漏；因果时域 Morlet 在字符尺度 K = 128 taps 覆盖 T = 256 上下文的 50%，无法胜过 BASE-DOT。
Conclusion: 振荡带通结构（而非任意低维谱摘要）是 FourierQK 增益的来源，且泄漏与谱覆盖存在权衡；FourierQK 定位为双向注意力（encoder 式，如 BERT）方法，自回归生成应改用因果谱变体 MorletQK。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

papers.title: On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-span records reproduce all reported numbers offline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇端侧 NER 部署性研究：把 9 个跨三类范式、13M 到 8B 参数的系统放在同一评测下，除准确率外还报告延迟与输出合法性，并用跨家族 LLM 评审团构建的 silver gold 替代人工标注。核心结论是 gold 来源会翻转范式排名（换成人工 gold 后所有 encoder 上升、所有生成式模型下降），而 encoder 的真正卖点是部署性：体积小 1/9 到 1/24、毫秒到秒级延迟、零非法输出，最小生成式模型在长输入上非法输出高达 27%。
Motivation: 端侧 NER 的实际问题是选哪个模型可部署、在没有人工标注时如何评测、以及置信度能否信任，而现有文献只报准确率排行榜，遗漏延迟与输出合法性这两条轴。
Method: 评测 9 个系统：经典 tagger spaCy、双向编码器专家 GLiNER（166–460M）、本地运行的生成式 LLM（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B），覆盖 13M–8B 参数与三个性质不同的数据集；因自有语料 RSS-News 无 gold，用跨家族 LLM 评审团构建 silver gold，并对照基准 gold 与全语料人工复验来度量其保真度；再对 GLiNER 的逐 span 置信度做校准（temperature scaling）、阈值化与全本地小到大级联路由。
Result: silver gold 对人工复验的 strict F1 为 0.95（因人工 gold 由 silver 播种，属上界）；gold 来源翻转范式排名，LLM-authored silver 换成人工 gold 后每个 encoder 上升、每个生成式模型下降。仅看准确率 4B instruct LLM 有竞争力并在干净新闻电讯上领先；encoder 以 1/9 到 1/24 的体积、毫秒到秒级延迟、零非法输出与之持平或略逊，而最小生成式模型在长输入上非法输出最高达 27%，该失败由模型规模而非输出预算修复。GLiNER 逐 span 置信度排序正确性 AUROC 0.76–0.86，但过度自信 ECE 0.24–0.47，temperature scaling 后减半；阈值化带来小幅诚实的样本外 F1 提升，全本地级联相对等成本随机路由仅有温和且依赖语料的增益。
Conclusion: 端侧 NER 的选择依据应是部署性而非排行榜：encoder 在体积、延迟与输出合法性上占优，且置信度虽能排序正确性却系统性过度自信，需校准后才能用于阈值或路由决策；gold 来源本身会改变范式优劣结论。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预训练 Vision Transformer 的冻结 patch 嵌入中可高精度解码出 IsSameObject 信号，说明物体绑定 (object binding) 由自监督预训练自发涌现。绑定是局部的：同物体两 patch 被判为绑定的概率随距离单调衰减并停在非零地板，服从带有限长度尺度的指数衰减，且在 ADE20K 与 COCO、三类 probe、DINO 与 CLIP 上一致，故是表征性质而非解码器性质。
Motivation: 单一聚合解码准确率掩盖了绑定信号的空间结构，无法解释大物体上绑定变弱、同类不同物体分离更差等行为。
Method: 从冻结 patch 嵌入解码 IsSameObject，拟合同物体绑定概率随 patch 距离的指数衰减（有限长度尺度与非零地板），用三类 probe、ADE20K 与 COCO、DINO 与 CLIP backbone 交叉验证，并在控制混淆（物体尺寸、类别）下逐项映射行为。
Result: 衰减在不同物体尺寸、三类 probe、ADE20K 与 COCO、DINO 与 CLIP 上均成立；据此解释了大物体绑定减弱、同类物体间分离弱于异类、部件与整体被归为一组，而在控制物体尺寸后遮挡不影响绑定。DINOv2 与 DINOv3 中长度尺度与地板分处不同深度，仅作初步观察（探测层数少且两模型存在混淆）。
Conclusion: 物体绑定应读作具有有限范围的局部空间相干性，这一视角解释了聚合准确率无法说明的一组行为；深度组织结论目前只是提示性的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?
papers.abstract_en: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Adam 完整更新规则（含动量）拆解为带对角截断、标签替换与时滞的对角 empirical Fisher 近似，用尺度不变的 γ(Δθ) 度量其与真 NGD 的几何偏离。在良态线性回归中偏离很小，病态与非凸小神经网络中升到约 10³ 的错位；几何漂移越大初始优化越慢，但最终 loss 仍能压低。结论是 Adam 的实用优化能力来自近似误差与动量平滑的平衡，而非贴合自然梯度路径。
Motivation: Adam 与 natural gradient descent 的几何关系仍有未解问题：此前缺少对 Adam 完整更新规则（含动量）相对 NGD 的定量偏离刻画，也未区分这种偏离是否真的损害最终优化。
Method: 将 Adam 视作对角 empirical Fisher 近似并显式标出三类误差源：对角截断、empirical label substitution、时滞；用尺度不变度量 γ(Δθ) 在四类 loss landscape 上度量几何偏离——良态线性回归、病态线性回归、logistic 回归、非凸小神经网络；同时对比 improved empirical Fisher (iEF) 与标准 EF 的路径稳定性。
Result: 良态设定下偏离保持低水平，病态设定显著上升，在神经网络中达到约 10³ 的错位 (misalignment)；几何漂移越高初始优化越慢，但不损害最终目标最小化，Adam 始终达到低 loss；iEF 跟踪的路径比标准 EF 更稳定，后者常振荡或发散。
Conclusion: Adam 的优化效力可能来自结构性近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而不是紧密跟踪自然梯度路径；几何偏离是上下文相关的，病态与非凸地形才显著。

summary_sections.conclusion: Adam 的优化效力可能来自结构性近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而不是紧密跟踪自然梯度路径；几何偏离是上下文相关的，病态与非凸地形才显著。

papers.title: STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets
papers.abstract_en: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STATERA 用几乎冻结的 V-JEPA 视频骨干加轻量 temporal tubelet mixer，从短单目视频逐帧预测不透明非对称刚体的质心 (CoM) 热图与轨迹。在自建 HiddenMass Benchmark（50K MuJoCo 轨迹 + 63 段实测序列）上，仿真归一化 CoM 误差从 DINOv2 的 41.7% 降到 25.2%；零样本 sim-to-real 下 phase-aware 目标是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，physics capture 从 2.6% 提到 41.0%，但会引入单目向量过冲、绝对欧氏误差略高于静态几何质心。
Motivation: 面向帧级外观的预训练视觉模型难以从运动推断隐藏物理属性；在自遮挡下表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，非对称刚体的质心无法从单帧外观直接读出。
Method: 以预训练视频骨干 V-JEPA 为主体，权重大部分冻结，仅接入轻量 temporal tubelet mixer，输出逐帧 CoM 热图与轨迹；训练数据为新提出的 HiddenMass Benchmark，含 50K 条 MuJoCo 仿真轨迹与 63 段带物理标定 CoM 真值的真实序列，并对比 phase-aware 与 phase-agnostic 两类监督目标。
Result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化 CoM 误差从 DINOv2 的 41.7% 降至 25.2%。零样本 sim-to-real 迁移中，phase-aware 目标会产生双峰预测、phase-agnostic 目标会塌向统计上安全的质心；phase-aware 的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是所有被评估方法中唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的，physics capture 从 2.6% 提升到 41.0%，代价是出现单目向量过冲伪影、绝对欧氏误差比静态几何质心略高。
Conclusion: 冻结的时序表征能把惯性动力学与视觉几何分开，从而支持隐藏参数估计；监督目标的选择决定 sim-to-real 是走向真实偏移还是塌向安全质心，phase-aware 换来物理捕捉但牺牲绝对定位精度。

papers.title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) 引入药物基因组学：癌种当被试、其耐药能力当潜变量，药物当题目、其逃逸难度当潜变量，在同一潜变量尺度上给出癌种级体外耐药与药物广谱活性排序。在 GDSC2 的 242,036 个药物敏感性测量上，60% 缺失的 MCAR、癌种偏置与药物偏置三种稀疏机制下，reverse IRT 对全数据潜变量排序的恢复比简单平均好 Δrho = +0.089 至 +0.095；留出预测的 Brier 分数在五种方法中最优。
Motivation: 药物敏感性矩阵常因实验批次与筛选策略而碎片化、缺失率高，简单平均在稀疏下会扭曲癌种耐药与药物活性的相对排序，需要在缺失机制下仍稳健的排序方法。
Method: 将 reverse IRT 用于 GDSC2 的 242,036 个药物敏感性测量：癌种作为潜变量被试（耐药能力），药物作为题目（逃逸难度），在共享潜变量尺度上估计；在四种缺失机制（含 MCAR、cancer-biased、drug-biased，最高 60% 缺失）下与简单平均等共五种方法比较，并用 bootstrap 置信区间与留出预测验证，另在 PRISM 平台做跨平台复现。
Result: 60% 缺失下 MCAR、cancer-biased、drug-biased 三种稀疏中，reverse IRT 恢复全数据潜变量排序相对简单平均的 Δrho 为 +0.089 至 +0.095；留出预测中 IRT 的 Brier 分数在五种被评方法里最好；28 个癌种中 19 个的耐药/敏感分类在 bootstrap 区间下稳定；PRISM 跨平台复现方向一致率 82%，但秩序相关弱（rho = 0.25）。
Conclusion: 作者主张该贡献是碎片化评估下的方法学稳健排序，而非普适的临床耐药排行榜：IRT 能在高缺失下稳住潜变量排序与分类，但跨平台秩序一致性弱。
Relevance: 0
